Veal ken haddaat hu kiyyum hammiddot vechayyutan vehu kolel chesed ugvura perush ahava vaanafeha veyira vaanafeha
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 4: Veod yesh lechal nefesh elohit shelosha levushim shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzot hattora shekkeshehaadam mekayyem bemaase kal mitzot maasiyyot uvdibbur hu osek beferush kal taryag mitzot vehilchotehen uvmachashava hu massig kal ma sheefshar lo lehassig bifshat-remez-derush-sod hattora hare kelalut taryag evre nafsho melubbashim betaryag mitzot hattora

Uvifratut bechinot chachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho melubbashot behassagat hattora shehu massig bifshat-remez-derush-sod kefi yecholet hassagato veshoresh nafsho lemala vehammiddot shehen yira veahava veanfehen vetoldotehen melubbashot bekiyyum hammitzot bemaase uvdibbur shehu talmud tora shekkeneged kullan

Ki haahava hi shoresh kal ramach mitzot ase umimmenna hen nimshachot uviladah en lahen kiyyum amitti ki hammekayeman beemet hu haohev et shem vechafetz ledavka bo beemet vei efshar ledavka bo beemet ki im bekiyyum ramach pekudin shehem ramach evarin demalka kivyachol kemo shekkatuv bemakom acher vehayyira hi shoresh leshasa lo taase ki yare limrod bemelech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu

O yira penimit mizzo shemmitboshesh miggedullato lamrot ene chevodo velaasot hara beenav kal toavat asher sane hem hakkelipot vesitra achora asher yenikatam mehaadam hattachton vaachizatam bo hu beshasa mitzot lo taase

Vehinne shelosha levushim ellu mehattora umitzoteha af shennikraim levushim lenefesh ruach unshama im kal ze gavha vegadla maalatam leen ketz vesof al maalat nefesh ruach unshama atzman kemo shekkatuv bazzohar deorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad perush deorayeta hi chachmato urtzono shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu vehakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uvatzmo kulla chad ki hu hayyodea vehu hammadda vechu kemo shennitbaer leel beshem harambam

Veaf dehakkadosh-baruch-hu nikra en sof veligdullato en cheker velet machashava tefisa veh kelal vechen birtzono vechachmato kedichtiv en cheker litvunato uchtiv hacheker eloha timtza uchtiv ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem

Hinne al ze amru bemakom sheatta motze gedullato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu sham atta motze anvetanuto vetzimtzem hakkadosh-baruch-hu retzono vechachmato betaryag mitzot hattora uvhilchotehen uvtzerufe otiyyot tora-neviim-ketuvim udrashotehen shebbeaggadot umidreshe chachamenu-zichronam-livracha

Bichde shekkal hanneshama o ruach vanefesh shebbeguf haadam tuchal lehassigan bedatah ulkayeman kal ma sheefshar lekayyem mehen bemaase dibbur umachashava veal yede ze titlabbesh bechal eser bechinoteha bishlosha levushim ellu

Velachen nimshela hattora lemayim ma mayim yordim mimmakom gavoha lemakom namuch kach hattora yarda mimmekom kevodah shehi retzono vechachmato yitbarech veorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad velet machashava tefisa veh kelal

Umishsham nasa veyarda beseter hammadregot mimmadrega lemadrega behishtalshelut haolamot ad shennitlabbesha bidvarim gashmiyyim veinyene olam hazze shehen rov mitzot hattora kechullam vehilchotehen uvtzerufe otiyyot gashmiyyot bido al hassefer esrim vearbaa sefarim shebbetora neviim uchtuvim kede shettehe kal machashava tefisa bahen vaafilu bechinat dibbur umaase shellematta mimmadregat machashava tefisa bahen umitlabbeshet bahen

Umeachar shehattora umitzoteha malbishim kal eser bechinot hannefesh vechal taryag evareha meroshah vead raglah hare kullah tzerura bitzror hachayyim et mammash veor mammash makkifah umalbishah meroshah vead raglah kemo shekkatuv tzuri echese bo uchtiv katztzinna ratzon taterennu shehu retzono vechachmato yitbarech hamlubbashim betorato umitzoteha

Velachen amru yafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim baolam hazze mikkal chayye olam habba ki olam habba hu shennehenin mizziv hashshechina shehu taanug hahassaga vei efshar leshum nivra afilu mehaelonim lehassig ki im ezo heara meor velachen nikra beshem ziv hashshechina aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uvatzmo let machashava tefisa veh kelal ki im kaasher tefisa umitlabbeshet battora umitzoteha azay hi tefisa umitlabbeshet behakkadosh-baruch-hu mammash deorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad

Veaf shehattora nitlabbesha bidvarim tachtonim gashmiyyim hare ze kimchabbek et hammelech derech mashal sheen hefresh bemaalat hitkarvuto udvekuto bammelech ben mechabbeko keshehu lavush levush echad ben shehu lavush kamma levushim meachar shegguf hammelech betocham
Vechen im hammelech mechabbeko bizroo gam shehi melubbeshet toch malbushav kemo shekkatuv vimino techabbekeni shehi hattora shennittena miyyamin shehi bechinat chesed umayim
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 5: Ultosefet beur baer hetev leshon tefisa sheamar eliyyahu let machashava tefisa vach chu
Hinne kal sechel keshemmaskil umassig besichlo eze muskal hare hassechel tofes et hammuskal umakkifo besichlo vehammuskal nitpas umukkaf umlubbash betoch hassechel shehissigo vehiskilo

Vegam hassechel melubbash bammuskal beshaa shemmassigo vetofso besichlo derech mashal kesheadam mevin umassig ezo halacha bemishna o bigmara laashurah al buryah hare sichlo tofes umakkif otah vegam sichlo melubbash bah beotah shaa
Vehinne halacha zo hi chachmato urtzono shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu sheala birtzono shekkesheyyiton reuven kach vechach derech mashal veshimon kach vechach yihye happesak benehem kach vechach

Veaf im lo haya velo yihye haddavar hazze leolam lavo lemishpat al teanot utviot ellu mikkal makom meachar shekkach ala birtzono vechachmato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu sheim yiton ze kach veze kach yihye happesak kach hare kesheadam yodea umassig besichlo pesak ze kahalacha haarucha bemishna o gemara o poskim hare ze massig vetofes umakkif besichlo retzono vechachmato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu delet machashava tefisa beh velo birtzono vechachmato ki im behitlabbeshutam bahalachot haaruchot lefanenu vegam sichlo melubbash bahem
Vehu yichud nifla sheen yichud kamohu velo keerko nimtza kelal begashmiyyut lihot laachadim umuchadim mammash mikkal tzad ufinna
Vezot maala yetera gedola veniflaa leen ketz asher bemitzvat yediat hattora vehassagatah al kal hammitzot maasiyyot vaafilu al mitzot hatteluot bedibbur vaafilu al mitzvat talmud tora shebbedibbur

Ki al yede kal hammitzot shebbedibbur umaase hakkadosh-baruch-hu malbish et hannefesh umakkifah or meroshah vead raglah uvidiat hattora millevad shehassechel melubbash bechachmat hinne gam chachmat bekirbo ma shehassechel massig vetofes umakkif besichlo ma sheefshar lo litpos ulhassig midiat hattora ish kefi sichlo vechoach yediato vehassagato bifshat-remez-derush-sod
Ulfi shebbidiat hattora hattora melubbeshet benefesh haadam vesichlo umukkefet betocham lachen nikret beshem lechem umzon hannefesh

Ki kemo shehallechem haggashmi zan et hagguf keshemmachniso betocho vekirbo mammash venehpach sham lihot dam uvasar kivsaro vaazay yichye veyitkayyem kach bidiat hattora vehassagatah benefesh haadam shellomdah hetev beiyyun sichlo ad shennitpeset besichlo umitachedet immo vehau laachadim naasa mazon lannefesh vechayyim bekirbah mechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash bechachmato vetorato shebbekirbah

Vezehu shekkatuv vetoratcha betoch meay uchmo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar perek shellevushe hanneshamot began eden hen hammitzot vehattora hi hammazon lanneshamot sheasku baolam hazze battora lishmah uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar vayyakhel daf
Velishmah hayenu kede lekashsher nafsho la al yede hassagat hattora ish kefi sichlo kemo shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim

Vehammazon hi bechinat or penimi vehallevushim bechinat makkifim velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shettalmud tora shakul keneged kal hammitzot lefi shehammitzot hen levushim levad vehattora hi mazon vegam levush lannefesh hammaskelet shemmitlabbesh bah beiyyunah velimmudah vechal shekken keshemmotzi befiv bedibbur shehevel haddibbur naase bechinat or makkif kemo shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 6: Vehinne ze leummat ze asa elohim

Ki kemo shennefesh haelohit kelula meeser sefirot kedoshot umitlabbeshet bishlosha levushim kedoshim kach hannefesh desitra achora mikkelipot nogah hamlubbeshet bedam haadam kelula meeser kitrin dimsaavuta shehen sheva middot raot habbaot mearba yesodot raim hannizkarim leel vesechel hammolidan hannechlak leshalosh shehen chachma bina vadaat mekor hammiddot ki hammiddot hen lefi erech hassechel ki hakkatan choshek veohev devarim ketannim pechute haerech lefi shessichlo katan vekatzar lehassig devarim yekarim yoter mehem vechen mitkaes umitkatztzef middevarim ketannim vechen behitpaarut ushar middot

Veeser bechinot ellu hattemeot kesheadam mechashshev bahen o medabber o ose hare machashavto shebbemocho vedibburo shebbefiv vechoach hammaasiy shebbeyadav ushar evarav nikraim levushe mesaavu leeser bechinot ellu hattemeot shemmitlabbeshot bahen bishat maase o dibbur o machashava

Vehen hem kal hammaasim asher naasim tachat hashshemesh asher hakkol hevel urut ruach uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar beshallach shehen teviru derucha chu vechen kal haddibburim vechal hammachashavot asher lo la hemma velirtzono velaavodato shezzehu perush leshon sitra achora perush tzad acher sheeno tzad hakkedushsha

Vetzad hakkedushsha eno ella hashraa vehamshacha mikkedushshato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu veen hakkadosh-baruch-hu shore ella al davar shebbatel etzlo yitbarech ben befoal mammash kemalachim elonim ben bechoach kechal ish yisrael lematta shebbechocho lihot batel mammash legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu bimsirat nafsho al kedushshat
Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheafilu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora shechina sheruya chu vechal be asara shechinta sharya leolam

Aval kal ma sheeno batel etzlo yitbarech ella hu davar nifrad bifne atzmo eno mekabbel chayyut mikkedushshato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu mibbechinat penimit hakkedushsha umahutah veatzmutah bichvodah uvatzmah ella mibbechinat achorayim sheyyordim mimmadrega lemadrega rivvot madregot behishtalshelut haolamot derech illa vealul vetzimtzumim rabbim ad shennitmaet kal kach haor vehachayyut miut achar miut ad sheyyachol lehittzamtzem ulhitlabbesh bivchinat galut toch oto davar hannifrad lehachaoto ulkayemo meayin leyesh shello yachazor lihot ayin vaefes kevattechilla mikkodem shennivra
Velachen nikra olam hazze umloo olam hakkelipot vesitra achora velachen kal maase olam hazze kashim veraim veharshaim govrim bo kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar sof perek

M heot betocho ser sefirot dasiyya dikdushsha uchmo shekkatuv betz chayyim shar uvtoch ser sefirot dasiyya ellu hen ser sefirot ditzira uvtochan ser sefirot divria uvtochan ser sefirot daatzilut shebbetochan or-en-sof baruch-hu venimtza or-en-sof baruch-hu male kal haaretz hallezu hattachtona l yede hitlabbeshuto beser sefirot dearba olamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-siyya kemo shekkatuv betz chayyim shar perek uvsefer gilgulim perek
Ella shehakkelipot hen nechlakot lishte madregot zo lematta mizzo
Hammadrega hattachtona hi shalosh kelipot hattemeot veraot legamre veen bahem tov kelal venikreu bemirkevet yechezkel ruach seara veanan gadol vego

Umehen nishpaot venimshachot nafshot kal ummot haolam vekiyyum gufam venafshot kal baale chayyim hattemeim vaasurim baachila vekiyyum gufam vekiyyum vechayyut kal maachalot asurot mehatztzomeach kemo arla vechile hakkerem chu uchmo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar perek vechen kiyyum vechayyut kal hammaase dibbur umachashava shel kal shasa lo taase veanfehen kemo shekkatuv sham sof perek
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 7: Ach nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shebbeyisrael shemmitztzad hakkelipa hamlubbeshet bedam haadam kannizkar leel venafshot behemot vechayyot veofot vedagim tehorim umuttarim baachila vekiyyum vechayyut kal haddomem vechal hatztzomeach hammuttar baachila vechen kiyyum vechayyut kal hammaase dibbur umachashava beinyene olam hazze sheen bahem tzad isur lo shoresh velo anaf mishshasa mitzot lo taase veanfehen deorayeta udrabbanan rak sheenan leshem shamayim ella retzon hagguf vecheftzo vetaavato vaafilu hu tzorech hagguf vekiyyumo vechayyuto mammash ella shekkavanato enah leshem shamayim kede laavod et begufo la adife maase dibbur umachashavot ellu minnefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit beatzmah vehakkol kaasher lakkol nishpa venimshach mimmadrega hashshenit shebbiklipot vesitra achora shehi kelipa reviit hannikret kelipat nogah shebbaolam hazze hannikra olam haasiyya rubbo kechullo ra rak meat tov meorav betochah shemmimmenna baot middot tovot shebbannefesh habbahamit shebbeyisrael kemo shennitbaer leel
Vehi bechina memutztzaat ben shalosh kelipot hattemeot legamre uven bechinat umadregat hakkedushsha

Velachen peamim shehi nichlelet beshalosh kelipot hattemeot kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar resh perek beshem hazzohar ufamim shehi nichlelet veola bivchinat umadregat hakkedushsha dehayenu keshehattov hamorav bah nitbarer mehara vegover veole venichlal bikdushsha

Kegon derech mashal haochel bisra shemena detora veshote yayin mevussam leharchiv dato la ultorato kidamar rava chamra verecha chu o bishvil kede lekayyem mitzvat oneg shabbat veom tov azay nitbarer chayyut habbasar vehayyayin shehaya nishpa mikkelipat nogah veole la keola uchkarban

Vechen haomer milta divdichuta lefakkeach dato ulsammeach libbo la ultorato vaavodato shetztzerichim lihot besimcha uchmo sheasa rava letalmidav sheamar lifnehem milta divdichuta techilla uvadche rabbanan

Ach mi shehu bezolle basar vesove yayin lemallot taavat gufo venafsho habbahamit shehu bechinat yesod hammayim mearba yesodot haraim shebbah shemmimmennu middat hattaava hinne al yede ze yored chayyut habbasar vehayyayin shebbekirbo venichlal lefi shaa bera gamur shebbeshalosh kelipot hattemeot vegufo naase lahen levush umerkava lefi shaa ad asher yashuv haadam veyachazor laavodat ultorato ki lefi shehaya besar heter veyayin kasher lechach yecholim lachazor velaalot immo beshuvo laavodat shezzehu leshon heter umuttar kelomar sheeno kashur veasur bide hachitzonim shello yuchal lachazor velaalot la
Rak sheharshimu mimmennu nishar bagguf veal ken tzarich hagguf lechibut hakkever kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman
Vechen hachayyut shebbetippot zera sheyyatzu mimmennu betaava bahamit shello kiddesh atzmo bishat tashmish im ishto tehora

Ma sheen ken bemaachalot asurot uviot asurot shehen mishshalsh kelipot hattemeot legamre hem asurim ukshurim bide hachitzonim leolam veen olim mishsham ad ki yavo yomam vivulla hammavet lanetzach kemo shekkatuv veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz o ad sheyyaase teshuva gedola kal kach shezzedonot naasu lo kizchuyyot mammash shehi teshuva meahava meumka delibba beahava rabba vachashika venefesh shokeka ledavka bo yitbarech vetzama nafsho la keeretz ayefa vetziyya lihot ki ad henna hayeta nafsho beeretz tziyya vetzalmavet hi hassitra achora urchoka meor pene betachlit velazot tzama nafsho beyeter oz mitztzimon nafshot hatztzaddikim kemaamaram zichronam livracha bemakom shebbaale teshuva omdim chu
Veal teshuva meahava rabba zo amru shezzedonot naasu lo kizchuyyot hoil veal yede ze ba leahava rabba zo
Aval teshuva shello meahava zo af shehi teshuva nechona va yislach lo mikkal makom lo naasu lo kizchuyyot veen olim mehakkelipa legamre ad et ketz sheyevulla hammavet lanetzach

Ach hachayyut shebbetippot zera sheyyatzu mimmennu levattala af sheyyarda venichlela beshalsh kelipot hattemeot hare zo ola mishsham bitshuva nechona uvchavana atzuma bikriat-shema-sheal-hammitta kannoda mehaari zichrono livracha umrummaz baggemara kal hakkore keriat shema al mittato keillu ochez cherev shel shette fiyyot chu laharog gufot hachitzonim shennaasu levush lachayyut shebbattippot veola hachayyut mehem kayyadua leode chen

Velachen lo huzkar aon zera levattala battora bichlal biot asurot af shechamur mehen vegadol aono bivchinat haggadlut veribbuy hattuma vehakkelipot shemmolid umarbe bimod meod behotzaat zera levattala yoter mibbiot asurot rak shebbeviot asurot mosif koach vechayyut biklipa temea beoter ad sheeno yachol lehaalot mishsham hachayyut bitshuva

Mippene shennikleta bisod denukva diklipa hamkabbelet vekoletet hachayyut mehakkedushsha ma sheen ken bezera levattala sheen sham bechinat nukva diklipa rak shekkochoteha vechayeloteha malbishim lachayyut shebbattippot kayyadva leode chen
Ella im ken yaase teshuva meahava rabba kal kach ad shezzedonot naasu lo kizchuyyot

Uvaze yuvan maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ezehu meuvat shello yuchal litkon ze shebba al haerva veholid mamzer sheaz gam im yaase teshuva gedola kal kach i efshar lo lehaalot hachayyut likdushsha meachar shekkevar yarda laolam hazze venitlabbesha beguf basar vadam
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 8: Veod zot bemaachalot asurot shellechach nikraim beshem isur mippene sheaf mi sheachal maachal isur belo hoda leshem shamayim laavod bechoach achila hahi vegam paal veasa ken vekara vehitpallel bechoach achila hahi en hachayyut shebbah ola umitlabbeshet betevot hattora vehattefilla kemo haheter mippene isurah bide hassitra achora mishshalosh kelipot hattemeot vaafilu hu isur derabbanan shechamurim divre sofrim yoter middivre tora chu
Velachen gam hayyetzer hara vechoach hammitave lidvarim haasurim hu shed mishshedin nuchrain shehu yetzer hara shel ummot haolam shennafshotehem mishshalosh kelipot hattemeot

Ma sheen ken hayyetzer hara vechoach hammitave lidvarim hammuttarim lemallot taavato hu shed mishshedin yehudain lefi sheyyachol lachazor likdushsha kedilel ach mikkal makom kodem shechazar likdushsha hu sitra achora uklipa vegam achar kach harshimu mimmennu nishar davuk bagguf lihot ki mikkal maachal umashke naasa techef dam uvasar mibbesaro

Velachen tzarich hagguf lechibut hakkever lenakkoto ultaharo mittumato shekkibel bahanaat olam hazze vetaanugav mittumat kelipat nogah veshedin yehudain ella im ken mi shello nehena meolam hazze kal yamav kerabbenu hakkadosh
Veal devarim betelim beheter kegon am haaretz sheeno yachol lilmod tzarich letaher nafsho mittuma zo diklipa zo al yede gilgulah bechaf hakkela kemo shekkatuv bazzohar parashat beshallach daf

Aval lediburim asurim kemo letzanut velashon hara vechayyotze vahem shehen mishshalosh kelipot hattemeot legamre en kaf hakkela levaddo moil letaher ulhaavir tumato mehannefesh rak tzericha lered legehinnom

Vechen mi sheefshar lo laasok battora veosek bidvarim betelim en kaf hakkela levaddo moil lenafsho lemarkah ulzakkechah rak onashim chamurim shemmaanishim al bitul tora bifratut millevad onesh hakkelali lechal bitul mitzvat ase mechamat atzlut begehinnom shel sheleg kimvoar bemakom acher
Vechen haosek bechachmot ummot haolam bichlal devarim betelim yechashev leinyan aon bitul tora kemo shekkatuv behilchot talmud tora

Veod zot yetera tumatah shel chachmat haummot al tumat devarim betelim sheeno malbish umtamme rak hammiddot misod haruach hakkadosh shebbenafsho haelohit betumat kelipat nogah shebbidvarim betelim habbaim misod haruach hara shebbiklipa zo benafsho habbahamit kedilel velo bechinot chachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho meachar shehem divre shetut uvurut sheggam hashshotim veamme haaretz yecholim ledabber ken

Ma sheen ken bechachmat haummot hu malbish umtamme bechinot chachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho haelohit betumat kelipat nogah shebbechachmot ellu shennaflu shamma bishvirat hakkelim mibbechinat achorayim shel chachma dikdushsha kayyadua leode chen

Ella im ken ose otan kardom lachtoch bahen dehayenu kede lehitparnes mehen berevach laavod o sheyyodea lehishtammesh bahen laavodat o letorato vezehu taamo shel harambam veramban zichronam livracha vesiatan sheasku bahen
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 9: Vehinne mekom mishkan nefesh habbahamit shemmikkelipat nogah bechal ish yisrael hu ballev bechalal semali shehu male dam uchtiv ki haddam hu hannafesh

Velachen kal hattaaot vehitpaarut vechaas vedomehen hen ballev umehallev hen mitpashshetot bechal hagguf vegam ole lammoach shebbarosh lechashshev ulharher bahen ulhitchakkem bahen kemo shehaddam mekoro ballev umehallev mitpashshet lechal haevarim vegam ole lehammoach shebbarosh
Ach mekom mishkan nefesh haelohit hu bammochin shebbarosh umishsham mitpashshetet lechal haevarim vegam ballev bechalal hayemani sheen bo dam uchmo shekkatuv lev chacham limino

Vehi ahavat kerishpe shalhevet mitlahevet belev maskilim hamvinim umitbonnim bedatam asher bemocham bidvarim hammeorrim et haahava vechen simchat levav betiferet vahadar geono kaasher ene hechacham asher berosho bemoach chachmato uvinato mistakkelim bikara demalka vetiferet gedullato ad en cheker veen sof vetachlit kimvoar bemakom acher vechen shear middot kedoshot shebballev hen mechachma-bina-daat shebbammochin

Ach hinne ketiv ulom milom yeematz ki hagguf nikra ir ketanna uchmo sheshshene melachim nilchamim al ir achat shekkal echad rotze lechavshah velimloch aleha dehayenu lehanhig yoshveha kirtzono vesheyyihu sarim lemishmato bechal asher yigzor alehem kach shette hannefashot haelohit vehachiyyunit habbahamit shemmehakkelipa nilchamot zo im zo al hagguf vechal evarav shehaelohit cheftzah urtzonah shettehe hi levaddah hammoshelet alav umanhigato vechal haevarim yihu sarim lemishmatah uvtelim etzlah legamre umerkava eleha veyihu levush leeser bechinoteha veg levusheha hannizkarim leel sheyyitlabbeshu chullam beevre hagguf veyihye hagguf kullo male mehem levaddam velo yaavor zar betocham chas veshalom dehayenu telat mochin shebbarosh yihu memullaim mechachma-bina-daat shebbannefesh haelohit shehi chachmat uvinato lehitbonen bigdullato asher ad en cheker veen sof ulholid mehen al yede haddaat hayyira bemocho ufachad belibbo veahavat keesh boara belibbo kerishpe shalhevet lihot nichsefa vegam kalta nafsho bachashika vachafitza ledavka vo been-sof baruch-hu bechal lev venefesh umod meumka delibba shebbechalal hayemani sheyyihye tocho ratzuf ahava male vegadush ad shettitpashshet gam lechalal hassemali leachpaya lesitra achora yesod hammayim haraim shebbah shehi hattaava shemmikkelipat nogah leshannotah ulhappechah mittaanuge olam hazze leahavat kemo shekkatuv bechal levavcha bishne yetzarecha

Vehayenu sheyyaale veyavo veyaggia lemadregat ahava rabba vechiba yetera mimmadregat ahava azza kerishpe esh vehi hannikret bakkatuv ahava bettaanugim lehitanneg al meen olam habba vehaoneg hu bemoach chachma vasechel hammitanneg behaskalat vidiato kefi hassagat sichlo vechachmato vehu bechinat hammayim vezera or zarua shebbikdushshat nefesh haelohit hamhappechet letov et bechinat hammayim shebbannefesh habbahamit shemmehem bau taaot taanuge olam hazze mittechilla uchmo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar perek beshem hazzohar shehara nehpach lihot tov gamur kemo yetzer tov mammash behasir habbegadim hatztzoim mimmennu shehem taanuge olam hazze shehu melubbash bahem

Vechen shear kal hammiddot shebballev shehen anfe hayyira vehaahava yihu la levaddo vechal koach haddibbur shebbappe vehammachashava shebbammoach yihu memullaim min levushe hammachashava vehaddibbur shel nefesh haelohit levaddah shehen machashevet vetorato lihot sichato kal hayyom la fasik pumeh miggirsa vechoach hammaasiy shebbeyadav ushar ramach evarav yihye bemaase hammitzot levad shehu levush hashshelishi shel nefesh haelohit
Ach nefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelipa retzonah lehefech mammash letovat haadam sheyyitgabber aleha vinatztzechenna kimshal hazzona shebbazzohar hakkadosh
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 10: Vehinne keshehaadam magbir nafsho haelohit venilcham kal kach im habbahamit ad shemmegaresh umvaer hara shebbah mechalal hassemali kemo shekkatuv uviarta hara mikkirbecha veen hara nehpach letov mammash nikra tzaddik sheeno gamur vetzaddik vera lo dehayenu sheyyesh bo adayin meat mizzeer ra bechalal hassemali ella shekkafuf uvatel lattov mechamat miuto velachen nidme lo ki vayegarshehu vayyelech lo kullo legamre aval beemet illu chalaf vehalach lo legamre kal hara shebbo haya nehpach letov mammash

Uveur hainyan ki hinne tzaddik gamur shennehpach hara shello letov velachen nikra tzaddik vetov lo hu al-yede hasarat habbegadim hatztzoim legamre mehara dehayenu limos meod betaanuge olam-hazze lehitanneg bam betaanugot bene adam lemallot taavat hagguf bilvad velo laavodat mippene heotam nimshachim venishpaim mehakkelipa vesitra achora vechal ma shehu mehassitra achora hatztzaddik gamur hu sono betachlit hassina mechamat godel ahavato la ukdushshato beahava rabba bettaanugim vechiba yetera hannizkarim leel ki hem ze leummat ze kedichtiv tachlit sina senetim leoyevim hau li chakreni veda levavi vego uchfi erech godel haahava la kach erech godel hassina lesitra achora vehammius bara betachlit ki hammius hu hefech haahava mammash kemo hassina
Vetzaddik sheeno gamur hu sheeno sone hassitra achora betachlit hassina velachen eno moes gam ken bara betachlit

Vechal sheen hassina vehammius betachlit al karchacha nishar eze shemetz ahava vetaanug lesham velo husru habbegadim hatztzoim legamre mikkol vachol velachen lo nehpach letov mammash meachar sheyyesh lo eze achiza adayin babbegadim hatztzoim ella shehu batel bemiuto uchla chashiv velachen nikra tzaddik vera kafuf uvatel lo veal ken gam ahavato la enah betachlit velachen nikra tzaddik sheeno gamur

Vehinne madrega zo mitchalleket lerivvot madregot beinyan bechinat miut hara hannishar meachat mearba yesodot haraim uvinyan bitulo bemiuto beshishshim al derech mashal o beelef urvava vechayyotze al derech mashal vehen hem bechinot tzaddikim harabbim shebbechal haddorot kidita baggemara ditamnesar alfe tzaddike kayeme kammeh hakkadosh-baruch-hu

Ach al maalat tzaddik gamur hu sheamar rabbi shimon ben yochai raiti bene aliyya vehem muatim chu shellachen nikraim bene aliyya shemmehappechin hara umaalim oto likdushsha kidita bazzohar bahakdama shekkesheratza rabbi chiyya laalot lehechal rabbi shimon ben yochai shama kala nafik veamar man minnechon di chashocha mehappechan linhora vetaamin meriru lemitka ad la yetun hacha vechu

Veod nikraim bene aliyya mippene sheggam avodatam bivchinat vaase tov bekiyyum hattora umitzoteha hu letzorech gavoha umala mala ad rum hammaalot velo kede ledavka bo yitbarech bilvad lerauot tzimon nafsham hatztzemea la kemo shekkatuv hoy kal tzame lechu lammayim uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher ella kidfershu battikunim ezehu chasid hammitchassed im kono im kan dileh leyachada kudsha berich hu ushchinteh battachtonim uchmo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat tetze kivra deishtaddel batar avoy veimeh derachim lon yattir miggarmeh venafsheh verucheh venishmeteh chu umasar garmeh lemita alayehu lemifrak lon chu uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher

Ushnehem olim bekane echad ki al yede habberurim shemmevarrim minnogah maalim mayyin nukvin venaasim yichudim elonim lehorid mayyin dechurin shehem hem meme hachasadim shebbechal mitzva umitzva meramach mitzot ase shekkullan hen bechinat chasadim umayyin dechurin dehayenu hamshachat kedushshat elohuto yitbarech milmala lematta lehitlabbesh battachtonim kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 11: Veze leummat ze rasha vetov lo leummat tzaddik vera lo
Dehayenu shehattov shebbenafsho haelohit shebbemocho uvechalal hayemani shebbelibbo kafuf uvatel legabbe hara mehakkelipa shebbechalal hassemali
Veze mitchallek gam ken lerivvot madregot chalukot beinyan kammut veechut habbitul uchfifat hattov lara chas veshalom

Yesh mi shehakkefifa vehabbitul etzlo meat mizzeer veaf gam zot eno bitmidut velo tadir lifrakim kerovim ella leittim rechokim mitgabber hara al hattov vechovesh et hair ketanna hu hagguf ach lo chullo ella miktzato levad sheyyihye sar lemishmato venaase lo merkava ulvush lehitlabbesh bo echad mishshelosha levusheha hannizkarim leel dehayenu o bemaase levad laasot averot kallot velo chamurot chas veshalom o bedibur levad ledabber avak lashon hara veletzanut uchhay gavena o bemachashava levad hirhure avera hakkashim meavera vegam im eno meharher baavera laasotah ella beinyan ziuug zachar unkeva baolam sheover al azharat hattora venishmarta mikkol davar ra shello yeharher bayyom chu o shehi sheat hakkosher laasok battora vehu mefanne libbo levattala keditnan beavot hanneor ballayela chu umfanne libbo chu shebbeachat mikkal elle vechayyotze vahen nikra rasha baet hahi shehara shebbenafsho gover bo umitlabbesh begufo umachatio umtammeo

Veachar kach gover bo hattov shebbenafsho haelokit umitcharet umvakkesh mechila uslicha me va yislach lo im shav bitshuva haruya al pi atzat chachamenu-zichronam-livracha bishlosha chilluke chappara shehaya rabbi yishmael doresh chu kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher

Veyesh mi shehara gover bo yoter umitlabbeshim bo kal shelosha levushim shel hara umachatio baaverot chamurot yoter uvittim kerovim yoter ach bentayim mitcharet uvaim lo hirhure teshuva mibbechinat hattov shebbenafsho shemmitgabber ketzat bentayim ella sheen lo hitgabberut kal kach lenatztzeach et hara lifrosh mechataav legamre lihot mode veozev veal ze amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha reshaim meleim charatot shehem rov harshaim sheyyesh bechinat tov benafsham adayin

Ach mi sheeno mitcharet leolam veen baim lo hirhure teshuva kelal nikra rasha vera lo shehara shebbenafsho hu levaddo nishar bekirbo ki gavar kal kach al hattov ad shennistallek mikkirbo veomed bivchinat makkif alav milmala
Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha akkal be asara shechinta sharya
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 12: Vehabbenoni hu shelleolam en hara gover kal kach lichbosh et hair ketanna lehitlabbesh bagguf lehachatio dehayenu sheshshelosha levushe nefesh habbahamit shehem machashava dibbur umaase shemmitztzad hakkelipa en govrim bo al nefesh haelohit lehitlabbesh bagguf bammoach uvappe uvishar ramach evarim lehachatiam ultammeam chas veshalom

Rak shelosha levushe nefesh haelohit hem levaddam mitlabbeshim bagguf shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzot hattora velo avar avera miyyamav velo yaavor leolam velo nikra alav shem rasha afilu shaa achat verega echad kal yamav

Ach mahut veatzmut nefesh haelohit shehen eser bechinoteha lo lahen levaddan hammelucha vehammemshala bair ketanna ki im beittim mezummanim kemo bishat keriat shema utfilla shehi sheat mochin degadlut lemala vegam lematta hi sheat hakkosher lechal adam sheaz mekashsher chachma-bina-daat shello la lehaamik dato bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu ulorer et haahava kerishpe esh bechalal hayemani shebbelibbo ledavka vo bekiyyum hattora umitzoteha meahava shezzehu inyan hamvoar bikriat shema deorayeta uvirchoteha shellefaneha ulachareha shehen midderabbanan hen hachana lekiyyum hakkeriat-shema kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher veaz hara shebbechalal hassemali kafuf uvatel lattov hammitpashshet bechalal hayemani mechachma-bina-daat shebbammoach hamkushsharim bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu
Aval achar hattefilla behistallekut hammochin degadlut en-sof baruch-hu hare hara chozer veneor bechalal hassemali umitave taava letaaot olam hazze vetaanugav

Rak mippene shello lo levaddo mishpat hammelucha vehammemshala bair eno yachol lehotzi taavato mikkoach el happoal lehitlabbesh beevre hagguf bemaase dibbur umachashava mammash lehaamik machashavto betaanuge olam hazze ech lemallot taavat libbo ki hammoach shallit al hallev kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat pinchas betoladto veteva yetzirato shekkach notzar haadam betoladto shekkal adam yachol birtzono shebbemocho lehitappek velimshol beruach taavato shebbelibbo shello lemallot mishalot libbo bemaase dibbur umachashava ulhassiach dato legamre mittaaot libbo el hahefech legamre uvifrat el tzad hakkedushsha

Kedichtiv veraiti sheyyesh yitron lachachma min hassichlut kitron haor min hachoshech perush kemo shehaor yesh lo yitron ushlita umemshala al hachoshech shemmeat or gashmi doche harbe min hachshech shennidche mimmennu meelav umimmela kach nidche mimmela sichlut harbe shel hakkelipa vesitra achora shebbechalal hassemali kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ella im ken nichnas bo ruach shetut vechu mippene hachachma shebbannefesh haelohit shebbammoach asher retzonah limshol levaddah bair ulhitlabbesh bishlosha levusheha hannizkarim leel bechal hagguf kullo kannizkar leel shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzot hattora kannizkar leel

Veaf-al-pi-chen eno nikra tzaddik kelal mippene sheyyitron hazze asher leor nefesh haelohit al hachoshech vesichlut shel hakkelipa hannidche mimmela eno ella bishlosha levusheha hannizkarim leel velo bemahutah veatzmutah al mahutah veatzmutah shel hakkelipa ki mahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelipa shebbechalal hassemali lo nidcha kelal mimmekomo babbenoni achar hattefilla sheen rishpe esh ahavat behitgallut libbo bechalal hayemani ki im tocho ratzuf ahava mesutteret shehi ahava hattivit shebbannefesh haelohit kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman
Vaazay yachol lihot sichlut hakkesil hara behitgallut libbo bechalal hassemali lehitaot taava lechal inyene gashmiyyut olam hazze ben beheter ben beisur chas veshalom keillu lo hitpallel kelal

Ella shebbidvar isur eno ole bedato laasot haisur befoal mammash chas veshalom ella hirhure avera hakkashim meavera yecholim lifol laalot lemocho ulvalbelo mittora vaavoda uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha averot en adam nitzol mehen bechal yom hirhur avera veiyyun tefilla chu

Rak shellaze moil harshimu bammochin veyirat veahavato hamsutteret bechalal hayemani lehitgabber velishlot al hara hazze hammitave taava shello lihot lo shelita umemshala bair lehotzi taavato mikkoach el happoal lehitlabbesh beevre hagguf

Vaafilu bammoach levaddo leharher bera en lo shelita umemshala leharher chas veshalom birtzono shebbemocho sheyekabbel beratzon chas veshalom hirhur ze hara haole meelav mehallev lammoach kannizkar leel ella miyyad baaliyyato lesham dochehu bishte yadayim umassiach dato miyyad shennizkar shehu hirhur ra veeno mekabbelo beratzon afilu leharher bo beratzon vechal shekken lehaaloto al haddaat laasoto chas veshalom o afilu ledabber bo ki hamharher beratzon nikra rasha beotah shaa vehabbenoni eno rasha afilu shaa achat leolam
Vechen bidvarim shebben adam lachavero miyyad sheole lo mehallev lammoach ezo tina vesina chas veshalom o ezo kina o kaas o kefeda vedomehen eno mekabbelan kelal bemocho uvirtzono

Veadderabba hammoach shallit umoshel baruach shebbelibbo laasot hahefech mammash lehitnaheg im chavero bemiddat chesed vechiba yetera mudaat lo lisbol mimmennu ad katze haacharon velo lichos chas veshalom vegam shello leshallem lo kefaolo chas veshalom ella adderabba ligmol lechayyavim tovot kemo shekkatuv bazzohar lilmod miyyosef im echav
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 13: Uvaze yuvan leshon maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha benonim ze vaze shoftan perush yetzer tov veyetzer hara dichtiv ki yaamod limin evon lehoshia mishshofte nafsho velo amru ze vaze moshlim chas veshalom ki kesheyyesh ezo shelita umemshala layyetzer hara bair ketanna afilu lefi shaa kalla nikra rasha beotah shaa

Ella hayyetzer hara eno rak al derech mashal kemo shofet vedayyan haomer dato bammishpat veaf-al-pi-chen yachol lihot shello yihye pesak halacha kach lemaase mippene sheyyesh od shofet vedayyan hacholek alav vetzarich lehachria benehem vahalacha kedivre hammachria

Kach hayyetzer hara omer dato bechalal hassemali shebballev umehallev ole lammoach leharher bo umiyyad cholek alav hashshofet hashsheni shehu hannefesh haelohit shebbammoach hammitpashshet bechalal hayemani shebballev mekom mishkan hayyetzer tov vahalacha kedivre hammachria hu hakkadosh-baruch-hu haozro lehayyetzer tov kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ilmale hakkadosh-baruch-hu ozro en yachol lo
Vehaezer hi haheara shemmeir or al nefesh haelohit lihot lah yitron ushlita al sichlut hakkesil veyetzer hara keyitron haor min hachoshech kannizkar leel

Ach meachar shehara shebbechalal hassemali babbenoni hu betakpo ketoladto lehitaot taava lechal taanuge olam hazze velo nitbattel bemiut legabbe hattov velo nidcha mimmekomo kelal rak sheen lo shelita umemshala lehitpashshet beevre hagguf mippene hakkadosh-baruch-hu haomed limin evon veozer umeir lannefesh haelohit lachen nikra kerasha kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha afilu kal haolam kullo omrim lecha tzaddik atta heye veenecha kerasha velo rasha mammash ella sheyyachazik atzmo levenoni velo lehaamin lehaolam sheomrim shehara shebbo nitbattel legabbe hattov shezzo madregat tzaddik ella yihye veenav keillu mahuto veatzmuto shel hara hu betakpo uvigvurato bechalal hassemali ketoladto velo chalaf vehalach mimmennu meuma veadderabba nitchazzek yoter behemshech hazzeman shennishtammesh bo harbe baachila ushtiyya ushar inyene olam hazze

Veaf mi shebbetorat cheftzo veyehge vah yomam valayela lishmah en zo hochacha kelal shennidcha hara mimmekomo ella yachol lihot shemmahuto veatzmuto hu betakpo uvigvurato bimkomo bechalal hassemali rak shellevushav shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel nefesh habbahamit enan mitlabbeshim bammoach vehappe vehayyadayim ushar evre hagguf mippene shennatan shelita umemshala lammoach al hallev velachen nefesh haelohit shebbammoach moshelet bair ketanna evre hagguf kullam sheyyihu levush umerkava lishlosha levusheha sheyyitlabbeshu bahem shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzot hattora

Aval mahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh haelohit en lah shelita umemshala al mahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh habbahamit babbenoni ki im beshaa sheahavat hu behitgallut libbo beittim mezummanim kemo bishat hattefilla vechayyotze vah veaf gam zot happaam enah rak shelita umemshala levad kedichtiv ulom milom yeematz keshezze kam ze nofel uchshezze kam chu shennefesh haelohit mitammetzet umitgabberet al nefesh habbahamit bimkor haggevurot shehi bina lehitbonen bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu ulholid ahava azza la kerishpe esh bechalal hayemani shebbelibbo veaz itkafya sitra achora shebbechalal hassemali
Aval lo nitbattel legamre babbenoni ella batztzaddik shenneemar bo velibbi chalal bekirbi vehu moes bera vesono betachlit hassina vehammius o shello betachlit hassina kannizkar leel

Aval babbenoni hu derech mashal keadam sheyyashen sheyyachol lachazor veleor mishshenato kach hara babbenoni hu keyashen bechalal hassemali bishat keriat shema utfilla shellibbo boer beahavat veachar kach yachol lihot chozer veneor

Velachen haya rabba machazik atzmo kevenoni af dela fasik pumeh miggirsa uvtorat cheftzo yomam valayela bachafitza vachashika utshuka venefesh shokeka la beahava rabba kevishat keriat shema utfilla venidme veenav kevenoni hammitpallel kal hayyom uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha halvay sheyyitpallel adam kal hayyom kullo

Vehinne middat ahava zo haamura bevenonim bishat hattefilla al yede hitgabberut hannefesh haelohit chu hinne legabbe madregat hatztzaddikim ovde beemet laamito en bechinat ahava zo nikret beshem avodat emet kelal meachar shecholefet veoveret achar hattefilla uchtiv sefat emet tikkon laad vead argia leshon shaker

Veaf-al-pi-chen legabbe madregat habbenonim nikret avoda tamma beemet laamito shellahem ish ish kefi madregato bemadregat habbenonim vahareni kore beahavatam shebbitfillatam gam ken sefat emet tikkon laad hoil uvchoach nafsham haelohit lachazor ulorer bechinat ahava zo leolam behitgabberutah bishat hattefilla midde yom beom al yede hachana haruya lechal nefesh kefi erkah umadregatah

Ki hinne middat emet hi middato shel yaakov hannikra beriach hattichon hammavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze merum hammaalot umadregot ad sof kal dargin uvchal maala umadrega mavriach toch nekudda haemtzait shehi nekuddat uvchinat middat emet shellah

Umiddat emet hi nachala beli metzarim veen lah shiur lemala ad rum hammaalot vechal maalot umadregot shellematta hem keayin legabbe maalot umadregot shellemala mehen kayyadua leode chen shebbechinat rosh umochin shel madregot tachtonot hen lematta mibbechinat akevayim veragle madregot elonot mehen uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ragle hachayyot keneged kullan
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 14: Vehinne middat habbenoni hi middat kal adam veachareha kal adam yimshoch shekkal adam yachol lihot benoni bechal et uvchal shaa ki habbenoni eno moes bera shezzehu davar hammasur lallev velo kal haittim shaot ela sur mera vaase tov dehayenu befoal mammash bemaase dibbur umachashava shebbahem habbechira vehayecholet veharshut netuna lechal adam laasot uldabber velachashov gam ma shehu neged taavat libbo vehefkah mammash ki gam beshaa shehallev chomed umitave ezo taava gashmiyyit beheter o beisur chas veshalom yachol lehitgabber ulhassiach dato mimmenna legamre beamro lelibbo enenni rotze lihot rasha afilu shaa achat ki enenni rotze lihot muvdal venifrad chas veshalom me echad beshum ofen kedichtiv aonotechem mavdilim vego rak ani rotze ledavka vo nafshi ruchi venishmati behitlabbeshan bishlosha levushav yitbarech shehem maase dibbur umachashava ba vetorato umitzotav meahava mesutteret shebbelibbi la kemo belev kelalut yisrael shennikreu ohave shemecha vaafilu kal shebbekallim yachol limsor nafsho al kedushshat velo nofel anochi mimmennu bevadday ella shennichnas bo ruach shetut venidme lo shebbaavera zo odennu beyahaduto veen nishmato muvdelet meelohe yisrael vegam shocheach ahavato la hamsutteret belibbo aval ani enenni rotze lihot shote kamohu lichpor haemet

Ma sheen ken bedavar hammasur lallev dehayenu sheyehe hara maus mammash ballev vesanuy betachlit sina o afilu shello betachlit sina hinne ze i efshar sheyyihye beemet laamito ella al yede godel vetokef haahava la bivchinat ahava bettaanugim lehitanneg al meen olam habba veal ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha olamcha tire bechayyecha chu veen kal adam zoche laze ki zehu keen kibbul sachar uchdichtiv avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem vego kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher

Velachen amar iyyov barata tzaddikim chu vechidita battikunim sheyyesh benishmot yisrael kamma mine madregot uvchinot chasidim gibborim hammitgabberim al yitzram mare tora neviim chu tzaddikim chu ayyen sham
Uvaze yuvan kefel leshon hashshevua tehi tzaddik veal tehi rasha delichora tamuha ki meachar shemmashbiim oto tehi tzaddik lamma tzerichim lehashbio od shello yihye rasha

Ella mishshum sheen kal adam zoche lihot tzaddik veen laadam mishpat habbechira baze kal kach lehitanneg al beemet vesheyyihye hara maus mammash beemet velachen mashbiim shenit al tehi rasha al kal panim shebbaze mishpat habbechira veharshut netuna lechal adam limshol beruach taavato shebbelibbo velichbosh yitzro shello yihye rasha afilu shaa achat kal yamav ben bivchinat sur mera ben bivchinat vaase tov veen tov ella tora dehayenu talmud tora shekkeneged kullan

Ach af-al-pi-chen tzarich likboa lo ittim gam ken lashit etzot benafsho lihot moes bera kegon baatzat chachamenu-zichronam-livracha ishsha chemet melea tzoa chu uchhay gavena vechen kal mine matammim umaadannim naasim kach chemet male chu vechen kal taanuge olam hazze hechacham roe hannolad mehen shessofan lirkov velihot rimma veashpa

Vehahefech lehitanneg velismoach ba al yede hitbonnut bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu kefi yecholto af sheyyodea benafsho shello yaggia lemadrega zo beemet laamito ki im bedimonot af-al-pi-chen hu yaase et shello lekayyem et hashshevua shemmashbiim tehi tzaddik va yaase hattov beenav

Veod shehahergel al kal davar shilton venaase teva sheni uchsheyyargil lemaes et hara yihye nimas ketzat beemet uchsheyyargil lesammeach nafsho ba al yede hitbonnut bigdullat hare beitaruta diltatta itaruta dilela vechulle hay veulay yeare alav ruach mimmarom veyizke livchinat ruach mishshoresh eze tzaddik shettitabber bo laavod besimcha amitit kedichtiv simchu tzaddikim ba vetitkayyem bo beemet hashshevua shemmashbiim tehi tzaddik
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 15: Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv veshavtem uritem ben tzaddik lerasha ben oved elohim laasher lo avado

Shehahefresh ben oved elohim letzaddik hu sheoved hu leshon hove shehu beemtza haavoda shehi hammilchama im hayyetzer hara lehitgabber alav ulgarsho mehair ketanna shello yitlabbesh beevre hagguf shehu beemet avoda veamal gadol lehillachem bo tamid vehayenu habbenoni

Aval hatztzaddik nikra eved beshem hattoar kemo shem chacham o melech shekkevar naasa chacham o melech kach ze kevar avad vegamar legamre avodat hammilchama im hara ad ki vayegarshehu vayyelech lo velibbo chalal bekirbo

Uvabbenoni yesh gam ken shette madregot oved elohim vaasher lo avado veaf-al-pi-chen eno rasha ki lo avar miyyamav shum avera kalla vegam kiyyem kal hammitzot sheefshar lo lekayeman vetalmud tora keneged kullam vela fasik pumeh miggirsa

Ella sheeno ose shum milchama im hayyetzer lenatztzecho al yede or hammeir al nefesh haelohit shebbammoach hashshallit al hallev kannizkar leel mippene sheen yitzro omed lenegdo kelal levattelo mittorato vaavodato veen tzarich lilchom immo kelal kegon shehu matmid belimmudo betivo mittoladto al yede tigboret hammara shechora vechen en lo milchama mittaavat nashim mippene shehu metzunnan betivo vechen bishar taanuge olam hazze hu mechussar hergesh hanaa betivo

Velachen en tzarich lehitbonen kal kach bigdullat leholid mibbinato ruach daat veyirat bemocho lehishshamer shello laavor al mitzot lo taase veahavat belibbo ledavka vo bekiyyum hammitzot vetalmud tora keneged kullan ella day lo beahava mesutteret asher belev kelalut yisrael shennikreu ohave shemo
Velachen eno nikra oved kelal ki ahava zo hamsutteret enah peullato vaavodato kelal ella hi yerushshatenu meavotenu lichlal yisrael uchmo sheyyitbaer lekamman
Vechen af mi sheeno matmid belimmudo betivo rak shehirgil atzmo lilmod behatmada gedola venaasa hahergel lo teva sheni day lo beahava mesutteret zo ella im ken rotze lilmod yoter mergiluto
Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv baggemara deoved elohim hayenu mi sheshshone pirko mea feamim veechad velo avado hayenu mi sheshshone pirko mea feamim levad

Vehayenu mishshum shebbimehem haya hargilut lishnot kal perek mea feamim kidita hatam baggemara mashal mishshuk shel chammarim shenniskarim leeser parse bezuza ulachad asar parse bitre zuze mippene shehu yoter mergilutam velachen zot happaam hammea veachat hayetera al hargilut shehurgal minneurav shekula keneged kullan veola al gabbehen beyeter seet veyeter oz lihot nikra oved elohim mippene shekkede leshannot teva hargilut tzarich leorer et haahava la al yede shemmitbonen bigdullat bemocho lishlot al hatteva shebbechalal hassemali hammale dam hannefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelipa shemmimmenna hu hatteva vezo hi avoda tamma labbenoni

O leorer et haahava hamsutteret shebbelibbo limshol al yadah al hatteva shebbechalal hassemali shezzo nikra gam ken avoda lehillachem im hatteva vehayyetzer al yede shemmeorer haahava hamsutteret belibbo
Ma sheen ken kesheen lo milchama kelal en ahava zo mitztzad atzmah nikret avodato kelal
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 16: Veze kelal gadol baavodat labbenonim haikar hu limshol velishlot al hatteva shebbechalal hassemali al yede or hammeir lannefesh haelohit shebbammoach velishlot al hallev

Keshemmitbonen bemocho bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu leholid mibbinato ruach daat veyirat bemocho lihot sur mera deorayeta udrabbanan vaafilu isur kal shel divrehem chas veshalom veahavat belibbo bechalal hayemani bachashika vachafitza ledavka vo bekiyyum hammitzot deorayeta udrabbanan vetalmud tora shekkeneged kullan

Veyeter al ken tzarich leda kelal gadol baavoda labbenonim sheggam im en yad sichlo veruach binato masseget leholid ahavat behitgallut libbo sheyyihye libbo boer kerishpe esh vechafetz bachafitza vachashika utshuka murgeshet ballev ledavka vo rak haahava mesutteret bemocho vetaalumot libbo
Vehassiba laze hi mippene heot hammochin shello venefesh-ruach-neshama shello mibbechinat ybur vehelem toch hattevuna velo mibbechinat leda vehitgallut kayyadva leode chen

Dehayenu shehallev mevin beruach chachma uvina shebbemocho gedullat en-sof baruch-hu dechulla kammeh kela chashiv mammash asher al ken yaata lo yitbarech shettichle elav nefesh kal chay lidavek ulhikkalel beoro vegam nafsho verucho asher bekirbo kach yaata lahen lihot kalot elav bachashika vachafitza latzet minartekan hu hagguf ledavka vo rak shebbeal karchan chaot henna betoch hagguf utzrurot bo kealmanot chayyot velet machashava dilhon tefisa veh kelal ki im kaasher tefisa umitlabbeshet battora uvmitzoteha kimshal hamchabbek et hammelech hannizkar leel vee lazot yaata lahen lechabbeko bechal lev venefesh umod dehayenu kiyyum hattaryag mitzot bemaase uvdibbur uvmachashava shehi hassagat vidiat hattora kannizkar leel

Hinne keshemmaamik beinyan ze betaalumot tevunot libbo umocho ufiv velibbo shavin shemmekayyem ken befiv kefi asher nigmar bitvunat libbo umocho dehayenu lihot betorat cheftzo veyehge vah yomam valayela befiv vechen hayyadayim ushar evarim mekayemim hammitzot kefi ma shennigmar bitvunat libbo umocho hare tevuna zo mitlabbeshet bemaase dibbur umachashevet hattora umitzoteha lihot lahem bechinat mochin vechayyut vegadfin lefarcha leela keillu asak bahem bidchilu urchimu mammash asher behitgallut libbo bachafitza vachashika utshuka murgeshet belibbo venafsho hatztzemea la mippene rishpe esh ahavato shebbelibbo kannizkar leel hoil utvuna zo shebbemocho vetaalumot libbo hi hammeviato laasok bahem velule shehaya mitbonen bitvuna zo lo haya osek bahem kelal ella betzarche gufo levad vegam im hu matmid belimmudo betivo af-al-pi-chen ohev et gufo yoter betivo

Veze ramzu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha beamram machashava tova hakkadosh-baruch-hu metzarfah lemaase vahava-leh-lememar maale alav hakkatuv keillu asaah ella hainyan ki dechilu urchimu shebbehitgallut libbo hem hammitlabbeshim bemaase hammitzot lehachaotam lefarcha leela ki hallev hu gam ken chumri kishar evarim shehem kele hammaase ella shehu penimi vechayyut lahem velachen yachol lehitlabbesh bahem lihot lahem gadfin lehaalotam

Ach haddechilu urchimu shebbitvunot mocho vetaalumot libbo hannizkarot leel gavhu darchehem lemala mala mibbechinat hammaase vei efshar lahem lehitlabbesh bivchinat maase hammitzot lihot lahem bechinat mochin vechayyut lehaalotan lefarcha leela im lo shehakkadosh-baruch-hu metzarfan umchabberan livchinat hammaase vehen nikraot beshem machashava tova ki enan dechilu urchimu mammash behitgallut libbo ki im bitvunat mocho vetaalumot libbo kannizkar leel
Uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar vetz chayim ditvuna otiyyot ben uvat shehen dechilu urchimu velifamim hattevuna yoredet lihot mochin benukva dizer anpin shehen otiyyot hattora vehammitzot vehammaskil yavin

Ach tzeruf ze metzaref hakkadosh-baruch-hu kede lehaalot maase hammitzot veesek hattora hannaasim al yede machashava tova hannizkeret leel ad olam habberia mekom aliyyat hattora vehammitzot hannaasim al yede dechilu urchimu sichliyyim asher behitgallut libbo mammash
Aval belav hache name olim leolam hayetzira al yede dechilu urchimu tiviyyim hamsuttarim belev kal yisrael betoldotam kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman baarichut
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 17: Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv ki karov elecha haddavar meod beficha uvilvavcha laasoto

Delichora hu bilvavcha neged hachush shellanu vehattora hi nitzchit sheen karov meod haddavar lehappech libbo mittaaot olam hazze leahavat beemet uchmo shekkatuv baggemara atu yira milta zutarti hi vechal shekken ahava vegam amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha detzaddikim daveka libbam birshutam

Ella delaasoto rotze lomar haahava hammevia lide asiyyat hammitzot bilvad shehi reuta delibba shebbetaalumot lev gam ki enah behitgallut libbo kerishpe esh vedavar ze karov meod venakel lechal adam asher yesh lo moach bekadkodo ki mocho birshuto veyachol lehitbonen bo kechal asher yachpotz uchsheyyitbonen bo bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu mimmela yolid bemocho al kal panim haahava la ledavka vo bekiyyum mitzotav vetorato
Veze kal haadam ki hayyom laasotam ketiv shehayyom hu olam hammaase daveka ulmachar chu kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher

Vehammoach shallit betivo vetoladto al chalal hassemali shebballev veal piv veal kal haevarim shehem kele hammaase im lo mi shehu rasha beemet kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheharshaim hem birshut libbam veen libbam birshutam kelal veze onesh al godel veotzem aonam velo dibbera tora bemetim ellu shebbechayyehem keruyim metim

Ki beemet i efshar larshaim lehatchil laavod beli sheyyaasu teshuva al heavar techilla leshabber hakkelipot shehem masach mavdil umchitza shel barzel hammafseket benam laavihem shebbashshamayim al yede shevirat libbo umrirat nafsho al chataav kemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk zivche elohim ruach nishbara lev nishbar vego sheal yede lev nishbar nishbara ruach hattuma desitra achora ayyen sham parashat pinchas daf ufarashat vayyikra daf vedaf ammud uvferush harav moshe zakkut sham

Vehi bechinat teshuva tattaa lehaalot he tattaa lahakimah minnefilatah shenafla el hachitzonim shehu sod galut hashshechina kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha galu leedom shechina immahem dehayenu kesheadam ose maase edom morid umamshich lesham bechinat venitzotz elohut hamchayye et nefesh-ruach-neshama shello hamlubbashim bo bannefesh habbahamit mehakkelipa shebbelibbo shebbechalal hassemali hammolechet bo beodo rasha umoshelet bair ketanna shello venefesh-ruach-neshama kevushim baggola etzlah
Uchshennishbar libbo bekirbo venishbera ruach hattuma vesitra achora veyitpardu chu hi kama minnefilatah vegam nitztzava kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 18: Ultosefet beur baer hetev millat meod shebbappasuk ki karov elecha haddavar meod vego

Tzarich leda neemana ki af mi sheddato ketzara bidiat veen lo lev lehavin bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu leholid mimmenna dechilu urchimu afilu bemocho utvunato levad af-al-pi-chen karov elav haddavar meod lishmor velaasot kal mitzot hattora vetalmud tora keneged kullan befiv uvilvavo mammash meumka delibba beemet laamito bidchilu urchimu shehi ahava mesutteret shebbelev kelalut yisrael shehi yerushsha lanu meavotenu
Rak shetztzarich levaer ulhakdim techilla baer hetev shoresh ahava zo veinyanah veech hi yerushsha lanu veech nichlal bah gam dechilu

Vehainyan ki haavot hen hen hammerkava veal ken zachu lehamshich nefesh-ruach-neshama livnehem acharehem ad olam meeser sefirot dikdushsha shebbearba olamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya lechal echad veechad kefi madregato uchfi maasav
Veal kal panim afilu lekal shebbekallim ufoshe yisrael nimshach beziuugam nefesh denefesh demalchut daasiyya shehi madrega hattachtona shebbikdushshat haasiyya

Veaf-al-pi-chen meachar shehi meeser sefirot kedoshot hi kelula mikkullan gam mechachma daasiyya shebbetochah melubbeshet chachma demalchut daatzilut shebbetochah chachma daatzilut shebbah meir or-en-sof baruch-hu mammash kedichtiv bechachma yasad aretz vekkullam bechachma asita

Venimtza ki en-sof baruch-hu melubbash bivchinat chachma shebbenefesh haadam yihye mi sheyyihye miyyisrael uvchinat hachachma shebbah im or-en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash bah mitpashshetet bechal bechinot hannefesh kullah lehachaotah mibbechinat roshah ad bechinat raglah kedichtiv hachachma techayye vealeha
Velifamim mamshichim poshe yisrael neshamot gevohot meod shehau beimke hakkelipot kemo shekkatuv besefer gilgulim
Hinne hachachma hi mekor hassechel vehahavana vehi lemala mehabbina shehu havanat hassechel vehassagato vehachachma hi lemala mehahavana vehahassaga vehi makor lahen
Vezehu leshon chachma koach ma shehu ma sheeno mussag umuvan veeno nitpas behassaga adayin velachen mitlabbesh bah or-en-sof baruch-hu delet machashava tefisa veh kelal

Velachen kal yisrael afilu hannashim veamme haaretz hem maaminim ba shehaemuna hi lemala min haddaat vehahassaga ki peti yaamin lechal davar vearum yavin vego ulgabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu shehu lemala min hassechel vehaddaat velet machashava tefisa veh kelal hakkol kiftayim etzlo yitbarech kedichtiv vaani vaar velo eda behemot hayiti immach vaani tamid immach vego kelomar shebbaze sheani baar uvhemot ani tamid immach
Velachen afilu kal shebbekallim ufoshe yisrael mosrim nafsham al kedushshat al harov vesovlim inuyim kashim shello lichpor ba echad

Veaf im hem burim veamme haaretz veen yodim gedullat vegam bamat sheyyodim en mitbonnim kelal veen mosrim nafsham mechamat daat vehitbonnut ba kelal ella beli shum daat vehitbonnut rak keillu hu davar shei efshar kelal lichpor ba echad beli shum taam vetaana umaane kelal
Vehayenu mishshum she echad meir umchayye kal hannefesh al yede hitlabbeshuto bivchinat chachma shebbah shehi lemala min haddaat vehassechel hammussag umuvan
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 19: Ultosefet beur tzarich levaer hetev ma shekkatuv ner nishmat adam

Perush sheyyisrael hakkeruyim adam nishmatam hi lemashal keor hanner shemmitnanea tamid lemala betivo mippene sheor haesh chafetz beteva lipared mehappetila velidavek besharsho lemala bisod haesh hakkelali shettachat galgal hayyareach kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim
Veaf sheal yede ze yichbe velo yair kelum lematta vegam lemala besharsho yitbattel oro bimtziut besharsho af-al-pi-chen bechach hu chafetz betivo

Kach nishmat haadam vechen bechinat ruach vanefesh cheftzah vecheshkah betivah lipared velatzet min hagguf velidavek besharshah umkorah ba chayye hachayyim baruch-hu hagam shettihye ayin vaefes vetitbattel sham bimtziut legamre velo yishshaer mimmenna meuma mimmahutah veatzmutah harishon af-al-pi-chen ze retzonah vecheftzah betivah
Veteva ze hu shem hammushal lechal davar sheeno bivchinat taam vadaat

Vegam kan hakkavana sheratzon vechefetz ze bannefesh eno bivchinat taam vadaat vesechel mussag umuvan ella lemala mehaddaat vesechel hammussag vehammuvan vehi bechinat chachma shebbannefesh shebbah or-en-sof baruch-hu

Vezehu kelal bechal sitra dikdushsha sheeno ella ma shennimshach mechachma shennikra kodesh haelon habbatel bimtziut beor-en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash bo veeno davar bifne atzmo kannizkar leel velachen nikra koach ma

Vehu hefech mammash mibbechinat hakkelipa vesitra achora shemmimmenna nafshot ummot haolam deavdin legarmayehu veamrin hav hav vehaliteni lihot yesh vedavar bifne atzmo kannizkar leel hefech bechinat hachachma velachen nikraim metim ki hachachma techayye uchtiv yamutu velo vechachma vechen harshaim ufoshe yisrael kodem shebbau lide nissaon lekaddesh hashshem ki bechinat hachachma shebbannefesh haelohit im nitzotz elohut meor-en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash bah hem bivchinat galut begufam bannefesh habbahamit mitztzad hakkelipa shebbechalal hassemali shebballev hammolechet umoshelet begufam besod galut hashshechina kannizkar leel

Velachen nikret ahava zo bannefesh haelohit shertzonah vecheftzah liddavek ba chayye hachayyim baruch-hu beshem ahava mesutteret ki hi mesutteret umchussa bilvush sak diklipa befoshe yisrael umimmenna nichnas bahem ruach shetut lachato kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en adam chote chu

Ella sheggalut hazze livchinat chachma eno ella labbechina hammitpashshetet mimmenna bannefesh kullah lehachaotah aval shoresh veikar shel bechinat chachma shebbannefesh haelohit hu bammochin veenah mitlabbeshet bilvush sak diklipa shebballev bechalal hassemali bivchinat galut mammash rak shehi bivchinat shena barshaim veenah poelet peullatah bahem kal zeman sheasukim bedatam uvinatam betaaot haolam

Ach keshebbaim lide nissaon bidvar emuna shehi lemala mehaddaat venaga ad hannefesh livchinat chachma shebbah azay hi neora mishshenatah ufoelet peullatah bechoach hamlubbash bah uchmo shekkatuv vayyikatz keyashen laamod bannissaon beemunat beli shum taam vadaat vesechel mussag lo lehitgabber al hakkelipot vetaaot olam hazze beheter uvisur shehurgal bahem velimos bahem velivchor lo lechelko ulgoralo limsor lo nafsho al kedushshat shemo

Veaf ki hakkelipot gavru alav kal yamav velo yachol lahem kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheharshaim hem birshut libbam mikkal makom keshebba lide nissaon bidvar emuna ba echad sheyesudatah beharre kodesh hi bechinat chachma shebbannefesh haelohit shebbah melubbash or-en-sof baruch-hu hare kal hakkelipot betelim umvuttalim vehau kelo hau mammash lifne kedichtiv kal haggoyim keayin negdo vego uchtiv ki hinne oyevecha ki hinne oyevecha yovedu yitpardu vego uchtiv kehimmes donag mippene esh yovdu vego uchtiv harim kaddonag namassu

Vehinne or en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash bachachma shebbannefesh gadol veatzum kocho kal kach legaresh velidchot hassitra achora vehakkelipot shello yuchlu yiggeu afilu bilvushav shehem machashava dibbur umaase shel emunat echad dehayenu laamod bannissaon limsor nafsho afilu shello laasot rak eze maase levad neged emunat echad kegon lehishtachaot laavoda zara af sheeno maamin bah kelal belibbo vechen shello ledabber toa chas veshalom al achdut af sheen piv velibbo shavin rak libbo shalem beemunat

Veze nikra dechilu hannichlal birchimu shehi ahava hattivit shebbannefesh haelohit shebbichlalut yisrael shecheftzah urtzonah betivah lidavek besharshah umkorah or-en-sof baruch-hu shemmippene ahava zo veratzon ze hi yerea umfachedet betivah minnegoa biktze tumat avoda-zara chas-veshalom shehi neged emunat echad afilu bilvusheha hachitzonim shehem dibbur o maase beli emuna ballev kelal
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 20: Vehinne mudaat zot lakkol ki mitzvat veazharat avoda zara shehem shene dibberot harishonim anochi velo yihye lecha hem kelalut kal hattora chullah ki dibbur anochi kolel kal ramach mitzot ase velo yihye lecha kolel kal shasa mitzot lo taase velachen shamanu anochi velo yihye lecha levad mippi haggevura kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha mippene shehem kelalut hattora chullah

Ulvaer hetev inyan ze tzarich lehazkir techilla biktzara inyan umahut achduto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu shennikra yachid umuchad vechol maaminim shehu levaddo hu kemo shehaya kodem shennivra haolam mammash uchmo sheomrim atta hu ad shello nivra haolam atta hu mishshennivra chu perush hu mammash beli shum shinuy kedichtiv ani lo shaniti ki olam hazze vechen kal haolamot haelonim enam poalim shum shinuy beachduto yitbarech behibbaram meayin leyesh
Shekkemo shehaya hu levaddo hu yachid umuchad kodem hibbaram ken hu levaddo hu yachid umuchad achar shebberaam mishshum dechulla kammeh kela chashiv uchayin vaefes mammash
Ki hithauut kal haolamot elonim vetachtonim meayin leyesh vechayyutam vekiyyumam hamkayemam shello yachzeru lihot ayin vaefes keshehaya eno ella devar veruach piv yitbarech hamlubbash bahem

Ulmashal kemo benefesh haadam keshemmedabber dibbur echad sheddibbur ze levaddo kela mammash afilu legabbe kelalut nafsho hamdabberet shehu bechinat levush haemtzai shellah shehu koach haddibbur shellah sheyyachol ledabber dibburim leen ketz vetachlit vechal shekken legabbe bechinat levush happenimi shellah shehu hammachashava shemmimmenna nimshechu haddibburim vehi chayyutam veen tzarich lomar legabbe mahut veatzmut hannefesh shehen eser bechinoteha hannizkarot leel chachma-bina-daat chu shemmehen nimshechu otiyyot machashava zo hamlubbashot bedibbur ze keshemmedabber ki hammachashava hi gam ken bechinat otiyyot kemo haddibbur rak shehen ruchaniyyot vedakkot yoter
Aval eser bechinot chachma-bina-daat chu hen shoresh umkor hammachashava veen bahem bechinat otiyyot adayin kodem shemmitlabbeshot bilvush hammachashava

Lemashal keshennofelet ezo ahava vechemda belibbo shel adam kodem sheola mehallev el hammoach lechashshev ulharher bah en bah bechinat otiyyot adayin rak chefetz pashut vachashika ballev el haddavar hahu hannechmad etzlo

Vechal shekken kodem shenafla hattaava vehachemda belibbo leoto davar rak hayeta bechoach chachmato vesichlo vidiato shehaya noda etzlo oto davar shehu nechmad venaim vetov veyafe lehassigo velidavek bo kegon lilmod ezo chachma o leechol eze maachal arev rak leachar shekkevar nafla hachemda vehattaava belibbo bechoach chachmato vesichlo vidiato veachar kach chazra vealta mehallev lammoach lechashshev ulharher bah ech lehotzi taavato mikkoach el happoal lehassig hammaachal o lemidat hachachma befoal hare bechan noldu bechinot otiyyot bemocho shehen otiyyot kilshon am vaam hamdabberim vehamharharim bahem kal inyene haolam
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 21: Vehinne middat hakkadosh-baruch-hu shello kemiddat basar vadam shehaadam keshemmedabber dibbur hare hevel haddibbur shebbefiv hu murgash venire davar bifne atzmo muvdal mishsharsho shehen eser bechinot hannefesh atzmah

Aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu en dibburo muvdal mimmennu yitbarech chas veshalom ki en davar chutz mimmennu velet atar panuy mineh velachen en dibburo yitbarech kedibburenu chas veshalom kemo sheen machashavto kemachashavtenu kedichtiv ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem uchtiv ken gavhu derachay middarchechem vego

Velo nikra dibburo yitbarech beshem dibbur rak al derech mashal kemo sheddibbur hattachton shebbaadam hu megalle lashshomim ma shehaya tzafun venelam bemachashavto kach lemala been-sof baruch-hu yetziat haor vehachayyut mimmennu yitbarech mehahelem el haggiluy livro olamot ulhachaotam nikret beshem dibbur
Vehen hen asara maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam vechen shear kal hattora neviim uchtuvim shehissigu hanneviim bemare nevuatam

Vahare dibburo umachashavto kivyachol meuchadot immo betachlit hayyichud derech mashal kemo dibburo umachashavto shel adam beodan bechoach chachmato vesichlo o bitshuka vechemda shebbelibbo kodem shealta mehallev lammoach leharher bah bivchinat otiyyot sheaz hau otiyyot hammachashava vehaddibbur hazze hannimshachot mechemda utshuka zo bechoach ballev umuchadot sham betachlit hayyichud besharshan shehen hachachma vesechel shebbammoach vechemda utshuka shebballev

Vechacha mammash derech mashal meuchadot dibburo umachashavto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech gam achar sheyyatza dibburo yitbarech el happoal bivriot haolamot kemo shehaya meuchad immo kodem beriat haolamot veen shum shinuy kelal lefanav yitbarech ella el habberuim hamkabbelim chayyutam mibbechinat dibburo yitbarech bivchinat yetziato kevar el happoal bivriat haolamot shemmitlabbesh bahem lehachaotam al yede hishtalshelut meilla lealul viridat hammadregot betzimtzumim rabbim veshonim ad sheyyuchlu habberuim lekabbel chayyutam vehithauutam mimmennu velo yitbattelu bimtziut

Vechal hatztzimtzumim hem bechinat hester panim lehastir ulhaalim haor vehachayyut hannimshach middibburo yitbarech shello yitgalle bivchinat giluy rav shello yuchlu hattachtonim lekabbel velachen gam ken nidme lahem or vechayyut haddibbur shel makom baruch-hu hamlubbash bahem keillu hu davar muvdal mimmahuto veatzmuto yitbarech rak shennimshach mimmennu yitbarech kemo dibbur shel adam minnafsho

Ach legabbe hakkadosh-baruch-hu en shum tzimtzum vehester vehelem mastir umaalim lefanav vechachashecha kaora kedichtiv gam choshech lo yachshich mimmekka vego mishshum sheen hatztzimtzumim vehallevushim davar nifrad mimmennu yitbarech chas veshalom ella kehaden kamtza dilvusheh mineh uveh kemo shekkatuv ki hu haelohim uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher
Velachen kammeh kulla kela chashiv mammash
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 22: Rak shehattora dibbera kilshon bene adam venikra battora dibburo shel makom baruch-hu beshem dibbur mammash kedibburo shel adam lefi shebbeemet kach hu derech yeridat vehamshachat hachayyut lattachtonim betzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim minim mimminim shonim lehibbarot mehem beruim rabbim minim mimminim shonim

Vechal kach gavru veatzmu hatztzimtzumim vehester panim haelonim ad sheyyuchlu lehithauot ulhibbarot gam devarim temeim uklipot vesitra achora ulkabbel chayyutam vekiyyumam middevar veruach piv yitbarech behester panim viridat hammadregot

Velachen nikraim elohim acherim mippene sheyenikatam vechayyutam enah mibbechinat panim ella mibbechinat achorayim dikdushsha uferush achorayim keadam hannoten davar lesono shello virtzono shemmashlicho lo kilachar ketefo ki machazir panav mimmennu missinato oto
Kach lemala bechinat panim hu penimit haratzon haelon vecheftzo haamiti asher chafetz lehashpia chayyut lechal hakkarov elav missitra dikdushsha

Aval hassitra achora vehattuma hi toavat asher sane veeno mashpia lah chayyut mippenimit haratzon vecheftzo haamiti asher chafetz bah chas veshalom ki im keman deshade batar katfoy lesono shello virtzono rak kede lehaanish et harshaim veliten sachar tov latztzaddikim deachpayan lesitra achora veze nikra bechinat achorayim deratzon haelon baruch-hu

Vehinne ratzon haelon bivchinat panim hu mekor hachayyim hamchayye et kal haolamot ulfi sheeno shore kelal al hassitra achora vegam bechinat achorayim shel ratzon haelon eno melubbash betochah mammash ella makkif aleha milmala lechach hi mekom hammita vehattuma yishmerenu ki meat mizzeer or vechayyut sheyyoneket umkabbelet letochah mibbechinat achorayim dikdushsha shellemala hu bivchinat galut mammash betochah besod galut hashshechina hannizkar leel

Velachen nikra beshem elohim acherim shehi avoda zara mammash uchfira beachduto shel melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu ki meachar sheor vechayyut dikdushsha hu bivchinat galut betochah enah betela kelal legabbe kedushshat hakkadosh-baruch-hu veadderabba magbiha atzmah kannesher lomar ani veafsi od vechammaamar yeor li vaani asitini

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheggassut haruach shekula kaavoda zara mammash ki ikar veshoresh avoda zara hu ma shennechshav ledavar bifne atzmo nifrad mikkedushshato shel makom velo kefira ba legamre kidita baggemara dekaru leh elaha deelahayya ella sheggam hem machashivim atzmam leyesh vedavar bifne atzmo uvaze mafridim et atzmam mikkedushshato shel makom baruch hu meachar sheen betelim lo yitbarech ki en kedushsha elona shora ella al ma shebbatel lo yitbarech kannizkar leel velachen nikraim ture difruda bazzohar hakkadosh vahare zo kefira beachduto haamitit dechulla kammeh kela chashiv uvatel beemet lo yitbarech velirtzono hamchayye et kullam umhave otam meayin leyesh tamid
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 23: Veim kal hannizkar leel yuvan vivoar hetev betosefet beur ma sheamru bazzohar deorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad uvattikunim pershu deramach pikudin inun ramach evarin demalka

Lefi shehammitzot hen penimiyyut ratzon haelon vecheftzo haamiti hamlubbash bechal haolamot haelonim vetachtonim lehachaotam ki kal chayyutam veshifam taluy bemaase hammitzot shel hattachtonim kannoda
Venimtza shemmaase hammitzot vekiyyuman hu levush happenimi lifnimit ratzon haelon shemmimmaase ze nimshach or vechayyut ratzon haelon lehitlabbesh baolamot

Velachen nikraim evre demalka derech mashal kemo sheevre guf haadam hem levush lenafsho uvtelim legamre eleha mikkol vachol ki miyyad sheole birtzono shel adam lifshot yado o raglo hen nishmaot lirtzono techef umiyyad beli shum tziuuy vaamira lahen uvli shum shehiyya kelal ella kerega mammash kesheala birtzono kach derech mashal hachayyut shel maase hammitzot vekiyyuman hu batel legamre legabbe ratzon haelon hamlubbash bo venaase lo mammash keguf linshama

Vechen hallevush hachitzon shel nefesh haelohit shebbaadam hamkayyem veose hammitzva shehu koach uvchinat hammaase shellah hu mitlabbesh bachayyut shel maase hammitzva venaase gam ken keguf linshama laratzon haelon uvatel elav legamre

Veal ken gam evre guf haadam hamkayemim hammitzva shekkoach uvchinat hammaase shel nefesh haelohit melubbash bahem bishat maase vekiyyum hammitzva hem naasu merkava mammash laratzon haelon kegon hayyad hamchalleket tzedaka laaniyyim o osa mitzva acheret veraglayim hamhallechot lidvar mitzva vechen happe velashon shemmedabberim divre tora vehammoach shemmeharher bedivre tora veyirat shamayim uvigdullat baruch-hu
Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha haavot hen hen hammerkava shekkal evrehem kullam hau kedoshim umuvdalim meinyene olam hazze velo naasu merkava rak laratzon haelon levaddo kal yemehem

Ach hammachashava vehahirhur bedivre tora shebbammoach vechoach haddibbur bedivre tora shebbappe shehem levushim happenimim shel nefesh haelohit vechal shekken nefesh haelohit atzmah hamlubbeshet bahem kullam meuchadim mammash beyichud gamur baratzon haelon velo merkava levad ki ratzon haelon hu hu haddevar halacha atzmah shemmeharher umdabber bah shekkal hahalachot hen perate hamshachot penimiyyut ratzon haelon atzmo shekkach ala birtzono yitbarech sheddavar ze muttar o kasher o patur o zakkay o lehefech vechen kal tzerufe otiyyot tora-neviim-ketuvim hen hamshachat retzono vechachmato hamuchadot been-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud shehu hayyodea vehu hammadda chu
Vezehu shekkatuv deorayeta vekudsha berich hu kulla chad velo evarin demalka lechud kefikudin

Umeachar sheratzon haelon hamuchad been-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud hu begiluy legamre velo behester panim kelal uchlal bannefesh haelohit ulvusheha happenimim shehem machashavtah vedibburah beotah shaa shehaadam osek bedivre tora hare gam hannefesh ulvusheha ellu meuchadim mammash been-sof baruch-hu beotah shaa betachlit hayyichud keyichud dibburo umachashavto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu bemahuto veatzmuto kannizkar leel ki en shum davar nifrad ki im behester panim kannizkar leel

Velo od ella sheyyichudam hu beyeter seet veyeter oz miyyichud or-en-sof baruch-hu beolamot elonim meachar sheratzon haelon hu begiluy mammash bannefesh ulvusheha haoskim battora shehare hu hu hattora atzmah vechal haolamot haelonim mekabbelim chayyutam meor vechayyut hannimshach mehattora shehi retzono vechachmato yitbarech kedichtiv kullam bechachma asita veim ken hachachma shehi hattora lemala mikkullam vehi hi retzono yitbarech hannikra sovev kal almin shehi bechinat ma sheeno yachol lehitlabbesh betoch almin rak mechayye umeir lemala bivchinat makkif vehi hi hammitlabbeshet bannefesh ulvusheha bivchinat giluy mammash kesheoskim bedivre tora veaf-al-gav deihu la chaze chu umishshum hache yachol lisbol mishshum dela chaze ma sheen ken baelonim

Uvaze yuvan lamma gadla meod maalat haesek battora yoter mikkal hammitzot vaafilu mittefilla shehi yichud olamot elonim veha demi sheen torato umanuto tzarich lehafsik hayenu meachar demafsik umvattel belav hache

Umizze yuchal hammaskil lehamshich alav yira gedola beasko battora kesheyyitbonen ech shennafsho ulvusheha shebbemocho uvfiv hem meuchadim mammash betachlit hayyichud baratzon haelon veor-en-sof baruch-hu mammash hammitgalle bahem ma shekkal haolamot elonim vetachtonim kela chashive kammeh uchayin vaefes mammash ad sheeno mitlabbesh betocham mammash ella sovev kal almin bivchinat makkif lehachaotam ikar chayyutam rak ezo heara mitlabbeshet betocham ma sheyecholim lisbol shello yitbattelu bimtziut legamre

Vezehu shekkatuv vayetzavenu et kal hachukkim haelle leyira et vego veal yira gedola zo amru im en chachma en yira vehattora nikret etzlah tara ledarta kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher ella delav kal mocha savil da yira kazo ach gam man dela savil mocho kelal yira zo lo minah velo miktzatah mippene pechitut erech nafsho besharshah umkorah bemadregot tachtonot deeser sefirot daasiyya en yira zo meakkevet bo lemaase kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 24: Veze leummat ze hen shasa mitzot lo taase deorayeta vechal isure derabbanan meachar shehen neged retzono vechachmato yitbarech vehefkam mammash hem nifradim miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech betachlit happerud mammash kemo hassitra achora vehakkelipa hannikret avoda zara velohim acherim mechamat hester panim shel ratzon haelon kannizkar leel

Vechen levushe hannefesh shemmikkelipat nogah shebbeyisrael shehem machashava dibbur umaase hamlubbashim beshasa lo taase deorayeta udrabbanan vechen mahut hannefesh atzmah hamlubbeshet bilvusheha kullam meuchadim mammash besitra achora uklipa zo hannikret avoda zara

Velo od ella shebbetelim utfelim eleha ugruim ufchutim mimmenna meod ki hi enah melubbeshet beguf chumri veodaat et ribbonah veenah moredet bo lifol peullatah bemishlachat malache raim shellah shello bishlichuto shel makom baruch-hu chas veshalom uchmaamar bilam lo uchal laavor et pi vego

Veaf shennikra avoda zara ha karu leh elaha deelahayya veenam yecholim laavor kelal al retzono yitbarech ki yodim umassigim shehu chayyutam vekiyyumam sheyyonkim mibbechinat achorayim daachorayim shel ratzon haelon baruch-hu hammakkif alehem ella sheyenikatam vechayyutam shebbetocham hi bivchinat galut betocham lehachashiv atzman elohut vahare zo kefira beachduto

Aval mikkal makom enan kofrim vechichashu ba legamre velomar lo hu ella dekaru leh elaha deelahayya dehayenu chayyutam vekiyyumam hannimshach veored alehem mertzono yitbarech velachen enan ovrin retzono yitbarech leolam

Veim ken haadam haover al retzono yitbarech hu garua ufachut harbe meod mehassitra achora uklipa hannikret avoda zara velohim acherim vehu betachlit happerud miyyichudo veachduto shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu yoter mimmenna uchillu kofer beachduto yoter mimmenna chas veshalom

Uchmo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar sof perek shehara shebbaolam hazze hachumri hu shimre hakkelipot haggassot chu vehu tachlit habberur vechu velachen kal maase olam hazze kashim veraim veharshaim govrim bo vechu

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk ki tiste ishto en adam over avera vechu daafilu ishsha hamnaefet sheddatah kalla hayeta moshelet beruach taavatah lule ruach shetut shebbah hamchasse umastir umaalim et haahava mesutteret shebbenafshah haelohit ledavka beemunat veyichudo veachduto velo lipared chas veshalom meachduto afilu notlim et nafshah mimmenna laavod avoda zara chas veshalom vaafilu behishtachavaa levaddah beli shum emuna ballev kelal vechal shekken lichbosh hayyetzer vetaavat hanniuf shehem yissurim kallim mimmita yishmerenu

Vehahefresh sheetzlah ben isur niuf leisur hishtachavaa laavoda zara hu gam ken ruach shetut diklipa hammalbeshet lannefesh haelohit ad bechinat chachma shebbah velo ad bichlal mippene or hamlubbash bachachma kannizkar leel

Aval beemet laamito afilu avera kalla hare haovrah over al ratzon haelon baruch-hu vehu betachlit happerud miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech yoter missitra achora uklipa hannikret elohim acherim vaavoda zara mammash veoter mikkal haddevarim hannishpaim mimmenna baolam hazze shehem behemot temeot vechayyot veofot temeim ushkatzim urmasim vechammaamar yattush kedamach perush deaf yattush shemmachnis veeno motzi shehi kelipa hayyoter tachtona urchoka mibbechinat hakkedushsha hammashpaat betachlit harichuk kodemet laish hachote behishtalshelut viridat hachayyut meratzon haelon baruch-hu vechal shekken shear baale chayyim hattemeim vaafilu chayyot raot shekkullam enam meshannim tafkidam ufkuddato yitbarech shamra rucham veaf-al-gav deihu la chaze chu uchmo shekkatuv umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kal chayyat haaretz uchferush rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheen chayya raa moshelet beadam ella im ken nidme lah kivhema vehatztzaddikim sheen tzelem elohim mistallek meal penehem kal chayyot raot itkafyan kammayehu kemo shekkatuv bazzohar gabbe daniyyel begov araot

Veim ken hachote veover retzono yitbarech afilu baavera kalla bishat maase hu betachlit harichuk mikkedushsha haelona shehi yichudo veachduto yitbarech yoter mikkal baale chayyim hattemeim ushkatzim urmasim hammushpaim missitra achora uklipat avoda zara

Uma sheppikuach nefesh doche shear averot vegam yaavor veal yehareg hayenu keferush chachamenu-zichronam-livracha amra tora challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harbe velo mishshum kallut haaverot vechumran

Teda shehare shabbat chamura ushkula kaavoda zara leinyan shechitat mumar ledavar echad beore dea siman ma sheen ken bemumar legiluy araot vaafilu hache pikuach nefesh doche shabbat velo giluy araot ella digzerat hakkatuv hu

Ella shelleachar maase hachet im hi meaverot sheen bahen karet umita bide shamayim sheen nafsho haelohit meta legamre venichretet mishsharshah belohim chayyim rak shennifgam ketzat devekutah vaachizatah besharshah bechet ze

Ulfi rech vechilluke bechinot happegam bannefesh uvsharshah balonim kach hem chilluke bechinot hammeruk vehaonesh begehinnom o baolam hazze lechal on vachet onesh meuchad lemarek ulhavir hallichluch vehappegam vechen bechayyave mita vecharet en pogmin kullam beshave

Hare gam nafsho hachiyyunit habbahamit hamlubbeshet begufo vechen gufo chozrim veolim mehassitra achora uklipa zo umitkarvim likdushshat nefesh haelohit hamlubbeshet bahem hammaamina ba echad vegam bishat hachet hayeta veamna itto yitbarech rak shehayeta bivchinat galut mammash toch nefesh habbahamit missitra achora hammachatia et hagguf umoridato immah beimke sheol lematta matta tachat tumat hassitra achora uklipat avoda zara yishmerenu
Veen lecha galut gadol mizze meigra rama chu uchmo shennitbaer leel deshoresh umkor nafshot kal bet yisrael hu mechachma ilaa vehu yitbarech vechachmato echad vechu
