Vehu kimshal haochez berosho shel melech umorido lematta vetomen panav betoch bet hakkisse male tzoa sheen lecha elbon gadol mizze afilu ose ken lefi shaa shehakkelipot vesitra achora nikraot ki tzoa kannoda
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 25: Vezehu shekkatuv ki karov elecha haddavar meod vego shebbechal et uvchal shaa beyado shel adam uvirshuto hu lehaavir ruach shetut vehashshichcha mikkirbo velizkor ulorer ahavato la echad hamsutteret bevadday bilvavo beli shum safek
Vezehu shekkatuv uvilvavcha venichlal bah gam dechilu dehayenu shello lipared beshum ofen miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech afilu bimsirat nefesh mammash beli shum taam vesechel mussag ella beteva elohi

Vechal shekken bishvirat hattaaot hakkalla miyyissure mita shekkarov elav haddavar yoter lichbosh hayyetzer hen bivchinat sur mera afilu meavera kalla shel divre sofrim shello laavor al retzono yitbarech meachar shennifrad bah miyyichudo veachduto kemo baavoda zara mammash bishat maase vahare gam baavoda zara yachol laasot teshuva achar kach
Veaf shehaomer echeta veashuv en maspikin chu hayenu sheen machazikim yado lihot lo sheat hakkosher laasot teshuva aval im dachak hashshaa veasa teshuva en lecha davar sheomed bifne hatteshuva

Veaf-al-pi-chen kal ish yisrael muchan umzumman limsor nafsho al kedushshat shello lehishtachaot laavoda zara afilu lefi shaa velaasot teshuva achar kach vehayenu mippene or hamlubbash benafsham kannizkar leel sheeno bivchinat zeman veshaa kelal ella lemala mehazzeman veshallit umoshel alav kannoda

Vehen bivchinat vaase tov lehitgabber kaari bigvura veometz hallev neged hayyetzer hammachbid et gufo umappil alav atzla mibbechinat yesod heafar shebbannefesh habbahamit millehatriach gufo bizrizut bechal mine torach vaavodat massa baavodat sheyyesh bah torach veamal kegon laamol battora beiyyun uvappe la fasik pumeh miggirsa uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha leolam yasim adam atzmo al divre tora keshor leol vechachamor lemasoy vechen litfilla bechavana bechal kocho mammash vechen baavodat shehi bedavar shebbemamon kemo avodat hatztzedaka

Vechayyotze veellu mimmilchamot hayyetzer vetachbulotav lekarer nefesh haadam shello lehafkir mamono uvriut gufo shellaamod negdo ulchavsho karov meod el haadam kesheyyasim el libbo shellenatztzeach hayyetzer bechal ze veoter mizze velaasot hefko mammash kal meod miyyissure mita yishmerenu veyissure mita yishmerenu haya mekabbel beahava uvratzon shello lipared miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech afilu lefi shaa lehishtachaot laavoda zara chas veshalom

Vechal shekken sheyyesh lo lekabbel beahava uvratzon kede ledavka vo leolam vaed dehayenu kesheyyaase retzono yitbarech baavoda zo yitgalle bah penimit ratzon haelon bivchinat panim vegiluy rav velo vehester kelal uchsheen shum hester panim baratzon haelon azay en davar nifrad kelal uchlal lihot yesh vedavar bifne atzmo
Velazot tihyena nafsho haelohit vehachiyyunit ulvushehen kullan meuchadot betachlit hayyichud baratzon haelon veor en-sof baruch-hu kannizkar leel

Veyichud ze lemala hu nitzchi leolam vaed ki hu yitbarech urtzono lemala mehazzeman vechen giluy retzono shebbedibburo shehi hattora hu nitzchi uchmo shekkatuv udvar elohenu yakum leolam udvarav chayim vekayyamim chu velo yachalif velo yamir dato leolamim chu

Ella shellematta hu tachat hazzeman uvotah shaa levaddah sheosek bah battora o bemitzva ki achar kach im osek bedavar acher nifrad mehayyichud haelon lematta vehayenu kesheosek bidvarim betelim legamre sheen bahem tzorech kelal laavodat

Veaf-al-pi-chen keshechozer veshav laavodat achar kach letora velitfilla umvakkesh mechila me al shehaya efshar lo laasok az battora velo asak yislach lo kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha avar al mitzvat ase veshav lo zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo
Velaze tikkenu birkat selach lanu shalosh peamim bechal yom al aon bitul tora sheen adam nitzol mimmennu bechal yom uchmo hattamid shehaya mechapper al mitzot ase
Veen ze echeta veashuv ella im ken shebbishat hachet mammash hu somech al hatteshuva ulchach chote kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher

Uvaze yuvan lamma tziva moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom bemishne tora laddor shennichnesu laaretz likrot keriat shema paamayim bechal yom lekabbel alav malchut shamayim bimsirat nefesh vahalo hivtiach lahem pachdechem umoraachem yitten vego ella mishshum shekkiyyum hattora umitzoteha taluy baze sheyyizkor tamid inyan mesirat nafsho la al yichudo sheyyihye kavua belibbo tamid mammash yomam valayela lo yamish mizzichrono ki baze yuchal laamod neged yitzro lenatztzecho tamid bechal et uvchal shaa kannizkar leel
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 26: Beram kegon da tzarich leodoe kelal gadol ki kemo shennitztzachon lenatztzeach davar gashmi kegon shene anashim hammitabbekim ze im ze lehappil ze et ze hinne im haechad hu beatzlut uchvedut yenutztzach bekal veyippol gam im hu gibbor yoter mechavero kacha mammash benitzchon hayyetzer i efshar lenatztzecho beatzlut uchvedut hannimshachot meatzvut vetimtum hallev kaeven ki im bizrizut hannimshechet missimcha uftichat hallev vetahorato mikkal nidnud deaga vaetzev baolam

Uma shekkatuv bechal etzev yihye motar perush sheyyihye eze yitron umaala mizze hinne adderabba millashon ze mashma shehaetzev mitztzad atzmo en bo maala rak sheyyaggia veyavo mimmennu eze yitron vehayenu hassimcha haamitit ba elohav habbaa achar haetzev haamiti leittim mezummanim al aonotav bemar nafsho velev nishbar sheal yede ze nishbera ruach hattuma vesitra achora umchitza shel barzel hammafseket beno leaviv shebbashshamayim kemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk ruach nishbara lev nishbar vego vaazay yekuyyam bo resheh dikra tashmieni sason vesimcha vego hashiva li seson yishecha veruach nediva vego

Vezehu taam happashut letikun haari zichrono livracha lomar mizmor ze achar tikun chatzot kodem hallimud kede lilmod besimcha amitit ba habbaa achar haetzev sheyyesh lesimcha zo yitron keyitron haor habba min hachoshech daveka kemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk veraiti sheyyesh yitron lachachma min hassichlut kitron haor chu ayyen sham veday lammevin
Umikra male dibber hakkatuv tachat asher lo avadta et elohecha besimcha vego venoda lakkol perush haari zichrono livracha al pasuk ze

Vehinne etza hayeutza letaher libbo mikkal etzev venidnud deaga mimmile dealma vaafilu bane chayye umzone mudaat zot lakkol maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha keshem shemmevarech al hattova chu ufershu baggemara lekabbule besimcha kemo simchat hattova hanniglet veniret ki gam zo letova rak sheenah niglet veniret leene vasar ki hi mealma deitkasya shellemala mealma deitgalya shehu mishshem havaya baruch-hu vealma deitkasya hu vezehu shekkatuv ashre haggever asher teyasserennu yah vego

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ki hassemechim beyissurim alehem hakkatuv omer veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato ki hassimcha hi meahavato kirvat yoter mikkal chayye haolam hazze kedichtiv ki tov chasdecha mechayyim vego vekirvat hi beyeter seet umaala leen ketz bealma deitkasya ki sham chevon uzzo veoshev beseter elon veal ken zoche letzet hashshemesh bigvurato leatid lavo shehi yetziat chamma minarteka shehi mechussa bo baolam hazze veleatid titgalle mikkissuyah dehayenu sheaz yitgalle alma deitkasya veyizrach veyair begiluy rav veatzum lechal hachosim bo baolam hazze umistoffim betzillo tzel hachachma shehu bechinat tzel velo ora vetova niret veday lammevin

Ach haatzvut mimmile dishmayya tzarich lashit etzot benafsho lipater mimmenna en tzarich lomar bishat avoda shetztzarich laavod besimcha uvtuv levav ella afilu mi shehu baal asakim vederech eretz im nofel lo etzev udaga mimmile dishmayya bishat asakav beyadua shehu tachbulat hayyetzer kede lehappilo achar kach betaaot chas veshalom kannoda sheim lo chen meayin baa lo atzvut amitit mechamat ahavat o yirato beemtza asakav

Vehinne ben shennafla lo haatzvut bishat avoda betalmud tora o bitfilla uven shennafla lo shello bishat avoda zot yasim el libbo ki en hazzeman gerama kaet leatzvut amitit afilu ledaagat aonot chamurim chas veshalom rak lazot tzarich keviut ittim ushat hakkosher beyishshuv haddaat lehitbonen bigdullat asher chata lo kede sheal yede ze yihye libbo nishbar beemet bimrirut amitit

Vechimvoar et zo bemakom acher vesham nitbaer gam ken ki miyyad achar shennishbar libbo beittim kevuim hahem azay yasir haetzev millibbo legamre veyaamin emuna shelema ki heevir chattato verav lisloach vezo hi hassimcha haamitit ba habbaa achar haetzev kannizkar leel
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 27: Veim haatzvut enah middaagat aonot ella mehirhurim raim vetaaot raot shennoflot bemachashavto hinne im noflot lo shello bishat haavoda ella beet asko baasakav vederech eretz uchhay gavena adderabba yesh lo lismoach bechelko sheaf shennoflot lo bemachashavto hu massiach dato mehen lekayyem ma shenneemar velo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem asher attem zonim acharehem

Veen hakkatuv medabber betzaddikim lekaram zonim chas veshalom ella bevenonim kayyotze vo shennoflim lo hirhure niuf bemachashavto ben beheter chu uchshemmassiach dato mekayyem lav ze veamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha yashav velo avar avera notnim lo sachar keillu asa mitzva veal ken tzarich lismoach bekiyyum hallav kemo bekiyyum mitzvat ase mammash

Veadderabba haatzvut hi miggassut haruach sheeno makkir mekomo veal ken yera levavo al sheeno bemadregat tzaddik shelletzaddikim bevadday en noflim lahem hirhure shetut kaellu ki ilu haya makkir mekomo shehu rachok meod mimmadregat tzaddik vehalvay haya benoni velo rasha kal yamav afilu shaa achat hare zot hi middat habbenonim vaavodatam lichbosh hayyetzer vehahirhur haole mehallev lammoach ulhassiach dato legamre mimmennu velidchoto bishte yadayim kannizkar leel

Uvchal dechiyya udchiyya shemmadchehu mimmachashavto itkafya sitra achora letatta uvitaruta diltatta itaruta dilela veitkafya sitra achora dilela hammagbiha atzmah kannesher lekayyem ma shenneemar im tagbiha kannesher vego mishsham oridcha neum

Uchmo shehiflig bazzohar parashat teruma daf begodel nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech kad itkafya sitra achora letatta deistallek yekara dekudsha-berich-hu leela al kulla yatir mishshevacha achora veistallekuta da yattir mikkulla vechu
Velachen al yippol lev adam alav velo yera levavo meod gam im yihye ken kal yamav bemilchama zo ki ulay lechach nivra vezot avodato leachpaya lesitra achora tamid

Veal ze amar iyyov barata reshaim velo sheyyihu reshaim beemet chas veshalom ella sheyyaggia alehem kemaase harshaim bemachashavtam vehirhuram levad vehem yihu nilchamim tamid lehassiach datam mehem kede leachpaya lesitra achora velo yuchlu levattelah mikkol vachol ki ze naase al yede tzaddikim

Ushne mine nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech lemala echad mibbitul hassitra achora legamre veithappecha mimmeriru lemitka umechashocha linhora al yede hatztzaddikim vehashshenit kad itkafya hassitra achora beodah betakpah ugvuratah umagbiha atzmah kannesher umishsham moridah beitaruta diltatta al yede habbenonim

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv vaase li matammim kaasher ahavti matammim leshon rabbim shene mine nachat ruach vehu maamar hashshechina levaneha kelalut yisrael kidfershu battikunim uchmo shebbematammim gashmiyyim derech mashal yesh shene mine maadannim echad mimmaachalim arevim umtukim vehashsheni middevarim charifim o chamutzim rak shehem metubbalim umtukkanim hetev ad shennaasu maadannim lehashiv hannefesh
Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv kol paal lammaanehu vegam rasha leom raa perush sheyyashuv merisho veyaase hara shello yom veor lemala kad itkafya sitra achora veistallek yekara dekudsha-berich-hu leela

Velo od ella afilu bidvarim hammuttarim legamre kal ma shehaadam zoveach yitzro afilu shaa kalla umitkaven leachpaya lesitra achora shebbechalal hassemali kegon shechafetz leechol umacher seuddato ad leachar shaa o pachot veosek battora beotah shaa kidita baggemara shaa reviit maachal kal adam shaa shishshit maachal talmide chachamim vehau marivim atzmam shette shaot lechavana zo af sheggam achar hasseudda hau lomdim kal hayyom

Vechen im bolem piv milledabber devarim shellibbo mitave meod ledabberam meinyene haolam vechen behirhure machashavto afilu bimat mizzeer deitkafya sitra achora letatta istallek yekara dekudsha-berich-hu ukdushshato leela harbe umikkedushsha zo nimshechet kedushsha elona al haadam lematta lesayeo siyyua rav veatzum laavodato yitbarech

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha adam mekaddesh atzmo meat lematta mekaddeshin oto harbe milmala levad ma shemmekayyem mitzvat ase shel tora vehitkaddishtem vechu keshemmekaddesh atzmo bammuttar lo

Uferush vehitkaddishtem shettaasu atzmechem kedoshim kelomar af shebbeemet eno kadosh umuvdal missitra achora ki hi betakpah uvigvuratah ketoladtah bechalal hassemali rak shekkovesh yitzro umkaddesh atzmo vihyitem kedoshim kelomar sofo lihot kadosh umuvdal beemet mehassitra achora al yede shemmekaddeshim oto harbe milmala umsayeim oto legarshah millibbo meat meat
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 28: Vaafilu im noflim lo hirhure taaot ushar machashavot zarot bishat haavoda battora o bitfilla bechavana al yashit lev alehen ella yassiach dato mehen kerega

Vegam al yehi shote laasok behaalaat hammiddot shel hammachashava zara kannoda ki lo neemru devarim hahem ella letzaddikim sheen noflim lahem machashavot zarot shellahem ki im mishshel acherim aval mi shennofel lo mishshello mibbechinat hara shebbelibbo bechalal hassemali ech yaalehu lemala vehu atzmo mekushshar lematta

Ach af-al-pi-chen al yippol libbo bekirbo lihot mizze atzev nivze bishat haavoda shetztzarich lihot besimcha rabba ella adderabba yitchazzek yoter veosif ometz bechal kocho bechavanat hattefilla bechedva vesimcha yetera besumo el libbo ki nefilat hammachashava zara hi mehakkelipa shebbechalal hassemali haosa milchama bevenoni im nefesh elohit shebbo

Venoda derech hannilchamim vechen hanneevakim yachad kesheechad mitgabber azay hashsheni mitammetz lehitgabber gam ken bechal maamatztze kocho velachen keshennefesh haelohit mitammetzet umitgabberet lehitpallel azay gam hakkelipa mitgabberet kenegdah levalbelah ulhappilah bemachashava zara shellah

Velo ketaut haolam shettoim lehochiach minnefilat hammachashava zara mikkelal sheen tefillatam kelum sheilu hitpallel karauy venachon lo hau noflim lo machashavot zarot vehaemet haya kedivrehem im hayeta nefesh achat levaddah hi hammitpallelet vehi hamchashshevet umharheret hammachashavot zarot

Aval beemet laamito hen shette nefashot hannilchamot zo im zo bemocho shel adam kal achat cheftzah urtzonah limshol bo velihot hammoach memulla mimmenna levaddah vechal hirhure tora veyirat shamayim minnefesh haelohit vechal mile dealma minnefesh habbahamit rak shehaelohit melubbeshet bah

Vehu kimshal adam hammitpallel bechavana veomed lenegdo arel rasha umesiach umdabber immo kede levalbelo shezzot atzato bevadday shello lehashiv lo mittov vead ra velaasot atzmo kecheresh lo yishma ulkayyem ma shekkatuv al taan kesil beivalto pen tishve lo gam atta

Kach al yashiv meuma veshum taana umaane neged hammachashava zara ki hammitabbek im menuval mitnavel gam ken rak yaase atzmo kelo yodea velo shomea hahirhurim shennaflu lo visirem middato veosif ometz bechoach kavanato

Veim yikshe lo lahasiram middato mippene shettordim dato meod bechazka azay yashpil nafsho la veyitchannen lo yitbarech bemachashavto lerachem alav berachamav hamrubbim kerachem av al banim hannimshachim mimmocho vechacha yerachem al nafsho hannimshechet meitto yitbarech lehatztzilah mimmayim hazzedonim ulmaano yaase ki chelek mammash ammo
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 29: Ach od achat tzarich lashit etzot benafshot habbenonim asher lifamim veittim rabbim yesh lahem timtum hallev shennaase kaeven velo yachol liftoach libbo beshum ofen laavoda shebballev zo tefilla
Vegam lifamim lo yuchal lehillachem im hayyetzer lekaddesh atzmo bemuttar lo mippene kevedut shebbelibbo
Vezot hi etza hayeutza bazzohar hakkadosh deamar rav metivta began eden aa dela salik beh nehora mevatteshin leh chu gufa dela salik beh nehora denishmeta mevatteshin leh chu
Perush nehora denishmeta sheor hanneshama vehassechel eno meir kal kach limshol al chumriut shebbagguf

Veaf shemmevin umitbonen besichlo bigdullat eno nitpas venidbak bemocho kal kach sheyyuchal limshol al chumriyyut hallev mechamat chumriyyutan vegassutan vehassiba hi gassut hakkelipa shemmagbiha atzmah al or kedushshat nefesh haelohit umasteret umachashicha orah

Velazot tzarich levatteshah ulhashpilah leafar dehayenu likboa ittim lehashpil atzmo lihot nivze veenav nimas kakkatuv velev nishbar ruach nishbara hi hassitra achora shehi hi haadam atzmo babbenonim shennefesh hachiyyunit hamchayya hagguf hi betakpah ketoladtah belibbo nimtza hi hi haadam atzmo

Veal nefesh haelohit shebbo neemar neshama shennatatta bi tehora hi shennatatta bi dayeka mikkelal shehaadam atzmo enennu hanneshama hattehora ki im batztzaddikim shebbahem hu lehefech shenneshama hattehora shehi nefesh haelohit hu haadam vegufam nikra besar adam

Uchmaamar hillel hazzaken letalmidav keshehaya holech leechol haya omer shehu holech ligmol chesed im haaluva vaaniyya hu gufo ki kemo zar nechshav etzlo velachen amar shehu gomel chesed immo bema shemmaachilo ki hu atzmo eno rak nefesh haelohit levad ki hi levaddah mechayya gufo uvsaro shehara shehaya bannefesh hachiyyunit hamlubbeshet bedamo uvsaro nithappech letov venichlal bikdushshat nefesh haelohit mammash batztzaddikim
Aval babbenoni meachar shemmahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shemmissitra achora hamlubbeshet bedamo uvsaro lo nehpach letov hare hi hi haadam atzmo

Veim ken hu rachok me betachlit harichuk shehare koach hammitave shebbenafsho habbahamit yachol gam ken lehitauot lidvarim haasurim shehem neged retzono yitbarech af sheeno mitave laasotam befoal mammash chas veshalom rak sheenam meusim etzlo beemet kevatztzaddikim kemo shennitbaer leel perek uvaze hu garua umshukkatz umtoav yoter mibbaale chayyim hattemeim ushkatzim urmasim kannizkar leel uchmo shekkatuv veanochi tolaat velo ish vego
Vegam keshemmitgabberet bo nafsho haelohit leorer haahava la bishat hattefilla enah beemet laamito legamre meachar shecholefet veoveret achar hattefilla kannizkar leel sof perek
Uvifrat kesheyyizkor tumat nafsho bechattat neurim vehappegam sheasa baelonim vesham hu lemala mehazzeman uchillu pagam venitma hayyom chas veshalom mammash
Veaf shekkevar asa teshuva nechona hare ikar hatteshuva ballev vehallev yesh bo bechinot umadregot rabbot vehakkol lefi ma shehu adam ulfi hazzeman vehammakom kayyadua layyodim

Velachen achshav beshaa zo sheroe beatzmo dela salik beh nehora denishmeta mikkelal shehayyom lo nitkabbela teshuvato vaaonotav mavdilim o sherotzim lehaaloto litshuva ilaa yoter meumka delibba yoter velachen amar david vechattati negdi tamid

Vegam mi shehu naki mechattot neurim hachamurim yasim el libbo lekayyem maamar zohar hakkadosh lihot mimmare dechushbana dehayenu laasot cheshbon im nafsho mikkal hammachashavot vehaddiburim vehammaasim shechalfu veavru miyyom heoto ad hayyom hazze im hau kullam mitztzad hakkedushsha o mitztzad hattuma rachamana litztzelan dehayenu kal hammachashavot vehaddiburim vehammaasim asher lo la hemma velirtzono velaavodato shezzehu perush leshon sitra achora kannizkar leel beferek

Umudaat zot ki kal et shehaadam mechashshev machashavot kedoshot naase merkava beet zo lehechlot hakkedushsha shemmehen mushpaot machashavot hallalu vechen lehefech naase merkava temea beet zo lehechlot hattuma shemmehen mushpaot kal machashavot raot vechen bedibbur umaase

Od yasim el libbo rov chalomotav shehem hevel urut ruach mishshum sheen nafsho ola lemala uchmo shekkatuv mi yaale behar neki chappayim vego veinun sitrin bishin atyan umitdabbekan beh umodin leh bechelma milin dealma vechu ulzimnin dechayechan beh veachaziu leh mile shekar vetzaarin leh bechelmeh chu kemo shekkatuv bazzohar vayyikra daf ammud veammud ayyen sham baarichut

Vehinne kal ma sheyyaarich beinyanim ellu bemachashavto vegam beiyyuno bisfarim lihot libbo nishbar bekirbo venivze veenav nimas kakkatuv betachlit hammius ulmaes chayyav mammash hare baze memaes umvazze hassitra achora umashpilah leafar umoridah miggedullatah vegassut ruchah vegavhutah shemmagbiha et atzmah al or kedushshat nefesh haelohit lehachashich orah

Vegam yarim aleha bekol raash verogez lehashpilah kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara shenneemar rigzu vego dehayenu lirgoz al nefesh habbahamit shehi yitzro hara bekol raash verogez bemachashavto lomar lo atta ra verasha umshukkatz umtoav umnuval vechu kechal hashshemot shekkaru lo chachamenu-zichronam-livracha beemet ad matay tastir lifne or-en-sof baruch-hu hammalle kal almin haya hove veyihye beshave gam bemakom ze sheani alav kemo shehaya or en-sof baruch-hu levaddo kodem shennivra haolam beli shum shinuy kemo shekkatuv ani lo shaniti ki hu lemala mehazzeman vechu veatta menuval vechu machchish haemet hannire laenayim dechulla kammeh kela mammash beemet bivchinat reiyya chushiyyit
Vehinne al yede ze yoil lenafsho haelohit lehair eneha beemet yichud or-en-sof biriyya chushiyyit velo bechinat shemia vahavana levaddah kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher shezzehu shoresh kal haavoda

Vehattaam lefi shebbeemet en shum mammashut kelal basitra achora shellachen nimshela lechoshech sheen bo shum mammashut kelal umimmela nidche mippene haor vechach hassitra achora af sheyyesh bah chayyut harbe lehachaot kal baale chayyim hattemeim venafshot ummot haolam vegam nefesh habbahamit shebbeyisrael kannizkar leel mikkal makom hare kal chayyutah enah mitztzad atzmah chas veshalom ella mitztzad hakkedushsha kannizkar leel velachen hi betela legamre mippene hakkedushsha kevitul hachoshech mippene haor haggashmi rak shellegabbe kedushshat nefesh haelohit shebbaadam natan lah hakkadosh-baruch-hu reshut vicholet lehagbiha atzmah kenegdah kede shehaadam yitorer lehitgabber aleha lehashpilah al yede shiflut unmichut rucho venivze veenav nimas

Uvitaruta diltatta itaruta dilela lekayyem ma shenneemar mishsham oridcha neum dehayenu shemmesirah mimmemshaltah vichaltah umsallek mimmenna hakkoach urshut shennittan lah lehagbiha atzmah neged or kedushshat nefesh haelohit vaazay mimmela betela venidchet kevitul hachoshech mippene or haggashmi

Uchmo shemmatzinu davar ze meforash battora gabbe meraggelim shemmittechilla amru ki chazak hu mimmennu al tikre mimmennu chu shello heeminu bicholet veachar kach chazru veamru hinnennu vealinu vego umeayin chazra uvaa lahem haemuna bicholet hare lo hera lahem moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom shum ot umofet al ze bentayim rak sheamar lahem ech shekkatzaf alehem venishba shello lahaviam el haaretz uma hoil ze lahem im lo hau maaminim bicholet chas veshalom lichbosh melachim umippene ze lo ratzu kelal likanes laaretz

Ella vadday mippene sheyyisrael atzman hem maaminim bene maaminim rak shehassitra achora hamlubbeshet begufam higbiha atzmah al or kedushshat nafsham haelohit begassut ruchah vegavhutah bechutzpa beli taam vadaat velachen miyyad shekkatzaf alehem vehirim bekol raash verogez ad matay laeda haraa hazzot vego bammidbar hazze yippelu figrechem vego ani dibbarti im lo zot eese lechal haeda haraa hazzot vego uchsheshshamu devarim kashim ellu nichna venishbar libbam bekirbam kedichtiv vayyitabbelu haam meod umimmela nafla hassitra achora mimmemshaltah vegavhutah vegassut ruchah veyisrael atzman hem maaminim
Umizze yachol lilmod kal adam shennoflim lo bemachashavto sefekot al emuna ki hem divre ruach hassitra achora levaddah hammagbiha atzmah al nafsho aval yisrael atzman hem maaminim chu

Vegam hassitra achora atzmah en lah sefekot kelal beemuna rak shennitan lah reshut levalbel haadam bedivre sheker umirma leharbot secharo kefituye hazzona leven hammelech besheker umirma birshut hammelech kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 30: Od zot yasim el libbo lekayyem maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha veheve shefal ruach bifne kl haadam veheve beemet laamito bifne chal haadam mammash afilu bifne kal shebbekallim vehayenu al pi maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al tadin et chaverach ad shettaggia limkomo

Ki mekomo gorem lo lachato lihot parnasato lelech bashshuk kal hayyom velihot miyyoshve keranot veenav root kal hattaaot vehaayin roa vehallev chomed veyitzro boer ketannur boera meofe kemo shekkatuv behoshea hu voer keesh lehava vego

Ma sheen ken mi sheholech bashshuk meat verov hayyom yoshev beveto vegam im holech kal hayyom bashshuk yachol lihot sheeno mechummam kal kach betivo ki en hayyetzer shave bechal nefesh yesh sheyyitzro chu kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher
Vehinne beemet gam mi shehu mechummam meod betivo ufarnasato hi lihot miyyoshve keranot kal hayyom en lo shum hitnatztzelut al chataav umikre rasha gamur al asher en pachad elohim leneged enav
Ki haya lo lehitappek velimshol al ruach taavato shebbelibbo mippene pachad haroe kal maasav kemo shennitbaer leel ki hammoach shallit al hallev betoladto
Vehinne beemet shehi milchama gedola vaatzuma lishbor hayyetzer habboer keesh lehava mippene pachad uchmo nissaon mammash

Vehilchach tzarich kal adam lefi ma shehu mekomo umadregato baavodat lishkol velivchon beatzmo im hu oved beerech uvchinat milchama atzuma kazo venissaon kaze bivchinat vaase tov kegon baavodat hattefilla bechavana lishpoch nafsho lifne bechal kocho mammash ad mitzuy hannefesh ulhillachem im gufo venefesh habbahamit shebbo hammonim hakkavana bemilchama atzuma ulvattesham ulchattetam keafar kodem hattefilla shacharit vearvit midde yom beom vegam bishat hattefilla leyagea atzmo bigiat nefesh vigiat basar kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman baarichut
Vechal shello higgia lide midda zo lehillachem im gufo milchama atzuma kazo adayin lo higgia livchinat veerech milchemet hayyetzer habboer keesh lehava lihot nichna venishbar mippene pachad
Vechen beinyan birkat hammazon vechal birchot hannehenin vehammitzot bechavana veen tzarich lomar kavanat hammitzot lishman
Vechen beinyan esek limud hattora lilmod harbe yoter mecheftzo urtzono lefi tivo urgiluto al yede milchama atzuma im gufo
Ki hallomed meat yoter mittivo hare zo milchama ketanna veen lah erech vedimon im milchemet hayyetzer habboer keesh demikre rasha gamur im eno menatztzeach yitzro lihot nichna venishbar mippene
Uma li bechinat sur mera uma li bechinat vaase tov hakkol hi mitzvat hammelech hakkadosh yachid umuchad baruch-hu
Vechen bishar mitzot uvifrat bedavar shebbemamon kemo avodat hatztzedaka uchhay gavena

Vaafilu bivchinat sur mera yachol kal ish maskil limtzo benafsho sheeno sar legamre mehara bakkol mikkol kol bemakom shetztzarich lemilchama atzuma keerech hannizkar leel vaafilu pachot meerech hannizkar leel kegon lehafsik beemtza sicha naa o sipur bignut chavero vaafilu genay katan vekal meod af shehu emet vaafilu kede lenakkot atzmo kannoda meha deamar rabbi shimon leaviv rabbenu hakkadosh lav ana katveh ella yehuda chayyata katveh veamar lo kallech millashon hara ayyen sham baggemara resh perek devava batra

Uchhay gavena kamma mile dishchiche tuva uvifrat beinyan lekaddesh atzmo bemuttar lo shehu middeorayeta kemo shekkatuv kedoshim tihu vego vehitkaddishtem vego vegam divre sofrim chamurim middivre tora vechu
Ella shekkal ellu vechayyotze vahen hen meaonot shehaadam dash baakevav vegam naasu keheter mechamat sheavar veshana vechu

Aval beemet im hu yodea sefer umachazik betorat vekirvat elokim yechpatz gadol aono minneso veashmato gadla bechifle chiflayim bema sheeno nilcham umitgabber al yitzro beerech uvchinat milchama atzuma hannizkeret leel meashmat kal shebbekallim miyyoshve keranot harchokim me vetorato veen ashmatam gedola kal kach bema sheenam kovshim yitzram habboer keesh lehava mippene pachad hammevin umabbit el kal maasehem keashmat kal hakkarev hakkarev el veel torato vaavodato uchmo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha gabbe acher sheyyada bichvodi vechu
Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al amme haaretz shezzedonot naasu lahem kishgagot
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 31: Vehinne af im kesheyyaarich harbe lehaamik bainyanim hannizkarim leel keshaa ushtayim lihot binmichat ruach velev nishbar yavo lide atzvut gedola lo yachush

Veaf sheatzvut hi mitztzad kelipat nogah velo mitztzad hakkedushsha ki betzad hakkedushsha ketiv oz vechedva bimkomo veen hashshechina shora ella mittoch simcha vechen lidvar halacha vechu ella sheim haatzvut hi mimmile dishmayya hi mibbechinat tov shebbenogah
Velachen katav haari zichrono livracha sheafilu daagat haaonot enah reuya ki im bishat haviduy velo bishat hattefilla vetalmud tora shetztzarich lihot besimcha shemmitztzad hakkedushsha daveka
Af-al-pi-chen hare kach hi hammidda leachpaya lesitra achora beminah vedugmatah kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha mineh uveh ibba lishdya beh narga ufaga bo kayyotze vo
Veal ze neemar bechal etzev yihye motar vehayyitron hi hassimcha habbaa achar haetzev kedilkamman

Ach beemet en lev nishbar umrirut hannefesh al richukah meor pene vehitlabbeshutah besitra achora nikraim beshem atzvut kelal bilshon hakkodesh ki atzvut hi shellibbo metumtam kaeven veen chayyut belibbo aval merirut velev nishbar adderabba hare yesh chayyut belibbo lehitpael ulhitmarmer rak shehi chayyut mibbechinat gevurot kedoshot vehassimcha mibbechinat chasadim ki hallev kalul mishtehen

Vehinne leittim tzarich leorer bechinat gevurot hakkedoshot kede lehamtik haddinim shehem bechinat nefesh habbahamit veyetzer hara kesheshsholet chas veshalom al haadam ki en haddinim nimtakin ella besharshan velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha leolam yargiz adam yetzer hattov vehayenu bechal et sheroe benafsho shetztzarich lechach

Ach sheat hakkosher shehi shaa hamuchedet uruya lechach lerov bene adam hi beshaa shehu atzev belav hache mimmile dealma o kach beli shum sibba azay hi sheat hakkosher lehappech haetzev lihot mimmare dechushbana hannizkar leel ulkayyem maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha leolam yargiz vechu kannizkar leel uvaze yippater mehaatzvut shemmimmile dealma

Veachar kach yavo lide simcha amitit dehayenu shezzot yashiv el libbo lenachamo bechiflayim achar haddevarim vehaemet haelle hannizkarim leel lemor lelibbo emet hu ken beli safek sheani rachok meod me betachlit umshukkatz umtoav chu ach kal ze hu ani levaddi hu hagguf im nefesh hachiyyunit shebbo aval mikkal makom yesh bekirbi chelek mammash sheyyeshno afilu bekal shebbekallim shehi nefesh haelohit im nitzotz elokut mammash hamlubbash bah lehachaotah rak shehi bivchinat galut veim ken adderabba kal ma sheani betachlit harichuk me vehattiuv veshikutz hare nefesh haelohit shebbi begalut gadol yoter veharachamanut aleha gedola meod velaze asim kal megammati vecheftzi lehotziah ulhaalotah miggalut ze lahashivah el bet aviha kinureha kodem shennitlabbesha begufi shehayeta nichlelet beoro yitbarech umuchedet immo betachlit vegam atta ken tehe kelula umuchedet bo yitbarech kesheasim kal megammati betora umitzot lehalbish bahen kal eser bechinoteha kannizkar leel uvifrat bemitzvat tefilla litzok el batztzar lah miggalutah begufi hamshukkatz lehotziah mimmasger uldavka bo yitbarech
Vezo hi bechinat teshuva umaasim tovim shehen maasim tovim sheose kede lehashiv chelek limkora vesharsha dechal almin

Vezot tihye avodato kal yamav besimcha rabba hi simchat hannefesh betzetah mehagguf hamtoav veshava el bet aviha kinureha bishat hattora vehaavoda uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lihot kal yamav bitshuva
Veen lecha simcha gedola ketzet mehaggalut vehashshivya kimshal ben melech shehaya beshivya vetochen bevet haasurim umnuval beashpa veyatza lachafshi el bet aviv hammelech

Veaf shehagguf omed beshikutzo vetiuvo uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar denikra mashka dechiveya ki mahutah veatzmutah shel hannefesh habbahamit lo nehpach letov likalel bikdushsha mikkal makom tikar nafsho beenav lismoach besimchatah yoter mehagguf hannivze shello learbev ulvalbel simchat hannefesh beitztzevon hagguf
Vehinne bechina zo hi bechinat yetziat mitzrayim shenneemar bah ki varach haam delichora hu tamuha lamma hayeta kazot vechi ilu amru lefaro leshallecham chafshi leolam lo haya muchrach leshallecham

Ella mippene shehara shebbenafshot yisrael adayin haya betakpo bechalal hassemali ki lo faska zuhamatam ad mattan tora rak megammatam vecheftzam hayeta letzet nafsham haelohit miggalut hassitra achora hi tumat mitzrayim uldavka bo yitbarech uchdichtiv uzzi umauzzi umnusi beom tzara vego misgabbi umnusi vego vehu manos li vego
Velachen leatid kesheyyaavir ruach hattuma min haaretz ketiv uvimnusa lo telechun ki holech lifnechem vego

Velihot bechinat teshuva zo beyeter seet veyeter oz meumka delibba vegam simchat hannefesh tihye betosefet ora vesimcha kaasher yashiv el libbo daat utvuna lenachamo meitztzevono vigono lemor kannizkar leel hen emet chu ach ani lo asiti et atzmi velamma asa kazot lehorid chelek meoro yitbarech hammalle vesovev kal almin vechulla kammeh kela chashiv vehilbisho bemashka dechiveya vetippa serucha en ze ki im yerida zo hi tzorech aliyya lehaalot la kal nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shemmikkelipat nogah vechal levusheha hen bechinot machashava dibbur umaase shellah al yede hitlabbeshutan bemaase dibbur umachashevet hattora uchmo sheyyitbaer lekamman inyan haalaa zo baarichut ech shehi tachlit beriat haolam veim ken efo zot eese vezot tihye kal megammati kal yeme cheldi lechal bahen chayye ruchi venafshi uchmo shekkatuv elecha nafshi essa dehayenu lekashsher machashavti vedibburi bemachashavto vedibburo yitbarech vehen hen gufe halachot haaruchot lefanenu vechen maase bemaase hammitzot
Shellachen nikret hattora meshivat nafesh perush limkorah vesharshah veal ze neemar pikkude yesharim mesammeche lev
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 32: Vehinne al yede kiyyum haddevarim hannizkarim leel lihot gufo nivze venimas beenav rak simchato tihye simchat hannefesh levaddah hare zo derech yeshara vekalla lavo lide kiyyum mitzvat veahavta lereacha kamocha lechal nefesh miyyisrael lemiggadol vead katan

Ki meachar sheggufo nimas umtoav etzlo vehannefesh veharuach mi yodea gedullatan umaalatan besharshan umkoran belokim chayyim besheggam shekkullan matimot veav echad lechullana velachen nikreu kal yisrael achim mammash mitztzad shoresh nafsham ba echad rak shehaggufim mechullakim velachen haosim gufam ikar venafsham tefela i efshar lihot ahava veachava amitit benehem ella hatteluya vedavar levaddah

Vezehu sheamar hillel hazzaken al kiyyum mitzva zo zehu kal hattora chullah veidach perusha hu chu ki yesod veshoresh kal hattora hu lehagbiha ulhaalot hannefesh al hagguf mala mala ad ikara vesharsha dechal almin vegam lehamshich or-en-sof baruch-hu bichneset yisrael kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman dehayenu bimkor nishmot kal yisrael lemeheve echad beechad daveka velo kesheyyesh perud chas veshalom banneshamot dekudsha-berich-hu la sharya baatar pegim uchmo sheomrim barchenu avinu kullanu keechad beor panecha uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut

Uma shekkatuv baggemara shemmi sheroe bachavero shechata mitzva lisnoto vegam lomar lerabbo sheyyisnaehu hayenu bachavero betora umitzot uchvar kiyyem bo mitzvat hocheach tochiach et amitecha am sheittecha betora uvmitzot veaf-al-pi-chen lo shav mecheto kemo shekkatuv besefer charedim

Aval mi sheeno chavero veeno mekorav etzlo hinne al ze amar hillel hazzaken heve mittalmidav shel aharon ohev shalom vechu ohev et habberiyyot umkarvan lattora lomar sheaf harchokim mittorat vaavodato velachen nikraim beshem beriyyot bealma tzarich lemashchan bechavle avotot ahava vechulle hay veulay yuchal lekarvan letora vaavodat vehen la lo hifsid sechar mitzvat ahavat reim

Vegam hamkoravim elav vehochicham velo shavu meaonotehem shemmitzva lisnotam mitzva leahovam gam ken ushtehen hen emet sina mitztzad hara shebbahem veahava mitztzad bechinat hattov hagganuz shebbahem shehu nitzotz elokut shebbetocham hamchayye nafsham haelokit vegam leorer rachamim belibbo aleha ki hi bivchinat galut betoch hara missitra achora haggover aleha barshaim veharachamanut mevattelet hassina umoreret haahava kannoda mimma shekkatuv leyaakov asher pada et avraham
Velo amar david hammelech alav hashshalom tachlit sina senetim vego ella al hamminim vehaeppikorsim sheen lahem chelek belohe yisrael kidita baggemara resh perek deshabbat
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 33: Od zot tihye simchat hannefesh haamitit uvifrat kesheroe benafsho beittim mezummanim shetztzarich lezakkechah ulhairah besimchat levav azay yaamik machashavto vitzayyer besichlo uvinato inyan yichudo yitbarech haamiti ech hu memalle kal almin elonim vetachtonim vaafilu melo kal haaretz hallezu hu kevodo yitbarech vechulla kammeh kela chashiv mammash vehu levaddo hu baelonim vetachtonim mammash kemo shehaya levaddo kodem sheshet yeme vereshit vegam bammakom hazze shennivra vo olam hazze hashshamayim vehaaretz vechal tzevaam haya hu levaddo memalle hammakom hazze vegam atta ken hu levaddo beli shum shinuy kelal

Mippene shekkal hannivraim betelim etzlo bimtziut mammash kevitul otiyyot haddibbur vehammachashava bimkoran vesharshan hu mahut hannefesh veatzmutah shehen eser bechinoteha chachma bina vadaat chu sheen bahem bechinat otiyyot adayin kodem shemmitlabbeshot bilvush hammachashava kemo shennitbaer bifrakim vech baarichut ayyen sham uchmo shennitbaer gam ken bemakom acher mashal gashmi laze meinyan bitul ziv veor hashshemesh bimkoro hu guf kaddur hashshemesh shebbarakia sheggam sham meir umitpashshet vadday zio veoro uvyeter seet mehitpashshetuto vehearato bachalal haolam ella sheshsham hu batel bimtziut bimkoro uchilu eno bimtziut kelal
Vechacha mammash derech mashal hu bitul haolam umloo bimtziut legabbe mekro shehu or-en-sof baruch-hu uchmo shennitbaer sham baarichut

Vehinne kesheyyaamik baze harbe yismach libbo vetagel nafsho af gilat verannen bechal lev venefesh umod beemuna zo ki rabba hi ki hi kirvat elohim mammash veze kal haadam vetachlit beriato uvriat kal haolamot elonim vetachtonim lihot lo dira zo battachtonim kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman baarichut

Vehinne kamma gedola simchat hedot ushfal anashim behitkarvuto lemelech basar vadam hammitachsen vedar itto immo beveto vekal vachomer leen ketz lekirvat vedirat melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu uchdichtiv ki mi hu ze asher arav libbo lageshet elay neum

Veal ze tiknu liten shevach vehodaya lishmo yitbarech bechal boker velomar ashrenu ma tov chelkenu vechu uma yafa yerushshatenu kelomar kemo shehaadam sas vesameach birushsha shennafla lo hon atek shello amal bo ken veoter mikken leen ketz yesh lanu lismoach al yerushshatenu shehinchilunu avotenu hu yichud haamiti asher afilu baaretz mittachat en od millevaddo vezo hi dirato battachtonim

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha taryag mitzot nitnu leyisrael ba chavakkuk veheemidan al achat shenneemar vetzaddik beemunato yichye kelomar keillu enah rak mitzva achat hi haemuna levaddah ki al yede haemuna levaddah yavo lekiyyum kal hattaryag mitzot

Dehayenu kesheyyihye libbo sas vesameach beemunato beyichud betachlit hassimcha keillu lo hayeta alav rak mitzva zo levaddah vehi levaddah tachlit beriato uvriat kal haolamot hare bechoach vechayyut nafsho besimcha rabba zo titalle nafsho lemala mala al kal hammonim kiyyum kal hattaryag mitzot mibbayit umichutz

Vezehu sheamar beemunato yichye yichye dayeka kitchiyyat hammetim derech mashal kach tichye nafsho besimcha rabba zo vehi simcha kefula umchuppelet ki millevad simchat hannefesh hammaskelet bekirvat vedirato itto immo od zot yismach bechiflayim besimchat vegodel nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech beemuna zo deitkafya sitra achora mammash veithappech chashocha linhora shehu choshech hakkelipot shebbaolam hazze hachumri hammachashichim umchassim al oro yitbarech ad et ketz kemo shekkatuv ketz sam lachoshech dehayenu ketz hayyamin sheyyaavir ruach hattuma min haaretz venigla kevod verau chal basar yachdav uchmo sheyyitbaer lekamman
Uvifrat bechutz laaretz sheavir eretz haammim tame umale kelipot vesitra achora veen simcha lefanav yitbarech keora vesimcha beyitron or habba min hachoshech dayeka
Vezehu shekkatuv yismach yisrael beosav perush shekkal mi shehu mizzera yisrael yesh lo lismoach besimchat asher sas vesameach bedirato battachtonim shehem bechinat asiyya gashmiyyit mammash

Vezehu shekkatuv beosav leshon rabbim shehu olam hazze haggashmi hammale kelipot vesitra achora shennikra reshut harabbim veture difruda veithappechan linhora venaasim reshut hayyachid leyichudo yitbarech beemuna zo
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 34: Vehinne mudaat zot shehaavot hen hen hammerkava shekkal yemehem leolam lo hifsiku afilu shaa achat millekashsher datam venishmatam leribbon haolamim babbitul hannizkar leel leyichudo yitbarech

Veacharehem kal hanneviim kal echad lefi madregat nishmato vehassagato umadregat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom hi haola al kullana sheamru alav shechina medabberet mittoch gerono shel moshe umeen ze zachu yisrael bemaamad har sinay rak shello yachlu lisbol kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheal kal dibur parcha nishmatan chu shehu inyan bitul bimtziut hannizkar leel
Lachen miyyad amar lahem laasot lo mishkan uvo kadshe hakkodashim lehashraat shechinato shehu giluy yichudo yitbarech kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman

Umishshecharav bet hammikdash en lehakkadosh-baruch-hu beolamo mishkan umachon leshivto hu yichudo yitbarech ella arba ammot shel halacha shehu retzono yitbarech vechachmato hamlubbashim bahalachot haaruchot lefanenu velachen achar sheyyaamik haadam machashavto beinyan bitul hannizkar leel kefi yechalto zot yashiv el libbo ki mihot katan sichli veshoresh nishmati mehachil lihot merkava umishkan leyichudo yitbarech beemet laamito meachar delet machashava dili tefisa umasseget bo yitbarech kelal uchlal shum hassaga baolam velo shemetz menhu mehassagat haavot vehanneviim e lazot eese lo mishkan umachon leshivto hu haesek betalmud tora kefi happenay shelli bikviut ittim bayyom uvallayela kedat hannitna lechal echad veechad behilchot talmud tora uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha afilu perek echad shacharit chu
Uvaze yismach libbo veyagil veyitten hodaa al chelko besimcha uvtuv levav al shezzacha lihot ushpezichan laggevura paamayim bechal yom kefi haet vehappenay shello kemissat yado asher hirchiv lo

Veim yarchiv lo od azay tehor yadayim yosif ometz umachashava tova chu vegam shear hayyom kullo sheosek bemassa umattan yihye machon leshivto yitbarech bintinat hatztzedaka sheyyitten migio shehi mimmiddotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu ma hu rachum vechu uchmo shekkatuv battikunim chesed deroa yemina

Veaf sheeno noten ella chomesh hare hachomesh maale immo kal haarba yadot la lihot machon leshivto yitbarech kannoda maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shemmitzvat tzedaka shekula keneged kal hakkarbanot uvkarbanot haya kal hachay ole la al yede behema achat vechal hatztzomeach al yede issaron solet echad balul bashshemen chu umillevad ze hare bishat hattora vehattefilla ole la kal ma sheachal veshata venehena mearba hayyadot livriut gufo kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman

Vehinne bechal perate mine simchot hannefesh hannizkarim leel en mehen menia lihot nivze veenav nimas velev nishbar veruach nemucha bishat hassimcha mammash meachar ki heoto nivze veenav vechu hu mitztzad hagguf venefesh habbahamit veheoto besimcha hu mitztzad nefesh haelohit venitzotz elohut hamlubbash bah lehachaotah kannizkar leel beferek
Uchhay gavena ita bazzohar bechiyya tekia belibbae missitra da vechedva tekia belibbae missitra da
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 35: Vehinne letosefet beur tevat laasoto vegam lehavin meat mizzeer tachlit beriat habbenonim viridat nishmotehem laolam hazze lehitlabbesh bannefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelipa vesitra achora meachar shello yuchlu leshallechah kal yemehem velidchotah mimmekomah mechalal hassemali shebballev shello yaalu mimmenna hirhurim el hammoach ki mahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh habbahamit shemmehakkelipa hi betakpah uvigvuratah etzlam ketoladtah rak shellevusheha enam mitlabbeshim begufam kannizkar leel veim ken lamma ze yardu nishmotehem laolam hazze liga larik chas veshalom lehillachem kal yemehem im hayyetzer velo yachlu lo
Uthi zot nechamatam lenachamam bechiflayim letushiyya ulsammeach libbam ba hashshochen ittam betoch toratam vaavodatam

Vehu behakdim leshon hayyannuka bazzohar parashat balak al pasuk hechacham enav berosho vechi bean atar enoy devar nash chu ella kera hache hu vadday ditnan lo yehach bar nash begiluya deresha arba ammot may taama dishchinta sharya al resheh vechal chacham enohi umiloy beresheh inun behahu desharya vekayema al resheh vechad enoy tamman linda dehahu nehora deadlik al resheh itzterich lemishcha begin degufa devar nash ihu petila unhora adlik leela ushlomo malka tzavach veamar veshemen al roshcha al yechsar deha nehora divrosho itzterich lemishcha veinun ovadan tavan veal da hechacham enav berosho ad kan leshono

Vehinne beur mashal ze shehimshil or hashshechina leor hanner sheeno meir veneechaz bappetila beli shemen vechach en hashshechina shora al guf haadam shennimshal liftila ella al yede maasim tovim daveka velo day lo benishmato shehi chelek eloha mimmaal lihot hi keshemen lappetila mevoar umuvan lechal maskil ki hinne nishmat haadam afilu hu tzaddik gamur oved beyira veahava bettaanugim af-al-pi-chen enah betela bimtziut legamre libatel velikalel beor mammash lihot laachadim umuchadim beyichud gamur rak hu davar bifne atzmo yere veohavo ma sheen ken hammitzot umaasim tovim shehen retzono yitbarech urtzono yitbarech hu mekor hachayyim lechal haolamot vehabberuim sheyyored alehem al yede tzimtzumim rabbim vehester panim shel ratzon haelon baruch-hu viridat hammadregot ad sheyyuchlu lehithauot ulhibbarot yesh meayin vedavar nifrad bifne atzmo velo yibbatlu bimtziut kannizkar leel ma sheen ken hammitzot shehen penimit retzono yitbarech veen sham hester panim kelal en hachayyut shebbahem davar nifrad bifne atzmo kelal ella hu meuchad venichlal birtzono yitbarech vehau laachadim mammash beyichud gamur

Vehinne inyan hashraat hashshechina hu giluy elohuto yitbarech veor en-sof baruch-hu beeze davar vehayenu lomar sheoto davar nichlal beor uvatel lo bimtziut legamre sheaz hu sheshshore umitgalle bo echad aval kal ma shello vatel elav bimtziut legamre en or shore umitgalle bo veaf tzaddik gamur shemmitdabbek bo beahava rabba hare let machashava tefisa veh kelal beemet ki amitat elohim emet hu yichudo veachduto shehu levaddo hu veefes bilado mammash

Veim ken ze haohev shehu yesh velo efes let machashava dileh tefisa veh kelal veen or shore umitgalle bo ella al yede kiyyum hammitzot shehen retzono vechachmato yitbarech mammash beli shum hester panim

Vechaasher shamatti mimmori lav hashshalom perush vetam lema shekkatuv betz chayyim sheor-en-sof baruch-hu eno mityached afilu beolam haatzilut ella l yede hitlabbeshuto techilla bisfirat chachma vehayenu mishshum sheen-sof baruch-hu hu echad haemet shehu levaddo hu veen zulato vezo hi madregat hachachma vechu

Vehinne keshehaadam osek battora azay nishmato shehi nafsho haelohit im shene levusheha happenimim levaddam shehem koach haddibbur umachashava nichlalot beor en-sof baruch-hu umuchadot bo beyichud gamur vehi hashraat hashshechina al nafsho haelohit kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheafilu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora shechina immo

Ach kede lehamshich or vehearat hashshechina gam al gufo venafsho habbahamit shehi hachiyyunit hamlubbeshet begufo mammash tzarich lekayyem mitzot maasiyyot hannaasot al yede hagguf mammash sheaz koach hagguf mammash shebbaasiyya zo nichlal beor urtzono umuchad bo beyichud gamur vehu levush hashshelishi shel nefesh haelohit

Vaazay gam koach nefesh hachiyyunit shebbegufo mammash shemmikkelipat nogah nithappech mera letov venichlal mammash bikdushsha kannefesh haelohit mammash meachar shehu hu happoel veose maase hammitzva shebbilado lo hayeta nefesh haelohit poelet bagguf kelal ki hi ruchaniyyit vehagguf gashmi vechumri vehammutztza benehem hi nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit hamlubbeshet bedam haadam shebbelibbo vechal hagguf

Veaf shemmahutah veatzmutah shel nefesh habbahamit shebbelibbo shehen middoteha haraot adayin lo nichlelu bikdushsha mikkal makom meachar deitkafyan likdushsha uval karchan onin amen umaskimin umitratztzin laasiyyat hammitzva al yede hitgabberut nafsho haelohit shebbammoach sheshshallit al hallev vehen beshaa zo bivchinat galut veshena kannizkar leel ulchach en zo menia mehashraat hashshechina al guf haadam beshaa zo

Dehayenu shekkoach nefesh hachiyyunit hamlubbash baasiyyat hammitzva hu nichlal mammash beor umuchad bo beyichud gamur veal yede ze mamshich heara lichlalut nefesh hachiyyunit shebbechal hagguf vegam al hagguf haggashmi bivchinat makkif milmala merosho vead raglav vezehu shekkatuv dishchinta sharya al resheh al dayeka vechen akkal be asara shechinta sharya

Vehinne kal bechinat hamshachat or hashshechina shehi bechinat giluy or-en-sof baruch-hu eno nikra shinuy chas veshalom bo yitbarech velo ribuy kidita besanhedrin deamar leh hahu mina lerabban gamliel amritu kal be asara shechinta sharya kamma shechinta it lechu veheshiv lo mashal meor hashshemesh hannichnas bechallonot rabbim chu vehammaskil yavin
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 36: Vehinne mudaat zot maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shettachlit beriat olam hazze hu shennitava hakkadosh-baruch-hu lihot lo dira battachtonim
Vehinne lo shayyach lefanav yitbarech bechinat mala umatta ki hu yitbarech memalle kal almin beshave

Ella beur hainyan ki kodem shennivra haolam haya hu levaddo yitbarech yachid umuchad ummalle kal hammakom hazze shebbara bo haolam vegam atta ken hu lefanav yitbarech rak shehashshinuy hu el hamkabbelim chayyuto veoro yitbarech shemmekabbelim al yede levushim rabbim hamchassim umastirim oro yitbarech kedichtiv ki lo yirani haadam vachay vechidfershu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheafilu malachim hannikraim chayyot en roin chu

Vezehu inyan hishtalshelut haolamot viridatam mimmadrega lemadrega al yede ribuy hallevushim hammastirim haor vehachayyut shemmimmennu yitbarech ad shennivra olam hazze haggashmi vehachumri mammash vehu hattachton bammadrega sheen tachton lematta mimmennu beinyan hester oro yitbarech vechoshech kaful umchuppal ad shehu male kelipot vesitra achora shehen neged mammash lomar ani veafsi od

Vehinne tachlit hishtalshelut haolamot viridatam mimmadrega lemadrega eno bishvil olamot haelonim hoil velahem yerida meor panav yitbarech ella hattachlit hu olam hazze hattachton shekkach ala birtzono yitbarech lihot nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech kad itkafya sitra achora veithappech chashocha linhora sheyyair or en-sof baruch-hu bimkom hachoshech vehassitra achora shel kal olam hazze kullo beyeter seet veyeter oz veyitron or min hachoshech mehearato beolamot elonim shemmeir sham al yede levushim vehester panim hammastirim umaalimim or-en-sof baruch-hu shello yibbatlu bimtziut

Velaze natan hakkadosh-baruch-hu leyisrael et hattora shennikret oz vechoach uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shehakkadosh-baruch-hu noten koach batztzaddikim lekabbel secharam leatid lavo shello yitbattelu bimtziut mammash beor hannigle leatid beli shum levush kedichtiv velo yikkanef od morecha perush shello yitkasse mimmecha bechanaf ulvush vehau enecha root et morecha uchtiv ki ayin beayin yiru vego uchtiv lo yihye lach od hashshemesh leor yomam vego ki yihye lach leor olam vego
Venoda sheyemot hammashiach uvifrat kesheyyichu hammetim hem tachlit ushlemut beriat olam hazze shellechach nivra mittechilato
Vekabbalat sachar ykaro baelef hashsheviyi kemo shekkatuv belikkute tora mehaari zichrono livracha

Vegam kevar haya leolamim meen ze bishat mattan tora kedichtiv atta hareta ladaat ki hu haelohim en od millevaddo hareta mammash biriyya chushiyyit kedichtiv vechal haam roim et hakkolot roim et hannishma ufershu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha mistakkelim lammizrach veshomin et haddibbur yotze anochi chu vechen learba ruchot ulmala ulmatta vechidfershu battikunim delet atar dela mallel mineh immehon chu

Vehayenu mippene giluy retzono yitbarech baaseret haddibberot shehen kelalut hattora shehi penimit retzono yitbarech vechachmato veen sham hester panim kelal kemo shenneemar ki veor panecha natatta lanu torat chayyim velachen hau betelim bimtziut mammash kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheal kal dibbur parcha nishmatan chu ella shehechezirah hakkadosh-baruch-hu lahen betal sheatid lehachaot bo et hammetim vehu tal tora shennikra oz kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha kal haosek battora tal tora mechayyehu chu

Rak sheachar kach garam hachet venitgashshemu hem vehaolam ad et ketz hayyamin sheaz yizdakkech gashmiyyut hagguf vehaolam veuchlu lekabbel giluy or sheyyair leyisrael al yede hattora shennikret oz umiyyitron haheara leyisrael yaggiha chshech haummot gam ken kedichtiv vehalchu goyim leorech vego uchtiv bet yaakov lechu venelcha beor uchtiv venigla kevod verau chal basar yachdav vego uchtiv lavo benikrot hatztzurim uvisife hasselaim mippene pachad vahadar geono vego uchmo sheomrim vehofa bahadar geon uzzecha al kal yoshve tevel artzecha vego
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 37: Vehinne tachlit hashshelemut hazze shel yemot hammashiach utchiyyat hammetim shehu giluy or-en-sof baruch-hu baolam hazze haggashmi taluy bemaasenu vaavodatenu kal zeman meshech haggalut

Ki haggorem sechar hammitzva hi hammitzva beatzmah ki baasiyyatah mamshich haadam giluy or-en-sof baruch-hu milmala lematta lehitlabbesh begashmiyyut olam hazze bedavar shehaya techilla tachat memshelet kelipat nogah umkabbel chayyutah mimmenna shehem kal devarim hattehorim umuttarim shennaaset bahem hammitzva maasiyt kegon kelaf hattefilin umzuza vesefer tora uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lo huchshar limlechet shamayim ella tehorim umuttarim beficha vechen etrog sheeno arla
Sheharla hi mishshalosh kelipot hattemeot legamre sheen lahem liyya leolam kemo shekkatuv betz chayyim vechen kal mitzva habbaa bavera chas veshalom
Umaot hatztzedaka sheenan gezel vechayyotze vahem

Veachshav shemmekayyem bahem mitzvat urtzono hare hachayyut shebbahem ole umitbattel venichlal beor-en-sof baruch-hu shehu retzono yitbarech hamlubbash bahem meachar sheen sham bechinat hester panim kelal lehastir oro yitbarech

Vechen koach nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shebbeevre guf haadam hamkayyem hammitzva hu mitlabbesh gam ken baasiyya zo veole mehakkelipa venichlal bikdushshat hammitzva shehi retzono yitbarech uvatel beor-en-sof baruch-hu

Vegam bemitzot talmud tora ukriat shema utfilla vechayyotze vahen af sheenan baasiyya gashmit mammash shettachat memshelet kelipat nogah mikkal makom ha kayema lan dehirhur lav kedibbur dame veeno yotze yede chovato ad sheyyotzi bisfatav vekayema lan daakimat sefatav have maase ki i efshar lannefesh haelohit levatte bisfatayim ufe velashon veshinayim haggashmiyyim ki im al yede nefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit hamlubbeshet beevre hagguf mammash vechal ma shemmedabber bechoach gadol yoter hu machnis umalbish yoter kochot minnefesh hachiyyunit bediburim ellu

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv kal atzmotay tomarna vego vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha im arucha bechal ramach evarim mishtammeret veim lav enah mishtammeret ki hashshichcha hi mikkelipat hagguf venefesh hachiyyunit habbahamit shehen mikkelipat nogah hannichlelet lifamim bikdushsha vehayenu keshemmattish kochan umachnis kal kochan bikdushshat hattora o hattefilla

Zot veod acheret shekkoach nefesh hachiyyunit hammitlabbeshet beotiyyot haddibbur betalmud tora o tefilla vechayyotze vahen o mitzot maasiyyot hare kal gidulo vechayyuto mehaddam shehu mikkelipat nogah mammash shehen kal ochalin umashkin sheachal veshata venaasu dam shehau tachat memshaltah veyanku chayyutam mimmenna veatta hi mithappechet mera letov venichlelet bikdushsha al yede koach nefesh hachiyyunit haggadel mimmenna shennitlabbesh beotiyyot ellu o baasiyya zo asher hen hen penimiyyut retzono yitbarech beli shum hester panim vechayyutan nichlal gam ken beor-en-sof baruch-hu shehu retzono yitbarech uvchayyutan nichlal veole gam ken koach nefesh hachiyyunit

Veal yede ze taale gam ken kelalut kelipat nogah shehi kelalut hachayyut shel olam hazze haggashmi vehachumri kaasher kal hanneshama venefesh haelohit shebbechal yisrael hammitchalleket bifratut leshishshim ribbo tekayyem kal nefesh peratit kal taryag mitzot hattora

Shasa lo taase lehafrid shasa gidim shel dam nefesh hachiyyunit shebbagguf shello yinku vikabbelu chayyut baavera zo meachat mishshalosh kelipot hattemeot legamre shemmehen nishpaim shasa lo taase deorayeta veanfehen shehen midderabbanan veshuv lo tuchal nefesh hachiyyunit laalot el im nitmea betumat hashshalosh kelipot hattemeot sheen lahen aliyya leolam ki im bitul vehaavara legamre kemo shekkatuv veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz veramach mitzot ase lehamshich or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta lehaalot lo ulkashsher ulyached bo kelalut hannefesh hachiyyunit shebberamach evre hagguf beyichud gamur lihot laachadim mammash kemo sheala birtzono yitbarech lihot lo dira battachtonim vehem lo lemerkava kemo haavot

Umeachar shekkelalut nefesh hachiyyunit shebbichlalut yisrael tihye merkava kedosha la azay gam kelalut hachayyut shel olam hazze shehi kelipat nogah achshav tetze az mittumatah vechelatah vetaale likdushsha lihot merkava la behitgallut kevodo verau chal basar yachdav veofia alehem bahadar geon uzzo veyimmale chevod et kal haaretz veyisrael yiru ayin beayin kivmattan tora dichtiv atta hareta ladaat ki hu haelohim en od millevaddo
Veal yede ze yitballeu veyitbattelu legamre kal hashshalosh kelipot hattemeot ki yenikatan vechayyutan mehakkedushsha achshav hi al yede kelipat nogah hammutztzaat benehen

Venimtza ki kal tachlit shel yemot hammashiach utchiyyat hammetim shehu giluy kevodo velohuto yitbarech ulhaavir ruach hattuma min haaretz taluy behamshachat elohuto veor-en-sof baruch-hu lannefesh hachiyyunit shebbichlalut yisrael bechal ramach evareha al yede kiyyumah kal ramach mitzot ase ulhaavir ruach hattuma mimmenna bishmiratah kal shasa mitzot lo taase shello yinku mimmenna shasa gideha

Ki kelalut yisrael shehem shishshim ribbo neshamot peratiyyot hem kelalut hachayyut shel kelalut haolam ki bishvilam nivra vechal perat mehem hu kolel veshayyach lo hachayyut shel chelek echad mishshishshim ribbo mikkelalut haolam hattaluy benafsho hachiyyunit lehaaloto la baaliyyatah dehayenu bema shemmishtammesh meolam hazze letzorech gufo venafsho hachiyyunit laavodat kegon achila ushtiyya vedomehem vedira vechal kele tashmishav

Ella sheshshishshim ribbo neshamot peratiyyot ellu hen sharashim vechal shoresh mitchallek leshishshim ribbo nitzotzot shekkal nitzotz hu neshama achat vechen benefesh veruach bechal olam mearba olamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya

Vechal nitzotz lo yarad laolam hazze af shehi yerida gedola uvchinat galut mammash ki gam sheyyihye tzaddik gamur oved beyira veahava rabba betaanugim lo yaggia lemaalot devekuto ba bidchilu urchimu beterem yeridato laolam hazze hachumri lo minah velo miktzatah veen erech vedimon benehem kelal kannoda lechal maskil shehagguf eno yachol lisbol chu ella yeridato laolam hazze lehitlabbesh bagguf venefesh hachiyyunit hu kede letakkenam bilvad ulhafridam mehara shel shalsh kelipot hattemeot al yede shemirat shasa lo taase veanfehen ulhaalot nafsho hachiyyunit im chelkah hashshayyach lah mikkelalut olam hazze ulkashsheram ulyachadam beor-en-sof baruch-hu asher yamshich bahem al yede kiyyumo kal ramach mitzot ase benafsho hachiyyunit shehi hi hamkayyemet kal mitzot maasiyyot kannizkar leel

Uchmo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar ki hanneshama atzmah enah tzericha tikun kelal chu velo hutzrecha lehitlabbesh baolam hazze vechu rak lehamshich or letakkenam chu vehu mammash dugmat sod galut hashshechina levarer nitzotzin vechu

Uvaze yuvan ma shehifligu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha bimod meod bemaalat hatztzedaka veamru sheshshekula keneged kal hamitzot uvchal talmud yerushalmi hi nikret beshem mitzva setam ki kach haya hergel hallashon likro tzedaka beshem mitzva setam mippene shehi ikar hammitzot maasiyyot veola al kullana shekkullan hen rak lehaalot nefesh hachiyyunit la shehi hi hamkayyemet otan umitlabbeshet bahen likalel beor-en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash bahen veen lecha mitzva shennefesh hachiyyunit mitlabbeshet bah kal kach kivmitzvat hatztzedaka shebbechal hammitzot en mitlabbesh bahen rak koach echad minnefesh hachiyyunit bishat maase hammitzva levad aval bitzdaka sheadam noten migia kappav hare kal koach nafsho hachiyyunit melubbash baasiyyat melachto o esek acher shennistakker bo maot ellu uchshennotnan litzdaka hare kal nafsho hachiyyunit ola la
Vegam mi sheeno nehene migio mikkal makom hoil uvmaot ellu haya yachol liknot chayye nafsho hachiyyunit hare noten chayye nafsho la

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shemmekarevet et haggeulla lefi shebbitzdaka achat maale harbe minnefesh hachiyyunit ma shello haya yachol lehaalot mimmenna kal kach kochot uvchinot bechamma mitzot maasiyyot acherot

Uma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shettalmud tora keneged kullam hayenu mippene shettalmud tora hi bedibbur umachashava shehem levushim happenimim shel nefesh hachiyyunit vegam mahutan veatzmutan shel bechinot chachma-bina-daat mikkelipat nogah shebbannefesh hachiyyunit nichlalot bikdushsha mammash kesheosek battora beiyyun vesechel

Veaf shemmahutan veatzmutan shel hammiddot chesed gevura tiferet chu lo yachlu lahem habbenonim lehappecham likdushsha hayenu mishshum shehara chazak yoter bammiddot mibbechachma-bina-daat mippene yenikatan sham mehakkedushsha yoter kayyadua leode chen

Zot veod acheret vehi haola al kullana bemaalat esek talmud tora al kal hamitzot al pi ma shennizkar leel beshem hattikunim deramach pikudin hen ramach evarin demalka uchmo baadam hattachton derech mashal en erech vedimon kelal ben hachayyut shebberamach evarav legabbe hachayyut shebbammochin shehu hassechel hammitchallek leg bechinot chachma-bina-daat kacha mammash derech mashal lehavdil berivvot havdalot leen ketz behearat or-en-sof baruch-hu hammitlabbeshot bemitzot maasiyyot legabbe hearat or-en-sof shebbivchinat chachma-bina-daat shebbechachmat hattora ish ish kefi sichlo vehassagato
Veaf sheeno massig ella begashmiyyut hare hattora nimshela lemayim sheyyordim mimmakom gavoha chu kemo shennitbaer leel

Veaf-al-pi-chen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lo hammidrash ikar ella hammaase vehayyom laasotam ketiv umvattelin talmud tora lekiyyum mitzva maasiyt keshei efshar laasotah al yede acherim mishshum ki ze kal haadam vetachlit beriato viridato laolam hazze lihot lo yitbarech dira battachtonim daveka leahafacha chashocha linhora veyimmale chevod et kal haaretz haggashmit dayeka verau chal basar yachdav kannizkar leel

Ma sheen ken kesheefshar laasotah al yede acherim en mevattelin talmud tora af shekkal hattora enah ella perush hammitzot maasiyyot vehayenu mishshum shehi bechinat chachma-bina-daat shel en-sof baruch-hu uvasko bah mamshich alav or-en-sof baruch-hu beyeter seet veheara gedola leen ketz meheara vehamshacha al yede pikkudin shehen evarin demalka vezehu sheamar rav sheshet chadai nafshai lach karai lach tanai kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut

Vehinne hamshacha veheara zo shehaadam mamshich umeir mehearat or-en-sof baruch-hu al nafsho veal nafshot kal yisrael hi hashshechina keneset yisrael mekor kal nishmot yisrael kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman al yede esek hattora nikret bilshon keria kore battora perush sheal yede esek hattora kore lehakkadosh-baruch-hu lavo elav kivyachol keadam hakkore lachavero sheyyavo elav uchven katan hakkore leaviv lavo elav lihot immo betzaveta chada velo lipared mimmennu velishaer yechidi chas veshalom

Vezehu shekkatuv karov lechal korav lechol asher yikrauhu veemet veen emet ella tora dehayenu shekkore lehakkadosh-baruch-hu al yede hattora daveka leappuke mi shekkore oto shello al yede esek hattora ella tzoek kach abba abba uchmo shekkovel alav hannavi veen kore veshimcha chu uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher umizze yitbonen hammaskil lehamshich alav yira gedola bishat esek hattora kemo shennitbaer leel perek
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 38: Vehinne im kal hannichtav leel yuvan hetev pesak hahalacha haarucha battalmud ufoskim dehirhur lav kedibbur dame veim kara keriat shema bemachashavto uvlibbo levad bechal koach kavanato lo yatza yede chovato vetzarich lachazor velikrot vechen bevirkat hammazon deorayeta uvishar berachot derabbanan uvitfilla veim hotzi bisfatav velo kiven libbo yatza yede chovato bediavad veen tzarich lachazor levad mippasuk rishon shel keriat shema uvracha rishona shel tefillat shemone esre vechidita beresh perek divrachot ad kan mitzvat kavana mikkan veelach mitzvat keria vechu

Vehayenu mishshum shehanneshama enah tzericha tikun leatzmah bammitzot rak lehamshich or letakken nefesh hachiyyunit vehagguf al yede otiyyot haddibbur shehannefesh medabberet be motzaot happe vechen bemitzot maasiyyot shehannefesh osa bishar evre hagguf

Ach af-al-pi-chen amru tefilla o shear beracha belo chavana hen keguf belo neshama perush ki kemo shekkal habberuim shebbaolam hazze sheyyesh lahem guf unshama shehem nefesh kal chay veruach kal besar ish venishmat kal asher ruach chayyim beappav mikkal baale chayyim va mechayye et kullam umhave otam meayin leyesh tamid beor vechayyut shemmashpia bahem sheggam hagguf hachumri vaafilu avanim veafar haddomem mammash yesh bo or vechayyut mimmennu yitbarech shello yachazor lihot ayin vaefes keshehaya veaf-al-pi-chen en erech vedimon kelal ben bechinat or vechayyut hammeir bagguf legabbe bechinat or vechayyut hammeir banneshama shehi nefesh kal chay

Veaf shebbishnehem or echad shave bivchinat hester panim ulvushim shavim shehaor mistatter umitallem umitlabbesh bo ki shenehem hem meolam hazze shebbichlaluto mistatter beshave haor vehachayyut shemmeruach piv yitbarach bivchinat hester panim viridat hammadregot behishtalshelut haolamot mimmadrega lemadrega betzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim ad shennitlabbesh biklipat nogah lehachaot kelalut olam hazze hachumri dehayenu kal devarim hammuttarim vehattehorim shebbaolam hazze umimmenna veal yadah mushpaim devarim hattemeim ki hi bechina memutztzaat kannizkar leel
Af-al-pi-chen haheara shehi hamshachat hachayyut asher meir umchayye derech levush ze enah shava bechullan bivchinat tzimtzum vehitpashshetut

Ki bagguf haggashmi vehaddomem mammash kaavanim veafar haheara hi bivchinat tzimtzum gadol asher en kamohu vehachayyut shebbo muetet kal kach ad sheen bo afilu koach hatztzomeach uvatztzomeach haheara enah betzimtzum gadol kal kach
Vederech kelal nechlakot learba madregot domem tzomeach chay medabber keneged otiyyot shem havaya baruch-hu shemmimmennu mushpaim

Uchmo sheen erech vedimon haheara vehamshachat hachayyut shebbedomem vetzomeach lehaheara vehamshachat hachayyut hamlubbeshet bechay umdabber af shebbechullan or echad shave bivchinat hester panim umlubbash bilvush echad bechullan shehu levush nogah kach en erech vedimon kelal ben hearat vehamshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu shehu penimiyyut retzono yitbarech beli hester panim ulvush kelal hammeira umlubbeshet bemitzot maasiyyot mammash vechen bemitzot hatteluot bedibbur uvituy sefatayim beli chavana shehu nechshav kemaase mammash kannizkar leel legabbe haheara vehamshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu hammeira umlubbeshet bechavanat hammitzot maasiyyot shehaadam mitkaven baasiyyatan kede ledavka bo yitbarech al yede kiyyum retzono shehu urtzono echad
Vechen bechavanat hattefilla ukriat shema uvirchoteha ushar berachot shebbechavanato bahen medabbek machashavto vesichlo bo yitbarech

Velo sheddevekut hammachashava vesechel haadam bo yitbarech hi mitztzad atzmah lemala middevekut kiyyum hammitzot maasiyyot befoal mammash kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman ella mippene shezzehu gam ken retzono yitbarech ledavka besechel umachashava vechavanat hammitzot maasiyyot uvchavanat keriat shema utfilla ushar berachot vehearat ratzon haelon hazze hammeira umlubbeshet bechavana zo hi gedola leen ketz lemala mala mehearat ratzon haelon hammeira umlubbeshet bekiyyum hammitzot atzman bemaase uvdibbur beli chavana kegodel maalat or hanneshama al hagguf shehu keli umalbush hanneshama kemo guf hammitzva atzmah shehu keli umalbush lechavanatah

Veaf shebbishtehen bammitzva uvchavanatah melubbash ratzon echad pashut betachlit happeshitut beli shum shinuy veribuy chas veshalom umuchad bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech betachlit hayyichud af-al-pi-chen haheara enah shava bivchinat tzimtzum vehitpashshetut

Uchmo shekkatuv betz chayyim shekkavanat hammitzot vetalmud tora hi bemadregat or veguf hammitzot hen madregot uvchinot kelim shehem bechinat tzimtzum shel yede tzimtzum haor nitihauu hakkelim kayyadva leode chen

Venechleket gam ken learba madregot ki guf hammitzot atzman mammash hen madregot shehen mitzot maasiyyot mammash umitzot hatteluot bedibbur umachashava kemo talmud tora ukriat shema utfilla uvirkat hammazon ushar berachot vechavanat hammitzot ledavka bo yitbarech shehi kinshama lagguf nechleket gam ken lishte madregot kemo shette madregot hanneshama shehen bagguf hachumri shehen chay umdabber

Ki mi sheddato yafa ladaat et ulhitbonen bigdullato yitbarech ulholid mibbinato yira ilaa bemocho veahavat bechalal hayemani shebbelibbo lihot nafsho tzemea la ledavka vo al yede kiyyum hattora vehammitzot shehen hamshachat vehearat or-en-sof baruch-hu al nafsho ledavka vo uvchavana zo hu lomed umkayyem hammitzot vechen bechavana zo mitpallel umvarech hare kavana zo al derech mashal kemo nishmat hamdabber shehu baal sechel uvchira uvdaat yedabber

Umi sheddato ketzara leda ulhitbonen bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu leholid haahava mibbinato behitgallut libbo vechen hayyira bemocho ufachad belibbo rak shezzocher umorer et haahava hattivit hamsutteret belibbo umotziah mehahelem vehester hallev el haggiluy bammoach al kal panim sheyyihye retzono shebbemocho vetaalumot libbo maskim umitratztze beritzuy gamur beemet laamito limsor nafsho befoal mammash al yichud kede ledavka vo nafsho haelohit ulvusheha ulchallan beyichudo veachduto shehu ratzon haelon hamlubbash betalmud tora uvkiyyum hammitzot kannizkar leel vegam hayyira kelula vah lekabbel malchuto shello limrod bo chas veshalom uvchavana zo hu sur mera veose tov velomed umitpallel umvarech beferush hammillot levaddo belo dechilu urchimu behitgallut libbo umocho hare kavana zo al derech mashal kemo nishmat hachay sheeno baal sechel uvchira vechal middotav shehen yirato middevarim hammazzikim oto veahavato laddevarim hanneehavim etzlo hen rak tiviyyim etzlo velo mibbinato vedato vechach hen al derech mashal hayyira vehaahava hattiviyyot hamsuttarot belev kal yisrael ki hen yerushsha lanu meavotenu uchmo teva benafshotenu kannizkar leel
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 39: Umippene ze gam ken nikraim hammalachim beshem chayyot uvhemot kedichtiv ufne arye el hayyamin vego ufne shor mehassemol vego lefi sheenam baale vechira veyiratam veahavatam hi tivit lahem kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat pinchas velachen maalat hatztzaddikim gedola mehem ki medor nishmot hatztzaddikim hu beolam habberia umdor hammalachim beolam hayetzira

Vehayenu bistam malachim aval yesh malachim leonim beolam habberia shevodatam bidchilu urchimu sichliyyim kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna sham sheyyesh shene mine chayyot hakkodesh tiviyyim vesichliyyim uchmo shekkatuv betz chayyim

Vehahevdel shebbenehem hu ki beolam hayetzira meirot sham middotav shel en-sof baruch-hu levaddan shehen ahavato ufachdo veyirato chu uchmo shekkatuv battikunim veetz chayyim deshit sefirin mekannenin bitzira

Velachen zot hi avodat hammalachim tamid yomam valayela lo yishkotu laamod beyira vafachad vechu vehayenu kal machane gavriel shemmehassemol vaavodat machane michael hi haahava chu aval beolam habberia meirot sham chachmato uvinato vedato shel en-sof baruch-hu shehen mekor hammiddot veem veshoresh lahen vechidita battikunim deima ilaa mekannena bitlat sefiran bechurseyya shehu olam habberia

Velachen hu medor nishmot hatztzaddikim ovde bidchilu urchimu hannimshachot min habbina vadaat digdullat en-sof baruch-hu sheahava zo nikra reuta delibba kannizkar leel umeruta delibba naase levush lanneshama beolam habberia shehu gan eden haelon kedilkamman uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar vayyakhel

Ach hayenu daveka neshamot mammash shehen bechinat mochin degadlut en-sof baruch-hu aval bechinat haruach shel hatztzaddikim vechen shear kal nishmot yisrael sheavdu et bidchilu urchimu hamsuttarot belev kelalut yisrael en olot lesham rak beshabbat verosh-chodesh levad derech haammud shemmiggan eden hattachton legan eden haelon shehu olam habberia hannikra gan eden haelon lehitanneg al velehanot mizziv hashshechina ki en hanaa vetaanug lesechel nivra ella bema shemmaskil umevin veodea umassig besichlo uvinato ma sheefshar lo lehavin ulhassig meor-en-sof baruch-hu al yede chachmato uvinato yitbarech hammeirot sham beolam habberia

Uma shezzochot neshamot ellu laalot lemala mehammalachim af sheavdu bidchilu urchimu tiviyyim levad hayenu mippene sheal yede dechilu urchimu shellahem itkafya sitra achora hamlubbeshet begufam ben bivchinat sur mera lichbosh hattaaot ulshabberan uven bivchinat vaase tov kannizkar leel vehem hau baale vechira livchor bera chas veshalom uvacharu betov leachpaya lesitra achora leistalleka yekara dekudsha berich-hu chu keyitron haor chu kannizkar leel

Vehinne kal ze hu bimdor hanneshamot umkom amidatan ach toratan vaavodatan nichlalot mammash be sefirot shehen bechinat elohut veor-en-sof mityached bahen betachlit hayyichud vehayenu be sefirot divria al yede dechilu urchimu sichliyyim uvy sefirot ditzira al yede dechilu urchimu tiviyyim uvtochan melubbashot sefirot daatzilut umuchadot bahen betachlit ve sefirot daatzilut meuchadot betachlit bemaatzilan en-sof baruch-hu

Ma sheen ken hanneshamot enan nichlalot belohut de sefirot ella omdot behechalot umdorin divria o yetzira venehenin mizziv hashshechina hu or-en-sof baruch-hu hamuchad be sefirot divria o ditzira vehu ziv toratan vaavodatan mammash ayyen zohar vayyakhel daf ki sechar mitzva hi mitzva atzmah

Veolam haatzilut shehu lemala mehassechel vehahassaga vehahavana lesechel nivra ki chachmato uvinato vedato shel en-sof baruch-hu meuchadot sham bo betachlit hayyichud beyichud atzum venifla beyeter seet veyeter oz leen ketz mibbeolam habberia ki sham yardu lehair bivchinat tzimtzum kede sheyyuchlu sechalim nivraim lekabbel mehen chachma-bina-daat leda et ulhavin ulhassig ezo hassaga beor-en-sof baruch-hu kefi koach sechalim hannivraim shehem baale gevul vetachlit shello yitbattelu bimtziutam velo yihu begeder nivraim kelal rak yachzeru limkoram vesharsham shehu bechinat elohut mammash
Vehinne tzimtzum ze hi sibbat haheara shemmeirot sham chachma-bina-daat shel en-sof baruch-hu linshamot ellu beolam habberia
Ma sheen ken baatzilut sheenam bivchinat tzimtzum kal kach i efshar lischalim nivraim lekabbel mehen velachen let machashavta dilhon tefisa sham kelal

Lachen hu mador latztzaddikim haggedolim sheavodatam hi lemala mala afilu mibbechinot dechilu urchimu hannimshachot min habbina vadaat bigdullato yitbarech kemo sheolam haatzilut hu lemala mala mibbechinat bina vadaat lesechel nivra ella avodatam hayeta bivchinat merkava mammash leen-sof baruch-hu velibatel elav bimtziut ulhikkalel beoro yitbarech hem vechal asher lahem al yede kiyyum hattora vehammitzot al derech sheamru haavot hen hen hammerkava vehayenu lefi shekkal yemehem hayeta zot avodatam

Ach mi sheshshoresh nishmato katan mehachil avoda tamma zo libatel velikalel beoro yitbarech baavodato bikviut rak lifrakim veittim shehem et ratzon lemala uchmo bitfillat shemone esre shehi baatzilut uvifrat behishtachavaot shebbah shekkal hishtachavaa hi bivchinat atzilut kemo shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim bekabbalat shabbat ki hi inyan bitul beoro yitbarech lihot chashiv kammeh kela mammash azay gam ken ikar keviut nishmato hu beolam habberia rak lifrakim beet ratzon taale nishmato laatzilut bivchinat mayyin nukvin kayyadua leode chen

Vehinne sechar mitzva mitzva perush shemmissecharah neda mahutah umadregatah veen lanu esek bannistarot shehem tzaddikim haggedolim shehem bivchinat merkava rak hanniglot lanu sheacharehem kal adam yimshoch leda neemana mahut umadregat avodat bidchilu urchimu behitgallut libbo hannimshachot min habbina vadaat bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu mekomah be sefirot divria vaavoda bidchilu urchimu hattiviyyim shebbemocho be sefirot ditzira

Aval avoda beli hitorrut dechilu urchimu afilu bemocho bivchinat giluy dehayenu leorer haahava hattivit hamsutteret ballev lehotziah mehahelem vehester hallev el haggiluy afilu bemocho vetaalumot libbo al kal panim rak hi nisheret mesutteret ballev ketoladtah kemo shehayeta kodem haavoda hare avoda zo nisheret lematta beolam happerud hannikra chitzoniyyut haolamot veen bah koach laalot velikalel beyichudo yitbarech shehen eser sefirot hakkedoshot uchmo shekkatuv battikunim divla dechilu urchimu la farcha leela vela yachla lesalka ulmekam kodam

Vehayenu afilu im eno osek shello lishmah mammash leshum ezo peniyya chas veshalom ella kemo shekkatuv vattehi yiratam oti mitzvat anashim melummada perush mechamat hergel shehurgal mikkatnuto shehirgilo velimdo aviv verabbo liro et ulavdo veeno osek lishmah mammash ki lishmah mammash i efshar belo hitorrut dechilu urchimu hattiviyyim al kal panim lehotzian mehester hallev el haggiluy bammoach vetaalumot libbo al kal panim ki kemo sheen adam ose davar bishvil chavero lemallot retzono ella im ken ohavo o yare mimmennu kach i efshar laasot lishmo yitbarech beemet lemallot retzono levad beli zichron vehitorrut ahavato veyirato kelal bemocho umachashavto vetaalumot libbo al kal panim
Vegam ahava levaddah enah nikret beshem avoda beli yira tattaa lefachot shehi mesutteret belev kal yisrael kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman

Uchsheosek shello lishmah mammash leshum ezo peniyya lichvod atzmo kegon lihot talmid chacham uchhay gavena azay otah peniyya shemmitztzad hakkelipa denogah mitlabbeshet betorato vehattora hi bivchinat galut betoch hakkelipa lefi shaa ad asher yaase teshuva shemmevia refua laolam shebbeshuvo el gam torato shava immo

Velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha leolam yaasok adam vechu shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah bevadday shebbevadday sofo laasot teshuva begilgul ze o begilgul acher ki lo yiddach mimmennu niddach

Ach kesheose setam lo lishmah velo shello lishmah en haddavar taluy bitshuva ella miyyad shechozer velomed davar ze lishmah hare gam ma shellamad bistam mitchabber umitztaref lelimud ze ufarcha leela meachar shello nitlabbesh bo adayin shum kelipa denogah velachen leolam yaasok adam chu
Vechen hainyan bitfilla shello vechavana kemo shekkatuv bazzohar
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 40: Ach kal zeman shello chazar velamad davar ze lishmah en limudo ole afilu be sefirot hammeirot beolam hayetzira vehaasiyya ki hassefirot hen bechinat elohut uvahen mitlabbesh umityached or-en-sof baruch-hu mammash uvla dechilu urchimu la yachla lesalka ulmekam kodam kemo shekkatuv battikunim rak limudo ole lehechalot umdorin shehen chitzoniyyut haolamot shebbahen omdim hammalachim uchmo shekkatav harav chayyim vital zichrono livracha beshaar hannevua perek shemmehattora shello vechavana nivraim malachim beolam hayetzira umehammitzot beli chavana nivraim malachim beolam haasiyya vechal hammalachim hem baale chomer vetzura

Aval tora shello lishmah mammash kegon lihot talmid chacham uchhay gavena enah ola kelal lemala afilu lehechalot umdor hammalachim dikdushsha ella nisheret lematta baolam hazze haggashmi shehu medor hakkelipot

Kemo shekkatuv bazzohar chelek daf mud vedaf mud yen sham hahi milla salka uvaka rekiyin chu veittar ma deittar i tav tav chu yen sham vedaf mud milla deorayeta itavid mineh kala vesalik chu vedaf mud kalin deorayeta utzlota bakin rekiyin chu

Uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk ma yitron laadam bechal amalo sheyyaamol tachat hashshamesh daafilu amala deorayeta i avid begin yekareh chu vezehu sheamru ashre mi shebba lechan vetalmudo beyado perush shello nishar lematta baolam hazze
