Veaf deorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad shehu urtzono echad hare kudsha-berich-hu ihu memalle kal almin beshave veaf-al-pi-chen en haolamot shavim bemaalatam vehashshinuy hu mehamkabbelim bev bechinot haechad shehaelonim mekabbelim heara yoter gedola leen ketz mehattachtonim vehashshenit shemmekabbelim beli levushim umasachim rabbim kal kach kevattachtonim veolam hazze hu olam hashshafal bev bechinot ki haheara shebbo metzumtzemet meod ad katze haacharon velachen hu chumri vegashmi vegam zot hi bilvushim umasachim rabbim ad shennitlabbesha biklipat nogah lehachaot kal devarim hattehorim shebbaolam hazze uvichlalam hu nefesh hachiyyunit hamdabberet shebbaadam

Velachen keshemmedabberet divre tora utfilla belo chavana af shehen otiyyot kedoshot veen kelipat nogah shebbannefesh hachiyyunit masach mavdil kelal lehastir ulchassot al kedushshato yitbarech hamlubbeshet bahen kemo shehi masteret umchassa al kedushshato yitbarech shebbannefesh hachiyyunit keshemmedabberet devarim betelim veshebbannefesh hachiyyunit shebbishar baale chayyim hattehorim deaf delet atar panuy mineh mikkal makom ihu setimu dechal setimin venikra el mistatter vegam haheara vehitpashshetut hachayyut mimmennu yitbarech mistatteret bilvushim umasachim rabbim vaatzumim ad shennitlabbesha venistattera bilvush nogah ma sheen ken baotiyyot hakkedoshot shel divre tora utfilla deadderabba kelipat nogah mithappechet letov venichlelet bikdushsha zo kannizkar leel mikkal makom haheara shebbahen mikkedushshato yitbarech hi bivchinat tzimtzum ad katze haacharon meachar shehakkol vehaddibbur hu gashmi

Aval bitfilla bechavana vetora bechavana lishmah hare hakkavana mitlabbeshet beotiyyot haddibbur hoil vehi makor veshoresh lahen shemmechamatah uvsibatah hu medabber otiyyot ellu lachen hi maala otan ad mekomah be sefirot ditzira o divria lefi ma shehi hakkavana bidchilu urchimu sichliyyim o tiviyyim chu kannichtav leel

Vesham meir umitgalle or-en-sof baruch-hu shehu ratzon haelon baruch-hu hamlubbash beotiyyot hattora shellomed uvchavanatan o bitfilla uvchavanatah o bemitzva uvchavanatah beheara gedola leen ketz ma shello yachol lehair ulhitgallot kelal beod haotiyyot vehammitzva baolam hazze haggashmi lo minah velo miktzatah ad et ketz hayyamin sheyyitalle haolam miggashmiyyuto venigla kevod vego kannichtav leel baarichut

Vesham meir umitgalle gam ken hayyichud halon hannase bechal mitzva vetalmud tora shehu yichud middotav yitbarech shennichlalot zo bazo venimtakot haggevurot bachasadim l yede t ratzon halon en-sof baruch-hu hammeir umitgalle bivchinat giluy rav vetzum beitaruta diltatta hi siyyat hammitzva o sek hattora shebbahen melubbash ratzon halon en-sof baruch-hu ach ykar hayyichud hu lemala mala beolam haatzilut sheshsham hu mahut vetzmut middotav yitbarech meuchadot bemaatzilan en-sof baruch-hu vesham hu mahut vetzmut ratzon halon en-sof baruch-hu vehearatan levad hi meira bivria yetzira siyya bechal olam mehen lefi malato veaf shennefesh haadam haosek betora umitzva zo enah meatzilut mikkal makom hare ratzon halon hamlubbash bemitzva zo vehu hu tzemo haddevar halacha vehattora sheosek bah hu elohut veor-en-sof hammaatzil baruch-hu shehu urtzono echad uvirtzono yitbarech heetzil middotav hamuchadot bo yitbarech vel yede giluy retzono hammitgalle l yede sek tora umitzva zo hen nichlalot zo bazo venimtakot haggevurot bachasadim bet ratzon zo

Uvaze yuvan hetev ha didchilu urchimu nikrain gadfin derech mashal kedichtiv uvishtayim yeofef uchmo shekkatav harav chayyim vital zichrono livracha beshaar hayyichudim perek shehakkenafayim baof hen zeroot haadam chu uvattikunim pershu shehaoskim betora umitzot bidchilu urchimu nikraim banim veim lav nikraim efrochim dela yachlin lefarcha

Uvtikun deofa hu resha dileh vegufa vav utren gadfin chu vehayenu olam hayetzira shennikra uvo hen gufe halachot shebbammishna veresha dileh hen hammochin uvchinot chachma bina dat shehen penimiyyut hahalachot vesodan vetamehen utren gadfin dechilu urchimu hen ylaa shehi rechimu ve tattaa hi yira tattaa ol malchut shamayim ufachad kefachad hammelech derech mashal shehi yira chitzonit veniglet ma sheen ken yira ylaa yere boshet hi mehannistarot la elohenu vehi bechachma ylaa yud shel shem havaya baruch-hu kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna

Ki kemo shekkanfe haof enam ikar haof veen chayyuto taluy bahem kelal keditnan nitlu agappeha keshera vehaikar hu rosho vechal gufo vehakkenafayim enam rak meshammeshim lerosho vegufo lefarcha behon vechach derech mashal hattora umitzot hen ikar hayyichud haelon al yede giluy ratzon haelon hammitgalle al yedehen vehaddechilu urchimu hem maalim otan lemakom sheyyitgalle bo haratzon or-en-sof baruch-hu vehayyichud shehen yetzira uvria

O afilu basiyya be sefirot dikdushsha mekom mitzot masiyyot vechen mikra aval bemishna mitgalle hayyichud veor-en-sof baruch-hu bitzira uvtalmud bivria dehayenu shebbelimud mikra mitpashshet hayyichud veor-en-sof baruch-hu meatzilut d hasiyya uvmishna d hayetzira levaddah uvtalmud d habberia levaddah ki kullan baatzilut aval kabbala enah mitpashshetet kelal meatzilut livria yetzira siyya kemo shekkatuv bifri tz chayyim

Vehinne af didchilu urchimu hem gam ken mittaryag mitzot af al pi chen nikrain gadfin lihot ki tachlit haahava hi haavoda meahava veahava beli avoda hi ahava bettaanugim lehitanneg al meen olam habba vekabbalat sachar vehayyom laasotam ketiv ulmachar lekabbel secharam

Umi shello higgia lemidda zo litom meen olam habba ella adayin nafsho shokeka utzmea la vechalta elav kal hayyom veeno merave tzimono beme hattora shellefanav hare ze kemi sheomed bannahar vetzoek mayim mayim lishtot kemo shekkovel alav hannavi hoy kal tzame lechu lammayim ki lefi feshuto eno muvan demi shehu tzame umitave lilmod peshita sheyyilmod meatzmo velamma lo lannavi litzok alav hoy uchmo shemmevoar bemakom acher baarichut
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 41: Beram tzarich lihot lezikkaron tamid reshit haavoda veikarah vesharshah vehu ki af shehayyira hi shoresh lesur mera vehaahava levaase tov af-al-pi-chen lo day leorer haahava levaddah levaase tov ulfachot tzarich leorer techilla hayyira hattivit hamsutteret belev kal yisrael shello limrod bemelech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu kannizkar leel shettehe behitgallut libbo o mocho al kal panim

Dehayenu lehitbonen bemachashavto al kal panim gedullat en-sof baruch-hu umalchuto asher hi malchut kal olamim elonim vetachtonim veihu memalle kal almin vesovev kal almin uchmo shekkatuv halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male umanniach haelonim vetachtonim umyached malchuto al ammo yisrael bichlal vealav bifrat ki chayyav adam lomar bishvili nivra haolam vehu gam hu mekabbel alav malchuto lihot melech alav ulavdo velaasot retzono bechal mine avodat aved
Vehinne nitztzav alav umlo chal haaretz kevodo umabbit alav uvochen kelaot valev im ovdo karauy veal ken tzarich laavod lefanav beema uvyira keomed lifne hammelech
Veyaamik bemachashava zo veyaarich bah kefi yecholet hassagat mocho umachashavto uchfi happenay shello lifne esek hattora o hammitzva kemo lifne levishat tallit utfilin

Vegam yitbonen ech sheor-en-sof baruch-hu hassovev kal almin ummalle kal almin hu ratzon haelon hu melubbash beotiyyot vechachmat hattora o betzitzit utfillin ellu uvikriato o bilvishato hu mamshich oro yitbarech alav dehayenu al chelek eloha mimmaal shebbetoch gufo likalel velibatel beoro yitbarech

Vederech perat bitfilin libatel velikalel bechinat chachmato uvinato shebbenafsho haelohit bivchinat chachmato uvinato shel en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbashot derech perat befarashiyyot kaddesh vehaya ki yeviacha dehayenu shello lehishtammesh bechachmato uvinato shebbenafsho bilti la levaddo vechen libatel velikalel bechinat haddaat shebbenafsho hakkolel chesed ugvura shehen yira veahava shebbelibbo bivchinat daat haelon hakkolel chesed ugvura hamlubbash befarashiyyot shema vehaya im shamoa vehayenu kemo shekkatuv beshulchan aruch leshabed hallev vehammoach chu
Uvaatifat tzitzit yechaven kemo shekkatuv bazzohar lehamshich alav malchuto yitbarech asher hi malchut kal olamim vechu leyachadah alenu al yede mitzva zo vehu keinyan som tasim alecha melech

Vaazay af im bechal zot lo tippol alav ema vafachad behitgallut libbo mikkal makom meachar shemmekabbel alav malchut shamayim umamshich alav yirato yitbarech behitgallut machashavto urtzono shebbemocho vekabbala zo hi amitit beli shum safek shehare hi teva nafshot kal yisrael shello limrod bammelech hakkadosh yitbarech hare hattora shellomed o hammitzva sheose mechamat kabbala zo umechamat hamshachat hayyira shebbemocho nikraot beshem avoda shelema kechal avodat haeved laadno umalko

Ma sheen ken im lomed umkayyem hammitzva beahava levaddah kede ledavka vo al yede torato umitzotav enah nikret beshem avodat haeved vehattora amra vaavadtem et elohechem vego veoto taavodu vego uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar parashat behar kehay tora deyahavin aleh ol bekadmeta begin leappaka mineh tav lealma chu hache name itzterich levar nash lekabbala aleh ol malchut shamayim bekadmeta chu vei hay la ishtechach gabbeh la sharya beh kedushsha chu uvraya mehemna sham daf ammud shekkal adam tzarich lihot bishte bechinot umadregot vehen bechinat eved uvchinat ben
Veaf deyesh ben shehu gam ken eved hare i efshar lavo lemadrega zo beli kedimat hayyira ilaa kayyadua layyodim

Vehinne af mi sheggam bemocho uvmachashavto eno margish shum yira uvusha mippene pechitut erech nafsho mimmekor chutzbah mimmadregot tachtonot de sefirot daasiyya af-al-pi-chen meachar shemmitkaven baavodato kede laavod et hammelech hare zo avoda gemura ki hayyira vehaavoda nechshavot lishte mitzot beminyan taryag veenan meakkevot zo et zo

Veod shebbeemet mekayyem gam mitzvat yira bema shemmamshich hayyira bemachashavto ki beshaa verega zo al kal panim mora shamayim alav al kal panim kemora basar vadam hedot lefachot sheeno melech hammabbit alav shennimna baavuro millaasot davar sheeno hagun beenav shezzo nikret yira kemo sheamar rabban yochanan ben zakkay letalmidav yehi ratzon sheyehe mora shamayim alechem kemora basar vadam chu tedu kesheadam over avera omer shello yirani adam chu

Rak sheyyira zo nikret yira tattaa veyirat chet shekkodemet lechachmato veyira ilaa hu yere boshet chu deit yira veit yira chu aval beli yira kelal la farcha leela beahava levaddah kemo shehaof eno yachol lifroach bechanaf echad didchilu urchimu hen teren gadfin kemo shekkatuv battikunim

Vechen hayyira levaddah hi kanaf echad vela farcha bah leela af shennikret avodat eved vetzarich lihot gam ken bechinat ben leorer haahava hattivit al kal panim hamsutteret belibbo shettehe behitgallut mocho al kal panim lizkor ahavato la echad bemachashavto uvirtzono ledavka bo yitbarech
Vezot tihye kavanato beesek hattora o hammitzva hazzo ledavka vo nafsho haelohit vehachiyyunit ulvushehen kannizkar leel

Ach amnam amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha leolam al yotzi adam atzmo min hakkelal lachen yitkaven leyached uldavka bo yitbarech mekor nafsho haelohit umkor nafshot kal yisrael shehu ruach piv yitbarech hannikra beshem shechina al shem sheshshochenet umitlabbeshet toch kal almin lehachaotan ulkayeman vehi hi hammashpaat bo koach haddibbur hazze shemmedabber bedivre tora o koach hammaase hazze laasot mitzva zo
Veyichud ze hu al yede hamshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta al yede esek hattora vehammitzot shehu melubbash bahen

Veyitkaven lehamshich oro yitbarech al mekor nafsho venafshot kal yisrael leyachadan uchmo sheyyitbaer lekamman perush yichud ze baarichut ayyen sham vezehu perush leshem yichud kudsha-berich-hu ushchinteh beshem kal yisrael

Vegam l yede ze yitmatteku gam ken haggevurot bachasadim mimmela behitkallut hammiddot veyichudam l yede giluy ratzon halon baruch-hu hammitgalle lemala beitaruta diltatta hu giluo lematta besek hattora vehammitzva shehen retzono yitbarech uchmo shekkatuv beidra rabba uvmishnat chasidim massechet arich anpin perek shettaryag mitzot hattora nimshachot mechivarta daarich anpin shehu ratzon halon mekor hachasadim

Veaf shellihot kavana zo amitit belibbo sheyyihye libbo chafetz beemet yichud haelon hazze tzarich lihot belibbo ahava rabba la levaddo laasot nachat ruach lefanav levad velo lerauot nafsho hatztzemea la ella kivra deishtaddel batar avoy veimmeh derachim lon yattir miggarmeh venafsheh chu kemo shennitbaer leel beshem raya mehemna mikkal makom yesh lechal adam lehargil atzmo bechavana zo

Ki af sheenah beemet laamito legamre belibbo sheyyachpotz baze bechal libbo mikkal makom meat mizzeer chafetz libbo baze beemet mippene ahava hattivit shebbelev kal yisrael laasot kal ma shehu ratzon haelon baruch-hu veyichud ze hu retzono haamiti vehayenu yichud haelon shebbaatzilut hannaase beitaruta diltatta al yede yichud nefesh haelohit vehitkallutah beor hamlubbash battora umitzot sheoseket bahen vehau laachadim mammash kemo shennitbaer leel ki al yede ze mityachadim gam ken mekor hattora vehammitzot shehu hakkadosh-baruch-hu im mekor nafsho haelohit hannikra beshem shechina shehen bechinat memalle kal almin uvchinat sovev kal almin kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut

Aval yichud nafsho vehitkallutah beor lihot laachadim baze chafetz kal adam miyyisrael beemet laamito legamre bechal lev uvchal nefesh meahava hattivit hamsutteret belev kal yisrael ledavka ba velo lipared velihot nichrat venivdal chas veshalom miyyichudo veachduto yitbarech beshum ofen afilu bimsirat nefesh mammash

Veesek hattora umitzot vehattefilla hu gam ken inyan mesirat nefesh mammash kemo betzetah min hagguf bimlot shivim shana sheenah meharheret betzarche hagguf ella machashavtah meuchedet umlubbeshet beotiyyot hattora vehattefilla shehen devar umachashavto yitbarech vehau laachadim mammash shezzehu kal esek hanneshamot began eden kidita baggemara uvazzohar ella sheshsham mitannegim behassagatam vehitkallutam beor

Vezehu shettikkenu bitchillat birchot hashshachar kodem hattefilla elohay neshama vechu veatta nefachtah chu veatta atid litlah mimmenni chu kelomar meachar sheatta nefachtah bi veatta atid litlah mimmenni lachen meatta ani mosrah umachazirah lecha leyachadah beachdutcha uchmo shekkatuv elecha nafshi essa vehayenu al yede hitkashsherut machashavti bemachashavtecha vediburi bediburcha beotiyyot hattora vehattefilla uvifrat baamira la lenocheach kemo baruch atta uchhay gavena

Vehinne bahachana zo shel mesirat nafsho la yatchil birchot hashshachar baruch atta chu vechen bahachana zo yatchil lilmod shiur kavua miyyad achar hattefilla vechen beemtza hayyom kodem sheyyatchil lilmod tzericha hachana zo lefachot kannoda sheikar hahachana lishmah leakkev hu bitchillat hallimud babbenonim uchmo beget vesefer tora shetztzerichim lishmah leakkev vedayyo sheyyomar bitchillat hakketiva hareni kotev leshem kedushshat sefer tora o lishmo velishmah chu

Uchshellomed shaot harbe retzufot yesh lo lehitbonen bahachana zo hannizkeret leel bechal shaa veshaa al kal panim ki bechal shaa veshaa hi hamshacha acheret meolamot elonim lehachaot hattachtonim vehamshachat hachayyut shebbeshaa shellefaneha chozeret limkorah besod ratzo vashov shebbesefer yetzira im kal hattora umaasim tovim shel hattachtonim ki bechal shaa sholet tzeruf echad miv tzerufe shem havaya baruch-hu bev sheot hayyom vetzerufe shem adnay ballayela kannoda

Vehinne kal kavanato bimsirat nafsho la al yede hattora vehattefilla lehaalot nitzotz elohut shebbetochah limkoro tehe rak kede laasot nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech kimshal simchat hammelech bevo elav beno yechido betzeto min hashshivya uvet haasurim kannizkar leel

Vehinne kavana zo hi amitit beemet laamito legamre bechal nefesh miyyisrael bechal et uvchal shaa meahava hattivit shehi yerushsha lanu meavotenu rak shetztzarich likboa ittim lehitbonen bigdullat lehassig dechilu urchimu sichliyyim vechulle hay veulay vechu kannizkar leel
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 42: Vehinne bema shennitbaer leel beinyan yira tattaa yuvan hetev ma shekkatuv baggemara al pasuk veatta yisrael ma elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira et elohecha atu yira milta zutarti hi in legabbe moshe milta zutarti hi vechu

Delichora eno muvan hatterutz deha shoel meimmach ketiv ella hainyan hu ki kal nefesh venefesh mibbet yisrael yesh bah mibbechinat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom ki hu mishshiva roim hammamshichim chayyut velohut lichlalut nishmot yisrael shellachen nikraim beshem roim umoshe rabbenu alav hashshalom hu kelalut kullam venikra raya mehemna dehayenu shemmamshich bechinat haddaat lichlalut yisrael leda et kal echad kefi hassagat nishmato vesharshah lemala vinikatah mishshoresh nishmat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom hammushreshet bedaat haelon shebbe sefirot daatzilut hamuchadot bemaatzilan baruch-hu shehu vedato echad vehu hammadda chu

Veod zot yeter al ken bechal dor vador yordin nitzotzin minnishmat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom umitlabbeshin beguf venefesh shel chachme haddor ene haeda lelammed daat et haam veleda gedullat ulavdo belev vanefesh ki haavoda shebballev hi lefi haddaat kemo shekkatuv da et elohe avicha veavdehu belev shalem venefesh chafetza veleatid hu omer velo yelammedu ish et reehu lemor deu et ki chullam yedu oti vego

Ach ikar haddaat enah hayedia levaddah sheyyedu gedullat mippi sofrim umippi sefarim ella haikar hu lehaamik dato bigdullat velitkoa machashavto ba bechozek veometz hallev vehammoach ad shettehe machashavto mekushsheret ba bekesher ammitz vechazak kemo shehi mekushsheret bedavar gashmi sheroe beene vasar umaamik bo machashavto kannoda sheddaat hu leshon hitkashsherut kemo vehaadam yada vego

Vechoach ze umidda zo lekashsher dato ba yesh bechal nefesh mibbet yisrael binikatah minnishmat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalm rak meachar shennitlabbesha hannefesh bagguf tzericha ligia rabba vaatzuma kefula umchuppelet haachat hi yegiat basar levattesh et hagguf ulhachnio shello yachshich al or hannefesh kemo shennitbaer leel beshem hazzohar degufa dela salik beh nehora denishmeta mevatteshin leh vehayenu al yede hirhure teshuva meomek hallev kemo shennitbaer sham

Vehashshenit hi yegiat hannefesh shello tichbad aleha haavoda leyaggea machashavtah lehaamik ulhitbonen bigdullat shaa gedola retzufa ki shiur shaa zo eno shave bechal nefesh yesh nefesh zakka betivah shemmiyyad shemmitbonenet bigdullat yaggia eleha hayyira ufachad kemo shekkatuv beshulchan aruch orach chayyim siman kesheyyitbonen haadam shehammelech haggadol melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu asher melo chal haaretz kevodo omed alav veroe bemaasav miyyad yaggia elav hayyira vchu

Veyesh nefesh shefala betivah vetoladtah mimmekor chutzbah mimmadregot tachtonot de sefirot daasiyya velo tuchal limtzo bemachashavtah haelohut ki im bekoshi uvchazka uvifrat im huttammea bechattat neurim shehaaonot mavdilim chu kemo shekkatuv besefer chasidim siman

Umikkal makom bekoshi uvchazka shettitchazzek meod machashavto beometz vigia rabba veomek gadol lehaamik bigdullat shaa gedola bevadday taggia elav al kal panim hayyira tattaa hannizkeret leel uchmo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha yagati umatzati taamin uchdichtiv im tevakshenna chakkasef vechammatmonim tachpesenna az tavin yirat perush kederech shemmechappes adam matmon veotzar hattamun betachtiyyot haaretz shechofer acharav bigia atzuma kach tzarich lachpor bigia atzuma legallot otzar shel yirat shamayim hatztzafun umustar bevinat hallev shel kal adam miyyisrael shehi bechina umadrega shellemala mehazzeman vehi hayyira hattivit hamsutteret hannizkeret leel

Rak shekkede shettavo lide maase bivchinat yirat chet lihot sur mera bemaase dibbur umachashava tzarich legallotah mimmatzpune binat hallev shellemala mehazzeman lahaviah livchinat machashava mammash shebbammoach lehaamik bah machashavto meshech zeman ma mammash ad shettetze peullatah mehakkoach el happoal mammash dehayenu lihot sur mera vaase tov bemachashava dibbur umaase mippene hatztzofe umabbit umaazin umakshiv umevin el kal maasehu uvochen kilotav velibbo uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha histakkel bishlosha devarim chu ayin roa veozen shomaat chu

Vegam ki en lo demut hagguf hare adderabba hakkol galuy veyadua lefanav beyeter seet leen ketz meriyyat haayin ushmiat haozen al derech mashal rak hu al derech mashal kemo adam hayyodea umargish beatzmo kal ma shennaase venifal beechad mikkal ramach evarav kemo kor o chom vaafilu chom shebbetzipparne raglav al derech mashal im nichva baur vechen mahutam veatzmutam vechal ma shemmitpael bahem yodea umargish bemocho

Uchen yedia zo al derech mashal yodea hakkadosh-baruch-hu kal hannifal bechal hannivraim elonim vetachtonim lihot kullam mushpaim mimmennu yitbarech kemo shekkatuv ki mimmecha hakkol vezehu sheomrim vegam kal hayetzur lo nichchad mimmekka uchmo shekkatav harambam vehiskimu laze chachme hakkabbala kemo shekkatav haramak bappardes shebbidiat atzmo kivyachol yodea kal hannivraim hannimtzaim meamitat himmatzo vechu

Rak shemmashal ze eno ella leshakkech et haozen aval beemet en hammashal dome lannimshal kelal ki nefesh haadam afilu hassichlit vehaelohit hi mitpaelet mimmeore hagguf vetzaaro mechamat hitlabbeshutah mammash bannefesh hachiyyunit hamlubbeshet bagguf mammash

Aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu eno mitpael chas veshalom mimmeore haolam veshinuyav velo mehaolam atzmo shekkullam enan poalim bo shum shinuy chas veshalom vehinne kede lehaskil ze hetev besichlenu kevar heerichu chachme haemet besifrehem ach kal yisrael maaminim bene maaminim beli shum chakirat sechel enoshi veomrim atta hu ad shello nivra haolam vechu kannizkar leel perek

Vehinne kal adam miyyisrael yihye mi sheyyihye kesheyyitbonen baze shaa gedola bechal yom ech shehakkadosh-baruch-hu male mammash et haelonim veet hattachtonim veet hashshamayim veet haaretz mammash melo chal haaretz kevodo mammash vetzofe umabbit uvochen kilotav velibbo vechal maasav vediburav vechal tzeadav yispor azay tikkava belibbo hayyira lechal hayyom kullo kesheyyachazor veyitbonen baze afilu behitbonnut kalla bechal et uvchal shaa yihye sur mera vaase tov bemachashava dibbur umaase shello lamrot chas veshalom ene chevodo asher male chal haaretz uchmaamar rabban yochanan ben zakkay letalmidav kannizkar leel

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv ki im leyira et elohecha lalechet bechal derachav shehi yira hammevia lekiyyum mitzotav yitbarech besur mera vaase tov vehi yira tattaa hannizkeret leel ulgabbe moshe dehayenu legabbe bechinat haddaat shebbechal nefesh miyyisrael haelohit milta zutarti hi kannizkar leel shehaddaat hu hamkashsher matzpune binat hallev el bechinat giluy bemachashava mammash kayyadua leode chen

Veod zot yizkor ki kemo shebbemelech basar vadam ikar hayyira hi mippenimiyyuto vechayyuto velo miggufo shehare kesheyyashen en shum yira mimmennu vehinne penimiyyuto vechayyuto en nire leene vasar rak beene hassechel al yede reiyyat ene vasar begufo ulvushav sheyyodea shechayyuto melubbash betocham veim ken kacha mammash yesh lo liro et al yede reiyyat ene vasar bashshamayim vaaretz vechal tzevaam asher or-en-sof baruch-hu melubbash bahem lehachaotam

Vegam nire biriyyat hayin shehem betelim leoro yitbarech behishtachavaatam kal yom kelappe marav bishkiyatam kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha l pasuk utzva hashshamayim lecha mishtachavim shehashshechina bammarav venimtza hilucham kal hayyom kelappe marav hu derech hishtachavaa uvitul vehinne gam mi shello raa et hammelech meolam veeno makkiro kelal af-l-pi-chen keshshenichnas lachatzar hammelech veroe sarim rabbim venichbadim mishtachavim leish echad tippol lav ema vafachad
Veaf shehu al yede hitlabbeshut bilvushim rabbim hare en hevdel vehefresh kelal beyirat melech basar vadam ben shehu arom uven shehu lavush levush echad uven shehu lavush bilvushim rabbim

Ella haikar hu hahergel lehargil dato umachashavto tamid lihot kavua belibbo umocho tamid asher kal ma sheroe beenav hashshamayim vehaaretz umloah hakkol hem levushim hachitzonim shel hammelech hakkadosh-baruch-hu veal yede ze yizkor tamid al penimiyyutam vechayyutam veze nichlal gam ken bilshon emuna shehu leshon regilut shemmargil haadam et atzmo kemo uman hamammen yadav vechu

Vegam lihot lezikkaron tamid leshon chachamenu-zichronam-livracha kabbalat ol malchut shamayim shehu keinyan som tasim alecha melech kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher vechu ki hakkadosh-baruch-hu manniach et haelonim vehattachtonim umyached malchuto alenu vechu vaanachnu mekabbelim vechu vezehu inyan hahishtachavaot shebbitfillat achar kabbalat ol malchut shamayim bedibbur bikriat shema lachazor ulkabbel befoal mammash bemaase vechu kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 43: Vehinne al yira tattaa zo shehi lekiyyum mitzotav yitbarech bivchinat sur mera vaase tov amru im en yira en chachma

Veyesh bah bechinat katnut uvchinat gadlut dehayenu keshennimshechet bechinat yira zo mehahitbonnut bigdullat deihu memalle kal almin umehaaretz larakia mahalach tk shana vechu uven rakia lerakia chu ragle hachayyot keneged kullan vechu vechen hishtalshelut kal haolamot lemala mala ad rum hammaalot af-al-pi-chen nikre yira zo yira chitzonit vetattaa meachar shennimshechet mehaolamot shehem levushim shel hammelech hakkadosh-baruch-hu asher mistatter umitallem umitlabbesh bahem lehachaotam ulkayemam lihot yesh meayin vechu rak shehi hashshaar vehappetach lekiyyum hattora vehammitzot

Ach hayyira ilaa yere boshet veyira fenimit shehi nimshechet mippenimit haelohut shebbetoch haolamot aleha amru im en chachma en yira dechachma hi koach ma vehachachma meayin timmatze veezehu chacham haroe et hannolad perush sheroe kal davar ech nolad venithave meayin leyesh bidvar veruach piv yitbarech kemo shekkatuv uvruach piv kal tzevaam

Vee lazot hare hashshamayim vehaaretz vechal tzevaam betelim bimtziut mammash bidvar veruach piv uchla mammash chashive veayin vaefes mammash kevitul or veziv hashshemesh beguf hashshemesh atzmah veal yotzi adam atzmo mehakkelal sheggam gufo venafsho verucho venishmato betelim bimtziut bidvar vedibburo yitbarech meuchad bemachashavto chu vechannizkar leel perakim baarichut bederech mashal minnefesh haadam sheddibbur echad middibburo umachashavto kela mammash chu vezehu sheamar hakkatuv hen yirat hi chachma
Ach i efshar lehassig leyira vechachma zo ella bekiyyum hattora vehammitzot al-yede yira tattaa hachitzonit vezehu sheamru im en yira en chachma

Vehinne beahava yesh gam ken shette madregot ahava rabba veahavat olam ahava rabba hi ahava bettaanugim vehi shalhevet haola meeleha uvaa milmala bivchinat mattana lemi shehu shalem beyira kannoda al maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha darko shel ish lechazzer achar ishsha sheahava nikret ish vezachar kemo shekkatuv zachar chasdo veishsha yirat kannoda uvli kedimat hayyira i efshar lehaggia leahava rabba zo ki ahava zo hi mibbechinat atzilut delet tamman kitzutz uferud chas veshalom

Ach ahavat olam hi habbaa mehattevuna vadaat bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu hammalle kal almin vesovev kal almin vechulla kammeh kela mammash chashiv uchvitul dibbur echad bannefesh hammaskelet beodo bemachashavtah o bechemdat hallev kannizkar leel asher al yede hitbonnut zo mimmela titpashshet middat haahava shebbannefesh millevusheha dehayenu shello titlabbesh beshum devar hanaa vetaanug gashmi o ruchani leahava oto velo lachpotz kelal shum davar baolam bilti levaddo mekor hachayyim shel kal hattaanugim shekkullam betelim bimtziut uchla mammash kammeh chashive veen aroch vedimon kelal benehem chas veshalom kemo sheen aroch leayin vaefes hammuchlat legabbe chayyim nitzchiyyim uchmo shekkatuv mi li vashshamayim veimmecha lo chafatzti vaaretz kala sheeri ulvavi tzur levavi vego uchmo sheyyitbaer lekamman

Vegam mi sheen middat ahava shebbenafsho melubbeshet kelal beshum taanug gashmi o ruchani yachol lehalhiv nafsho kerishpe esh veshalhevet azza velahav haole hashshamayema al yede hitbonnut hannizkeret leel kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman

Vehinne bechinat ahava zo peamim shekkodemet leyira kefi bechinat haddaat hammolidah kannoda shehaddaat kolel chasadim ugvurot shehem ahava veyira ufamim shehachasadim kodmim lered ulhitgallot velachen efshar lerasha uvaal averot sheyyaase teshuva meahava hannolda belibbo bezachro et elohav

Umikkal makom hayyira gam ken kelula bah mimmela rak shehi bivchinat katnut vehelem dehayenu yirat chet limrod bo chas veshalom vehaahava hi behitgallut libbo umocho ach zehu derech mikre vehoraat shaa behashgacha feratit meet letzorech shaa kemaase derabbi elazar ben durdayya

Aval seder haavoda hakkevua utluya bivchirat haadam tzarich lehakdim techilla kiyyum hattora vehammitzot al yede yira tattaa bivchinat katnut al kal panim besur mera vaase tov lehair nafsho haelohit beor hattora umitzoteha veachar kach yair aleha or haahava ki veahavta begimatriyya peamim or kayyadua leode chen
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 44: Vehinne kal madregat ahava mibb madregot ellu ahava rabba veahavat olam nechleket lechamma bechinot umadregot leen ketz kal chad lefum shiura dileh kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh al pasuk noda bashshearim balah da kudsha-berich-hu deihu ityeda veitdabbek lechal chad lefum ma dimshaer belibbeh vechu

Velachen nikraim dechilu urchimu hannistarot la elohenu vetora umitzot hen hanniglot lanu ulvanenu laasot chu ki tora achat umishpat echad lechullanu bekiyyum kal hattora umitzot bivchinat maase ma-sheen-ken bidchilu urchimu shehem lefi haddaat et shebbemoach valev kannizkar leel
Ach achat hi ahava hakkelula mikkal bechinot umadregot ahava rabba veahavat olam vehi shava lechal nefesh miyyisrael virushsha lanu meavotenu

Vehayenu ma shekkatav hazzohar al pasuk nafshi iviticha ballayela vego deyarchim lekudsha-berich-hu rechimuta denafsha verucha kema deitdabbeku ilen begufa vegufa rachim lon vechu vezehu shekkatuv nafshi iviticha kelomar mippene sheatta nafshi vechayyay haamittim lechach iviticha perush sheani mitave vetaev lecha keadam hammitave lechayye nafsho uchshehu challash umunne mitave vetaev shettashuv nafsho elav vechen keshehu holech lishon mitave vechafetz shettashuv nafsho elav kesheyyeor mishshenato kach ani mitave vetaev leor en-sof baruch-hu chayye hachayyim haamittiyyim lehamshicho bekirbi al yede esek hattora bahakitzi mishshenati ballayela deorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad
Kemo shekkatav hazzohar sham devae bar nash merchimuta dekudsha-berich-hu lemekam bechal lela leishtaddela befulchaneh ad tzafra chu

Veahava rabba ugdola mizzo vehi mesutteret gam ken bechal nefesh miyyisrael birushsha meavotenu hi ma shekkatuv beraya mehemna kivra deishtaddel batar avoy veimeh derachim lon yattir miggarmeh venafsheh verucheh chu ki halo av echad lechullanu

Veaf ki mi hu ze veezehu asher arav libbo lageshet lehassig afilu chelek echad minni elef mimmadregat ahavat raya mehemna mikkal makom hare efes katzehu veshemetz menhu merav tuvo veoro meir lichlalut yisrael bechal dor vador kemo shekkatuv battikunim deitpashshetuteh bechal dara vedara leanhara lon vechu

Rak sheheara zo hi bivchinat hester vehelem gadol benafshot kal bet yisrael ulhotzi ahava zo hamsutteret mehahelem vehahester el haggiluy lihot behitgallut libbo umocho lo niflet velo rechoka hi ella karov haddavar meod beficha uvilvavcha dehayenu lihot ragil al leshono vekolo leorer kavanat libbo umocho lehaamik machashavto bechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu ki hu avinu mammash haamiti umkor chayyenu ulorer elav haahava keahavat habben el haav uchsheyyargil atzmo ken tamid hare hahergel naase teva

Veaf im nidme lo lichora shehu koach dimoni lo yachush meachar shehu emet laamito mitztzad atzmo bivchinat ahava mesutteret rak shettoelet yetziatah el haggiluy kede lahaviah lide maase shehu esek hattora vehammitzot shellomed umkayyem al yede ze kede laasot nachat ruach lefanav yitbarech keven haoved et aviv

Veal ze amru machashava tova hakkadosh-baruch-hu metzarfah lemaase lihot gadfin lefarcha kannizkar leel vehannachat ruach hu kimshal simchat hammelech mibbeno shebba elav betzeto mibbet haasurim kannizkar leel o lihot lo dira battachtonim kannizkar leel
Vehinne gam livchinat nafshi iviticha hannizkar leel karov haddavar meod lehotziah mehahelem el haggiluy al yede hahergel tamid befiv velibbo shavin

Ach im eno yachol lehotziah el haggiluy belibbo af-al-pi-chen yachol laasok battora umitzot lishman al yede tziyyur inyan ahava zo bammachashava shebbemocho umachashava tova hakkadosh-baruch-hu metzarfah chu

Vehinne b bechinot ahavot ellu af shehen yerushsha lanu meavotenu uchmo teva benafshotenu vechen hayyira hakkelula bahen shehi liro millipared chas veshalom mimmekor chayyenu veavinu haamiti baruch-hu af-al-pi-chen enan nikraot beshem dechilu urchimu tiviyyim ella keshehen bemocho umachashavto levad vetaalumot libbo veaz mekoman be sefirot ditzira ulsham hen maalot immahen hattora vehammitzot habbaot mechamatan uvsibatan

Aval keshehen behitgallut libbo nikraim reuta delibba bazzohar umkoman be sefirot divria ulsham hen maalot immahen hattora vehammitzot habbaot mechamatan mippene sheyetziatan mehahelem vehester hallev el bechinat giluy hi al yede haddaat utkiat hammachashava bechozek vehitbonnut atzuma meumka delibba yattir vetadir been-sof baruch-hu ech hu chayyenu mammash veavinu haamiti baruch-hu
Umudaat zot ma shekkatuv battikunim ki beolam habberia mekannena tamman ima ilaa shehi hahitbonnut beor-en-sof chayye-hachayyim baruch-hu uchmaamar eliyyahu bina libba uvah hallev mevin
Velo od ella shebb bechinot ahavot ellu hannizkarot leel hen kelulot min bechinat ahava rabba ugdola umulla middechilu urchimu sichliyyim asher haahava nikret leel beshem ahavat olam

Rak sheaf-al-pi-chen tzarich litroach besichlo lehassig ulhaggia gam livchinat ahavat olam hannizkeret leel habbaa mehattevuna vadaat bigdullat kede lehagdil medurat esh haahava berishpe esh veshalhevet azza velahav haole hashshamayema ad shemmayim rabbim lo yuchlu lechabbot vechu unharot lo yishtefuha vechu ki yesh yitron umaala livchinat ahava kerishpe esh veshalhevet azza vechu habbaa mehattevuna vadaat bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu al shette bechinot ahava hannizkarot leel kaasher enan kerishpe esh veshalhevet chu keyitron umaalat hazzahav al hakkesef vechu kemo sheyyitbaer lekamman
Vegam ki ze kal haadam vetachlito lemaan daat et kevod vikar tiferet gedullato ish ish kefi asher yuchal seet kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat bo begin deyishtemodun leh vechu vechannoda
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 45: Od yesh derech yashar lifne ish laasok battora umitzot lishman al yede middato shel yaakov avinu alav hashshalom shehi middat harachamim leorer bemachashavto techilla rachamim rabbim lifne al nitzotz elohut hamchayye nafsho asher yarad mimmekoro chayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu hammalle kal almin vesovev kal almin vechulla kammeh kela chashiv venitlabbesh bemashka dechiveya harachok meor pene hammelech betachlit haherchek ki haolam hazze hu tachlit hakkelipot haggassot chu

Uvifrat kesheyyizkor al kal maasav vedibburav umachshevotav miyyom heoto asher lo tovim hemma umelech asur barhatim birhite mocha ki yaakov chevel nachalato vechimshal hammoshech bechevel vechu vehu sod galut hashshechina veal ze neemar veyashov el virachamehu leorer rachamim rabbim al shem hashshochen ittanu kedichtiv hashshochen ittam betoch tumotam

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv vayyishshak yaakov lerachel vayyissa et kolo vayyevke ki rachel hi keneset yisrael mekor kal hanneshamot veyaakov bemiddato haelona shehi middat harachamim shebbaatzilut hu hammeorer rachamim rabbim aleha vayyissa et kolo lemala limkor harachamim haelonim hannikra av harachamim umkoram vayyevke leorer ulhamshich mishsham rachamim rabbim al kal hanneshamot veal mekor keneset yisrael lehaalotan miggalutan ulyachadan bayyichud haelon or-en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat neshikin shehi itdabbekut rucha berucha kemo shekkatuv yishshakeni minneshikot pihu dehayenu hitkashsherut dibbur haadam bidvar zo halacha vechen machashava bemachashava umaase bemaase shehu maase hammitzot uvifrat maase hatztzedaka vachesed dechesed deroa yemina vehu bechinat chibuk mammash kemo shekkatuv vimino techabbekeni veesek hattora bedibbur umachashevet haiyyun hen bechinat neshikin mammash
Vehinne al yede ze yachol lavo livchinat ahava rabba behitgallut libbo kedichtiv leyaakov asher pada et avraham kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 46: Veyesh derech yashar lifne ish shave lechal nefesh vekarov haddavar meod meod leorer ulhair or haahava hattekua umsutteret belibbo lihot meira betokef orah keesh boara behitgallut libbo umocho limsor nafsho la vegufo umodo bechal lev uvchal nefesh umod meumka delibba beemet laamito uvifrat bishat keriat shema uvirchoteha kemo sheyyitbaer

Vehu kaasher yasim el libbo ma sheamar hakkatuv kammayim happanim lappanim ken lev haadam el haadam perush kemo shekkidmut vetzurat happanim shehaadam mare bammayim ken nire lo sham bammayim otah tzura atzmah kacha mammash lev haadam hanneeman beahavato leish acher hare haahava zo meoreret ahava belev chavero elav gam ken lihot ohavim neemanim ze laze bifrat kesheroe ahavat chavero elav

Vehinne zehu teva hannahug bemiddat kal adam af im shenehem shavim bemaala veal achat kamma vechamma im melech gadol verav mare ahavato haggedola vehaatzuma leish hedot venivze ushfal anashim umnuval hammuttal beashpa veored elav mimmekom kevodo im kal sarav yachdav umkimo umrimo meashpato umachniso lehechalo hechal hammelech cheder lifnim mecheder makom sheen kal eved vesar nichnas lesham umityached immo sham beyichud vekeruv amiti vechibuk venishuk veitdabbekut rucha berucha bechal lev vanefesh al achat kamma vechamma shettitorer mimmela haahava kefula umchuppelet belev hahedot ushfal anashim hazze el nefesh hammelech behitkashsherut hannefesh mammash millev vanefesh meumka delibba leen ketz veaf im libbo kelev haeven himmes yimmas vehaya lemayim vetishtappech nafsho kammayim bichlot hannefesh mammash leahavat hammelech

Vehinne kechal haddevarim haelle uchchal hachizzaon hazze vegadol yater meod bechifle chiflayim leen ketz asa lanu elohenu ki ligdullato en cheker veihu memalle kal almin vesovev kal almin venoda mizzohar hakkadosh vehaari zichrono livracha ribuy hahechalot vehaolamot ad en mispar uvchal olam vehechal ribo rivvot malachim leen ketz vetachlit uchmo shekkatuv baggemara ketiv hayesh mispar ligdudav uchtiv elef alfin yeshammeshunneh veribo rivvan kadamohi chu umshanne elef alfin vechu mispar gedud echad aval ligdudav en mispar vechullam kammeh kela mammash chashive uvtelim bimtziut mammash kevitul dibbur echad mammash legabbe mahut hannefesh hamdabberet veatzmutah beod shehaya diburah adayin bemachashavtah o birtzon vechemdat hallev kannizkar leel baarichut

Vechullam shoalim ayye mekom kevodo veonim melo chal haaretz kevodo hem yisrael ammo ki hinniach hakkadosh-baruch-hu et haelonim veet hattachtonim velo vachar bechullam ki im beyisrael ammo vehotziam mimmitzrayim ervat haaretz mekom hazzuhama vehattuma lo al yede malach velo al yede chu ella hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uvatzmo yarad lesham kemo shekkatuv vaered lehatztzilo vego kede lekarvam elav bekeruv veyichud amiti behitkashsherut hannefesh mammash bivchinat neshikin pe lafe ledabber devar zo halacha veitdabbekut rucha berucha hi hassagat hattora vidiat retzono vechachmato dechulla chad mammash vegam bivchinat chibuk hu kiyyum hammitzot maasiyyot beramach evarim deramach pikudin hen ramach evarin demalka kannizkar leel vederech kelal nechlakin leshalosh bechinot yamin usmol veemtza shehen chesed din rachamim teren deroin vegufa vechu

Vezehu sheomrim asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav keadam hamkaddesh ishsha lihot meuchedet immo beyichud gamur kemo shekkatuv vedavak beishto vehau levasar echad kacha mammash veyeter al ken leen ketz hu yichud nefesh haelohit haoseket battora umitzot venefesh hachiyyunit ulvushehen hannizkarim leel beor-en-sof baruch-hu
Velachen himshil shelomo alav hashshalom beshir hashshirim yichud ze leyichud chatan vechalla bidvika chashika vachafitza bechibuk venishuk

Vezehu sheomrim asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav sheheelanu lemaalat kodesh haelon baruch-hu shehi kedushshato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uvatzmo ukdushsha hi leshon havdala ma shehakkadosh-baruch-hu hu muvdal mehaolamot vehi bechinat sovev kal almin ma sheeno yachol lehitlabbesh bahen

Ki al yede yichud hannefesh vehitkallutah beor-en-sof baruch-hu hare hi bemaalat umadregat kedushshat en-sof baruch-hu mammash meachar shemmityachedet umitkallelet bo yitbarech vehau laachadim mammash vezehu shekkatuv vihyitem li kedoshim ki kadosh ani vaavdil etchem min haammim lihot li veomer vaasitem et kal mitzotay vihyitem kedoshim lelohechem ani elohechem vego perush ki al yede kiyyum hammitzot hareni eloha shellachem kemo elohe avraham elohe yitzchak vechu shennikra ken mippene shehaavot hau bechinat merkava lo yitbarech uvtelim venichlalim beoro

Vechacha hu bechal nefesh miyyisrael bishat esek hattora vehammitzot velachen chiyevu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lakum velaamod mippene kal osek bemitzva af im hu bur veam haaretz vehayenu mippene hashshochen umitlabbesh benafsho beshaa zo rak sheen nafsho margeshet mippene masach hachomer haggufani shello nizdakkech umachashich ene hannefesh merot marot elohim kemo haavot vechayyotze vahen sherau olamam bechayyehem

Vezehu sheamar asaf beruach hakkodesh bead kal keneset yisrael shebbaggola vaani vaar velo eda behemot hayiti immach vaani tamid immach kelomar sheaf al pi sheani kivhema bihoti immecha velo eda velo argish benafshi yichud ze shettippol aleha emata vafachad techilla veachar kach ahava rabba bettaanugim o kerishpe esh kemiddat hatztzaddikim shennizdakkech chumram vechannoda sheddaat hu leshon hargasha bannefesh vehu kolel chesed ugvura af-al-pi-chen ani tamid immach ki en hachomer monea yichud hannefesh beor-en-sof baruch-hu hammalle kal almin uchmo shekkatuv gam choshech lo yachshich mimmekka

Uvaze yuvan chomer onesh isur melacha beshabbatot vechametz bappesach hashshave lechal nefesh lefi sheaf benefesh bur veam haaretz gamur meir or kedushshat shabbat veom tov venidon benafsho becharet uskila al chilul kedushsha zo
Vegam mashshehu chametz o tiltul muktze pogem bakkedushsha sheal nafsho kemo bikdushshat nefesh hatztzaddik ki tora achat lechullanu

Uma shekkatuv behemot leshon rabbim lerammez ki lefanav yitbarech gam bechinat daat haelon hakkolel chesed ugvura nidme kivhemot vaasiyya gufanit legabbe or-en-sof kemo shekkatuv kullam bechachma asita venikra behema rabba kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher vehu shem ban begimatriyya behema shellifne haatzilut
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 47: Vehinne bechal dor vador vechal yom vaom chayyav adam lirot atzmo keilu hu yatza hayyom mimmitzrayim vehi yetziat nefesh haelohit mimmaasar hagguf mashka dechiveya likalel beyichud or-en-sof baruch-hu al yede esek hattora vehammitzot bichlal uvifrat bekabbalat malchut shamayim bikriat shema shebbah mekabbel umamshich alav yichudo yitbarech beferush beamro elohenu echad

Uchmo shennitbaer leel ki elohenu hu kemo elohe avraham vechu lefi shehaya batel venichlal beyichud or-en-sof baruch-hu rak sheavraham zacha laze bemaasav vehilucho bakkodesh mimmadrega lemadrega kemo shekkatuv vayyissa avram haloch venasoa vego

Aval anachnu yerushsha umattana hi lanu shennatan lanu et torato vehilbish bah retzono vechachmato yitbarech hamuchadim bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech betachlit hayyichud vahare ze keillu natan lanu et atzmo kivyachol kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh al pasuk veyikchu li teruma deli kelomar oti vahava-leh-lememar utruma ella mishshum dechulla chad ayyen sham hetev

Vezehu sheomrim vattitten lanu elohenu beahava chu ki veor panecha natatta lanu elohenu chu velaze en monea lanu middevekut hannefesh beyichudo veoro yitbarech ella haratzon sheim en haadam rotze kelal chas veshalom ledavka vo chu aval miyyad sherotze umkabbel umamshich alav elohuto yitbarech veomer elohenu echad hare mimmela nichlelet nafsho beyichudo yitbarech deruach ayeti ruach veamshich ruach vehi bechinat yetziat mitzrayim velachen tikkenu parashat yetziat mitzrayim bishat keriat-shema daveka af shehi mitzva bifne atzmah velo mimmitzvat keriat shema kidita baggemara ufoskim ella mippene shehen davar echad mammash vechen besof parashat yetziat mitzrayim mesayyem gam ken ani elohechem vehayenu gam ken kemo shennitbaer leel
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 48: Vehinne kaasher yitbonen hammaskil bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu ki kishmo ken hu en-sof veen ketz vetachlit kelal leor vechayyut hammitpashshet mimmennu yitbarech birtzono happashut umuchad bemahuto veatzmuto yitbarech betachlit hayyichud veilu hayeta hishtalshelut haolamot meor-en-sof baruch-hu beli tzimtzumim rak keseder hammadregot mimmadrega lemadrega bederech illa vealul lo haya haolam hazze nivra kelal kemo shehu atta bivchinat gevul vetachlit mehaaretz larakia mahalach tk shana vechen ben kal rakia lerakia vechen ovi kal rakia verakia

Vaafilu olam habba vegan eden haelon medor nishmot hatztzaddikim haggedolim vehanneshamot atzman veen tzarich lomar hammalachim hen bivchinat gevul vetachlit ki yesh gevul lehassagatan beor-en-sof baruch-hu hammeir alehen behitlabbeshut chachma-bina-daat chu velachen yesh gevul lahanaatan shennehenin mizziv hashshechina umitannegin beor ki en yecholin lekabbel hanaa vetaanug bivchinat en-sof mammash shello yitbattelu mimmetziutan veyachzeru limkoran

Vehinne peratiyyut hatztzimtzumim ech uma en kan mekom beuram ach derech kelal hen hem bechinat hester vehelem hamshachat haor vehachayyut shello yair veumshach lattachtonim bivchinat giluy lehitlabbesh ulhashpia bahen ulhachaotam lihot yesh meayin ki im meat mizzeer or vechayyut bichde sheyyihu bivchinat gevul vetachlit shehi heara muetet meod umammash kela chashive legabbe bechinat heara beli gevul vetachlit veen benehem erech veyachas kelal kannoda perush millat erech bemisparim sheechad bemispar yesh lo erech legabbe mispar elef alafim shehu chelek echad minni elef alafim aval legabbe davar shehu bivchinat beli gevul umispar kelal en kenegdo shum erech bemisparim sheafilu elef alfe alafim veribo revavot enan afilu keerech mispar echad legabbe elef alfe alafim veribbo revavot ella kela mammash chashive

Vechacha mammash hi bechinat haheara muetet zo hammitlabbeshet beolamot elonim vetachtonim lehashpia bahem lehachaotam legabbe erech or hagganuz venelam shehu bivchinat en-sof veeno mitlabbesh umashpia baolamot bivchinat giluy lehachaotam ella makkif alehem milmala venikra sovev kal almin

Veen happerush sovev umakkif milmala bivchinat makom chas veshalom ki lo shayyach kelal bechinat makom beruchaniyyut ella rotze lomar sovev umakkif milmala leinyan bechinat giluy hashpaa ki hahashpaa shehu bivchinat giluy baolamot nikret beshem halbasha shemmitlabbeshet baolamot ki hem malbishim umassigim hahashpaa shemmekabbelim ma sheen ken hahashpaa sheenah bivchinat giluy ella behester vehelem veen haolamot massigim otah enah nikret mitlabbeshet ella makkefet vesovevet hilkach meachar shehaolamot hem bivchinat gevul vetachlit nimtza sheen hashpaat or-en-sof mitlabbesh umitgalla bahem bivchinat giluy rak meat mizzeer heara muetet metzumtzemet meod meod vehi rak kede lehachaotam bivchinat gevul vetachlit
Aval ikar haor beli tzimtzum kal kach nikra makkif vesovev meachar sheen hashpaato mitgallet betocham meachar shehem bivchinat gevul vetachlit

Vehammashal baze hinne haaretz hallezu haggashmiyyut af shemmelo chal haaretz kevodo vehayenu or-en-sof baruch-hu kemo shekkatuv halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male neum af-al-pi-chen en mitlabbesh betochah bivchinat giluy hahashpaa rak chayyut meat mizzeer bechinot domem vetzomeach levad vechal or-en-sof baruch-hu nikra sovev aleha af shehu betochah mammash meachar sheen hashpaato mitgallet bah yoter rak mashpia bah bivchinat hester vehelem vechal hashpaa shebbivchinat hester nikra makkif milmala ki alma deitkasya hu lemala bemadrega mealma deitgalya

Ulkarev el hassechel yoter hu bederech mashal kemo haadam shemmetzayyer bedato eze davar sheraa o sheroe hinne af shekkal guf etzem haddavar hahu vegabbo vetocho vetoch tocho kullo metzuyyar bedato umachashavto mippene sheraahu chullo o sheroehu hinne nikret dato makkefet haddavar hahu kullo vehaddavar hahu mukkaf bedato umachashavto rak sheeno mukkaf befoal mammash rak bedimon machashevet haadam vedato

Aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu dichtiv beh ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem chu hare machashavto vedato sheyyodea kal hannivraim makkefet kal nivra venivra merosho vead tachtito vetocho vetoch tocho hakkol befoal mammash

Lemashal kaddur haaretz hallezu hare yediato yitbarech makkefet kal ovi kaddur haaretz vechal asher betocho vetoch tocho ad tachtito hakkol befoal mammash shehare yedia zo hi chayyut kal ovi kaddur haaretz kullo vehithauuto meayin leyesh rak shello haya mithave kemot shehu atta baal gevul vetachlit vechayyut muetet meod kede bechinot domem vetzomeach im lo al yede tzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim shetztzimtzemu haor vehachayyut shennitlabbesh bechaddur haaretz lehachaoto ulkayemo bivchinat gevul vetachlit uvivchinot domem vetzomeach bilvad

Ach yediato yitbarech hamuchedet bemahuto veatzmuto ki hu hammadda vehu hayyodea vehu hayyadua uvidiat atzmo kivyachol yodea kal hannivraim velo bidia shechutz mimmennu kidiat haadam ki kullam nimtzaim meamitato yitbarech vedavar ze en bicholet haadam lehassigo al buro vechu

Kemo shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha vehiskimu mo chachme hakkabbala kemo shekkatuv bappardes meharmak zichrono livracha vechen hu lefi kabbalat haari zichrono livracha besod hatztzimtzumim vehitlabbeshut orot bakkelim kemo shennitbaer lel perek

Hare yedia zo meachar shehi bivchinat en-sof enah nikret beshem mitlabbeshet bechaddur haaretz shehu baal gevul vetachlit ella makkefet vesovevet af sheyedia zo kolelet kal avo vetocho befoal mammash umhava oto al yede ze meayin leyesh uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 49: Vehinne af ki perate bechinot hahester vehahelem or-en-sof baruch-hu behishtalshelut haolamot ad shennivra olam hazze haggashmi atzmu misfor uminim mimminim shonim kayyadua lattoamim meetz hachayyim ach derech kelal hem shelosha mine tzimtzumim atzumim kelaliyyim lishlosha mine olamot kelaliyyim uvchal kelal yesh ribbo rivvot peratiym vehem shelosha olamot beria yetzira asiyya ki olam haatzilut hu elohut mammash

Uchde livro olam habberia shehen neshamot umalachim elonim asher avodatam la bivchinat chachma-bina-daat hammitlabbeshim bahem vehem massigim umkabbelim mehem haya techilla tzimtzum atzum kannizkar leel

Vechen mibberia litzira ki or meat mizzeer hammitlabbesh beolam habberia adayin hu bivchinat en-sof legabbe olam hayetzira vei efshar lehitlabbesh bo ella al yede tzimtzum vehelem vechen mitzira laasiyya uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher beur shelosha tzimtzumim ellu baarichut lekarev el sichlenu haddal

Vetachlit kal hatztzimtzumim hu kede livro guf haadam hachumri ulachpaya lesitra achora velihot yitron haor min hachoshech behaalot haadam et nafsho haelohit vehachiyyunit ulvusheha vechal kochot hagguf kullan la levaddo kannizkar leel baarichut ki ze tachlit hishtalshelut haolamot

Vehinne kammayim happanim lappanim kemo shehakkadosh-baruch-hu kivyachol hinniach vesilek letzad echad derech mashal et oro haggadol habbilti tachlit ugnazo vehistiro beg mine tzimtzumim shonim vehakkol bishvil ahavat haadam hattachton lehaaloto la ki ahava docheket habbasar al achat kamma vechamma bechifle chiflayim leen ketz ki rauy leadam gam ken lehanniach velaazov kal asher lo minnefesh vead basar ulhafkir hakkol bishvil ledavka bo yitbarech bidvika chashika vachafitza velo yihye shum monea mibbayit umibbachutz lo guf velo nefesh velo mamon velo ishsha uvanim

Uvaze yuvan tuv taam vadaat letakkanat chachamim shettikkenu birchot keriat shema shettayim lefaneha chu delichora en lahem shayyachut kelal im keriat shema kemo shekkatvu harashba ushar poskim velamma karu otan birchot keriat shema velamma tikkenu otan lefaneha daveka

Ella mishshum sheikar keriat shema lekayyem bechal levavcha chu bishne yetzarecha chu dehayenu laamod neged kal monea meahavat ulvavcha hen haishsha viladeha shellevavo shel adam keshura vahen betivo kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk hu amar vayyehi zo ishsha hu tziva vayyaamod ellu vanim venafshecha umodecha kemashmao chayye umzone lehafkir hakkol bishvil ahavat

Veech yavo haadam hachumri lemidda zo lechach sidru techilla birkat yotzer or vesham neemar venishna baarichut inyan veseder hammalachim haomdim berum olam lehodia gedullato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu ech shekkullam betelim leoro yitbarech umashmiim beyira chu umakdishim chu veomrim beyira kadosh chu kelomar shehu muvdal mehen veeno mitlabbesh bahen bivchinat giluy ella melo chal haaretz kevodo hi keneset yisrael lemala veyisrael lematta kannizkar leel
Vechen haofannim vechayyot hakkodesh beraash gadol vechu baruch kevod mimmekomo lefi sheen yodim umassigim mekomo uchmo sheomrim ki hu levaddo marom vekadosh

Veachar-kach beracha sheniyya ahavat olam ahavtanu elohenu kelomar shehinniach kal tzeva mala hakkedoshim vehishra shechinato alenu lihot nikra elohenu kemo elohe avraham chu kannizkar leel vehayenu ki ahava docheket habbasar velachen nikra ahavat olam shehi bechinat tzimtzum oro haggadol habbilti tachlit lehitlabbesh bivchinat gevul hannikra olam baavur ahavat ammo yisrael kede lekarvam elav likalel beyichudo veachduto yitbarech

Vezehu sheomrim chemla gedola vitera perush yetera al kirvat elohim shebbechal tzeva mala uvanu vacharta mikkal am velashon hu hagguf hachumri hannidme bechumriyyuto legufe ummot haolam vekeravtanu vechu lehodot vechu uferush hodaa yitbaer bemakom acher ulyachedcha chu likalel beyichudo yitbarech kannizkar leel

Vehinne kaasher yasim hammaskil elle haddevarim el umka delibba umocha azay mimmela kammayim happanim lappanim titlahet nafsho vetitlabbesh beruach nediva lehitnaddev lehanniach velaazov kal asher lo minneged verak ledavka bo yitbarech velikalel beoro bidvika chashika vechu bivchinat neshikin veitdabbekut rucha berucha kannizkar leel

Ach ech hi bechinat itdabbekut rucha berucha laze amar vehau haddevarim haelle chu al levavecha vedibbarta bam chu uchmo shekkatuv beetz chayyim sheyyichud hanneshikin ikaro hu yichud chachma-bina-daat bechachma-bina-daat vehu iyyun hattora vehappe hu motza haruach vegiluo bivchinat giluy vehayenu bechinat haddibbur bedivre tora ki al motza fi yichye haadam

Umikkal makom lo yatza yede chovato behirhur veiyyun levaddo ad sheyyotzi bisfatav kede lehamshich or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta ad nefesh hachiyyunit hashshochenet bedam haadam hammithave middomem-tzomeach-chay kede lehaalot kullan la im kal haolam kullo ulchallan beyichudo veoro yitbarech asher yair laaretz veladdarim bivchinat giluy venigla kevod verau chal basar vechu shezzehu tachlit hishtalshelut kal haolamot lihot kevod male chal haaretz hallezu daveka bivchinat giluy leahafacha chashocha linhora umrira lemitka kannizkar leel baarichut
Vezehu tachlit kavanat haadam baavodato lehamshich or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta rak shetztzarich techilla haalaat mayyin nukvin limsor lo nafsho umodo kannizkar leel
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 50: Vehinne kal bechinot umadregot ahava hannizkarot leel hen missitra deyammina uvchinat kohen ish chesed venikraot kesef hakkodashim milleshon nichsof nichsafta levet avicha
Ach yesh od bechinat ahava haola al kullana kemaalat hazzahav al hakkesef vehi ahava kerishpe esh mibbechinat gevurot elonot devina ilaa

Dehayenu sheal yede hitbonnut bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu dechulla kammeh kela mammash chashiv titlahet vetitlahev hannefesh likar tiferet gedullato ulistakkela bikara demalka kerishpe esh shalhevet azza haola lemala velipared mehappetila vehaetzim shenneechezet bahen vehayenu al yede tigboret yesod haesh elohi shebbannefesh haelohit umizze baa lide tzimmaon uchmo shekkatuv tzama lecha nafshi veachar kach livchinat cholat ahava veachar kach baa lide kelot hannefesh mammash kemo shekkatuv gam kalta nafshi

Vehinne mikkan yatza shoresh halviyyim lematta veleatid shehaolam yitalle yihu hem hakkohanim uchmo sheamar haari zichrono livracha al pasuk vehakkohanim halviyyim shehalviyyim shel achshav yihu kohanim leatid vaavodat halviyyim hayeta leharim kol rina vetoda beshira vezimra benigun unima bivchinat ratzo vashov shehi bechinat ahava azza zo keshalhevet hayyotze min habbazak kidita baggemara perek b dachagiga

Vei efshar levaer inyan ze hetev bemichtav rak kal ish nilbav venavon hammaskil al davar umaamik lekashsher dato utvunato ba yimtza tov veor hagganuz benafsho hammaskelet kal chad lefum shiura dileh yesh mitpael chu veyesh mitpael chu achare kedimat yirat chet lihot sur mera betachlit shello lihot aonotechem mavdilim chu chas veshalom

Vehinne seder haavoda beesek hattora vehammitzot hannimshechet mibbechinat ahava azza zo hi bivchinat shov levad kemo shekkatuv besefer yetzira veim ratz libbecha shuv leechad perush veim ratz libbecha hi teshukat hannefesh shebballev bechalal hayemani keshemmitgabberet umitlahevet umitlahetet bimod meod ad kelot hannefesh mammash lehishtappech el chek aviha chayye hachayyim baruch-hu velatzet mimmaasarah bagguf haggufani vegashmi ledavka bo yitbarech azay zot yashiv el libbo maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ki al karchach atta chay bagguf hazze lehachaoto kede lehamshich chayyim elonim mechayye hachayyim baruch-hu lematta al yede torat chayyim lihot dira battachtonim leachduto yitbarech bivchinat giluy kemo shennitbaer leel uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh lemeheve echad beechad perush shehayyichud hannelam yihye bivchinat alma deitgalya

Vezehu sheomrim lecha dodi vechu uvaze yuvan maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al karchach atta chay veal karchach vchu veella ech yihye retzono uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut al mishna zo al karchach atta chay beezrat chayye hachayyim baruch-hu
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 51: Vehinne letosefet beur leshon hayyannuka dilel tzarich levaer techilla lehavin ketzat inyan hashraat hashshechina shehayeta shora bevet kadshe kadashim vechen kal mekom hashraat hashshechina ma inyano halo melo chal haaretz kevodo velet atar panuy mineh

Ach hainyan kedichtiv umibbesari echeze eloha shekkemo shennishmat haadam hi memallea kal ramach evre hagguf merosho vead raglo veaf-al-pi-chen ikar mishkanah vehashraatah hi bemocho umehammoach mitpashshetet lechal haevarim vechal ever mekabbel mimmenna chayyut vechoach harauy lo lefi mizgo utchunato haayin lirot vehaozen lishmoa vehappe ledabber veharaglayim lahaloch kannire bechush shebbammoach margish kal hannifal beramach evarim vechal hakkorot otam

Vehinne en shinuy kabbalat hakkochot vehachayyut shebbeevre hagguf min hanneshama mitztzad atzmah umahutah sheyyihye mahutah veatzmutah mitchallek leramach chalakim shonim mitlabbeshim beramach mekomot kefi tziyyur chelke mekomot evre hagguf shellefi ze nimtza atzmutah umahutah metzuyyar betziyyur gashmi udmut vetavnit ketavnit hagguf chas veshalom ella kullah etzem echad ruchani pashut umufshat mikkal tziyyur gashmi umibbechinat vegeder makom umidda ugvul gashmi mitztzad mahutah veatzmutah velo shayyach bemahutah veatzmutah lomar shehi bammochin shebbarosh yoter mibbaraglayim meachar shemmahutah veatzmutah eno begeder uvchinat makom ugvul gashmi rak shettaryag mine kochot vechayyut kelulim bah bemahutah veatzmutah latzet el happoal vehaggiluy mehahelem lehachaot ramach evarin veshasa gidin shebbagguf al yede hitlabbeshutam bannefesh hachiyyunit sheyyesh lah gam ken ramach veshasa kochot vechayyut hallalu

Vehinne al hamshachat kal hattaryag mine kochot vechayyut mehelem hanneshama el hagguf lehachaoto aleha amru sheikar mishkanah vehashraatah shel hamshacha zo vegiluy ze hu kullo bammochin shebbarosh velachen hem mekabbelim techilla hakkoach vehachayyut harauy lahem lefi mizgam utchunatam shehen chachma-bina-daat vechoach hammachashava vechal hashshayyach lammochin velo zo bilvad ella gam kelalut kal hamshachot hachayyut lishar haevarim gam ken kelula umlubbeshet bammochin shebbarosh vesham hu ikarah vesharshah shel hamshacha zo bivchinat giluy haor vehachayyut shel kal hanneshama chullah umishsham mitpashshetet heara lishar kal haevarim umkabbel kal echad koach vechaut harauy lo kefi mizgo utchunato koach hariyya mitgalle baayin vechoach hashshemia baozen vechu vechal hakkochot mitpashshetim mehammoach kannoda ki sham hu ikar mishkan hanneshama chullah bivchinat giluy shenniglet sham kelalut hachayyut hammitpashshet mimmenna rak kochoteha shel kelalut hachayyut meirim umitpashshetim mishsham lechal evre hagguf kedimon haor hammitpashshet umeir mehashshemesh lechadre chadarim vaafilu hallev mekabbel mehammoach velachen hammoach shallit alav betoladto kannizkar leel

Vechacha mammash al derech mashal en-sof baruch-hu memalle kal almin lehachaotam uvchal olam yesh beruim leen ketz vetachlit ribbo revavot mine madregot malachim unshamot chu vechen ribuy haolamot en lo ketz ugvul gavoha al gavoha chu

Vehinne mahuto veatzmuto shel en-sof baruch-hu shave baelonim vetachtonim kimshal hanneshama hannizkar leel uchmo shekkatuv battikunim deihu setimu dechal setimin perush daafilu bealmin setimin dilela hu satum venelam betocham kemo shehu satum venelam battachtonim ki let machashava tefisa veh kelal afilu beolamot elonim venimtza kemo shemmatzuy sham kach nimtza battachtonim mammash

Vehahevdel shebben olamot elonim vetachtonim hu mitztzad hamshachat hachayyut asher en-sof baruch-hu mamshich umeir bivchinat giluy mehahelem shezze echad mehatteamim shehahashpaa vehamshachat hachayyut mechunna beshem or al derech mashal lehachaot haolamot vehabberuim shebbahem shehaolamot haelonim mekabbelim bivchinat giluy ketzat yoter mehattachtonim vechal habberuim shebbahem mekabbelim kal echad kefi kocho utchunato shehi techunat uvchinat hamshacha happeratit asher en-sof baruch-hu mamshich umeir lo
Vehattachtonim afilu haruchaniyyim enam mekabbelim bivchinat giluy kal kach rak bilvushim rabbim asher en-sof baruch-hu malbish bahem hachayyut vehaor asher mamshich umeir lahem lehachaotam

Vechal kach atzmu vegavru hallevushim asher en-sof baruch-hu malbish umastir bahem haor vehachayyut ad asher bara vo olam hazze hachumri vehaggashmi mammash umhavehu umchayyehu bechayyut veor asher mamshich umeir lo or hamlubbash umchusse umustar betoch hallevushim harabbim vehaatzumim hammaalimim umastirim haor vehachayyut ad sheen nire venigle shum or vechayyut rak devarim chumriyyim vegashmiyyim venirim metim ach betocham yesh or vechayyut hamhave otam meayin leyesh tamid shello yachzeru lihot ayin vaefes keshehau veor ze hu meen-sof baruch-hu rak shennitlabbesh bilvushim rabbim uchmo shekkatuv beetz chayyim sheor vechayyut kaddur haaretz hachumri hannire leene vasar hu mimmalchut demalchut daasiyya uvtochah malchut ditzira vechu ad shebbetoch kullan sefirot daatzilut hamuchadot bemaatzilan en-sof baruch-hu
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 52: Uchmo shebbenishmat haadam ikar giluy kelalut hachayyut hu bammochin vechal haevarim mekabbelim or vechoach levad hammeir lahem mimmekor giluy hachayyut shebbammochin kacha mammash al derech mashal ikar giluy kelalut hamshachat hachayyut lehachaot haolamot vehabberuim shebbahem hu melubbash venichlal birtzono vechachmato uvinato vedato yitbarech hannikrain beshem mochin vehen hen hamlubbashim battora umitzoteha

Vegiluy kelalut hamshacha zo hu mekor hachayyut asher haolamot mekabbelim kal echad bifratut rak heara mitpashshetet umira mimmakor ze kedimon or hammitpashshet mehashshemesh al derech mashal vechochot evre hagguf mehammoach hannizkar leel

Umakor ze hu hannikra alma deitgalleya umatronita veima tattaa ushchina milleshon veshachanti betocham al shem shemmakor ze hu reshit hitgallut or-en-sof asher mamshich umeir laolamot bivchinat giluy umimmakor ze nimshach lechal echad haor vechayyut perati harauy lo veshochen umitlabbesh betocham lehachaotam

Velachen nikra em habbanim al derech mashal uchneset yisrael shemmimmakor ze neetzlu neshamot daatzilut venivreu neshamot divria vechu vechullan enan rak mehitpashshetut hachayyut vehaor mehammakor hazze hannikra shechina kehitpashshetut haor mehashshemesh

Aval hashshechina atzmah shehi reshit haggiluy veikaro ma sheen-sof baruch-hu meir laolamot bivchinat giluy vehi mekor kal hamshachot hachayyut shebbechal haolamot shekkal hachayyut shebbahem eno rak or hammitpashshet mimmenna kaor hammitpashshet mehashshemesh i efshar laolamot lisbol ulkabbel or shechinatah shettishkon vetitlabbesh betocham mammash belo levush hammaalim umastir orah mehem shello yitbattelu bimtziut legamre bimkoram kevitul or hashshemesh bimkoro beguf hashshemesh sheen nire sham or ze rak etzem guf hashshemesh bilvad

Umahu hallevush sheyyuchal lehastirah ulhalbishah velo yitbattel bimtziut beorah hu retzono yitbarech vechachmato vechu hamlubbashim battora umitzoteha hanniglet lanu ulvanenu deorayeta mechachma nafkat hi chachma ilaa dilela leela mealma deitgalya deihu chakkim vela vechachma yedia vechu uchmo shennitbaer leel sheor-en-sof baruch-hu melubbash umuchad bechachma ilaa vehu yitbarech vechachmato echad rak sheyyarda beseter hammadregot mimmadrega lemadrega behishtalshelut haolamot ad shennitlabbesha bidvarim gashmiyyim shehen taryag mitzot hattora

Uviridatah behishtalshelut meolam leolam gam hashshechina yarda venitlabbesha bah bechal olam veolam vezehu hechal kadshe kadashim shebbechal olam veolam uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar veetz chayyim shehashshechina shehi malchut daatzilut shehi bechinat giluy or-en-sof baruch-hu vechayyut shemmeir laolamot velachen hi nikret devar veruach piv kivyachol al derech mashal kemo shebbaadam haddibbur hu megalle machashavto hassetuma venelama lehashshomim hi mitlabbeshet behechal kadshe kadashim divria shehi chachma-bina-daat divria uvhitlabbeshutan bemalchut divria nivreu hanneshamot vehammalachim shebbabberia

Vegam mishsham nimshach hattalmud shellefanenu uchmo shennitbaer leel beshem hattikunim shebbeolam habberia meirot umashpiot sham chachmato uvinato vedato shel en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat tzimtzum atzum bichde sheyyuchlu hanneshamot vehammalachim shehem baale gevul vetachlit lekabbel hashpaa mibbechinat chachma-bina-daat ellu velachen nimshach mishsham hattalmud shehu gam ken bechinat chachma-bina-daat shehattalmud hu taame hahalachot al buryan vehatteamim hem bechinat chachma-bina-daat vehahalachot atzman hen mimmiddotav shel en-sof baruch-hu shehen chesed din rachamim chu shemmehen nimshach haheter vehaisur vehakkasher vehappasul vehachiyyuv vehappetur kemo shekkatuv battikunim

Uvhitlabbeshut malchut daatzilut bemalchut divria mitlabbeshet behechal kadshe kadashim ditzira shehu chachma-bina-daat ditzira uvhitlabbeshutan bemalchut ditzira notzru haruchot vehammalachim shebbitzira
Vegam mishsham hi hammishna shellefanenu shehi halachot pesukot hannimshachot gam ken mechachma-bina-daat shel en-sof baruch-hu

Rak shebbechinot chachma-bina-daat shehem taame hahalachot hem melubbashim ugnuzim begufe hahalachot velo bivchinat giluy vegufe hahalachot shehen bivchinat giluy hen hen hearat middotav shel en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat giluy kemo shennitbaer leel beshem hattikunim deshit sefiran mekannenin bitzira shehen derech kelal shene kavin yamin usmol lehakel missitra dechesed dehayenu lehattir sheyyuchal laalot el o lehachamir chu vehakkol al pi chachma ilaa daatzilut uvina vadaat kelulot bah umuchadot been-sof baruch-hu ki betoch kullan melubbashot chachma-bina-daat daatzilut sheor-en-sof baruch-hu meuchad bahen betachlit hayyichud
Vechen bederech ze yarda hashshechina venitlabbesha behechal kadshe kadashim daasiyya
Vechal olam mig olamot ellu mitchallek lerivvot madregot hannikraot gam ken olamot peratim umalchut daatzilut melubbeshet bammalchut
Uvaze yuvan leshon hakkatuv malchutcha malchut kal olamim
Shel kal olam perati yoredet umitlabbeshet behechal kadshe kadashim shehu chachma-bina-daat shebbaolam shellemata mimmennu bemadrega

Vehinne mehashshechina hamlubbeshet behechal kadshe kadashim shel kal olam veolam kelali o perati nimshach umitpashshet mimmenna or vechayyut lechal haolam vehabberuim shebbo neshamot umalachim vechu ki kullam nivreu baasara maamarot shebbemaase vereshit shehem devar hannikra beshem shechina
Tanya, Part I; Likkutei Amarim 53: Vehinne keshehaya bayit rishon kayyam shebbo haya haaron vehalluchot bevet kadshe kadashim hayeta hashshechina shehi malchut daatzilut shehi bechinat giluy or-en-sof baruch-hu shora sham umlubbeshet baaseret haddibberot beyeter seet veyeter oz begiluy rav veatzum yoter miggiluyah behechlot kadshe kadashim shellemala beolamot elonim

Ki aseret haddibberot hen kelalut hattora chullah denafka miggo chachma ilaa dilela leela mealma deitgalya uchde lechakkan beluchot avanim gashmiyyim lo yarda mimmadrega lemadrega kederech hishtalshelut haolamot ad olam hazze haggashmi ki olam hazze haggashmi mitnaheg behitlabbeshut hatteva haggashmi vehalluchot maase elohim hemma vehammichtav michtav elohim hu lemala mehatteva shel olam hazze haggashmi hannishpa mehearat hashshechina shebbehechal kadshe kadashim daasiyya shemmimmenna nimshach or vechayyut leolam haasiyya sheggam olam hazze bichlalo ella bechinat chachma ilaa daatzilut shehi kelalut hattora shebbe haddibberot nitlabbesha bemalchut daatzilut vedivria levaddan vehen levaddan hamuchadot beor-en-sof shebbetochan hen hannikraot beshem shechina hashshora bekadshe kadashim devayit rishon al yede hitlabbeshutah be haddibberot hachakukot balluchot shebbaaron benes umaase elohim chayyim hu alma deitkasya hamkannen beolam habberia kannoda leode chen

Uvvayit sheni shello haya vo haaron vehalluchot amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shello hayeta shechina shora bo perush madregat shechina shehayeta shora bevayit rishon shello kederech hishtalshelut haolamot ella bevayit sheni hayeta shora kederech hishtalshelut vehitlabbeshut malchut daatzilut bemalchut divria vedivria bemalchut ditzira veditzira behechal kadshe kadashim daasiyya vekadshe kadashim daasiyya haya mitlabbesh bekadshe kadashim shebbevet hammikdash shellematta vesharta bo hashshechina malchut ditzira hamlubbeshet bekadshe kadashim daasiyya velachen lo haya rashshay shum adam likanes sham levad kohen gadol beom hakkippurim umishshecharav bet hammikdash en lo lehakkadosh-baruch-hu beolamo ella ammot shel halacha bilvad vaafilu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora shechina immo kidita bivrachot perek kamma perush shechina immo kederech hishtalshelut vehitlabbeshut malchut daatzilut bemalchut divria vitzira vaasiyya

Ki taryag mitzot hattora rubban kechullan hen mitzot maasiyyot vegam hatteluot bedibbur umachashava kemo talmud tora uvirkat hammazon ukriat shema utfilla ha kayema lan dehirhur lav kedibbur dame veeno yotze yede chovato behirhur vechavana levad ad sheyyotzi bisfatav vekayema lan daakimat sefatav have maase

Vetaryag mitzot hattora im sheva mitzot derabbanan begimatriyya keter shehu ratzon haelon baruch hu hamlubbash bechachmato yitbarech hamuchadot beor-en-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud va bechachma yasad aretz hi tora shebbeal pe denafka mechachma ilaa kemo shekkatuv bazzohar deabba yasad beratta

Vezehu sheamar hayyannuka dinhora ilaa deadlik al resheh hi shechinta itzterich lemishcha perush lehitlabbesh bechachma hannikret shemen mishchat kodesh kemo shekkatuv bazzohar veinun ovadin tavin hen taryag mitzot hannimshachot mechachmato yitbarech kede leechoz or hashshechina bappetila hi nefesh hachiyyunit shebbagguf hannikret petila al derech mashal ki kemo shebbanner haggashmi haor meir al yede kilon usrefat happetila hannehpechet leesh kach or hashshechina shore al nefesh haelohit al yede kilon nefesh habbahamit vehithappechutah mechashocha linhora umimmeriru lemitka batztzaddikim o lefachot al yede kilon levusheha shehen machashava dibbur umaase vehithappechutan mechoshech hakkelipot leor en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash umuchad bemachashava dibbur umaase shel taryag mitzot hattora babbenonim

Ki al yede hithappechut nefesh habbahamit habbaa mikkelipat nogah mechashocha linhora vechu naase bechinat haalaat mayyin nukvin lehamshich or hashshechina hi bechinat giluy or-en-sof baruch-hu al nafsho haelohit shebbammochin shebberosho uvaze yuvan hetev ma shekkatuv ki elohecha esh ochla hu uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher
Nishlam chelek rishon bezrat yitbarech veyitalle
Tanya, Part II; Shaar HaYichud VehaEmuna: Likkute amarim chelek sheni
Hannikra beshem chinuch katan
Melukkat mippi sefarim umippi sofrim kedoshe elon nishmatam-eden meussad al parasha rishona shel keriat-shema
Chanoch lannaar al pi darko gam ki yazkin lo yasur mimmenna hinne middichtiv al pi darko mashma sheenah derech haemet laamito veim ken may maaluta sheggam ki yazkin lo yasur mimmenna

Ach hinne mudaat zot ki sharshe avodat visodoteha hen dechilu urchimu hayyira shoresh visod lesur mera vehaahava levaase tov vekiyyum kal mitzot ase deorayeta udrabbanan kemo sheyyitbaer bimkoman umitzvat hachinuch hi gam ken bemitzot ase kemo shekkatuv beorach chayyim siman
Vehinne beahava ketiv besof parashat ekev asher anochi metzave etchem laasotah leahava et vego vetzarich lehavin ech shayyach leshon asiyya gabbe ahava shebballev

Ach hainyan hu deyesh shene mine ahavat haachat hi kelot hannefesh betivah el borah kaasher titgabber nefesh hassichlit al hachomer vetashpilehu vetachniehu tachteha azay titlahev vetitlahet beshalhevet haola meeleha vetagel vetismach ba oseha vetitanneg al taanug nifla vehazzochim lemaalat ahava rabba zo hem hannikraim tzaddikim kedichtiv simchu tzaddikim ba ach lo kal adam zoche laze ki laze tzarich zikuch hachomer bimod meod vegam tora umaasim tovim harbe lizkot linshama elona shellemala mimmadregat ruach vanefesh kemo shekkatuv bereshit chachma shaar haahava

Vehashshenit hi ahava shekkal adam yuchal lehaggia eleha kesheyyitbonen hetev beumka delibba biddevarim hammeorrim et haahava la belev kal yisrael hen derech kelal ki hu chayyenu mammash vechaasher haadam ohev et nafsho vechayyav ken yeehav et kaasher yitbonen veyasim el libbo ki hu nafsho haamitit vechayyav mammash kemo shekkatuv bazzohar al pasuk nafshi iviticha vego vehen derech perat shekkesheyyavin veyaskil bigdullato shel melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu derech peratit kaasher yuchal seet besichlo uma shellemala missichlo

Veachar kach yitbonen beahavat haggedola veniflaa elenu lered lemitzrayim ervat haaretz lehotzi nishmotenu mikkur habbarzel shehu hassitra achora rachamana litztzelan lekarvenu elav uldabbekenu bishmo mammash vehu ushmo echad dehayenu sherommanu mittachlit hashshiflut vehattuma letachlit hakkedushsha ugdullato yitbarech sheen lah ketz vetachlit azay kammayim happanim el panim titorer haahava belev kal maskil umitbonen beinyan ze beumka delibba leehov et ahava azza uldavka vo belev vanefesh kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomah baarichut

Vehinne inyan ahava zo ratza moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom lita belev kal yisrael befarasha veatta yisrael vego bappasuk hen la elohecha hashshamayim vego rak baavotecha chashak vego umaltem vego beshivim nefesh vego veahavta vego velachen siyyem devarav al ahava zo asher anochi metzave etchem laasotah shehi ahava asuya ballev al yede habbina vehaddaat bidvarim hammeorrim et haahava veal ze tziva kevar techilla vehau haddevarim haelle asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha kede sheal yede ze tavo leahava et kidita besifre al pasuk ze

Vehinne al ahava zo hashshenit shayyach leshon mitzva vetziuuy dehayenu lasum libbo vedato bidvarim hammeorrim et haahava aval beahava rishona shehi shalhevet haola meeleha lo shayyach leshon tziuuy umitzva kelal velo od ella shehi mattan secharan shel tzaddikim litom meen olam habba baolam hazze shealeha neemar avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomah

Ach hinne yadua layyodim taama dikra may dichtiv ki sheva yippol tzaddik vakam uvifrat shehaadam nikra mehallech velo omed vetzarich lelech mimmadrega lemadrega velo laamod bemadrega achat leolam uven madrega lemadrega terem sheyyaggia lemadrega elona mimmenna hu bivchinat nefila mimmadrega harishona ach ki yippol lo yutal ketiv veenah nikret nefila ella legabbe madregato harishona velo legabbe shear kal adam chas veshalom sheaf-al-pi-chen hu lemala mikkal haadam baavodato ki nishar bah bechinat reshimu mimmadregato harishona ach ikarah meahava shennitchannech vehurgal bah minneurav beterem shehiggia lemadregat tzaddik vezehu shekkatuv gam ki yazkin vego vehinne reshit haddevarim hammeorrim haahava vehayyira visodan hi haemuna hattehora veneemana beyichudo veachduto yitbarech veyitalle
Lehavin meat mizzeer ma shekkatuv bazzohar dishma yisrael chu hu yichuda ilaa uvaruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed hu yichuda tattaa

Veyadata hayyom vahashevota el levavecha ki hu haelohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat en od vetzarich lehavin vechi taale al datecha sheyyesh elohim nishre bammayim mittachat laaretz shetztzarich lehazhir kal kach vahashevota el levavecha

Hinne ketiv leolam devarcha nitztzav bashshamayim ufiresh habbaal-shem-tov zichrono livracha ki devarcha sheamarta yehi rakia betoch hammayim vego tevot veotiyyot ellu hen nitztzavot veomdot leolam betoch rekia hashshamayim umlubbashot betoch kal harkiim leolam lehachaotam kedichtiv udvar elohenu yakum leolam udvarav chayim vekayyamim laad chu ki ilu hau haotiyyot mistallekot kerega chas veshalom vechozrot limkoran hau kal hashshamayim ayin vaefes mammash vehau kelo hau kelal uchmo kodem maamar yehi rakia chu mammash

Vechen bechal habberuim shebbechal haolamot elonim vetachtonim vaafilu eretz hallezu haggashmit uvchinat domem mammash ilu hau mistallekot mimmenna kerega chas veshalom haotiyyot measara maamarot shebbahen nivret haaretz besheshet yeme vereshit hayeta chozeret leayin vaefes mammash kemo lifne sheshet yeme vereshit mammash

Vezehu sheamar haari zichrono livracha sheggam bedomem mammash kemo avanim veafar umayim yesh bechinat nefesh vechayyut ruchanit dehayenu bechinat hitlabbeshut otiyyot haddibbur measara maamarot hamchayyot umhauot et haddomem lihot yesh meayin vaefes shellifne sheshet yeme vereshit

Veaf shello huzkar shem even baasara maamarot shebbattora af-al-pi-chen nimshach chayyut laeven al yede tzerufim vechilufe otiyyot hammitgalgelot berl shearim panim veachor kemo shekkatuv besefer yetzira ad shemmishtalshel measara maamarot venimshach mehen tzeruf shem even vehu chayyuto shel haeven

Vechen bechal hannivraim shebbaolam hashshemot shennikraim bahem bilshon hakkodesh hen hen otiyyot haddibbur hammishtalshelot mimmadrega lemadrega measara maamarot shebbattora al yede chilufim utmurot haotiyyot berl shearim ad shemmaggiot umitlabbeshot beoto nivra lehachaoto

Lefi sheen perate hannivraim yecholim lekabbel chayyutam measara maamarot atzman shebbattora shehachayyut hannimshach mehen atzman gadol meod mibbechinat hannivraim peratiyyim veen koach bahem lekabbel hachayyut ella al yede sheyyored hachayyut umishtalshel mimmadrega lemadrega pechuta mimmenna al yede chilufim utmurot haotiyyot vegimatriyyaot shehen cheshbon haotiyyot ad sheyyuchal lehittzamtzem ulhitlabbesh ulhithauot mimmennu nivra perati

Veze shemo asher yikreu lo bilshon hakkodesh hu keli lachayyut hamtzumtzam beotiyyot shem ze shennishtalshel measara maamarot shebbattora sheyyesh bahem koach vechayyut livro yesh meayin ulhachaoto leolam deorayeta vekudsha berich hu kulla chad

Vehinne mikkan teshuvat hamminim vegiluy shoresh tautam hakkofrim behashgacha feratit uvotot umofte hattora shettoim bedimonam hakkozev shemmedamin maase ose shamayim vaaretz lemaase enosh vetachbulotav ki kaasher yatza latztzoref keli shuv en hakkeli tzarich lide hatztzoref ki af sheyyadav mesullakot hemennu veholech lo bashshuk hakkeli kayyam betavnito vetzalmo mammash kaasher yatza mide hatztzoref kach medammin hassechalim haellu maase shamayim vaaretz

Ach tach merot enehem hahevdel haggadol shebben maase enosh vetachbulotav shehu yesh miyyesh rak shemmeshanne hatztzura vehattemuna mittemunat chatichat kesef litmunat keli lemaase shamayim vaaretz shehu yesh meayin

Vehu pele gadol yoter mikkeriat yam suf al derech mashal sheholich et hayyam beruach kadim azza kal hallayela vayyibbaku hammayim venitztzevu chemo ned uchchoma veilu hifsik et haruach kerega hau hammayim chozrim venigarim bemorad kedarkam vetivam velo kamu kechoma beli safek af shehatteva hazze bammayim gam ken nivra umchuddash yesh meayin shehare chomat avanim nitztzevet meatzmah beli ruach rak shetteva hammayim eno chen
