Vechal shekken vekal vachomer bivriat yesh meayin shehi lemala mehatteva vehafle vafele yoter mikkeriat yam suf al achat kamma vechamma shebbehistallekut koach habbore min hannivra chas veshalom yashuv hannivra leayin vaefes mammash ella tzarich lihot koach happoel bannifal tamid lehachaoto ulkayemo vehen hen bechinot otiyyot haddibbur measara maamarot shebbahem nivreu

Veal ze neemar veatta mechayye et kullam al tikre mechayye ella mehave dehayenu yesh meayin veatta hen bechinot haotiyyot mealef vead tav vehahe hi motzaot happe mekor haotiyyot vehen hen bechinot otiyyot haddibbur measara maamarot shebbahem nivreu

Veaf sheen lo demut hagguf hare mikra male dibber hakkatuv vayedabber vayyomer vehi bechinat hitgallut hachv otiyyot elonot lanneviim umitlabbeshot besichlam vehassagatam bemare hannevua vegam bemachashavtam vediburam kemo shekkatuv ruach dibber bi umillato al leshoni uchmo sheamar haari zichrono livracha beshaar hannevua

Uchen ze hi hitlabbeshut haotiyyot babberuim kedichtiv bidvar shamayim naasu uvruach piv kal tzevaam rak shehi al yede hishtalshelut rabbot vaatzumot ad sheyyordot laasiyya gufanit ma sheen ken hassagat hanneviim hi baatzilut hammitlabbeshet beolam habberia

Vehinne achare haddevarim vehaemet haelle kal maskil al davar yavin laashuro ech shekkal nivra vayesh hu beemet nechshav leayin vaefes mammash legabbe koach happoel veruach piv shebbannifal hamhave oto tamid umotzio meayin mammash leyesh

Uma shekkal nivra venifal nire lanu leyesh umammashut zehu mechamat sheen anu massigim veroim beene vasar et koach veruach piv shebbannivra aval ilu nitna reshut laayin lirot ulhassig et hachayyut veruchaniyyut shebbechal nivra hashshofea bo mimmotza fi veruach piv lo haya gashmiyyut hannivra vechumro umammasho nire kelal leenenu ki hu batel bimtziut mammash legabbe hachayyut veharuchaniyyut shebbo meachar shemmibbalade haruchaniyyut haya ayin vaefes mammash kemo kodem sheshet yeme vereshit mammash veharuchaniyyut hashshofea alav mimmotza fi veruach piv hu levaddo hammotzio tamid meefes vaayin leyesh umhave oto im ken efes bilado beemet

Vehaover al mitzvat lo taase al-yede shennidbak hara benafsho ose pegam lemala besharshah umkor chutzbah ballevushim de sefirot daasiyya kemo shekkatuv betikune zohar levushin tekkinat lon deminnayehu parchin nishmatin livne nasha vechu lechach en kappara lenafsho velo lemala ad yom hakkippurim kemo shekkatuv vechipper al hakkodesh mittumot bene yisrael umippishehem vego lifne titharu lifne dayeka

Velachen en lilmod mikkan shum kulla chas-veshalom bemitzot ase uvifrat betalmud tora veadderabba amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha viter hakkadosh-baruch-hu al avoda-zara vechu af shehen keretot umitot bet-din velo viter al bitul talmud tora

Avar al keretot umitot bet-din teshuva veom hakkippurim tolin veyissurin memarkin perush gomrin hakkappara vehu milleshon merika ushtifa letzachtzeach hannefesh ki kappara hi leshon kinuach shemmekanneach lichluch hachet shenneemar ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim aonam ad kan leshon habbarayeta

Vehinne mitzvat hatteshuva min hattora hi azivat hachet bilvad kidita baggemara perek desanhedrin uvchoshen-mishpat sof siman leinyan edut dehayenu sheyyigmor belibbo belev shalem leval yashuv od lechisla limrod bemalchuto yitbarech velo yaavor od mitzot hammelech chas veshalom hen bemitzot ase hen bemitzot lo taase

Vezehu ikar perush leshon teshuva lashuv el bechal libbo uvchal nafsho leavdo velishmor kal mitzotav kemo shekkatuv yaazov rasha darko veish aven machshevotav veyashov el vego uvfarashat nitztzavim ketiv veshavta ad elokecha veshamata vekolo vego bechal levavcha vego shuva yisrael ad elokecha vego hashivenu elecha vego

Velo kedaat hehamon shehatteshuva hi hattaanit vaafilu mi sheavar al keretot umitot bet-din sheggemar kapparato hi al-yede yissurim hayenu shehakkadosh-baruch-hu mevi alav yissurim uchmo shekkatuv ufakadti veshevet vego ufakadti dayeka vehayenu keshetteshuvato retzuya lefanav yitbarech beshuvo el bechal libbo venafsho meahava azay beitaruta diltatta vekkammayim happanim vechu itaruta dilela leorer haahava vechesed lemarek aono beyissurim baolam hazze uchmo shekkatuv ki et asher yeehav yochiach vego
Velachen lo hizkiru harambam vehassemag shum taanit kelal bemitzvat hatteshuva af bichretot umitot bet-din rak haviduy uvakkashat mechila kemo shekkatuv battora vehitvaddu et chattatam vego

Uma shekkatuv beoel shuvu aday bechal levavchem betzom uvivchi go hayenu levattel haggezera shennigzera lemarek aon haddor al-yede yissurim baarbe vezehu hattaam bechal taaniyyot shemmitannin al kal tzara shello tavo al hatztzibbur uchmo shekkatuv bimgillat ester

Uma shekkatuv besifre hammusar uvrosham sefer harokeach vesefer chasidim harbe taaniyyot vesigufim laover al keretot umitot bet-din vechen lemotzi zera levattala shechayyav mita bide shamayim kemo shekkatuv battora gabbe er veonan vedino kechayyave cheretot leinyan ze hayenu kede linatzel meonesh yissurim shel mala chas veshalom vegam kede lezarez ulmaher gemar kapparat nafsho vegam ulay eno shav el bechal libbo venafsho meahava ki im miyyira
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 2: Ach kal ze leinyan kappara umchilat heaon shennimchal lo legamre ma sheavar al mitzot hammelech kesheasa teshuva shelema veen mazkirin lo davar vachatzi davar beom haddin leansho al ze chas veshalom baolam-habba veniftar legamre min haddin baolam-habba

Amnam sheyyihye leratzon lifne umrutztze vechaviv lefanav yitbarech kekodem hachet lihot nachat ruach lekono meavodato haya tzarich lehavi karban ola afilu al mitzvat ase kalla sheen bah karet umitat bet-din kemo sheddarshu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha betorat kohanim al pasuk venirtza lo vechidita baggemara perek kamma dizvachim deola mechapperet al mitzvat ase vehi doron leachar sheasa teshuva venimchal lo haonesh

Uchadam shessarach bammelech ufiyeso al-yede peraklitin umachal lo af-al-pi-chen sholeach doron umincha lefanav sheyyitratztze lo lirot pene hammelech ulshon mechapperet vechen ma shekkatuv battora venirtza lo lechapper alav en zo kapparat nafsho ella lechapper lifne lihot nachat ruach lekono kidita sham baggemara uchmo shekkatuv tamim yihye leratzon
Veachshav sheen lanu karban lehafik ratzon me hattaanit hu bimkom karban kemo shekkatuv baggemara sheyehe miut chelbi vedami shennitmaet keillu hikravti lefanecha vechu

Velachen matzinu bechamma tannaim veamoraim sheal davar kal hau mitannim taaniyyot harbe meod kemo rabbi elazar ben azarya shehaya mattir shettehe para yotza birtzua shebben karneha beshabbat vachachamim osrim ufaam achat yatza ken parato shel shechento velo micha bah vehushcharu shinav mippene hatztzomot al shello kiyyem divre chaverav vechen rabbi yehoshua sheamar boshni middivrechem bet shammay vehushcharu shinav mippene hatztzomot verav huna paam achat nithappecha lo retzua shel tefilin vehitanna tzomot vechahenna rabbot

Veal yesod ze limed haarizal letalmidav al pi chachmat haemet mispar hatztzomot lechamma aonot vachataim af sheen bahen karet velo mita bide shamayim kemo al hakkaas taaniyyot vechu vaafilu al isur derabbanan kemo setam yenam yitanne taaniyyot vechu vechen al bitul mitzvat ase derabbanan kemo tefilla yitanne taaniyyot vechu

Vederech kelal sod hattaanit hi segulla niflaa lehitgallut ratzon haelon baruch-hu kemo hakkarban shenneemar bo reach nichoach la uchmo shekkatuv bishaya halaze tikra tzom veom ratzon la mikkelal shehatztzom hannirtze hu yom ratzon
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 3: Vehinne chachme hammusar haacharonim nechleku bemi shechata chet echad peamim rabbot deyesh omrim shetztzarich lehitannot mispar hatztzomot leoto chet peamim rabbot kefi hammispar asher chata kegon hammotzi zera levattala shemmispar hatztzomot hamforash betikune teshuva mehaarizal hen taaniyyot veim chata baze eser o esrim peamim al derech mashal tzarich lehitanot eser o esrim peamim vechen leolam dumya dekarban chattat shechayyav lehavi al kal paam ufaam
Veyesh medammin inyan ze lekarban ola habbaa al mitzvat ase daafilu avar al kamma mitzot ase mitkapper beola achat kidita baggemara perek kamma dizvachim

Vehachraa hamkubbelet baze lehitannot peamim kefi mispar hatztzomot dechet ze dehayenu tzomot al hotzaot shichvat zera levattala vechen bishar chataim vaaonot vehattaam hu al pi ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh sof parashat noach kevan dechav bar nash kamme kudsha-berich-hu zimna chada avid reshimu chu zimna telitaa itpashshet hahu kitma missitra da lesitra da chu lechach tzarich mispar hatztzomot gam ken peamim vechu

Achen kal ze beadam chazak uvari sheen ribuy hatztzomot mazzik lo kelal livriut gufo uchmo baddorot harishonim aval mi sheribuy hatztzomot mazzik lo sheefshar sheyyuchal lavo lide choli o mechosh chas veshalom kemo bedorotenu elle asur lo leharbot betaaniyyot afilu al keretot umitot bet-din umikkal shekken al mitzot ase umitzot lo taase sheen bahen karet ella kefi asher yeshaer benafsho shebbevadday lo yazzik lo kelal

Ki afilu baddorot harishonim bime tannaim veamoraim lo hau mitannin bichhay gavena ella habberiim dematzu letzaure nafshayehu udla matzi letzaure nafsheh umitanne nikra chote baggemara perek kamma detaanit vaafilu mitanne al averot shebbeyado kidferesh rashi sham vechidita baggemara perek kamma dizvachim sheen lecha adam miyyisrael sheeno mechuyyav ase vechu
Umikkal shekken mi shehu baal tora shechote veneenash bechiflayim ki mechamat chalishut hattaanit lo yuchal laasok bah karauy

Ella may takkanteh kedichtiv vachataach betzidka feruk uchmo shekkatvu happoskim liten bead kal yom taanit shel teshuva erech gedolim polish vechu veheashir yosif lefi ashro vechu kemo shekkatav hammagen-avraham hilchot taanit

Umikkal makom kal baal nefesh hechafetz kirvat letakken nafsho lahashivah el bitshuva meulla min hammuvchar yachmir al atzmo lehashlim al kal panim paam achat kal yeme chayyav mispar hatztzomot lechal aon veaon meaonot hachamurim shechayyavin alehem mita al kal panim vaafilu bide shamayim bilvad kegon lehotzaot zera levattala tzomot paam achat bime chayyav

Veyachol lidchotan layyamim hakketzarim bachoref veyitanne keeser taaniyyot al derech mashal bechoref echad o pachot veyigmor mispar hafd tzomot bet shanim o yoter kefi chocho vegam yachol leechol meat keg shaot lifne netz hachamma veaf-al-pi-chen nechshav letaanit im hitna ken

Ultashlum tzomot kannizkar leel yitanne od peamim ad achar chatzot hayyom bilvad demichshav gam ken taanit birushalmi uv chatzae yom nechshavim lo leom echad leinyan ze vechen lishar aonot kayyotze vahen asher kal lev yodea marat nafsho vechafetz behitztzadkah

Achen mispar hatztzomot haodfim al uchhay gavena shehaya tzarich lehitannot lachush ledaat hammachmirim lehitannot mispar hatztzomot sheal kal chet vechet kefi mispar happeamim shechata kannizkar leel yifde chullan bitzdaka erech gedolim polish bead kal yom vechen shear kal taaniyyot shetztzarich lehitannot al averot sheen bahen mita vaafilu al bitul mitzot ase deorayeta udrabbanan vetalmud tora keneged kullam kefi hammispar hamforash betikune hatteshuva mehaari zichrono livracha verubbam nizkarim bemishnat chasidim bemassechet hatteshuva hakkol kaasher lakkol yifde bitzdaka kannizkar leel i la matzi letzaure nafsheh kannizkar leel

Veaf sheyyaale lesach mesuyyam en lachush mishshum al yevazbez yoter mechomesh dela mikre bizbuz bichhay gavena meachar sheose lifdot nafsho mittaaniyyot vesigufim vela gara merfuat hagguf ushar tzerachav

Ulfi shemmispar hatztzomot hammuzkarim betikkune teshuva hannizkarim leel rabbu bimod meod lachen nahagu achshav kal hacharedim lidvar leharbot meod meod bitzdaka mechamat chalishut haddor dela matzu letzaure nafsham kulle hay uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher al pasuk chasde ki lo tamnu
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 4: Veulam kal hannizkar leel hu ligmar hakkappara umeruk hannefesh la achar hatteshuva kemo shennitbaer leel mehaggemara perek kamma dizvachim deola doron hi leachar sheritza happeraklit vechu amnam hatchalat mitzvat hatteshuva veikarah lashuv ad beemet uvlev shalem hahechreach levaer hetev beharchavat habbeur

Behakdim ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh beveur millat teshuva al derech hassod tashuv tattaa teshuva tattaa ilaa teshuva ilaa vegam ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh biktzat mekomot sheen teshuva moelet lefogem berito umotzi zera levattala vehu davar tamuha meod sheen lecha davar omed bifne hatteshuva vaafilu avoda-zara vegilluy-araot vechu uferesh bereshit chachma shekkavanat hazzohar sheen moelet teshuva tattaa ki im teshuva ilaa vechu

Hinne lehavin zot meat mizzeer tzarich lehakdim ma shemmevoar mehakkatuv umiddivre rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha inyan hakkaret umita bide shamayim kesheavar avera shechayyavim aleha karet haya met mammash kodem chamishshim shana uvmita bide shamayim met mammash kodem shishshim shana kachananya ben azzur hannavi beyirmeya velifamim gam bemita bide shamayim nifrain lealtar kemo shemmatzinu beer veonan vahare nimtzeu bechal dor kamma vechamma chayyave keretot umitot veheerichu yemehem ushnotehem banneimim

Ach hainyan yuvan al pi ma shekkatuv ki chelek ammo vego chelek mishshem havaya baruch-hu kedichtiv vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim uman denafach mittocho nafach vechu veaf sheen lo demut hagguf vechu chas veshalom ach dibbera tora kilshon bene adam

Ki kemo sheyyesh hefresh vehevdel gadol baadam hattachton al derech mashal ben hahevel sheyyotze mippiv bediburo lahevel hayyotze al-yede neficha shebbayyotze bediburo melubbash bo koach vechayyut meat mizzeer vehu bechinat chitzoniyyut minnefesh hachayya shebbekirbo aval bayyotze bechoach hannofeach demittocho nafach melubbash bo koach vechayyut penimit mibbechinat hannefesh hachayya vechu

Kacha mammash al derech mashal hammavdil havdalot leen ketz yesh hefresh atzum meod lemala ben kal tzeva hashshamayim vaafilu hammalachim shennivreu meayin leyesh vechayyim vekayyamim mibbechinat chitzoniyyut hachayyut vehashshefa shemmashpia en-sof baruch-hu lehachaot haolamot uvchina zo nikret beshem ruach piv al derech mashal kemo shekkatuv uvruach piv kal tzevaam vehi bechinat chayyut hamlubbeshet baotiyyot shebbaasara maamarot shehen bechinat kelim vehamshachot vechu kemo shennitbaer belikkute-amarim chelek perek uven nishmat haadam shennimshecha techilla mibbechinat penimiyyut hachayyut vehashshefa shemmashpia en-sof baruch-hu kemo shekkatuv vayyippach vechu veachar kach yarda beseter hammadrega gam ken al-yede bechinat haotiyyot shebbemaamar naase adam vechu kede lehitlabbesh beguf olam hazze hattachton

Velachen nikreu hammalachim beshem elokim bakkatuv uchmo shekkatuv ki elokechem hu eloke haelokim go hodu leloke haelokim go vayyavou bene haelokim lehityatzev go lefi sheyenikat chayyutam hi mibbechinat chitzoniyyut shehi bechinat haotiyyot levad veshem elokim hu bechinat chitzoniyyut legabbe shem havaya baruch-hu
Aval nishmat haadam shehi mibbechinat penimiyyut hachayyut hi chelek shem havaya baruch-hu ki shem havaya more al penimiyyut hachayyut shehi lemala mala mibbechinat haotiyyot
Uveur hainyan kannoda mimmaamar eliyyahu ante hu deappikat asar tikunin vekarinan lehon asar sefiran leanhaga vehon almin setimin vechu vechal hay sefirot nichlalot venirmazot beshem havaya baruch-hu

Ki hayyud shehi bechinat nekudda levad merammezet lechachmato yitbarech shehi bivchinat helem vehester kodem shebbaa livchinat hitpashshetut vegiluy hahassaga vehahavana vehakkotz sheal hayyud romez livchinat ratzon haelon baruch-hu shellemala mala mimmadregat bechinat chachma ilaa kannoda

Veachar shebbaa livchinat hitpashshetut vegiluy hahassaga vehahavana lealmin setimin nichlelet venirmezet beot he sheyyesh lah bechinat hitpashshetut larochav hammore umrammez al harchavat habbeur vehahavana vegam laorech hammore al bechinat hahamshacha vehahashpaa milmala lematta lealmin setimin

Veachar kach keshennimshechet hamshacha vehashpaa zo yoter lematta lealmin deitgalyan uchmo haadam sherotze legallot chachmato laacherim al-yede diburo al derech mashal nichlelet venirmezet hamshacha zo beotiyyot

Ki havav mora al hahamshacha milmala lematta vegam hamshacha zo hi al-yede middat chasdo vetuvo ushar middotav hakkedoshot hannichlalot bederech kelal bemispar shesh shebbappasuk lecha haggedulla vechu ad lecha hammamlacha vechu velo ad bichlal ki middat malchuto yitbarech nikret beshem devar kemo shekkatuv baasher devar melech shilton

Venichlelet venirmezet beot he acharona shel shem havaya ki penimiyyut umkor haddibur hu hahevel haole min hallev umitchallek le motzaot happe mehaggaron vechu vegam havarat hahe hi bechinat hevel levad kemo shennikret ata kallila delet bah meshasha

Veaf sheen lo demut hagguf chas veshalom ach dibbera tora kilshon bene adam besheggam sheggam devar otiyyot hammitchallekot le chelke hammotzaot uvahen nivra kal hayetzur uchmo shennitbaer belikkute-amarim chelek perek beur inyan otiyyot ellu

Vechacha mammash al derech mashal hammavdil havdalot leen ketz benishmat haadam shehi bechinat nefesh haelokit demittocheh nafach yesh bah bechinat sechel hannelam hamrummaz beot yud shebbechocho latzet el haggiluy lehavin ulhaskil baamittato yitbarech uvigdullato vechu kal chad vechad lefum shiura dileh lefi rochav sichlo uvinato

Uchfi asher maamik sichlo umarchiv dato uvinato lehitbonen bigdullato yitbarech azay merummezet binato beot he sheyyesh lah rochav vegam orech hammore al hahamshacha milmala lematta leholid mibbinato vehitbonnuto bigdullat ahava veyira vetoldotehen bemocho vetaalumot libbo veachar kach bivchinat hitgallut libbo
Umizze nimshecha avoda haamitit beesek hattora vehammitzot bekol vedibbur o maase hen otiyyot vav he vechu
Vegam hahitbonnut lehavin ulhaskil baamittato ugdullato yitbarech nimshecha gam ken mehattora deorayeta mechachma nafka hi bechinat yud shel shem havaya vechu
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 5: Vehinne hamshachat viridat hannefesh haelokit laolam hazze lehitlabbesh beguf haadam nimshecha mibbechinat penimiyyut umkor haddibur hu hevel haelon hamrummaz beot he tattaa kannizkar leel uchmo shekkatuv vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim vayehi haadam lenefesh chayya uman denafach vechu
Vezehu shekkatuv ki chelek ammo yaakov chevel nachalato perush kemo chevel al derech mashal sherosho echad kashur lemala vekatzehu lematta

Ki hinne peshat hakkatuv ma shekkatuv vayyippach hu lehorot lanu kemo sheal derech mashal keshehaadam nofeach leeze makom im yesh eze davar chotzetz umafsik bentayim en hevel hannofeach ole umaggia kelal leoto makom kacha mammash im yesh davar chotzetz umafsik ben guf haadam livchinat hevel haelon

Ach beemet en shum davar gashmi veruchani chotzetz lefanav yitbarech ki halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male umlo chal haaretz kevodo velet atar panuy mineh bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat en od veihu memalle kal almin vechu

Ella kemo shekkatuv bishaya ki im aonotechem hau mavdilim benechem leven elokechem vehattaam lefi shehem neged ratzon haelon baruch-hu hamchayye et hakkol kemo shekkatuv kol asher chafetz asa bashshamayim uvaaretz uchmo shennitbaer leel shehu mekor hashpaat shem havaya venirmaz bekotzo shel yud

Vezehu inyan hakkaret shennichrat venifsak chevel hahamshacha mishshem havaya baruch-hu shennimshecha mehe tattaa kannizkar leel uchmo shekkatuv befarashat emor venichreta hannefesh hahi millefanay ani millefanay dayeka
Uvishar averot sheen bahen karet al kal panim hen pogmin hannefesh kannoda ufgam hu milleshon pegimat hassakkin
Vehu al derech mashal mechevel av shazur mittaryag chavalim dakkim kacha chevel hahamshacha hannizkar leel kalul mittaryag mitzot uchsheover chas veshalom al achat mehenna nifsak chevel haddak vechu

Ach gam bechayyav karet umita nishar adayin bo harshimu minnafsho haelokit veal-yede ze yachol lichot ad o shana velo yoter uma shekkatuv beshem haarizal shennichnesa bo bechinat hammakkif vechu eno inyan lechayye gashmiyyut hagguf umayeri ad shana o bizman hazze kedilkamman
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 6: Amnam zehu bizman shehau yisrael bemadrega elona keshehayeta hashshechina shora beyisrael bevet hammikdash veaz lo hau mekabbelim chayyut legufam rak al-yede nefesh haelokit levaddah mibbechinat penimiyyut hashshefa shemmashpia en-sof baruch-hu al-yede shem havaya baruch-hu kannizkar leel

Ach leachar sheyyardu mimmadregatam vegarmu bemaasehem sod galut hashshechina kemo shekkatuv uvfishechem shullecha immechem dehayenu sheyyarda hashpaat bechinat he tattaa hannizkeret leel venishtalshela mimmadrega lemadrega lematta matta ad shennitlabbesha hashpaatah be sefirot denogah hammashpiot shefa vechayyut al-yede hammazzalot vechal tzeva hashshamayim vehassarim shealehem lechal hachay haggashmi shebbaolam hazze vegam lechal hatztzomeach kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en lecha kal esev millematta sheen lo mazzal vechu
Vaazay yachol gam hachote ufoshe yisrael lekabbel chayyut legufam venafsham habbahamiot kemo shear baale chayyim mammash kemo shekkatuv nimshal kabbehemot nidmu

Veadderabba beyeter seet veyeter oz al pi hamvoar mizzohar hakkadosh parashat pekude shekkal shefa vechayyut hannishpaot laadam hattachton beshaa verega sheose hara beene bemaase o bedibur o behirhure avera vechu hakkol nishpa lo mehechlot hassitra achora hamvoarim sham bazzohar hakkadosh
Vehaadam hu baal bechira im lekabbel hashpaato mehechlot hassitra achora o mehechlot hakkedushsha shemmehem nishpaot kal machashavot tovot ukdoshot vechu

Ki ze leummat ze asa haelokim vechu vehechlot hassitra achora mekabbelim veonkim chayyutam mehitlabbeshut vehishtalshelut hashshefa de sefirot denogah hakkelula mibbechinat tov vara hi bechinat etz haddaat vechu kannoda leode chen

Vehinne yaakov chevel nachalato ketiv al derech mashal kemo hachevel sherosho echad lemala verosho hashsheni lematta im yimshoch adam berosho hashsheni yenaanea veyimmashech acharav gam rosho harishon kamma sheefshar lo lehimmashech

Vechacha mammash beshoresh nishmat haadam umkorah mibbechinat he tattaa hannizkeret leel hu mamshich umorid hashpaatah al-yede maasav haraim umachshevotav ad toch hechlot hassitra achora kivyachol shemmishsham mekabbel machshevotav umaasav umippene shehu hu hammamshich lahem hahashpaa lachen hu notel chelek barosh veday lamevin

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en beyadenu lo mishshalvat harshaim vechu beyadenu daveka kelomar bizman haggalut achar hachurban vezohi bechinat galut hashshechina kivyachol lehashpia lehechlot hassitra achora asher sana nafsho yitbarech
Uchshehaadam ose teshuva nechona azay mesallek mehem hahashpaa shehimshich bemaasav umachshevotav ki bitshuvato machazir hashpaat hashshechina limkomah
Vezehu tashuv he tattaa mibbechinat galut uchmo shekkatuv veshav elokecha et shevutcha kelomar im shevutcha uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha veheshiv lo neemar vechu
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 7: Veulam derech haemet vehayyashar livchinat teshuva tattaa he tattaa hannizkeret leel hem devarim derech kelal

Haechad hu leorer rachamim haelonim mimmekor harachamim al nishmato venafsho haelokit shennafla meigra rama chayye hachayyim baruch-hu levira amikta hen hechlot hattuma vehassitra achora veal mekorah bimkor hachayyim hu shem havaya baruch-hu uchmo shekkatuv veyashov el havaya virachamehu perush leorer rachamim al hashpaat shem havaya baruch-hu shennishtalshela veyarda toch hechlot hassitra achora hattemeim lehachaotam al-yede maase enosh vetachbulotav umachshevotav haraot uchmo shekkatuv melech asur barhatim birhite mocha vechu hi bechinat galut hashshechina kannizkar leel
Uzman hamsuggal laze hu betikun chatzot kemo shekkatuv bassidur beheara ayyen sham baarichut vezehu shekkatuv sham nafla ateret roshenu oy na lanu ki chatanu

Velachen nikra hakkadosh-baruch-hu melech aluv befirke hechalot kemo shekkatav haramak zichrono livracha ki en lecha elbon gadol mizze uvifrat kaasher yitbonen hammaskil bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu memalle kal almin vesovev kal almin kal echad veechad lefi shiur sichlo vahavanato yitmarmer al ze meod meod

Vehav levattesh ulhachnia hakkelipa vesitra achora asher kal chayyutah hi rak bechinat gassut vehagbaha kemo shekkatuv im tagbiha kannesher vego vehabbitush vehahachnaa ad afar mammash zohi mitatah uvitulah

Vehayenu al-yede lev nishbar venidke velihot nivze veenav nimas vechu uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh al pasuk zivche elokim ruach nishbara lev nishbar venidke vechu ki kal karban min habbehema hu leshem havaya hi middat harachamim aval leshem elokim hi middat haddin en makrivin karban behema ki im leshabber ulhaavir ruach hattuma vehassitra achora vezehu ruach nishbara
Vehaech nishbera ruach hassitra achora keshehallev nishbar venidke vechu

Vehaech nishbar hallev venidke hinne meat mizzeer hu al-yede sigufim vetaaniyyot bedorotenu elle sheen lanu koach lehitannot harbe kedavid hammelech kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk velibbi chalal bekirbi sheharago betaanit

Ach ikar hachnaat hallev lihot nishbar venidke vehaavarat ruach hattuma vesitra achora hu lihot mimmare dechushbana beomek haddaat lehaamik dato uvinato shaa achat bechal yom o layela lifne tikun-chatzot lehitbonen bema sheppaal veasa bachataav bechinat galut hashshechina kannizkar leel vegaram laakor nishmato venafsho haelokit mechayye hachayyim baruch-hu vehoridah limkom hattuma vehammavet hen hechlot hassitra achora venaaset bivchinat merkava alehem lekabbel mehem shefa vechayyut lehashpia legufo kannizkar leel

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha reshaim bechayyehem keruyim metim kelomar shechayyehem nimshachim mimmekom hammavet vehattuma vechen ma shekkatuv lo hammetim yehallu vego eno keloeg larash chas veshalom ella hakkavana al harshaim shebbechayyehem keruyim metim shemmevalbelim otam bemachashavot zarot beodam berisham veenam chafetzim bitshuva kannoda

Veaf mi shello avar al aon karet vegam lo al aon mita bide shamayim shehu hotzaat zera levattala uchhay gavena ella shear averot kallot af-al-pi-chen meachar shehen pogmim banneshama venefesh haelokit vechimshal pegimat ufsikat chavalim dakkim kannizkar leel hare beribuy hachataim yachol lihot pegam kemo belav echad sheyyesh bo karet o mita vaafilu bichfilat chet echad peamim rabbot meod

Kemo shehimshil hannavi hachataim leanan hammaafil or hashshemesh kemo shekkatuv machiti chaav peshaecha hem averot chamurot hammavdilim ben penimit hashpaat shem havaya baruch-hu lannefesh haelokit kehavdalat anan av vechashuch hammavdil ben hashshemesh laaretz veladdarim aleha al derech mashal vecheanan chattotecha hen averot kallot sheadam dash baakevav hammavdilim kehavdalat anan kal vekalush al derech mashal

Vehinne kemo shebbammashal hazze im mesim adam neged or hashshemesh bachallon mechitzot kallot uklushot larov meod hen maafilot kemo mechitza achat ava veoter vechacha mammash hu bannimshal bechal aonot sheadam dash baakevav umikkal shekken hamfursamot middivre rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shehen mammash kaavoda-zara vegiluy-araot ushfichut-damim

Kemo haalamat ayin min hatztzedaka kemo shekkatuv hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha veliyyaal vego uvliyyaal hi oved avodat elilim vechu vehamsapper bignut chavero hi lashon hara hashshekula kaavoda-zara vegiluy-araot ushfichut-damim vechal hakkoes keillu oved avoda-zara vechen mi sheyyesh bo gassut haruach vechahenna rabbot baggemara vetalmud tora keneged kullan kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha viter hakkadosh-baruch-hu al avoda-zara vechu

Velachen sidru bikriat-shema sheal-hammitta lekabbel alav mitot bet-din vechu millevad sheal pi hassod kal happogem beot yud shel shem havaya keilu nitchayyev sekila vehappogem beot he keilu nitchayyev serefa uvot vav keilu nitchayyev hereg uvot he acharona keilu nitchayyev chenek vehamvattel keriat-shema pogem beot yud utfilin beot he vetzitzit beot vav utfilla beot he vechu
Umizze yachol hammaskil lilmod lishar aonot vachataim uvitul tora keneged kullan
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 8: Vehinne achare haamakat haddaat bechal hannizkar leel yuchal levakkesh beemet meumka delibba kerov rachamecha meche feshaay vego ki azay tikkava belibbo beemet godel harachamanut al bechinat elokut shebbenafsho veshellemala kannizkar leel uvaze yeorer rachamim haelonim mig middot harachamim hannimshachot meratzon haelon baruch-hu hannirmaz bekotzo shel yud shellemala mala mibbechinat hahashpaa hannishpaat meotiyyot shem havaya

Velachen hag middot harachamim menakkim kal happegamim uchmo shekkatuv nose aon vafesha venakke veshuv en yenika lehachitzonim vehassitra achora mehashpaat he tattaa kannizkar leel uvaze tashuv he tattaa limkomah lehityached behv veday lamevin

Vechen mammash lematta bannefesh haelokit shebbaadam shuv en aonotechem mavdilim uchmo shekkatuv venakke menakke hu lashshavim lirchotz ulnakkot nafsham millevushim hatztzoim hem hachitzonim vesitra achora kemo shekkatuv baggemara melappafto vechu

Umeachar sheruach avra vattetaharem azay tuchal nafsham lashuv ad havaya baruch-hu mammash velaalot mala mala limkorah uldavka bo yitbarech beyichud nifla kemo shehayeta meuchedet bo yitbarech betachlit hayyichud beterem shennefachah beruach piv yitbarech lered lematta ulhitlabbesh beguf haadam uchmo al derech mashal beadam hannofeach beruach piv beterem sheyyotze haruach mippiv hu meuchad benafsho vezo hi teshuva shelema

Vehinne bechinat yichud ze utshuva zo hi bechinat teshuva ilaa shelleachar teshuva tattaa uchmo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh beraya mehemna parashat naso ditshuva ilaa hi deyitassek beorayeta bidchilu urchimu dekudsha-berich-hu vechu deihu ben bina vechu umaalat baale teshuva al tzaddikim gemurim baze hi kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh parashat chayye sara deinun mashche alayehu biruta delibba yattir uvchela saggi leitkarva lemalka vechu
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 9: Uveur hainyan kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh vetikunim bechamma mekomot devina ihi teshuva ilaa vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim vechu

Dehayenu sheal-yede shemmitbonen bigdullat behaamakat haddaat umolid meruach binato dechilu urchimu sichliyyim uvtuv taam vadaat kainyan shenneemar leahava et elokecha mishshum ki hu chayyecha vego velo day lo beahava tivit hamsutteret levad vechu vechen beyira vafachad o busha vechu kannoda azay nikret haem rovetzet al haefrochim vechu

Vehinne ikar haahava hi itdabbekut rucha berucha kemo shekkatuv yishshakeni minneshikot pihu vego kannoda veal ze neemar uvchal nafshecha shehem hem kal chelke hannefesh sechel umiddot ulvushehem machashava dibur umaase ledavka chullan bo yitbarech
Dehayenu hammiddot bemiddotav yitbarech ma hu rachum vechu
Vehassechel besichlo vechachmato yitbarech hu iyyun hattora deorayeta mechachma nafka
Vechen hammachashava bemachashavto yitbarech vehaddibur bidvar zo halacha uchmo shekkatuv vaasim devaray beficha udvaray asher samti beficha
Vehammaase hu maase hatztzedaka lehachaot ruach shefalim kemo shekkatuv ki sheshet yamim asa vego kannoda bemakom acher

Vezo hi itdabbekut derucha berucha betachlit haddevekut vehayyichud keshehi mechamat ahava vechu ulfi sheppegam habberit behotzaat zera levattala veen tzarich lomar baaraot o shear isure bia deorayeta o derabbanan ki chamurim divre sofrim vechu pogem bammoach lachen tikuno hu deyitassek beorayeta demechachma nafka

Vezehu shekkatuv betana deve eliyyahu adam avar avera venitchayyev mita lammakom ma yaase veyichye im haya ragil likrot daf echad yikra dappim lishnot perek echad yishne perakim vechu vehayenu kimshal chevel hannifsak vechozer vekoshro shebbimkom hakkesher hu kaful umchuppal vechacha hu bechevel nachalato vechu
Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv bechesed veemet yechuppar aon vego veen emet ella tora vechu
Vaaon bet eli bezevach umincha hu deeno mitkapper aval mitkapper betora ugmilut chasadim kidita besof perek kamma derosh hashshana
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 10: Vehinne teshuva ilaa zo deitdabbekuta derucha berucha al-yede tora ugmilut chasadim hi bivchinat hamshacha milmala lematta lihot devar mammash befiv uchmo shekkatuv vaasim devaray beficha vimino techabbekeni bigmilut chasadim dechesed deroa yemina vechu

Aval adam hattachton tzarich lelech mimmadrega lemadrega mimmatta lemala hi bechinat teshuva ilaa veitdabbekut rucha berucha bechavanat hallev bitfilla uvifrat bikriat-shema uvirchoteha kede lomar veahavta vego bechal levavcha uvchal nafshecha vego beemet laamito vechen vehau haddevarim haelle vego vedibbarta bam vego lihot devar befiv beemet veen emet vechu

Vechen lekayyem kal hammitzot kemo sheomrim asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav kemo hare atte mekuddeshet li hi bechinat kodesh haelon leshon perishut vehavdala sheeno yachol lehitlabbesh toch almin mishshum dechulla kammeh kela chashiv ella bivchinat sovev kal almin hu ratzon haelon baruch-hu vechu kemo shennitbaer belikkute-amarim perek

Vegam achar hattefilla omrim elecha nafshi essa dehayenu leitdabbeka rucha berucha kal hayyom vechu vechal ze al-yede hahitbonnut bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu behaamakat haddaat bishtayim lefaneha uvifsuke dezimra kannoda

Umeachar shehattefilla hi bechinat teshuva ilaa tzarich lehakdim lefaneha bechinat teshuva tattaa vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha bammishna en omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch koved rosh uferesh rashi hachnaa vehi bechinat teshuva tattaa leorer rachamim kannizkar leel vechidyalif hatam baggemara mikkera dichtiv vehi marat nafesh

Achen babbarayeta sham tanu rabbanan en omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch simcha veachshav bedor yatom hazze sheen hakkol yecholin lahafoch libbam kerega min hakkatze azay etza hayeutza lehakdim bechinat teshuva tattaa betikun chatzot kannizkar leel umi shei efshar lo bechal layela al kal panim lo yifchot mippaam achat bashshavua lifne yom hashshabbat kannoda layyodim shehashshabbat hi bechinat teshuva ilaa veshabbat otiyyot tashev enosh ki beshabbat hi aliyyot haolamot limkoram chu uvifrat tefillot hashshabbat veday lamevin

Uvaze yuvan ma shekkatuv shuva elay ki gealticha perush ki meachar shemmachiti chaav peshaecha hi haavarat hassitra achora ugalticha min hachitzonim behitorrut rachamim elonim beitaruta diltatta bitshuva tattaa kannizkar leel azay shuva elay bitshuva ilaa
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 11: Veamnam lihot belibbo hahachnaa hi bechinat teshuva tattaa kannizkar leel vegam hassimcha ba shettehen beyachad kevar milta amura belikkute-amarim sof perek kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh chedva tekia belibbay missitra da vechu uvtzeruf od haemuna vehabbittachon lihot nachon libbo batuach ba ki chafetz chesed hu vechannun verachum verav lisloach techef umiyyad shemmevakkesh mechila uslicha meitto yitbarech kerov rachamecha meche feshaay kabbeseni tahareni vechal aonotay meche vechu beli shum safek usfek sefeka baolam

Uchmo sheanu mevarchin bechal tefillat techef shemmevakshim selach lanu chu baruch atta channun hammarbe lisloach vahare sefek berachot lehakel mishshum chashash beracha levattala ella en kan shum safek kelal meachar shebbikkashnu selach lanu mechal lanu veilu lo hayinu chozrim vechotim hayinu nigalin miyyad kemo sheanu mevarchin baruch atta goel yisrael

Vahare afilu bemiddat basar vadam ken shetztzarich haadam limchol techef umiyyad shemmevakshim mimmennu mechila velo yehe achzari millimchol vaafilu bekotea yad chavero kidita baggemara besof perek devava kamma

Veim bikesh mimmennu peamim velo machal lo shuv en tzarich levakkesh mimmennu vehaggivonim shebbikesh david hammelech alav-hashshalom mehem mechila bead shaul shehemit et haggivonim velo ratzu limchol gazar david alehem shello yavou bikhal shehem rachamanim vechu kidita beferek divamot
Uvmiddat hakkadosh-baruch-hu al achat kamma vechamma leen ketz

Uma shemmeshabbechim umvarchim et channun hammarbe lisloach hammarbe dayeka uchmo shekkatuv beezra verav lisloach dehayenu shebbemiddat basar vadam im yecheta ish leish uvikesh mimmennu mechila umachal lo veachar kach chazar lesuro kashe meod sheyyimchol lo shenit umikkal shekken bishlishit urviit

Aval bemiddat hakkadosh-baruch-hu en hefresh ben paam achat leelef peamim ki hammechila hi mimmiddat harachamim umiddotav hakkedoshot enan bivchinat gevul vetachlit ella bivchinat en-sof kemo shekkatuv ki lo chalu rachamav ulgabbe bechinat en-sof en hefresh kelal ben mispar katan legadol dechulla kammeh kela mammash chashiv umashve katan vegadol vechu

Velachen maavir ashmotenu bechal shana veshana vechal hachataim shemmitvadim beal chet midde shana af shechazar veavar alehem chozer umitvadde alehem beom hakkippurim beshana habbaa vechen leolam uvchal shana veshana lav daveka ella kemo chen bechal yom vaom peamim mevarchim baruch atta channun hammarbe lisloach

Uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha tefilla keneged temidin tikkenuha vetamid shel shachar haya mechapper al averot hallayela vetamid shel ben haarbayim al shel yom vechen midde yom beom leolam ella sheyyom hakkippurim mechapper al averot chamurot vehattamid shehu karban ola mechapper al mitzot ase bilvad vechen hattefilla bizman hazze im hatteshuva kannizkar leel

Veen ze echeta veashuv ki hayenu daveka shebbishat hachet haya yachol lichbosh yitzro ella shessomech belibbo al hatteshuva velachen hoil vehatteshuva goremet lo lachato en maspikin vechu veaf gam zot en maspikin dayeka aval im dachak venitchazzek venitgabber al yitzro veasa teshuva mekabbelin teshuvato

Aval anu shemmevakshim bechal yom selach lanu anu makdimin levakkesh vehachazirenu bitshuva shelema lefanecha dehayenu shello nashuv od lechisla vechen beom hakkippurim mevakshim yehi ratzon millefanecha shello echeta od maspikin umaspikin kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha habba littaher mesayein oto habba dayeka miyyad shebba vee lazot gam hasselicha vehammechila hi miyyad

Uma shekkatuv vechattati negdi tamid en hamchuvan lihot tamid atzev nivze chas veshalom deha ketiv batreh tashmieni sason vesimcha vego veruach nediva tismecheni vego umishshum shetztzarich lihot kal yamav bitshuva ilaa shehi besimcha rabba kannizkar leel ella negdi dayeka kemo veatta tityatztzev minneged minneged saviv leohel moed yachanu uferesh rashi merachok vehamchuvan rak levilti rum levavo velihot shefal ruach bifne chal haadam kesheyyihye lezikkaron ben enav shechata neged

Veadderabba leinyan hassimcha yoil zichron hachet beyeter seet bichde lekabbel besimcha kal hammeoraot hammitraggeshot uvaot ben min hashshamayim ben al-yede habberiyyot bedibur o bemaase vezo etza tova lehinnatzel mikkaas vechal mine kefeda vechu uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha hanneelavin veenan olvin shomin cherpatam veen meshivin osim meahava usmechim beyissurim vechu vechal hammaavir al middotav maavirim lo al kal peshaav
Tanya, Part III; Iggeret HaTeshuvah 12: Vetaam hassimcha beyissure hagguf lefi shehi tova gedola vaatzuma lannefesh hachotet lemarkah baolam hazze ulhatztzilah mehammeruk beggehinnom bifrat bedorotenu elle sheen bicholet lehitannot kefi mispar kal hatztzomot shebbetikune teshuva mehaari zichrono livracha hatztzerichot lemeruk hannefesh lehatztzilah mimmeruk beggehinnom

Uchmo shekkatav haramban zichrono livracha bahakdama leferush iyyov sheafilu yissurim shel iyyov shana en lahen erech kelal leyissure hannefesh shaa achat beggehinnom ki esh echad mishshishshim vechu ella lefi sheolam hazze chesed yibbane uvyissurin kallin baolam hazze nitzol middinim kashim shel olam-habba

Kimshal hiluch vehatakat hatztzel baaretz tefach lefi hiluch galgal hashshemesh barakia alafim milin vechu veyeter al ken leen ketz hu bannimshal bivchinat hishtalshelut haolamot merum hammaalot ad olam hazze haggashmi vechannoda mimma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh meinyan aliyyot olamot haelonim beitaruta diltatta behakravat of echad ben yona o tor al gabbe hammizbeach o kometz mincha vechen hu bechal hammitzot maasiyyot kannoda mehaarizal

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim adam mekaddesh atzmo meat millematta mekaddeshin oto harbe milmala vechu uchmo shennitbaer leel beinyan asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vechu bechinat sovev kal almin vechu
Vechacha mammash hu beinyan sachar veonesh kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sechar mitzva mitzva vechu uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher vedaat lenavon nakal umaskil al davar yimtza tov
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 1: Potchin bivracha levarech ulhodot la ki tov shemua tova shama vattechi nafshi torat temima zo hashlamat kal hashshas kullo berov ayarot uminyanim meanshe shelomenu hodaa al heavar uvakkasha al heatid ko yitten vecho yosif leammetz libbam baggibborim midde shana beshana bigvura shel tora ulhodia livne adam gevuratah shel tora shebbeal pe vechochah oz
Peresh shelomo hammelech alav-hashshalom chagra veoz matneha chu matnayim hem bechinat davar hammaamid kal hagguf im harosh hannitztzav veomed alehem vehem hammolichim umviim oto limchoz cheftzo

Uchmo shehu begashmiyyut hagguf kach hu bivchinat ruchaniyyut hannefesh haelohit haemuna haamitit ba echad en-sof baruch-hu deihu memalle kal almin vesovev kal almin velet atar panuy mineh lemala ad en ketz ulmatta ad en tachlit vechen led sitrin bivchinat en-sof mammash vechen bivchinat shana venefesh kannoda

Hinne emuna zo nikret beshem bechinat matnayim davar hammaamid umkayyem et harosh hu hassechel hammitbonen umaamik daat bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat olam-shana-nefesh uvrov chasdo venifleotav immanu lihot am kerovo uldavka vo mammash kannoda mimmaamar yafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim baolam hazze mikkal chayye olam-habba shehu rak ziv veheara mibbechina hannikret shechina hashshochen chu venivra beud achat mishshemo yitbarech chu aval teshuva umaasim tovim mekarvin yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim mammash lemahuto veatzmuto kivyachol bechinat en-sof mammash uchmo shekkatuv hodo al eretz veshamayim vayyarem keren leammo chu asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu chu

Vechammayim happanim chu leholid mittevuna zo dechilu urchimu sichliyyim o tiviyyim lihot bechinat tzaak libbam el o bechinat rishpe esh veshalhevet azza bivchinat ratzo veachar kach bivchinat shov lihot pachad belibbo velevosh miggedullato chu vehu bechinat semol docha kemo shekkatuv bemattan-tora vayyar haam vayyanuu vayyaamdu merachok chu vehen bechinot hazzeroot vehagguf shebbannefesh

Ach mi hu hannoten koach vaoz livchinat matnayim lehaamid ulkayyem harosh vehazzeroot hu esek velimud halachot battora shebbeal pe shehi bechinat giluy ratzon haelon deorayeta mechachma hi denafkat aval mekorah vesharshah hu lemala mala mibbechinat chachma vehu hannikra beshem ratzon haelon baruch-hu uchmo shekkatuv katztzinna ratzon taterennu kaatara shehi al hammochin shebbarosh vechannoda mimma sheppershu al pasuk eshet chayil ateret balah vechal hashshone halachot bechal yom chu

Vezehu chagra veoz matneha en oz ella tora shehi notenet koach vaoz livchinat matnayim hachagurim umlubbashim bah lechazzek ulammetz zerooteha hen dechilu urchimu sichliyyim o tiviyyim kal chad lefum shiura dileh veal haamadat vekiyyum bechinat harosh shebbannefesh hu hassechel hammitbonen chu amar taama ki tov sachrah chu umvoar bemakom acher

Ach et uzman hachizuk veimutz hazzeroot veharosh hi sheat tefillat hashshachar shehi sheat rachamim veet ratzon haelon lemala velazot otah avakkesh mimmevakshe yavinu veyaskilu yachdav velihot lezikkaron ben enehem kal ma shekkatavti alehem eshtakad bichlal uvifrat meinyan kavanat hattefilla meumka delibba yom yom yidreshun bechal libbam uvchal nafsham venafsham tishtappech kammayim nochach pene uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha besifre ad mitzuy hannefesh chu
Veatta happaam hinneni yosif shenit yadi betosefet beur uvakkasha kefula shetucha ufrusa lifne kal anshe shelomim hakkerovim veharchokim lekayyem alehem

Shekkal yeme hachol lo yerdu lifne hatteva habbaale asakim sheen lahem penay kal kach rak otam sheyyesh lahem penay o hamlammedim o hassemuchim al shulchan avihem sheyecholim lehaarich bitfillat hashshachar erech shaa umechetza lefachot kal yemot hachol mehem yihye hayyored lifne hatteva al pi haggoral o al pi ritzuy harov vehu yeesof elav besaviv lo kal hassemuchim al shulchan avihem o melammedim sheyyuchlu lehaarich kamohu beval yeshunne na vena

Ach beshabbatot veyamim tovim sheggam kal baale asakim yesh lahem penay ushat hakkosher lehaarich bitfillatam bechavanat libbam venafsham la veadderabba alehem muttal beyeter seet veyeter oz kemo shekkatuv beshulchan aruch orach chayyim uchmo shekkatuv betorat moshe sheshet yamim taavod chu veom hashshevii shabbat la elohecha dayeka kullo la velazot gam hem yerdu lifne hatteva beshabbat veom tov al pi haggoral o beritzuy harov kemo shekkatavti eshtakad

Uchgon da tzarich leodoe shebbedati im yirtze lishloach lechal hamminyanim meraggelim basseter leda ulhodia kal mi sheefshar lo vechal mi sheyyesh lo penay lehaarich ulayyen bitfilla umitatztzel yihye nidon berichuk makom lihot nidche bishte yadayim bevoo lefo lishmoa divre elokim chayyim umikkelal lav atta shomea hen velashshomim yunam vetavo alehem birkat tov veen tov ella tora vechu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 2: Katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkal chu perush shebbechal chesed vachesed shehakkadosh-baruch-hu ose leadam tzarich lihot shefal ruach bimod ki chesed deroa yemina vimino techabbekeni shehi bechinat kirvat elohim mammash beyeter seet millefanim vechal hakkarov el beyeter seet vehagbeha lemala mala tzarich lihot yoter shefal ruach lematta matta kemo shekkatuv merachok nira li vechannoda dechulla kammeh daveka kela chashiv veim ken kal shehu kammeh yoter hu yoter kela veayin vaefes

Vezo hi bechinat yamin shebbikdushsha vechesed leavraham sheamar anochi afar vaefer vezo hi gam ken middato shel yaakov uvazot hitnatztzel al yirato mippene esav velo day lo behavtachato vehinne anochi immach chu mippene heot katan yaakov bimod meod beenav mechamat ribuy hachasadim ki vemakli chu veeno rauy uchday kelal lehinnatzel chu uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shemma yigrom hachet shennidme veenav shechata
Ma sheen ken beze leummat ze hu yishmael chesed diklipa kal shehachesed gadol hu holech vegadel begovah vegassut haruach verochav libbo

Velazot bati min hammodiim modaa rabba lichlalut anshe shelomenu al ribuy hachasadim asher higdil laasot immanu leechoz bemiddotav shel yaakov shear ammo usherit yisrael shemmesim atzmo keshirayim umotarot mammash sheen bo shum tzorech levilti rum levavam meachehem chu velo leharchiv alehem pe o lishrok alehem chas veshalom has millehazkir beazhara noraa rak lehashpil rucham velibbam bemiddat emet leyaakov mippene kal adam binmichut ruach umaane rach meshiv chema veruach nechea chu vechulle hay veulay yitten belev achehem kammayim happanim vego
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 3: Vayyilbash tzedaka kashshiron vechova yeshua berosho vedarshu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ma shiron ze kal kelipa uklipa mitztarefet leshiron gadol af tzedaka kal peruta ufruta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol perush shehashshiron asuy kaskassim al nekavim vehem meginim shello yikkanes chetz bannekavim vechacha hu maase hatztzedaka

Uveur hainyan ki gedola tzedaka mikkal hammitzot shemmehen naasim levushim lehanneshama hannimshachim meor-en-sof baruch-hu mibbechinat sovev kal almin kimmevoar happerush memalle kal almin vesovev kal almin belikkute amarim ayyen sham beitaruta diltatta hi mitzvat veratzon haelon baruch-hu veikar hamshacha zo meor-en-sof baruch-hu hu levush veor makkif le sefirot daatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya hammishtalshelot meila leila umimmadrega lemadrega chu hannikraot beshem memalle kal almin

Perush ki or-en-sof baruch-hu mitlabbesh umeir betoch kal hishtalshelut haeser sefirot daatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya vehu hammaatzil haeser sefirot daatzilut hammishtalshelot livria-yetzira-asiyya al-yede tzimtzum atzum hamvoar beetz chayyim venikra or penimi

Veal-yede kiyyum hammitzot nimshach or makkif hannizkar leel umeir toch haeser sefirot daatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya umityached im haor penimi venikra yichud kudsha-berich-hu ushchinteh kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher umeheara deheara meor makkif hannizkar leel al-yede tzimtzum rav naase levush livchinot nefesh-ruach-neshama shel haadam began eden hattachton vehaelon sheyyuchlu lehanot ulhassig eze hassaga veheara meor-en-sof baruch-hu kemo shemmevoar bemakom acher

Veze sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sechar mitzva behay alma leka ki baolam hazze haggashmi uvaal gevul vetzimtzum rav veatzum meod meod i efshar lehitlabbesh shum heara meor-en-sof baruch-hu ki im al-yede sefirot hannikraim gufa bazzohar hakkadosh chesed deroa yemina chu

Lefi shekkemo sheen aroch lo lehagguf haggashmi legabbe hanneshama kach en aroch kelal le sefirot daatzilut legabbe hammaatzil haelon en-sof baruch-hu ki afilu chachma ilaa shehi reshitan hi bivchinat asiyya gufanit legabbe en-sof baruch-hu kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim

Vee lazot bemaase hatztzedaka ugmilut chasadim sheadam ochel mipperotehen baolam hazze yesh nekavim al derech mashal ballevush haelon hammakkif al gufa hem hakkelim de sefirot lehair mehem ulhashpia or veshefa mechesed deroa yemina orech yamim baolam hazze haggashmi veosher vechavod midderoa semala vechen betiferet vehod vehadar vechedva vechu

Ach kede shello yinku hachitzonim lemala meor veshefa hammishtalshel veored lematta matta ad olam hazze haggashmi vechen lematta lehagen al haadam ulshamro ulhatztzilo mikkal davar ra begashmiyyut uvruchaniyyut lazot chozer umeir or hammakkif vesotem hannekev al derech mashal ki hu mibbechinat en-sof vesovev kal almin kannizkar leel vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol dayeka ki gadol umhullal meod beli sof vetachlit ugvul chas veshalom

Ach mi hu haggorem liridat haor vehashshefa laolam hazze haggashmi mi sefirot hannikraim gufa hu hayyichud hannizkar leel shehi tosefet heara vehashpaa mibbechinat or-en-sof hammaatzil haelon baruch-hu beyeter seet al haheara vehahashpaa shebbitchilat haatzilut vehahishtalshelut vechu vereshit tosefet haheara vehahashpaa hi lereshit hay sefirot

Veze hu vechova yeshua berosho yeshua hu milleshon vayyisha el hevel veel minchato vehu yeridat haor vehashshefa desh nehorin shebbazzohar hakkadosh uchmo shekkatuv yaer panav elecha yaer panav ittanu sela ittanu hu al-yede maase hatztzedaka

Veze hu zorea tzedakot matzmiach yeshuot vechacha yaer panav alehem tzidkatam omedet laad vekarnam tarum bishuat matzmiach keren yeshua tzemach tzedaka mehakkova yeshua hannizkar leel kenefesh tidreshennu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 4: En yisrael nigalin ella bitzdaka shenneemar veshaveha bitzdaka ketiv tzedek lefanav yehallech vahava-leh-lememar yelech ach hainyan al pi ma shekkatuv lecha amar libbi bakkeshu fanay perush bakkeshu penimit hallev ki hinne belahav yesod haesh haelokit shebballev hinne behallev yesod haesh haelokit shebballev yesh bechinot bechinat chitzoniyyut uvchinat penimiyyut
Chitzoniyyut hallev hi hitlahavut hammitlahevet mibbechinat habbina vehaddaat bigdullat en-sof baruch-hu lehitbonen bigdullato ulholid mittevuna zo ahava azza kerishpe esh vechu

Ufnimiyyut hallev hi hannekudda shebbifnimiyyut hallev veumka delibba shehi lemala mala mibbechinat haddaat vehattevuna sheyyuchal haadam lehitbonen belibbo bigdullat uchmo shekkatuv mimmaamakkim keraticha meumka deliba veal derech mashal kemo bemile dealma lifamim yesh inyan gadol meod meod shekkal chayyut haadam taluy bo venogea ad nekuddat penimiyyut hallev vead bichlal vegorem lo lifamim laasot maasim uldabber devarim shello vedaat kelal

Veze leummat ze kacha hu mammash baavoda shebballev vehayenu lefi shebbechinat nekuddat penimit hallev hi lemala mibbechinat haddaat hammitpashshet umitlabbesh bammiddot shennoldu mechachma-bina-daat kannoda rak hi bechinat hearat chachma elona shellemala mehabbina vehaddaat uvah melubbash veganuz or mammash kemo shekkatuv bechachma chu vehi hi bechinat nitzotz elokut shebbechal nefesh miyyisrael

Uma sheen kal adam zoche lemadrega zo laavoda shebballev meumka delibba bivchinat penimiyyut hayenu lefi shebbechina zo hi etzlo bivchinat galut veshivya vehi bechinat galut hashshechina mammash ki hi hi bechinat nitzotz elohut shebbenafsho haelohit vesibbat haggalut hu maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha galu levavel shechina immahem dehayenu mippene shehilbish bechinat penimit nekuddat levavo beze leummat ze dehayenu bilvushim tzoim demile dealma vetaaot olam hazze hannikra beshem bavel vehi bechinat arla hamchassa al habberit unkudda happenimit shebballev veal ze neemar umaltem et arlat levavchem

Vehinne bammila yesh shene bechinot mila ufria shehen arla gassa uklipa dakka vechen bearlat hallev yesh gam ken taaot gassot vedakkot mila ufria umal velo fara keillu lo mal mippene shessof sof adayin nekuddat penimit hallev hi mechussa bilvush sak dak bivchinat galut veshivya

Vehinne al milat haarla mammash ketiv umaltem et arlat levavchem attem beatzmechem ach lehasir hakkelipa haddakka zehu davar hakkashe al haadam veal ze neemar beviat hammashiach umal elohecha et levavcha chu leahava et elohecha bechal levavcha uvchal nafshecha lemaan chayyecha kelomar lemaan ki levaddo hu kal chayyecha mammash shellachen ahava zo hi meumka delibba minnekudda penimit mammash kannizkar leel ulmala mibbechinat haddaat

Velachen mashiach ba behesach haddaat lichlalut yisrael vehi giluy bechinat nekudda penimit hakkelalit vitziat hashshechina hakkelalit mehaggalut vehashshivya laad ulolme olamim vechen kal nitzotz perati mehashshechina shebbenefesh kal echad miyyisrael yotzet mehaggalut vehashshivya lefi shaa bechayye shaa zo tefilla vaavoda shebballev meumka delibba mibbechinat nekudda happenimit hanniglet mehaarla veola lemala ledavka vo bitshuka azza bivchinat lemaan chayyecha

Vehu gam ken bivchinat hesach daat haadam ki bechina zo hi lemala middaat haadam vehitbonnuto bigdullat rak hi bechinat mattana netuna meet min hashshamayim mehearat bechinat panim haelonim kemo shekkatuv yaer panav elecha uchmo shekkatuv umal elokecha chu

Ach mudaat zot ki itaruta dilela hi beitaruta diltatta daveka bivchinat haalaat mayyin nukvin kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en tippa yoredet milmala chu velachen tzarich haadam laasot beatzmo techillat mila zo lehasir arlat hallev uklipa haggassa vedakka hammalbishot umchassot al bechinat nekuddat penimit hallev shehi bechinat ahavat bechinat lemaan chayyecha shehi baggalut betaaot olam hazze shehem gam ken bivchinat lemaan chayyecha beze leummat ze kannizkar leel

Vehayenu al-yede netinat hatztzedaka la mimmamono shehu chayyuto uvifrat mi shemmezonotav metzumtzamim udchika leh shata tuva shennoten mechayyav mammash uvifratut im nehene migia kappav shei efshar shello asak bahem peamim rabbot bivchinat nekuddat penimit hallev meumka delibba keminhag haolam beiskehem bemassa umattan uchhay gavena

Vahare atta happaam keshemmefazzer migio venoten la besimcha uvtuv levav hinne baze pode nafsho mishshachat dehayenu bechinat nekuddat penimit levavo shehayeta bivchinat galut veshivya betoch hakkelipa gassa o dakka kemo shekkatuv mikkal mishmar netzor libbecha mishmar perush bet haasurim veatta nifde mehachitzonim bitzdaka zo veze gam ken leshon peria inyan periat chov shennitchayyev venishtabed lachitzonim shemmashlu vo al nekuddat penimiyyut levavo vezehu veshaveha bitzdaka

Vezehu tzedek lefanav yehallech lefanav hu milleshon penimiyyut viyehallech hu milleshon holacha shemmolich et penimit hallev la veachar kach yasim lederech peamav kemo shekkatuv vehalachta bidrachav achare elohechem telechu bechal maase hammitzot vetalmud tora keneged kullan shekkullan olin la al-yede penimit hallev beyeter seet umala mala mealiyyatan la al-yede chitzonit hallev hannolad mehattevuna vehaddaat levaddan beli hearat panim milmala ella bivchinat hester panim ki en happanim haelonim meirim lematta ella beitaruta diltatta bemaase hatztzedaka hannikra shalom vezehu shekkatuv pada veshalom nafshi nafshi dayeka

Vezehu gam ken hattaam shennikra hatztzedaka shalom lefi shennaase shalom ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha dehayenu al-yede pidon nafshotehen hem chelek mammash mide hachitzonim uvifrat tzidkat eretz yisrael shehi tzidkat mammash kemo shekkatuv tamid ene elohecha bah vehau enay velibbi sham kal hayyamim

Vehi sheamda lanu lifdot chayye nafshenu meatzat hachoshvim lidchot peamenu vetaamod lanu laad lasum nafshenu bechayyim amitim mechayye hachayyim leor beor hachayyim asher yaer panav ittanu sela amen ken yehi ratzon
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 5: Vayyaas david shem uferesh bazzohar hakkadosh mishshum shenneemar vayehi david ose mishpat utzdaka lechal ammo chu bacha rabbi shimon veamar man avid shema kaddisha bechal yoma man deyahiv tzedaka lemiskene chu

Veuvan behakdim maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk ki beyah tzur olamim be nivra olam hazze beud nivra olam-habba perush shehattaanug shemmitannegim nishmot hatztzaddikim venehenin mizziv hashshechina hammeir began eden elon vetachton hu shemmitannegim behassagatam vehaskalatam shemmaskilim veodim umassigim eze hassaga beor vechayyut hashshofea sham meen-sof baruch-hu bivchinat giluy lenishmatam veruach binatam lehavin ulhassig eze hassaga kal echad veechad lefi madregato ulfi maasav velachen nikra olam-habba beshem bina bazzohar hakkadosh

Vehashpaa zo nimshechet mibbechinat chachma ilaa shehu mekor hahaskala vehahassaga hannikra beshem bina vehu kadmut hassechel kodem shebba lichlal giluy hassaga vahavana rak adayin hu bivchinat helem vehester rak shemmeat mizzeer sham zeer sham shofea venimshach mishsham livchinat bina lehavin ulhassig sechel hannelam velachen nikra beshem nekudda behechala bazzohar hakkadosh vezo hi temunat yud shel shem havaya baruch-hu venikra eden asher alav neemar ayin lo raata chu venikra abba yasad beratta

Perush ki hinne hithauut otiyyot haddibbur hayyotzot me motzaot happe enan davar muskal velo mutba beteva motzaot hallalu lehotzi mivta haotiyyot al-yede hahevel vehakkol hammakke bahen al pi derech hatteva velo al pi derech hassechel kegon hassefatayim al derech mashal sheotiyyot yotzot mehen en hatteva velo hassechel noten litziat mivta arba chelke shinuye bituy otiyyot ellu al pi shinuye tenuat hassefatayim shemmitnoanot behevel echad vekol echad happogea bahen beshave veadderabba shinuy hattenuot shebbisfatayim hu lefi shinuy bituy haotiyyot shebbirtzon hannefesh levatte visfatayim kirtzonah lomar ot o o o velo lehefech sheyyihye retzon hannefesh vechavanatah laasot shinuy tenuot hassefatayim kemo shehen mitnaanot atta bevituye otiyyot ellu vechannire bechush sheen hannefesh mitkavenet veodaat lechaven kelal shinuy tenuot hassefatayim beshinuyim ellu

Veoter nire ken bevituy hannekuddot shekkeshehannefesh retzonah lehotzi mippiha nekuddat kamatz azay mimmela nikmatzim hassefatayim uvfattach niftachim hassefatayim velo shertzon hannefesh likmotz velo liftoach kelal uchlal veen lehaarich bedavar happashut umuvan umuskal lechal maskil shemmivta haotiyyot vehannekuddot hu lemala mehassechel hammussag umuvan ella missechel hannelam vekadmut hassechel shebbannefesh hamdabberet velachen en hattinok yachol ledabber af shemmevin hakkol

Ach haotiyyot hen bivchinat chomer vetzura hannikra penimit vechitzonit ki hagam shemmekoran hu mikkadmut hassechel urtzon hannefesh zo hi bechinat tzurat shinuy hammivta shebbechv otiyyot aval bechinat hachomer veguf hithauutan vehu bechinat chitzoniyyutan hu hahevel hayyotze mehallev shemmimmennu mithave kol pashut hayyotze mehaggaron veachar kach nechlak lechv havarot uvituy otiyyot be motzaot hayeduot mehaggaron mehachech chu umivta hahevel hu ot ata kallila chu vehu mekor hachomer veguf haotiyyot terem hitchallekutan lechv velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheolam hazze nivra be

Vehinne hagam shehi tattaa acharona shebbeshem havaya verabbotenu-zichronam-livracha darshu ze al pasuk ki beyah hayenu lefi shemmekorah vereshitah lavo livchinat giluy mehelem hayyud hu mushpa venimshach mibbechinat ilaa sheyyesh lah hitpashshetut orech verochav lehorot al bechinat bina shehi hitpashshetut hassechel hannelam bivchinat giluy vehassaga beharchavat haddaat vehashpaatah mistayyemet ballev uchmo shekkatuv battikunim devina libba uvah hallev mevin umishsham yotze hahevel mekor giluy guf haotiyyot haddibbur hammitgallot be motzaot mehelem hayyud

Utmunat tattaa bichtivatah gam ken behitpashshetut orech verochav mora al hitpashshetut bechinat malchuto yitbarech malchut kal olamim lemala ulmatta uld sitrin hammitpashshetot venimshachot meotiyyot devar kemo shekkatuv bekohelet baasher devar melech shilton kemo shemmevoar bemakom acher
Ulhavin meat mizzeer inyan umahut otiyyot haddibbur belohut sheen lo demut hagguf velo hannefesh chas veshalom kevar nitbaer bederech arukka uktzara belikkute amarim chelek perakim vev ayyen sham

Ach beur hainyan lamma amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheolam hazze daveka nivra be hinne yadua lechal chachme lev ki ribuy haolamot vehahechalot asher en lahem mispar kemo shekkatuv hayesh mispar ligdudav uvchal hechal ugdud elef alfin veribbo rivvan malachim vechen nefesh-ruach-neshama-chayya-yechida madregot leen ketz uvchal olam vehechalot meribuy hechalot shebbaatzilut-beria-yetzira

Hinne kal ribuyim ellu ribuy achar ribuy ad en ketz mammash hakkol nimshach venishpa meribuy tzerufe otiyyot devar hammitchallekot gam ken letzerufim rabbim ad en ketz vetachlit mammash kemo shekkatuv besefer yetzira shiva avanim bonot chameshet alafim vearbaim battim mikkan veelach tze vachashov ma sheen happe yachol ledabber chu

Vahagam sheyyesh bemaalot umadregot hammalachim unshamot kamma vechamma mine maalot umadregot chalukot leen ketz gavoha al gavoha hinne hakkol nimshach lefi chilufe hatztzerufim vehattemurot beatt bash chu uchmo shennitbaer beferek ach derech kelal hinne kullam baale chachma vadaat veodim et boram mippene heot chayyutam mippenimiyyut haotiyyot hannimshachot mibbechinat chachma ilaa vechannizkar leel

Ach haolam hazze hashshafal im hachayyut shebbetocho katan mehachil velisbol or vechayyut mibbechinat tzurat haotiyyot ufnimiyyutan lehair ulhashpia bo beli levush vehester kemo shemmeirot umashpiot linshamot umalachim rak haheara vehahashpaa baa venishpa laolam hazze mibbechinat chomer veguf haotiyyot vechitzoniutam shehu bechinat hahevel hammitchallek lez havalim shebbekohelet shealehem haolam omed kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh

Vehu motza fi hammitlabbesh baolam hazze vechal tzevaav lehachaotam uvtocho melubbeshet bechinat tzurat otiyyot haddibbur vehammachashava mimmiddotav hakkedoshot urtzono vechachmato vechu hamuchadot been-sof baruch-hu betachlit vezehu sheamar haari zichrono livracha shebbechinat chitzoniyyut hakkelim demalchut daatzilut hamrummazot be shel shem havaya baruch-hu hem yardu venaasu neshama leolam haasiyya vechen katuv battikkunim shehayyud hu baatzilut chu ve tattaa mekannenet baasiyya

Vehinne baadam hattachton lemashal mi shehu chacham gadol lehaskil nifleot chachma umtzamtzem sichlo umachashavto beot echad middibburo hinne ze hu tzimtzum atzum virida gedola lechachmato hanniflaa kacha mammash al derech mashal veyater mizze leen ketz haya tzimtzum gadol atzum verav kaasher bidvar shamayim naasu besheshet yeme vereshit uvruach piv kal tzevaam hi ot shel shem havaya baruch-hu ata kallila kemo shekkatuv behibbaram be beraam hi mekor hat maamarot shenimshechu mimmaamar rishon bereshit dename maamar hu hi bechinat chachma hannikret reshit
Ach az hayeta hamshacha virida zo beli itaruta diltatta kelal ki adam ayin laavod chu rak ki chafetz chesed hu veolam chesed yibbane vezehu behibbaram beavraham ki chesed leavraham chu

Ach achar beriat haadam leavdah chu azay kal itaruta dilela leorer middat chesed elon hu beitaruta diltatta bitzdaka vachesed sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze lachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha kal haomer en lo ella tora beli gemilut chasadim afilu tora en lo ella laasok battora uvigmilut chasadim

Ki hinne hagam deorayeta mechachma nafkat uvorayeta mitkayyem alma uvinun delaan bah ki bedibburam mamshichim hearot vehashpaot vehashraot chachma ilaa mekor hattora livchinat otiyyot haddibbur shebbahen nivra haolam kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al tikre banayich ella bonayich hare hamshacha zo hi bechinat yerida gedola velaze tzarich leorer chesed elon hannimshach kammayim mimmakom gavoha lemakom namuch beitaruta diltatta bitzdaka vachesed tattaa shemmamshichim chayyim vachesed lehachaot ruach shefalim venidkaim

Vezehu shekkatuv al yithallel chacham bechachmato chu ki im bezot yithallel chu ki ani ose chesed chu ki hachesed hu hammamshich chayye hachachma lematta veim lav hare nikret chachmato levaddo beli hamshachat chayyim mimmenna chas veshalom

Uvaze yuvan ma sheamar haarizal sheyyesh mine neshamot beyisrael nishmot talmide chachamim haoskim battora kal yemehem venishmot baale mitzot haoskim bitzdaka ugmilut chasadim delichora hare gam talmide chachamim tzerichim laasok bigmilut chasadim kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheafilu tora en lo

Ella shehattalmide chachamim shettoratan ikar verov yemehem bah umiut yemehem bigmilut chasadim hinne peullat itarutam diltatta leorer chesed elon lehamshich ulhorid or-en-sof hamlubbash bechachma ilaa mekor torat shebbefihem hu rak leolam hanneshamot shebbabberia al-yede esek hattalmud velammalachim shebbayetzira al-yede limud hammishna yaan heot chayyut hanneshamot vehammalachim nishpaot mitztzerufe otiyyot haddibur hi tora shebbeal pe umkor haotiyyot hu mechachma ilaa kannizkar leel

Ach lehamshich ulhorid heara vechayyut mibbechinat hevel haelon tattaa laolam hazze hashshafal shehu tzimtzum gadol beyeter oz lo day beitaruta diltatta shel talmide chachamim haoskim miut yemehem bitzdaka ugmilut chasadim ella al-yede itaruta devaale mitzot haoskim rov yemehem bitzdaka ugmilut chasadim uchmo shennitbaer belikkute amarim bechelek perek velachen nikreu tamche orayeta vehen bechinot umadregot netzach vehod lihotan mamshichin or hattora lematta leolam haasiyya

Uvaze yuvan lamma nikra hatztzedaka beshem maase kemo shekkatuv vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom al shem sheppeullatah lehamshich or leolam haasiyya vezehu dikduk leshon zohar hakkadosh man deavid shema kaddisha deavid dayeka ki beitaruta diltatta bitzdaka vachesed tattaa meorer chesed elon lehamshich or-en-sof mibbechinat chachma ilaa yud shel shem le shel shem bechinat haddibbur veruach piv yitbarech kede lehashpia leolam haasiyya
Veal derech mashal lehavdil havdalot en ketz kemo sheadam eno medabber ella laacherim velo keshehu beno leven atzmo veaz metzamtzem sichlo umachashavto bedibburo alehem vehammaskilim yavinu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 6: Zorea tzedaka secher emet bemishle perush shessechar zeriat hatztzedaka hi middat emet
Uchtiv titten emet leyaakov ushvacha dekudsha-berich-hu mesadder neviyya chu kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh perush shehakkadosh-baruch-hu hu hannoten middat emet leyaakov
Vetzarich lehavin vechi en emet beyaakov chas veshalom ad shehakkadosh-baruch-hu yitten lo milmala

Ach hinne mudaat zot demiddat yaakov hi middat rachamanut vaavodat bemiddat rachamanut hi habbaa mehitorrut rachamim rabbim belev haadam al nitzotz elokut shebbenafsho harchoka meor pene kaasher holech bechoshech havle olam vehitorrut rachamanut zo hi baa mehattevuna vehaddaat bigdullat ech sheafilu haolamot haelonim lemala mala ad en ketz kela mammash chashive kammeh ki kal shifam vechayyutam eno rak mizziv veheara meot echad mishshemo yitbarech kammaamar beud nivra olam-habba chu

Vehinne beziv veheara zo shehu hitpashshetut hachayyut mishshemo yitbarech lehachaot elonim vetachtonim hu sheyyesh hevdel vehefresh ben elonim letachtonim sheolam hazze nivra be vechu vechen kal shinuye happeratim shebbechal olam veolam hu lefi shinuye tzerufe haotiyyot vechen shinuye hazzemannim beavar hove veatid veshinuye kal hakkorot bechilufe hazzemannim hakkol mishshinuye tzerufe haotiyyot shehen hen hamshachat hachayyut mimmiddotav yitbarech shemo kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim chelek perek

Aval legabbe mahuto veatzmuto yitbarech ketiv ani lo shaniti ben bivchinat shinuye hahishtalshelut merum hammaalot ad lematta matta shekkemo shehu yitbarech matzuy baelonim kach hu mammash beshave battachtonim uchmo shennitbaer belikkute amarim chelek perek uven bivchinat shinuye hazzeman shekkemo shehaya hu levaddo hu yachid umuchad lifne sheshet yeme vereshit kach hu atta achar habberia vehayenu mishshum shehakkol keayin vaefes mammash legabbe mahuto veatzmuto uchmo ot echad middibburo shel adam o afilu mimmachashavto legabbe kelalut mahut hannefesh hassichlit veatzmutah al derech mashal leshakkech et haozen uveemet en aroch elecha ketiv uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher belikkute amarim chelek perek ayyen sham

Vezehu sheomrim hammelech hamromam levaddo meaz perush kemo shemmeaz kodem habberia haya hu levaddo hu kach atta hu meromam chu umitnasse mimot olam perush shehu ram venissa lemala mala mibbechinat zeman hannikra beshem yemot olam vehayenu lefi shechayyut kal yemot olam hu rak mibbechinat hammelech chu uchmo shemmevoar bemakom acher

Vee lazot harachamanut gedola meod meod al hannitzotz hashshochen bagguf hechashuch vehaafel mashka dechiveya healul lekabbel tuma ulhitgael bechal hattaaot rachamana litztzelan lule shehakkadosh-baruch-hu magen lo venoten lo oz vetaatzumot lilchom im hagguf vetaaotav ulnatztzechan vezehu sheomrim adon uzzenu chu magen yishenu chu

Vehinne mudaat zot deyesh mine dechilu urchimu harishonot hen hannoladot mehattevuna vehaddaat bigdullat uvidvarim hammeviin lide ahavat veyirato vehaacharonot hen habbaot achar kach milmala bivchinat mattana uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher al pasuk avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem shehi middat ahava vechen hu gam ken beyyira

Vehinne vadday en aroch kelal ben harishonot shehen toldot hassechel hannivra legabbe haacharonot shehen mehabbore yitbarech shemo velachen hen hen hannikraot beshem emet ki chotamo shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu emet shehu emet haamiti vechal haemet shebbannivraim kela chashive kammeh

Ach eze hadderech sheyyizke haadam leemet hinne hu al yede sheyeorer rachamim rabbim lifne al hannitzotz shebbenafsho shehi middato shel yaakov mavriach mehakkatze el hakkatze dehayenu merum hammaalot ad lematta matta lehamshich emet laolam hashshafal hazze hechashuch uchmo shekkatuv ki eshev bachoshech or li vezehu ki gavar alenu chasdo chu
Ach hitorrut rachamim rabbim lifne tzarich lihot gam ken beemet vegam keshehu beemet shello ech yuchal al-yede emet shello leorer rachamim elonim meemet

Ach haetza laze hi middat hatztzedaka shehi middat harachamim al man delet leh miggarmeh lehachaot ruach shefalim chu uvitaruta diltatta itaruta dilela meorer yeshenim umekitz nirdamim hem bechinat rachamim rabbim vachasadim elonim hannelamim latzet mehahelem el haggiluy veheara rabba leor beor hachayyim emet leolam

Vezehu leshon zeria hanneemar bitzdaka lehatzmiach emet haelon emet uvifrat bitzdaka vachesed shel emet sheosim im eretz hakkodesh tibbane vetikkonen bimhera veyamenu amen lekayyem ma shekkatuv emet meeretz titzmach al-yede zeriat hatztzedaka bah vechesed verachamim rabbim hanneesafim venilkatim letochah hem meorrim gam ken chasadim elonim hatztzefunim venelamim bah kemo shekkatuv asher tzafanta chu lechonnah velahakimah vezehu shekkatuv bitzdaka tikkonani
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 7: Ashrenu ma tov chelkenu uma naim goralenu chu menat chelki vechosi vego chavalim naflu li vego

Lehavin leshon chelkenu vegoralenu tzarich levaer hetev lashon hashshagur bemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en lo chelek belohe yisrael ki hagam delichora lo shayyach leshon chelek kelal belokut yitbarech sheeno mitchallek lachalakim chas veshalom

Ach hainyan kemo shekkatuv beyaakov vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael perush ki hinne beemet hakkadosh-baruch-hu kishmo ken hu ki af deihu memalle kal almin elonim vetachtonim merum hammaalot ad mittachat laaretz hallezu hachumrit kemo shekkatuv halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male ani mammash dehayenu mahuto veatzmuto kivyachol velo kevodo levad af-al-pi-chen hu kadosh umuvdal meelonim vetachtonim veeno nitpas kelal betocham chas veshalom kitfisat nishmat haadam begufo al derech mashal kemo shemmevoar bemakom acher baarichut

Velazot lo hau yecholim lekabbel chayyutam mimmahuto veatzmuto levaddo kivyachol rak hitpashshetut hachayyut asher hakkadosh-baruch-hu mechayye elonim vetachtonim hu al derech mashal kemo heara meira mishshemo yitbarech shehu ushmo echad uchmo shekkatuv ki nisgav shemo levaddo rak zio vehodo al eretz veshamayim vego
Veheara zo mitlabbeshet mammash baelonim vetachtonim lehachaotam venitpeset betocham al-yede memutztzaim rabbim vetzimtzumim rabbim vaatzumim behishtalshelut hammadregot derech illa vealul vechu

Vehinne heara zo af shellemala hi meira umitpashshetet bivchinat beli gevul vetachlit lehachaot olamot nelamim leen ketz vetachlit kemo shekkatuv beidra rabba af-al-pi-chen beridtah lematta al-yede tzimtzumim rabbim lehachaot hannivraim vehayetzurim vehannaasim hi nechleket derech kelal lemispar taryag keneged taryag mitzot hattora shehen hen taryag mine hamshachot heara zo meor-en-sof baruch-hu lehair lenishmat haadam hakkelula meramach evarim veshasa gidim asher baavurah hu ikar tachlit yeridat vehamshachat heara zo lematta lechal hannivraim vehayetzurim vehannaasim shettachlit kullan hu haadam kannoda

Vehinne mispar ze hu bederech kelal aval bederech perat hinne kal mitzva umitzva mitchalleket lifratim rabbim leen ketz vetachlit vehen hen gufe halachot peratiyyot shebbechal mitzva sheen lahem mispar kemo shekkatuv shishshim hemma melachot hen massechtot chu vaalamot en mispar hen hahalachot chu shehen hamshachat ratzon haelon chu

Vechen hu mammash benishmat haadam ki hinne kal hanneshamot shebbaolam hau kelulot beadam harishon vederech kelal hayeta nishmato nechleket lemispar taryag ramach evarim veshasa gidim ach derech perat nechleket lenitzotzot en mispar shehen nishmot kal yisrael mimot haavot vehashshevatim ad biat hammashiach vead bichlal sheyekuyyam az ma shekkatuv vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam asher lo yimmad velo yissafer merov

Vehinne shufreh deyaakov meen shufreh deadam harishon shettiken chet adam harishon vehayeta nishmato gam ken kelula mikkal hanneshamot shebbeyisrael meolam vead olam vehaya merkava lattora shellemala shennikret beshem adam kemo shekkatuv veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam vechu uchmo shekkatuv vezot lefanim beyisrael chu en zot ella tora chu shehayeta kelula umlubbeshet benishmat yisrael sava hakkelula mikkal hanneshamot

Vezehu vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael el leshon hamshachat haheara meor-en-sof baruch-hu mehahelem el haggiluy lehair bivchinat giluy benishmato uchmo shekkatuv el vayaer lanu veacharav kal yishre lev haoskim battora uvammitzot meir or en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat giluy benishmatam
Uzman giluy ze beyeter seet veyeter oz haheara bemocham velibbam hu bishat hattefilla kemo shemmevoar bemakom acher

Vehinne af sheggiluy ze al-yede esek hattora vehammitzot hu shave lechal nefesh miyyisrael bederech kelal ki tora achat umishpat echad lechullanu af-al-pi-chen bederech perat en kal hannefashot o haruchot vehanneshamot shaot beinyan ze lefi et uzman gilgulam uvoam baolam hazze uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha avuch bemay have zahir tefe amar leh betzitzit chu
Vechen en kal haddorot shavin ki kemo sheevre haadam kal ever yesh lo peulla peratit umuchedet haayin lirot vehaozen lishmoa kach bechal mitzva meir or perati umuchad meor-en-sof baruch-hu

Veaf shekkal nefesh miyyisrael tzericha lavo begilgul lekayyem kal taryag mitzot mikkal makom lo nitzrecha ella lehaadafa uzhirut uzrizut yetera beyeter seet veyeter oz kefula umchuppelet lemala mala mizzehirut shear hammitzot vezehu sheamar bemay have zahir tefe tefe dayeka

Vehinne yitron haor hazze happerati linshamot peratiyyot eno bivchinat taam vadaat mussag ella lemala mibbechinat haddaat shekkach ala bemachashava lefanav yitbarech vedugmato lematta hu bechinat haggoral mammash
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 8: Zorea tzedakot matzmiach yeshuot hinne ma shekkatuv leshon zeria bemitzvat hatztzedaka uchmo shekkatuv bappasuk ziru lachem litzdaka chu yuvan al pi ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha rabbi elazar yahiv peruta leani vahadar matzle dichtiv ani betzedek echeze fanecha perush ki giluy elokuto yitbarech hammitgalle bemachashavto shel adam vechavanato bitfillato kal chad lefum shiura dileh hu betorat tzedaka vechesed meolam vead olam al yereav chu

Kelomar sheor en-sof baruch-hu hammeir lemala beolamot elonim beheara rabba bivchinat giluy rav veatzum ad shebbeemet hen betelin bimtziut uchla mammash chashive kammeh venichlalin beoro yitbarech vehen hen hahechalot im hammalachim vehanneshamot shebbahen hamvoarim bazzohar hakkadosh bishmotam limkomotam beseder hattefilla shessidderu lanu anshe keneset haggedola hinne mishsham meir haor ki tov laolam hashshafal hazze al yire vechoshve shemo hachafetzim leavdo baavoda shebballev zo tefilla uchmo shekkatuv va yaggiha chashki
Vehinne yeridat heara zo lematta laolam hazze nikret beshem chesed hamchunne beshem mayim hayyordim mimmakom gavoha lemakom namuch chu

Vehinne mudaat zot sheyyesh lemala gam ken middat haggevura vehatztzimtzum letzamtzem ulhastir oro yitbarech leval yitgalle lattachtonim ach hakkol taluy beitaruta diltatta sheim haadam mitnaheg bachasidut lehashpia chayyim vachesed chu kach meorer lemala kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha bemidda sheadam moded bah moddin lo

Ella delichora zo enah min hammidda ki im lehashpia lo chayye haolam-habba levad keneged ma shehu mashpia chayye olam hazze aval lo lehashpia lo chayye hearat or en-sof baruch-hu mammash sheyyair veyaggiha chashko baavoda shebballev zo tefilla shehi bechinat umadregat teshuva ilaa kannoda shehare hi lemala mala mikkal chayye olam-habba kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha yafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim chu uchmo shennitbaer bemakom acher baarichut deolam-habba eno ella ziv veheara vechu

Ach hainyan hu al derech mashal kemo shezzorin zeraim o notin garin shehashshibbolet hatztzomachat mehazzera vehailan uferotav mehaggarin enan mahutan veatzmutan shel hazzera vehaggarin kelal ki mahutam veatzmutam kale venirkav baaretz vechoach hatztzomeach shebbaaretz atzmah atzmo hu hammotzi vehamgaddel hashshibbolet vehailan uferotav rak sheeno motzi umgalle kocho lachutz mehakkoach el happoal ki im al-yede hazzera vehaggarin shennirkavin baaretz vechale kal kocham bechoach hatztzomeach shebbaaretz venitachadu vehau laachadim veal-yede ze motzi koach hatztzomeach et kocho el happoal umashpia chayyut legaddel shibbolet keen hazzera aval beribuy harbe meod beshibbolet achat vechen perot harbe al ilan echad vegam mahutan veatzmutan shel happerot meulla beiluy rav veatzum lemala mala mimmahuto veatzmuto shel haggarin hannatua vechen kehay gavena beferot haaretz haggedelim mizzeronin keen garinin kemo kishshuim uchhay gavena

Vehakkol hu mippene sheikar veshoresh chayyut happerot nishpa mikkoach hatztzomeach shebbaaretz hakkolel chayyut kal happerot vehaggarinin hazzeruim baaretz enan ella keen itaruta diltatta hannikret beshem haalaat mayyin nukvin bechitve haarizal

Vechacha mammash al derech mashal kal maase hatztzedaka sheosin yisrael ole lemala bivchinat haalaat mayyin nukvin leshoresh nishmotehen lemala hannikra beshem keneset yisrael veima tattaa bilshon hazzohar ushchina bilshon haggemara hakkelula mikkal middotav shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu umuchedet bahen betachlit vereshitan hi middat hachesed veal-yede haalaa zo mitorer chesed mammash shehu giluy oro yitbarech lered ulhair lematta lenishmot yisrael bivchinat giluy rav veatzum bishat hattefilla al kal panim ki af shelligdullato en cheker ad dechulla kammeh kela chashive hare bemakom sheatta motze gedullato sham atta motze anvetanuto kemayim sheyyordin chu

Vezehu shekkatuv zarach bachoshech or layesharim channun verachum vetzaddik deal-yede shehaadam channun verachum vetzaddik tzedakot ahev gorem leor sheyyizrach lenishmato hamlubbeshet begufo haomed bachoshech shehu mashka dechiveya veze nikra beshem yeshua kad ithappecha chashocha linhora

Vezehu matzmiach yeshuot sheyeshua zo tzomachat mizzeriat hatztzedaka shezzorin baaretz haelona eretz chefetz hi hashshechina uchneset yisrael shennikret ken al shem shemmitlabbeshet battachtonim lehachaotam kemo shekkatuv malchutcha malchut kal olamim
