Uvifrat min happerat keshezzorin beeretz hakkodesh hattachtona hamchuvenet kenegdah mammash shehazzeria nikletet techef umiyyad baaretz haelona beli shum menia veikuv baolam meachar sheen shum davar chotzetz umafsik kelal ben artzot hachayyim ki ze shaar hashshamayim ma-sheen-ken bechutz laaretz veday lammevin
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 9: Ahuvay achay vereay asher kenafshi bati kemazkir umorer yeshenim betardemat havle havalim velifkoach ene haiverim yabbitu lirot lihot kal yisham vecheftzam umgammatam lechal bahem chayye rucham bimkor mayim chayyim chayye hachayyim kal yeme chayyehem minnefesh vead basar dehayenu kal mile dealma veiske parnasa lo yihye keellu deavdin legarmayehu velo yihye bet yisrael kechal haggoyim dezanin umfarnesin umokrin linshayehu uvnayehu meahava ki mi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz ketiv dehayenu sheggam beinyene eretz lo yafridu yippardu meechad haemet chas veshalom lehaid edut sheker chas veshalom bikriat-shema erev vavoker beenayim segurot echad bed ruchot uvashshamayim mimmaal uvaaretz mittachat uvifkoach ene haiverim hataif enecha bo veenennu chas veshalom

Ach bezot yeot lanu lihot bihot kal iskenu bemile dealma lo legarmayehu ki im lehachaot nafshot chelke elokut ulmallot machsorehem bechesed chinnam shebbaze anu medammin hatztzura leotzrah echad asher chesed el kal hayyom chesed shel emet lehachaot haolam umloo bechal rega varega rak sheishto uvanav shel adam kodmin lakkol al pi hattora chutz mitztzaddikim shebbaddor shehen kodmin levanav vetzaddikim shebbeeretz yisrael kodmin latzaddikim shebbechutz laaretz levad mizzot shello hinnichu kemotan bechutz laaretz veday lamevin

Al ken ahuvay achay simu na levavchem laelle haddevarim hanneemarim biktzara meod veim yirtze pe el pe adabber bam baarukka ech heot kal ikar avodat baittim hallalu beikkevot meshicha hi avodat hatztzedaka kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en yisrael nigalin ella bitzdaka velo amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha talmud tora shakul keneged gemilut chasadim ella bimehem shettalmud tora haya ikar haavoda etzlam veal ken hau chachamim gedolim tannaim veamoraim ma sheen ken beikkevot meshicha shennafla sukkat david ad bechinat raglayim vaakevayim shehi bechinat asiyya en derech ledavka bah beemet ulhappecha chashocha linhora dilah dileh ki im bivchinat asiyya gam ken shehi maase hatztzedaka kayyadua lammaskilim shebbechinat asiyya belokut hi bechinat hashpaat vehamshachat hachayyut lematta matta leman delet leh miggarmeh kelum vechal hazzoveach et yitzro baze ufoteach yado ulvavo itkafya sitra achora umhappech chashocha leor hashshem yitbarech hashshochen alenu bivchinat asiyya beikkevot meshicha veyizke lirot ayin beayin beshuv tziyyon chu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 10: Achar derishat shelomam vechayyim petach devaray yair ozen shomaat tochachat chayyim asher hochiach chayyim al-yede nevio veamar chasde ki lo tamnu vego vahava-leh-lememar ki lo tammu kemo sheomrim ki lo tammu chasadecha vego veuvan al pi ma shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh it chesed veit chesed it chesed olam chu veit chesed ilaa dehu rav chesed chu

Ki hinne mudaat zot hattora nikret oz shehu leshon gevura uchmo sheamru chachamenu-zichronam-livracha taryag mitzot neemru lemoshe missinay mippi haggevura uchdichtiv mimino esh dat lamo perush shehattora mekorah vesharshah hu rak chasde hamchunnim beshem yamin dehayenu hamshachat bechinat elohuto yitbarech veheara meor-en-sof baruch-hu el haolamot elonim vetachtonim al-yede haadam hammamshich haor al atzmo bekiyyum ramach mitzot ase shehen ramach evarim demalka perush ramach kelim ulvushim leheara lehaheara meor-en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash bahen umeor ze yumshach lo dechilu urchimu bechal mitzva kannoda

Rak shehamshacha zo nitlabbesha techilla bemiddat gevurato shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu hamchunna beshem esh shehi bechinat tzimtzum haor vehachayyut hannimshachot meor-en-sof baruch-hu kede shettuchal lehitlabbesh bemaase hammitzot sherubban kechullan hem bidvarim chumriyyim ketzitzit utfilin vekarbanot utzdaka

Veaf mitzot shehen beruchaniyyut haadam kemo yira veahava af-al-pi-chen hen bivchinat gevul umidda velo bivchinat en-sof kelal ki ahava rabba la beli ketz ugvul umidda en haadam yachol lesovlah belibbo velihot kayyam begufo afilu rega uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shebbishat mattan tora shehayeta hitgallut elohuto yitbarech veor-en-sof baruch-hu bivchinat dibur vehitgallut parcha nishmatan chu

Vehinne lefi shehammitzot nitnu lanu al-yede hitlabbeshut bemiddat gevura vetzimtzum haheara chu lachen rov hammitzot yesh lahen shiur metzumtzam kemo orech hatztzitzit yb gudalin vehattefilin etzbaayim al etzbaayim umrubbaot daveka vehallulav tefachim vehassukka tefachim vehashshofar tefach vehammikve sea vechen bekarbanot yesh lahen shiur metzumtzam lizman kemo kevasim bene shana veelim bene shettayim ufarim chu

Vechen bemaase hatztzedaka ugmilut chasadim bemamono af shehi mehaammudim shehaolam omed alehem uchdichtiv olam chesed yibbane afilu hache yesh lah shiur katzuv chomesh lemitzva min hammuvchar umaaser lemidda venonit chu veze nikra chesed olam perush chesed el kal hayyom hammitlabbesh baolamot elonim vetachtonim al-yede itaruta diltatta hi mitzvat hatztzedaka vachesed sheosim bene adam ze im ze

Ulfi shehaolam hu bivchinat gevul umidda mehaaretz ad larakia shana vechen merakia lerakia chu veshit alfe shene have alma chu lachen nitan shiur umidda gam ken lemitzvat hatztzedaka vehachesed shebbattora kemo lishar mitzot hattora

Ach hayenu daveka leshomer hattora velo sar mimmenna yamin usmol afilu kimlo nima aval mi sheheevir alav hadderech chas veshalom meachar sheheeva darko latet migraot bakkodesh haelon sheggara erko bechinat hamshachato ma shehaya yachol lehamshich mibbechinat elohuto vehearat haor meor-en-sof baruch-hu ilu haya shomer hattora umkayemah kehilchatah hare meuvat ze lo yuchal litkon ki im behamshachat haor haelon shellemala mehaolamot veeno mitlabbesh bahen hannikra chesed ilaa verav chesed lefi shemmeir umitpashshet bivchinat en-sof beli gevul umidda meachar sheenennu metzumtzam toch haolamot ella bivchinat makkif alehen milmala meresh kal dargin ad sof vechu uchshehaadam mamshicho lematta bemaasav veitaruta diltatta azay or elon ze meir umitpashshet toch haolamot umtakken kal meuvat vechal migraot shennitnu bakkodesh haelon umchaddesh oran vetuvan beyeter seet veyeter oz bivchinat or chadash mammash lachen amru bemakom shebbaale teshuva omdin vechu
Vehinne ikar hatteshuva hu ballev ki al-yede hacharata meumka delibba meorer omek or haelon hazze

Ach kede lehamshicho lehair baolamot elonim vetachtonim tzarich itaruta diltatta mammash bivchinat maase dehayenu maase hatztzedaka vachesed beli gevul umidda dichmo shehaadam mashpia rav chesed perush chas delet dehayenu ledal veevon delet leh miggarmeh kelum veeno noten gevul umidda lintinato vehashpaato kach hakkadosh-baruch-hu mashpia oro vetuvo bivchinat chesed ilaa hannikra rav chesed hammeir bivchinat en-sof beli gevul umidda toch haolamot elonim vetachtonim shekkullam hem bivchinat delet etzlo yitbarech delet lehon miggarmehon kelum vecholla kammeh kela chashive veal-yede ze nitkenu kal happegamim sheppagam haadam baaonotav lemala baolamot elonim vetachtonim
Vezehu shekkatuv aso tzedaka umishpat nivchar la mizzavach lefi shehakkarbanot hen bivchinat shiur umidda ugvul ma sheen ken bitzdaka sheyyuchal lefazzer beli gevul letakken aonotav

Uma sheamru hamvazbez al yevazbez yoter mechomesh hayenu daveka bemi shello chata o shettikken chataav besigufim vetaaniyyot karauy letakken kal happegamim lemala aval mi shetztzarich letakken nafsho adayin peshita dela gara refuat hannefesh merfuat hagguf sheen kesef nechshav vechol asher laish yitten bead nafsho ketiv

Vehinne middat chesed zo beli gevul umidda nikret al shemo shel hakkadosh-baruch-hu chasde kedichtiv vechesed meolam vead olam chu ki hagam shekkal yisrael hem rachamanim vegomle chasadim beram yesh gevul umidda lerachame haadam aval hakkadosh-baruch-hu nikra en-sof baruch-hu ulmiddotav en sof kedichtiv ki lo chalu rachamav vechu

Vezehu sheamar hannavi achar hachurban vehaggalut chasde ki lo tamnu vego perush lefi shello tamnu sheen anu temimim ushlemim beli shum chet ufgam bannefesh uvaolamot elonim al ken tzerichin anu lehitnaheg bechasde shehem beli gevul vetachlit kede leorer alenu rachamim vechesed ilaa shehu rav chesed verachamim beli gevul vetachlit kemo shekkatuv ki lo chalu rachamav vego
Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en yisrael nigalin ella bitzdaka sheyyaasu gam im yihu peturim middina ki en ben david ba chu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 11: Lehaskilcha bina ki lo zo hadderech yishkon or lihot chafetz bechayye vesarim uvane umzone ki al ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha battel retzoncha chu dehayenu sheyyihye retzono batel bimtziut velo yihye lo shum ratzon kelal beinyene olam hazze kullam hannichlalim bevane chayye umzone uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheal karchach atta chay

Uveur hainyan hu rak emuna amitit beotzer bereshit dehayenu shehabberia yesh meayin hannikret reshit chachma vehi chachmato sheenah musseget leshum nivra habberia hazzot hi bechal et varega shemmithavim kal habberuim yesh meayin mechachmato yitbarech hamchayya et hakkol uchsheyyitbonen haadam beomek havanato vitzayyer bedato havayato meayin bechal rega varega mammash haech yaale al dato ki ra lo o shum yissurim mibbane chayye umzone o sheare yissurin baolam hare haayin shehi chachmato yitbarech hu mekor hachayyim vehattov vehaoneg vehu haeden shellemala meolam-habba rak mippene sheeno mussag lachen nidme lo ra o yissurim aval beemet en ra yored milmala vehakkol tov rak sheeno mussag legodlo verav tuvo
Vezehu ikar haemuna shebbishvilah nivra haadam lehaamin delet atar panuy mineh uvor pene melech chayyim veal ken oz vechedva bimkomo hoil vehu rak tov kal hayyom

Veal ken reshit hakkol sheyyismach haadam veyagel bechal et veshaa veyichye mammash beemunato ba hamchayye umetiv immo bechal rega umi shemmitatztzev umitonen mare beatzmo sheyyesh lo meat ra veyissurin vechaser lo eze tova vahare ze kechofer chas veshalom veal ken hirchiku middat haatzvut bimod chachme haemet
Aval hammaamin lo yachush mishshum yissurin baolam uvchal inyene haolam hen velav shavin etzlo behashvaa amitit

Umi sheen shavin lo mare beatzmo shehu meerev rav dilgarmayehu avdin veohev et atzmo latzet mittachat yad velichot bechayye haggoyim bishvil ahavato et atzmo veal ken hu chafetz bechayye vesarim uvane umzone ki ze tov lo

Venoach lo shello nivra ki ikar beriat haadam baolam hazze hu bishvil lenassoto benisonot ellu veladaat et asher bilvavo im yifne levavo achare elohim acherim shehem taaot hagguf hammishtalshelim missitra achora uvahem hu chafetz o im cheftzo urtzono lichot chayyim amitim hammishtalshelim meelokim chayyim

Veyaamin shebbeemet hu chay bahem vechal tzerachav vechal inyanav mishtalshelim beemet bifrate peratiyyutehem shello missitra achora ki me mitzade gever konanu veen milla chu veim ken hakkol tov betachlit rak sheeno mussag

Uveemuna zo beemet naase hakkol tov gam begaluy shebbeemuna zo shemmaamin shehara hannidme begaluy kal chayyuto hu mittov haelon shehi chachmato yitbarech sheenah musseget vehi haeden shellemala meolam-habba hare beemuna zo nichlal umitalle beemet hara hamdumme battov haelon hagganuz
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 12: Vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom vaavodat hatztzedaka hashket vavetach ad olam lehavin hahefresh shebben maase laavoda uven shalom lehashket vavetach chu al pi ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk ose shalom bimromav ki michael sar shel mayim vegavriel sar shel esh veen mechabbin ze et ze

Kelomar shemmichael sar shel chesed hannikra beshem mayim hayyordim mimmakom gavoha lemakom namuch vehu bechinat hahashpaa vehitpashshetut hachayyut meolamot elonim letachtonim uvchinat esh shettivah laalot lemala hi bechinat haggevura vehistallekut hashpaat hachayyim mimmatta lemala shello lehashpia rak betzimtzum atzum verav vehen middot negdiyyot vehafkiyyot zo lazo vehayenu keshehen bivchinat middot levaddan

Ach hakkadosh-baruch-hu ose shalom benehem dehayenu al-yede giluy shemmitgalle bahen heara rabba vehashpaa atzuma meod meor-en-sof baruch-hu asher kishmo ken hu sheeno bivchinat midda chas veshalom ella lemala mala ad en ketz afilu mibbechinat chachma-bina-daat mekor hammiddot vaazay hammiddot negdiyyot shel michael vegavriel nichlalot bimkoran vesharshan vehau laachadim mammash uvtelim beoro yitbarech hammeir lahem bivchinat giluy

Vaazay mitmazzegim umitmattekim haggevurot bachasadim al-yede bechina memutztzaat kav hammachria umatte kelappe chesed hi middat harachamim hannikret beshem tiferet bedivre chachme haemet lefi shehi kelula miv gevanin loven veodem hamrammezim lechesed ugvura

Velachen setam shem havaya baruch-hu shebbechal hattora more al middat hattiferet kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh lefi shekkan hu bechinat giluy or-en-sof baruch-hu heara rabba beyeter seet mishshear middotav hakkedoshot yitbarech

Vehinne itaruta dilela leorer giluy heara rabba vehashpaa atzuma hannizkeret leel meor-en-sof baruch-hu laasot shalom hannizkar leel hi beitaruta diltatta bemaase hatztzedaka vehashpaat chayyim chen vachesed verachamim leman delet leh miggarmeh kelum ulhachaot ruach shefalim chu

Umudaat zot ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al haosek battora lishmah mesim shalom befamalya shel mala uvfamalya shel matta pamalya shel mala hem hassarim vehammiddot hannizkarot leel shehen hahechalot elonim beolam habberia shebbazzohar hakkadosh ufamalya shel matta hen hahechalot hattachtonim uvifrat olam hazze hashshafal hamorav tov vara mechet adam harishon vehara sholet al hattov kemo shekkatuv asher shalat haadam beadam chu ulom milom yeematz
Vechannire bechush baadam hattachton hannikra beshem olam katan shellifamim hattov gover velifamim lehefech chas veshalom

Veen shalom baolam ad et ketz sheyyitbarer hattov mehara lidavek besharsho umkoro mekor hachayyim baruch-hu vaazay yitpardu kal poale aven veruach hattuma yaavor min haaretz kesheyyitbarer mittocho bechinat hattov hamchayyehu
Uverur ze yihye gam ken al-yede giluy elokuto lematta beheara rabba vehashpaa atzuma kemo shekkatuv ki mala haaretz dea et venigla kevod chu

Vezehu bichlalut haolam leatid ach baadam hattachton bechal et metzo zo tefilla o shear ittim mezummanim lehitboded im kono kal echad lefi maasav zoche lemeen berur ze al-yede esek hattora lishmah vechen al-yede hatztzedaka kemo sheamru rabbi elazar yahiv peruta leani vahadar matzle dichtiv ani betzedek echeze fanecha hi bechinat giluy heara vehashpaat haddaat vehattevuna lehitbonen bigdullat ulholid mizze dechilu urchimu sichliyyim kannoda

Veal-yede ze nivrar hattov la venifrad hara kemo shekkatuv matzref lakkesef vechur lazzahav veish lefi mahalalo perush lefi hilulo et beomek haddaat leholid dechilu urchimu kacha nivrar hattov venifrad hara keverur uferud hassigim mikkesef vezahav bematzref vechur

Vehinne mudaat zot sheyyisrael betivam hem rachamanim vegomle chasadim mippene heot nafshotehem nimshachot mimmiddotav yitbarech asher hachesed gover bahen al middat haddin vehaggevura vehatztzimtzum uchmo shekkatuv gavar chasdo al yereav shellachen nikret hanneshama bat kohen kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh

Vehinne hatztzedaka hannimshechet mibbechina zo nikret beshem maase hatztzedaka ki shem maase nofel al davar shekkevar naasa o shennaase tamid mimmela vehi davar hahove veragil tamid veaf kan hare middat hachesed veharachamanut hutbea benafshot kal bet yisrael mikkevar meet beriutan vehishtalshelutan mimmiddotav yitbarech kemo shekkatuv vayyippach beappav chu veatta nafachta bi uman denafach chu vegam bechal yom vaom betuvo mechaddesh maase vereshit vachadashim labbekarim chu

Ach leshon avoda eno nofel ella al davar shehaadam ose bigia atzuma neged teva nafsho rak shemmevattel tivo urtzono mippene ratzon haelon baruch-hu kegon leyagea atzmo betora uvitfilla ad mitzuy hannefesh chu veaf kan bemitzvat hatztzedaka liten harbe yoter mitteva rachamanuto urtzono uchmo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk naton titten afilu mea feamim vechu

Vezehu shekkatuv vehaya maase hatztzedaka sheggam hatztzedaka hannikret beshem maase velo beshem avoda af-al-pi-chen beitaruta diltatta itaruta dilela meorer giluy or-en-sof baruch-hu beheara rabba vehashpaa atzuma venaase shalom bimromav vegam befamalya shel matta

Rak shebbaolam hazze hashshafal lo yitgalle hashshalom vehabberur uferud hara mehattov ad et ketz velo bizman haggalut kannizkar leel rak beolam katan hu haadam bechal et metzo zo tefilla kemo shekkatuv betzedek echeze fanecha kannizkar leel ach achar hattefilla yuchal lihot hara chozer veneor bekal ulhitarev battov kaasher yithallech becheshchat olam hazze

Ach hatztzedaka bivchinat avoda hinne measher yakra vegadla maalatah bimod meod bihoto mevattel tivo urtzono haggufani mippene ratzon haelon baruch-hu veitkafya sitra achora vaazay istallek yekara dekudsha-berich-hu chu uchyitron haor min hachoshech daveka kannoda e lazot en hara yachol lihot od chozer veneor bekallut kal kach meelav rak im haadam yeorrennu veyamshichennu al atzmo chas veshalom

Vezehu shekkatuv hashket vavetach ad olam hashket hu milleshon shoket al shemarav dehayenu shehashshemarim nifradim legamre min hayyayin venoflin lematta legamre vehayyayin lemala zach vetzalul betachlit veal derech ze hu baavodat hatztzedaka hashshemarim hen bechinat taarovet ra shebbenafsho nivrar venifrad meat meat ad shennofel lematta limkoro vesharsho uchmo shekkatuv vetashlich bimtzulot yam kal chattotam
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 13: Ma rav tuvcha asher tzafanta lireecha vego
Hinne bichlal ovde yesh bechinot umadregot chalukot mitztzad shoresh nishmatam lemala mibbechinat yamin usmol
Dehayenu shebbechinat semol hi middat hatztzimtzum vehahester baavodat kemo shekkatuv vehatznea lechet chu bammistarim tivke chu kal haosek battora basseter chu

Vehinne mimmidda zo nimshecha gam ken bechinat hatztzimtzum vehaggevul baavodat kemo bitzdaka lihot nidon behesseg yad vehamvazbez al yevazbez yoter mechomesh uchhay gavena betalmud tora ushare mitzot day lo sheyyotze yede chovato mechiyyuv meforash shechiyevattu hattora beferush likboa ittim chu umimmenna nimshach gam ken ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha zerok mara battalmidim chu

Ach bechinat yamin hi middat hachesed vehahitpashshetut baavodat behitrachavut beli tzimtzum vehester kelal kemo shekkatuv veethallecha varchava chu vegam beli tzimtzum ugvul kelal veen maatzor leruach nidvato ben bitzdaka uven betalmud tora ushare mitzot velo day lo latzet yede chovato bilvad ella ad beli day chu
Vehinne kal ish yisrael tzarich lihot kalul miv bechinot ellu veen lecha davar sheen lo makom

Velachen matzinu kamma devarim mikkulle bet shammay umechumre bet hillel lelammedenu sheaf bet shammay sheshshoresh nishmatam mibbechinat semol haelon velachen hau danin lehachamir tamid bechal isure hattora uvet hillel shehau mibbechinat yamin haelon hau melammedin zechut lehakel ulhattir isure bet shammay sheyyihu muttarim meisuram veuchlu laalot lemala af-al-pi-chen bechamma devarim hau bet shammay mekilin mippene hitkallut shoresh nishmatam shehu kalul gam miyyamin

Vechen shoresh nishmat bet hillel kalul gam missemol kayyadua derech umiddot kodesh haelon delet taman kitzutz uferud chas veshalom vechal hammiddot kelulot zo mizzo velachen hem meuchadot zo bazo kayyadua leode chen uchdichtiv beavraham shehu middat hachesed vehaahava atta yadati ki yere elohim atta al-yede shellavash middat haggevura vayyaakod et yitzchak beno vayyikkach et hammaachelet chu

Uma sheamar hakkatuv avraham ohavi ufachad yitzchak hinne hahefresh vehahevdel hazze hu bivchinat giluy vehelem shebbemiddat yitzchak happachad hu bivchinat giluy vehaahava mesutteret bivchinat helem vehester vehahefech bemiddat avraham avinu alav-hashshalom

Vezehu sheamar david hammelech alav-hashshalom ma rav tuvcha vego kelomar shemmiddat hattov vehachesed asher hi bivchinat helem vehester etzel kal mi sheshshoresh nishmato mibbechinat semol hannikra beshem yereecha kemiddat bet shammay hinne af shehu tov hagganuz vetzafun af-al-pi-chen hu rav vegadol meod kemo middat haggedulla vehachesed mammash shemmibbechinat yamin ushtehen hen mibbechinat giluy beli gevul umidda veshiur

Vezehu shekkatuv ma rav tuvcha kelomar beli gevul umidda ben hattov asher tzafanta lireecha uven asher paalta lachosim bach shehem baale habbittachon shemmibbechinat yamin vechasdam vetuvam hu gam ken bivchinat giluy vehitpashshetut neged bene adam velo bivchinat tzimtzum vehester kelal

Uma shekkatuv lireecha velo bireecha hayenu mishshum shekkal ma shehu bivchinat helem bechal neshama hinne bechina zo enah melubbeshet toch hagguf bemocho velibbo ella hu bivchinat makkif milmala umishsham hi meira lemocho velibbo laittim hatztzerichim lehitorrut bechina zo shettitorer vetair lemocho velibbo kede lavo lide maase befoal mammash

Veamar al ken asher rav tuv levet yisrael hatztzafun vehaggaluy hu bivchinat beli gevul umidda lefi erech nafshotam hamlubbeshet bagguf lachen gam atta titnaheg immahem bemiddat chasdecha haggadol beli gevul vetachlit hannikra rav chesed

Deit chesed veit chesed it chesed olam sheyyesh kenegdo ulummato middat haddin chas veshalom lemaet ultzamtzem chasdo vetuvo aval chesed elon hannikra rav chesed en kenegdo middat haddin lemaet ultzamtzem rov chasdo millehitpashshet beli gevul vetachlit ki hu nimshach mibbechinat sovev kal almin utmira dechal temirin hannikra keter elon vezehu shekkatuv tastirem beseter panecha vego titzpenem besukka vego
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 14: Leorer et haahava hayeshana vechibbat eretz hakkodesh lihot boeret kerishpe esh mikkerev ish velev amok keillu hayyom mammash natan rucho alenu ruach nediva behitnaddev am lemallot yadam la beyad melea urchava beribuy achar ribuy midde shana beshana holech veole lemala rosh kemiddat kodesh haelon hammeir leeretz hakkodesh hammitchaddesh umitrabbe tamid kedichtiv tamid ene elohecha bah mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana
Dehay vead acharit chu eno muvan lichora shehare beacharit shana zo matchelet shana sheniyya veim ken hava-leh-lememar leolam vaed

Ach hainyan yuvan al pi ma shekkatuv bechachma yasad aretz sheyesod haaretz haelona hi bechinat memalle kal almin vehattachtona hi eretz chefetz hamchuvenet kenegdah mammash venikret al shemah eretz hachayyim hinne hu nimshach mehamshachat vehearat chachma ilaa mekor hachayyim haelonim kedichtiv hachachma techayye vealeha vechu

Veheara vehamshacha zo hi mitchaddeshet beor chadash mammash bechal shana veshana ki hu yitbarech vechachmato echad betachlit hayyichud venikra beshem or-en-sof baruch-hu sheen sof veen ketz lemaalat ugdullat haor vehachayyut hannimshach mimmennu yitbarech umechachmato beiluy achar iluy ad en ketz vetachlit lerum hammaalot lemala mala

Uvchal shana veshana yored umeir mechachma ilaa or chadash umchuddash shello haya meir adayin meolam laaretz haelona ki or kal shana veshana mistallek lesharsho bechal erev rosh-hashshana keshehachodesh mitkasse bo veachar kach al-yede tekiat shofar vehattefillot nimshach or chadash elon mibbechina elona yoter shebbemadregat chachma ilaa lehair laaretz elona veladdarim aleha hem kal haolamot haelonim vehattachtonim hamkabbelim chayyutam mimmenna dehayenu min haor-en-sof baruch-hu vechachmato hamlubbash bah kedichtiv ki immecha mekor chayyim beorcha nire or dehayenu or hammeir mechachma ilaa mekor hachayyim vechannoda leode chen shebbechal rosh-hashshana hi hannesira umkabbelet mochin chadashim elonim yoter chu
Uvifrate peratiyyut ken hu bechal yom vaom nimshachin mochin elonim yoter bechal tefillat hashshachar veenan mochin harishonim shennistalleku achar hattefilla rak gevohin yoter
Vederech kelal bichlalut haolam beshit alfe shenin ken hu bechal rosh-hashshana verosh-hashshana
Vezehu shekkatuv tamid ene elohecha bah shehaenayim hem kinuyim lehamshachat vehearat or hachachma shellachen nikreu chachamim ene haeda vaavira deeretz yisrael machkim

Veheara vehamshacha zo af shehi temidit af-al-pi-chen enah bivchina umadrega achat levaddah mime olam ella shebbechal shana veshana hu or chadash elon ki haor shennitchaddesh veheir berosh-hashshana ze hu mistallek beerev rosh-hashshana habbaa lesharsho vezehu shekkatuv mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana levaddah

Velachen ketiv mereshit chaser romez al histallekut haor shemmistallek belel rosh-hashshana ad achar hattekiot sheyyored or chadash elon yoter shello haya meir adayin mime olam or elon kaze vehu mitlabbesh umistatter beeretz hachayyim shellemala veshellematta lehachaot et kal haolamot kal meshech shana zo
Ach giluo mehahester hazze taluy bemaase hattachtonim uzchutam utshuvatam baaseret yeme teshuva veday lammevin
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 15: Lehavin mashal umlitza divre chachamim vechidotam beinyan hassefirot mudaat zot baaretz mippi kedoshe elon nishmatam eden

Lekarev ketzat el hassechel may dichtiv umibbesari echeze eloha shehakkavana hi lehavin ketzat elohuto yitbarech minnefesh hamlubbeshet bivsar haadam veal pi maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk barchi nafshi vego ma hakkadosh-baruch-hu chu af hanneshama chu veal pi maamar hazzohar al pasuk vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim man denafach mittocheh nafach vaafilu nefesh daasiyya hi baa mizziuug zeer anpin venukva daasiyya vehammochin shellahem shehem bechinat chayya unshama dizer anpin venukva shehen hen achorayim dechelim dizer anpin venukva daatzilut shehem elohut mammash shebbetocham meir or-en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash veganuz bechachma daatzilut deihu vegarmohi chad baatzilut

Veal ken gam benishmat haadam meir or-en-sof baruch-hu melubbash veganuz beor hachachma shebbah lehachaot et haadam umimmenna yuchal haadam lehavin ketzat bisfirot haelonot shekkullan meirot benishmato hakkelula mehen

Ach tzarich lehakdim ma sheshshamati mimmori alav-hashshalom al pasuk veanochi afar vaefer sheamar avraham avinu alav-hashshalom al hearat nishmato hammeira begufo meor chesed elon vehi middato middat ahava rabba shebbah haya shehaya ohev et hakkadosh-baruch-hu ahava gedola veelona kal kach ad shennaasa merkava lehakkadosh-baruch-hu

Vesalka datach amina shebbechinat chesed veahava shellemala bassefirot haelonot hi meen vesug mahut middat ahava rabba shel avraham avinu alav-hashshalom rak shehi gedola veniflaa mimmenna lemala mala ad en ketz vetachlit kannoda mimmiddot haelonot sheen lahem ketz sof vetachlit mitztzad atzman ki or-en-sof baruch-hu meir umlubbash betocham mammash veihu vegarmohi chad ma sheen ken benishmat haadam hamlubbeshet bachomer sheyyesh lemiddoteha ketz ugvul aval mikkal makom salka datach amina shemmiddoteha hen meen vesug middot haelonot

Velaze amar veanochi afar vaefer dichmo shehaefer hu mahuto veatzmuto shel haetz hannisraf shehaya murkav mid yesodot esh ruach mayim afar veg yesodot esh mayim ruach chalfu vehalchu lahem vechalu beashan hammithave meharkavatan kannoda visod had shehaya baetz shehu heafar shebbo hayyored lematta veen haesh sholetet bo hu hannishar kayyam vehu haefer

Vehinne kal mahut haetz umammasho vechumro vetzurato beorech verochav veovi shehaya nire laayin kodem shennisraf ikaro haya misod heafar shebbo rak sheesh mayim ruach kelulim bo ki heafar hu chumri yoter mikkullan veyesh lo orech verochav veovi ma sheen ken beesh veruach vegam hammayim hem meat mizzeer baetz vechal arko verachbo veovo hakkol haya min heafar vehakkol shav el heafar shehu haefer hannishar achare shennifredu mimmennu esh mayim ruch

Vehinne kemo shehaefer en lo dimon veerech el mahut haetz haggadol beorech verochav veovi kodem shennisraf lo bechammuto velo beechuto af shehu hu mahuto veatzmuto umimmennu nithava kach al derech mashal amar avraham avinu alav-hashshalom al middato middat hachesed vehaahava hammeira bo umlubbeshet begufo deaf shehi hi middat haahava vechesed haelon shebbaatzilut hammeir benishmato shehayeta merkava elona af-al-pi-chen beridtah lematta lehitlabbesh begufo al-yede hishtalshelut haolamot mimmadrega lemadrega al-yede tzimtzumim rabbim en dimon veerech mahut or haahava hammeir bo el mahut or ahava vechesed elon shebbaatzilut ella keerech vedimon mahut heafar shennaasa efer el mahuto veechuto keshehaya etz nechmad lemare vetov lemaachal al derech mashal veoter mizze lehavdil baalafim havdalot rak sheddibbera tora kilshon bene adam bemashal umlitza

Vehinne kelalut hay sefirot shebbenishmat haadam noda lakkol bederech kelal shehammiddot nechlakot bederech kelal lez middot vechal perate hammiddot shebbaadam baot meachat miz middot ellu shehen shoresh kal hammiddot uchlalutan shehen middat hachesed lehashpia beli gevul umiddat haggevura letzamtzem millehashpia kal kach o shello lehashpia kal ikar kelal umiddat harachamim lerachem al mi sheshshayyach leshon rachamanut alav vehi midda memutztzaat ben gevura lechesed shehi lehashpia lakkol gam lemi shello shayyach leshon rachamanut alav kelal mippene sheeno chaser kelum veeno sharuy betzaar kelal

Ulfi shehi midda memutztzaat nikret tiferet kemo bigde tiferet al derech mashal shehu beged tzavua bigvanim harbe meoravim bo bederech shehu tiferet venoy ma sheen ken beged hatztzavua begaven echad lo shayyach bo leshon tiferet

Veachar kach bevo hahashpaa lide maase dehayenu bishat hahashpaa mammash tzarich lehityaetz ech lehashpia bederech sheyyuchal hamkabbel lekabbel hahashpaa kegon sherotze lehashpia devar chachma lelammedah livno im yomrenna lo kullah kemo shehi besichlo lo yuchal habben lehavin ulkabbel rak shetztzarich lesadder lo beseder veinyan acher davar davur al ofnav meat meat

Uvchinat etza zo nikret netzach vehod shehen kelaot yoatzot vegam vehen teren bein hamvashshelim hazzera shehi hattippa hannimshechet mehammoach dehayenu devar chachma vasechel hannimshach missechel haav shello yumshach kemo shehu sechel dak meod bemocho vesichlo rak yishtanne ketzat middakkut sichlo veyithave sechel sheeno dak kal kach kede sheyyuchal habben lekabbel bemocho vahavanato vehu mammash al derech mashal ketippa hayyoredet mehammoach shehi dakka meod meod venaaset gassa vechumrit mammash bakkelaot utren bein

Vegam netzach vehod nikraim shechakim verechayim sheshshochakim man latztzaddikim kemo hattochen chittim barechayim al derech mashal shemmefarer hachittim lachalakim dakkim meod kach tzarich haav lehaktin hassechel udvar chachma sherotze lehashpia livno ulchallekam lachalakim rabbim velomar lo meat meat bemoetzot vadaat

Vegam bichlal bechinat netzach hu lenatztzeach velaamod neged kal monea hahashpaa vehallimud mibbeno mibbayit umichutz mibbayit hayenu lehitchazzek neged middat haggevura vehatztzimtzum shebbaav atzmo shehi meoreret dinim birtzono al beno lomar sheeno rauy lechach adayin chaser

Uvchinat yesod hi al derech mashal hahitkashsherut shemmekashsher haav sichlo besechel beno bishat limmudo immo beahava veratzon sherotze sheyyavin beno uvilade ze gam im haya habben shomea dibburim ellu atzmam mippi aviv shemmedabber baado velomed leatzmo lo haya mevin kal kach kemo achshav sheaviv mekashsher sichlo elav umdabber immo panim el panim beahava vacheshek shechoshek meod sheyyavin beno

Vechal ma shehacheshek vehattaanug gadol kach hahashpaa vehallimud gadol shehabben yuchal lekabbel yoter vehaav mashpia yoter ki al-yede hacheshek vehattaanug mitrabbe umitgaddel sichlo beharchavat haddaat lehashpia ullammed livno uchmo al derech mashal begashmiyyut mammash ribbuy hazzera hu merov hacheshek vehattaanug veal-yede ze mamshich harbe mehammoach velachen himshilu chachme haemet leziuug gashmi kemo sheyyitbaer

Vehinne middot ellu hen bechinot chitzoniyyot shebbannefesh uvtochan melubbashot middot penimiyyot shehen bechinot ahava veyira chu dehayenu al derech mashal baav hammashpia livno mechamat ahavato umonea hashpaato mippachdo veyirato shello yavo lide michshol chas veshalom

Umkor veshoresh middot ellu happenimiyyot vehachitzoniyyot hu mechachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho ki lefi sechel haadam kach hen middotav kannire bechush shehakkatan shehachachma-bina-daat shello hen bivchinat katnut kach kal middotav hen bidvarim ketanne haerech
Vegam bigdolim lefi sichlo yehullal ish ki lefi rov chachmato kach hu rov ahavato vechasdo vechen shear kal middotav penimiyyot vechitzoniyyot mekoran hu mechachma-bina-daat shebbo
Vehaikar hu haddaat shebbo hannimshach mibbechinat hachachma uvina shebbo kannire bechush ki lefi shinuy deot bene adam ze mizze kach hu shinuy middotehem

Vehinne kal ze hu rak al derech mashal levad ki kal ze hu bannefesh hassichlit hattachtona shebbaadam habbaa mikkelipat nogah ach beemet laamito bannefesh haelona haelohit shehi chelek eloha mimmaal kal hammiddot penimiyyot vechitzoniyyot hen la levaddo
Ki mechamat ahavat umerov cheftzo ledavka vo hu chafetz chesed kede lidavek bemiddotav kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al pasuk uldavka vo hiddavek bemiddotav

Vechen bemiddat haggevura lehippara min harshaim ulansham beonshe hattora vechen lehitgabber al yitzro ulkaddesh et atzmo bammuttar lo velaasot gader usyag lattora mippene pachad veyirato pen yavo lide chet chas veshalom
Vechen lefaer et vetorato bechal mine peer uldavka bishvachav bechal bechinot nafsho dehayenu behitbonnut sichlo umachashavto gam bediburo
Vechen laamod benitztzachon neged kal monea meavodat umilledavka vo veneged kal monea millihot kevod male et kal haaretz kemilchamot asher nilcham david hammelech alav-hashshalom

Vechen lehishtachaot ulhodot la asher mechayye umhave et hakkol vehakkol batel bimtziut etzlo vechulla kammeh kela chashiv uchayin vaefes mammash veaf sheen anu massigim ech hu hakkol efes mammash kammeh af-al-pi-chen modim anachnu behodaa amitit shekken hu beemet laamito

Uvichlal ze gam ken lehodot la al kal hattovot asher gemalanu velo lihot kefuy tova chas veshalom uvichlal ze lehodot al kal shevachav umiddotav ufullotav baatzilut uvriat elonim vetachtonim shehem meshubbachim ad en tachlit cheker venaim uruyim elav yitbarech veyitalle vehu milleshon hod vehadar
Vechen bemiddat tzaddik yesod olam lihot nafsho keshura ba chayye hachayyim uldavka vo bidvika vachashika becheshek vetaanug nifla
Uvmiddat malchut lekabbel alav ol malchuto vaavodato kaavodat kal eved laadono beema uvyira

Umkor veshoresh kal hammiddot hen mechachma-bina-daat dehayenu hachachma hi mekor hassechel hammassig et vechachmato ugdullato umiddotav hakkedoshot shemmanhig umchayye bahen kal haolamot elonim vetachtonim uvina hi hahitbonnut behassaga zo beorech verochav veomek binato lehavin davar mittoch davar ulholid mehassaga zo toldoteha shehen middot ahava veyira ushare middot hannoladot bannefesh haelohit hammaskelet umitbonenet bigdullat ki ligdullato en cheker

Veyesh bechinat gedullat sheal-yede hitbonnut hannefesh haelohit bah tippol aleha emata vafachad shehi yira tattaa shehi bechinat malchut veyesh bechinat gedullat shemmimmenna baa yira ilaa yira boshet veyesh bechina shemmimmenna baa ahava rabba veyesh bechina shemmimmenna baa ahava zuta vechen bammiddot hachitzoniyyot shehen chesed chu

Uvchullan tzarich lihot melubbash bahen bechinat haddaat shehu bechinat hitkashsherut hannefesh hakkeshura utkua behassaga zo shemmasseget eze inyan miggedullat shemmimmenna nolda bah eze midda mehammiddot ki behesach haddaat kerega mehassaga zo mistalleket gam ken hammidda hannolda mimmenna mehaggiluy bannefesh el hahelem lihot bah bechoach velo befoal
Velachen nikra hazziuug bilshon daat mippene shehu leshon hitkashsherut vezehu bechinat daat tachton haddaat hattachton hammitpashshet bammiddot umitlabbesh bahen lehachaotan ulkayeman

Veyesh bechinat daat haelon shehu bechinat hitkashsherut vechibur mekor hassechel hammassig omek hammussag shehu kinkudda uchvarak hammavrik al sichlo sheyyitpashshet lematta veyavo omek hammussag lide havana beharchavat habbeur beorech verochav shehi bechinat bina hannikret rechovot hannahar kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 16: Ahuvay achay vereay asher kenafshi hinne lo nelam mimmenni tzok haittim asher nitdaldela happarnasa uvifrat hayeduim li mimmachanechem asher mata yadam beli shum mashen umashena umammash lovim veochlim yerachem alehem veyarchiv lahem batztzar bekarov

Veim kal ze lo tov hem osim lenafsham lefi hannishma asher kaftzu yadam happetucha meodam ad hayyom hazze liten beyad melea veayin yafa lechal hitztarchut hahechrechiyim lede machsore haevonim nekiyyim asher enehem nesuot elenu veim anu lo nerachem alehem chas veshalom mi yerachem alehem veche achicha immach ketiv

Velo amru chayyecha kodmin ella keshebbeyad echad kiton shel mayim vechu shehu davar hashshave lishnehem beshave lishtot lehashiv nafsham batztzama aval im heani tzarich lechem lefi hattaf veetzim uchsut bakkara uchhay gavena kal devarim ellu kodmin lechal malbushe chavod vezevach mishpacha basar vedagim vechal matammim shel haadam vechal bene veto velo shayyach baze chayyecha kodmin meachar sheenan chayye nefesh mammash kemo shel heani shave beshave mammash kidita bindarim daf

Vehinne zehu al pi shurat haddin gamur aval beemet gam im hu inyan delo shayyach kal kach hay taama rauy lechal adam shello ledakdek lehaamid al haddin rak lidchok chayyav velikanes lifnay velifnim mishshurat haddin velidog leatzmo mimmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shekkal hamdakdek bechach sof ba lide chach chas veshalom

Vegam ki kullanu tzerichim lerachame shamayim bechal et beitaruta diltatta daveka bechal et uvchal shaa leorer rachamenu al hatztzerichim lerachamim vechal hamammetz levavo vechovesh rachamav yihye meeze taam sheyyihye gorem kach lemala lichbosh vechu chas veshalom

Uma gam ki adam en tzaddik baaretz asher yaase tov tamid velo yecheta vehatztzedaka mechapperet umgina min happuranut vechu velazot hi refuat hagguf venefesh mammash asher or bead or vechol asher laish yitten bead nafsho

Besheggam anu maaminim bene maaminim ki hatztzedaka enah rak halvaa lehakkadosh-baruch-hu kedichtiv malve chonen dal ugmulo yeshallem lo bechiflayim baolam hazze dischar kal hammitzot leka baolam hazze levad mitztzedaka lefi shehu tov labberiyyot kidita bekiddushin sof perek kamma
Vegam yesh lachush leonesh chas veshalom keshechaverav nimnim lidvar mitzva vehu lo nimne immahem kannoda mimmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha
Velashshomim yunam vetavo alehem birkat tov bechal mile demetav hetiva lattovim visharim kenafsham venefesh haddoresh shelomam mikkal lev vanefesh
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 17: Noda divitaruta diltatta shehaadam meorer belibbo middat hachesed verachamanut al kal hatztzerichim lerachamim itaruta dilela leorer alav rachamim rabbim mimmekor harachamim lehashpia lo happerot baolam hazze vehakkeren laolam-habba

Perush happerot hi hashpaa hannishpaat mimmekor harachamim vechayye hachayyim baruch-hu venimshechet lematta matta bivchinat hishtalshelut haolamot milmala lematta chu ad shemmitlabbeshet baolam hazze haggashmi bevane chayye umzone
Vehakkeren hu kemo shekkatuv rechava mitzvatcha meod vahava-leh-lememar mitzotecha leshon rabbim vegam leshon rechava eno muvan

Ella mitzvatcha dayeka hi mitzvat hatztzedaka shehi mitzvat mammash ma shehakkadosh-baruch-hu bichvodo uvatzmo ose tamid lehachaot haolamot veyaase leatid beyeter seet vaoz uchmo shekkatuv veshamru derech laasot tzedaka chu kemo derech sheholchim bah meir leir al derech mashal kach hatztzedaka hi bechinat giluy vehearat or-en-sof baruch-hu sovev kal almin sheyyair veyitgalle ad olam hazze beitaruta diltatta betorat tzedaka vechesed chinnam leatid bitchiyyat hammetim beyeter seet veyeter oz leen ketz mibbechinat giluy heara haheara began eden hattachton vehaelon shehare kal nishmot hatztzaddikim vehattannaim vehanneviim shehem atta began eden haelon berum hammaalot yitlabbeshu begufotehem leatid veyakumu bizman hattechiyya lehanot mizziv hashshechina

Lefi shehaheara vehaggiluy shebbegan eden hi bechinat memalle kal almin shehu bechinat hishtalshelut mimmadrega lemadrega al-yede tzimtzumim atzumim uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha beud nivra olam-habba vehi bechinat chachma ilaa hannikret eden haelon hammishtalshelet umitlabbeshet bechal haolamot kemo shekkatuv kullam bechachma asita chu vehachachma techayye chu uvgan eden hi bivchinat giluy hahassaga lechal chad lefum shiura dileh kannoda sheoneg hanneshamot began eden hu mehassagat sodot hattora sheasak baolam hazze bannigle kidita bazzohar hakkadosh parashat shelach uvaggemara beuvda derabba bar nachmani

Aval giluy haheara shebbitchiyyat hammetim yihye mibbechinat sovev kal almin sheenah bivchinat tzimtzum veshiur ugvul ela beli gevul vetachlit kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim perek beur inyan sovev kal almin sheeno kemashmao kemo igul chas veshalom ella sheeno bivchinat hitlabbeshut vechu veayyen sham hetev

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha veatrotehem berashehem venehenin chu atara hi bechinat makkif vesovev venikra keter milleshon koteret vehu bechinat memutztza hamchabber hearat hammaatzil en-sof baruch-hu lehanneetzalim veleatid yair veyitgalle baolam hazze lechal hatztzaddikim sheyyakumu battechiyya veammech kullam tzaddikim chu

Veze sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha atidim tzaddikim sheyyomru lifnehem kadosh ki kadosh hu bechinat muvdal sheeno begeder hassaga vadaat ki hu lemala mala mibbechinat hachachma vadaat shebbegan eden ki hachachma meayin timmatze ketiv hu bechinat keter elon hannikra ayin bazzohar hakkadosh vehashpaato vehearato bivchinat giluy hu daveka keshehanneshama titlabbesh beguf zach vetzach achar hattechiyya ki nautz techillatan besofan daveka vesof maase bemachashava techilla chu kannoda
Ach i efshar lehaggia lemadrega zo ad sheyehe began eden techilla lehassig bechinat chachma ilaa chu kal chad kefum shiura dileh vetal tora mechayyehu vahakitzota hi tesichecha chu veday lammevin

Vezehu rechava mitzvatcha meod hi mitzvat hatztzedaka shehi keli veshetach rachav meod lehitlabbesh bah hearat or-en-sof baruch-hu uchmo shekkatuv levusho tzedaka asher yair leatid bivchinat beli gevul vetachlit bechesed chinnam beitaruta diltatta zo hannikret derech vezehu leshon meod shehu beli gevul vetachlit

Aval lechal tichla raiti ketz tichla hi milleshon kelot hannefesh shebbegan eden shehi bivchinat ketz vetachlit vetzimtzum kannizkar leel ulchal tichla hu lefi sheyyesh kamma vechamma maalot umadregot gan eden ze lemala mizze ad rum hammaalot kemo shekkatuv belikkute hashshas mehaarizal beferush maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha talmide chachamim en lahem menucha chu sheolim tamid mimmadrega lemadrega behassagat hattora sheen lah sof chu ad achar hattechiyya sheyyihye lahem menucha chu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 18: Ketiv ma yafit uma naamte ahava battaanugim

Hinne mine ahavot hen haachat ahava battaanugim dehayenu shemmitanneg al oneg nifla besimcha rabba vaatzuma simchat hannefesh uchlotah betaamah ki tov venaim neimut arevut ad lehafli meen olam-habba mammash shennehenin chu veal ze ketiv simchu tzaddikim ba velo kal adam zoche laze

Vezo hi bechinat kahana biruta delibba shebbazzohar hakkadosh veal ze neemar avodat mattana vego vehazzar hakkarev vego ki en derech lehassigah al-yede yegiat basar kemo hayyira sheshshoalin aleha yagata beyira veoy levasar shello nityagea beyira kemo shekkatuv bereshit chachma uchtiv beyira im tevakshenna chakkasef vego melammed shetztzericha yegia rabba vaatzuma kimchappes achar otzarot

Aval ahava rabba zo ahava battaanugim nofelet laadam meeleha milmala beli sheyyachin vichaven lah ach verak achar shennityagea beyirat harommut vehiggia letachlit ma sheyyuchal lehassig mimmenna lefi bechinat nishmato azay mimmela baa haahava battaanugim milmala lishkon ulhityached im hayyira ki darko shel ish lechazzer chu kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim

Vehashshenit hi ahava vetaava shehannefesh mitava veohevet vachafetza ledavka ba litzror bitzror hachayyim vekirvat elohim tov lah meod uvo tachpotz vera lah meod lehitrachek mimmennu yitbarech chas veshalom lihot mechitza shel barzel mehachitzonim mafseket chas veshalom
Veahava zo hi musteret belev kelal yisrael afilu birshaim umimmenna baa lahem hacharata
Ach mippene shehi musteret venelama bivchinat galut bagguf hare hakkelipa yechola lishlot aleha vezehu ruach shetut hammachati laadam

Veal ken avodat haadam lekono hi lehitchazzek ulhitgabber al hakkelipa bakkol mikkol kol dehayenu mittechilla legarshah mehagguf legamre mimmachashava dibbur umaase shebbemoach velashon veramach evarim veachar kach yuchal gam ken lehotzi mimmasger assir bechozek yad dehayenu lihot chazak veammitz libbo baggibborim lihot haahava hamsutteret niglet begiluy rav bechal kochot chelke hannefesh shebbagguf dehayenu haikar besechel uvmachashava shebbammoach shehassechel yachshov veyitbonen tamid kefi sichlo vehaskalato babbore yitbarech ech shehu chayye hachayyim bichlal vechayye nishmato bifrat

Veal ken yichsof veyitave lihot davuk bo vekarov elav kosef tivi keven hakkosef lihot tamid etzel aviv uchmo esh haola lemala tamid betivah limkorah vechal ma sheyyatmid lachashov besichlo kosef ze kacha yitgabber veyitpashshet kosef ze gam befiv uvchal evarav laasok betora umitzot ledavka vahem ba mammash deorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad
Veal kosef ze shebbegiluy rav ketiv tzama nafshi vego keadam hatztzame lemayim veen lo taanug adayin kelal

Vegam al kosef ze veahava zo hamusteret banu anu matirim la lihot beezrenu lehotziah mimmasger vesheyyihye hallev male mimmenna levaddah velo tikkanes tzaratah bevetah shehi taavat olam hazze rak shettihye hi akeret habbayit limshol betzaratah ulgarshah hachutza mimmachashava dibbur umaase al kal panim hagam shello yuchal leshallechah legamre millibbo al kal panim tihye hi musteret bivchinat galut veavdut laakeret habbayit gevirtah lehishtammesh bah lidvarim hechrechim lah levad kaachila ushtiyya kedichtiv bechal derachecha daehu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 19: Ote or kassalma vego hinne belikkute tora shel haarizal parashat ki tissa ufarashat vayyikra katav ki hassagat moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom lo hayeta bivchinat penimiyyut dechachma ilaa hannikra abba daatzilut vechal shekken bisfirat hakketer shellemala mimmenna hannikra arich anpin ki im bivchinat achorayim dechachma hammitlabbeshim bevina hammitlabbeshet bez sefirot tachtonot shennikraim zeer anpin sod hattora umitpashshetet ad sof sefirot hattachtonot shehen netzach-hod-yesod-malchut vesham hayeta hassagat nevuato bivchinat penimiyyut dehayenu mibbechinat penimiyyut denetzach-hod-yesod-malchut

Aval lemala minnetzach-hod-yesod-malchut lo hayeta lo shum hassaga bifnimiyyut ki im bivchinat achorayim dechachma hamlubbashim bevina hamlubbeshet umitpashshetet toch penimiyyut denetzach-hod-yesod-malchut besod novlot chachma shellemala tora shehi bivchinat zeer anpin uchdichtiv veraita et achoray ufanay lo yerau ayyen sham uvshaar hannevua perek

Velichora yesh lehafli hare neemar velo kam navi od beyisrael kemoshe veech hissig haarizal yoter mimmennu vedarash kamma derushim bivchinat penimiyyut afilu bisfirot umadregot rabbot shellemala mehachachma vecheter daatzilut

Ach hainyan hu pashut umuvan lakkol sheyyesh hefresh gadol ben hassagat chachme haemet kerashbi vehaarizal shehi hassagat chachma vadaat uven hassagat moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom ushar hanneviim binvua hamchunna bakkatuv beshem reiyya mammash veraita et achoray vaere et vayyera elav

Veaf shezzehu derech mashal veenah reiyyat en basar gashmi mammash mikkal makom hannimshal tzarich lihot dome lammashal uchtargum vayyera elav veitgeli leh vechu shehu bechinat hitgallut shennigla elav hannelam baruch-hu bivchinat hitgallut ma sheen ken behassagat chachme haemet shello nigla alehem havaya bivchinat hitgallut rak shehem massigim taalumot chachma hannelam bannelam umufla mehem

Velachen amru chacham adif minnavi sheyyachol lehassig bechachmato lemala mala mimmadregot sheyyuchlu lered lematta bivchinat hitgallut linviim bemare nevuatam ki lo yuchlu lered ulhitgallot alehem rak madregot hattachtonot shehen netzach-hod-yesod-malchut shehen hen hayyordot tamid umitgallot mehammashpia lehamkabbel bivchinat mochin vechayyut kayyadua leode chen shehannetzach-hod-yesod-malchut shel haelon mitlabbeshim battachton lehachaoto shehen hen kele hahashpaa vehoradat hachayyut mehaelon lattachton bechal haolamot vehammadregot velachen gam ken hen hen hammitgallot lanneviim bivchinat hitgallut mammash uvtochan melubbash or habbina shehi bechinat havanat haelohut meor veor en-sof baruch-hu

Uvtochah melubbashim achorayim dechachma shehi madrega shellemala mehassechel vehahavana belohut baruch-hu ki shem chachma more al mekor hassechel vehahavana velachen amru bazzohar deorayeta mechachma nafkat ki taame mitzot lo nitgallu vehem lemala mehassechel vehahavana

Vegam beezehu mekoman shennitgalla venitparesh eze taam hammuvan lanu lichora en ze hattaam hammuvan lanu levaddo tachlit hattaam ugvulo ella betocho melubbash penimiyyut vetaalumot chachma shellemala mehassechel vehahavana

Vechen bechal dibur vedibur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh-baruch-hu lanneviim hakketuvim battora-neviim-ketuvim hen divre tochacha vehen sipure maasiyyot melubbash betocham bechinat chachmat elohut shellemala mehassechel vehahavana kannire bechush meinyan hakkeri vehakketiv ki hakkeri hu lefi hahavana hanniglet lanu vehakketiv hu lemala mehassechel vehahavana shetteva zo kichtivatah en lah levush bivchinat hahavana uvikriatah bappe yesh lah levush
Vechen hainyan beotiyyot gedolot shebbetora neviim uchtuvim shehen mealma ilaa umirot mishsham begiluy beli levush kishar haotiyyot

Vehinne bechinat chachmat elohut baruch-hu hamlubbeshet betaryag mitzot hattora nikret beshem bechinat achorayim dechachma ki kal achorayim shebbassefirot hen madregot hachitzonot vehattachtonot bemaala shebbisfira zo ma sheyyuchlu lered ulhitpashshet lematta lehitlabbesh babberuim lehachaotam uvchinat happanim hi hassefira atzmah hamuchedet bemaatzilah en-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud

Kegon derech mashal sefirat chachma shehi meuchedet bemaatzilah en-sof baruch-hu betachlit hayyichud ki hakkadosh-baruch-hu vechachmato echad kemo shennitbaer leel uma shemmeir umitpashshet mechachmato yitbarech lematta battachtonim shehem baale gevul vetachlit umitlabbesh bahem nikra achorayim venikra gam ken bechinat asiyya shebbaatzilut

Perush al derech mashal kemo shebbaadam hattachton sheyyesh benishmato madregot zo lematta mizzo shehen bechinot hassechel vehammiddot umachashava vedibbur umaase vehammaase hi hattachtona shebbechullam shehachayyut hammitpashshet mehanneshama umlubbash bechoach hammaase hu keayin legabbe hachayyut hammitpashshet mimmenna umlubbash bechoach haddibbur shehu keayin legabbe hachayyut hammitpashshet mimmenna umlubbash bemachashava umiddot vesechel

Ken al derech ze mammash hi bechinat chachmato yitbarech ma sheyyuchal lehitpashshet mimmenna lehashpia lehitlabbesh battachtonim kullam hem keayin legabbe bechinat panim hamuchad bammaatzil baruch-hu dechulla kammeh kela chashiv vehahashpaa lechal hannivraim kullam shehem baale gevul vetachlit nechshevet yerida vetzimtzum kivyachol legabbe hammaatzil en-sof baruch-hu al derech mashal kemo shennechshevet yerida vetzimtzum lesechel haadam hammaskil hamtzumtzam beeze asiyya gashmiyyut vechumrit mammash

Velachen moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom shehissig ad achorayim dechachma zacha shettinnaten al yado hattora shehi novlot chachma shellemala perush ma shennovel mimmenna veored lematta umitlabbesh betora gashmiyyut shellanu sheikarah vetachlitah hu kiyyum hammitzot lo taase vaase befoal umaase mammash kammaamar hayyom laasotam vegadol talmud shemmevi lide maase vehallomed shello laasot noach lo shennehefcha shilyato vechu vechal adam muchrach lehitgalgel ad sheyekayyem kal hattaryag mitzot befoal mammash kannoda mehaarizal
Haotiyyot hanniglot lanu hen bemaase dibbur umachashava
Demaase hen temunat haotiyyot shebbichtav ashuri shebbesefer tora

Veotiyyot haddibbur nechkakot behevel vekol hammitchallek lechv chalakim shonim ze mizze betzuratan shehi havarat umivta hachv otiyyot bechal lashon ki en hefresh ben leshon hakkodesh uven shear leshonot bemahut havarat haotiyyot ki im betzerufan
Veotiyyot hammachashava hen gam ken bechal lashon sheadam mechashshev tevot veotiyyot hallashon shehen levad

Rak shebbemachashava yesh bah mine bechinot otiyyot shehare kesheroe besefer tora temunat haotiyyot hen mitztayerot bemachashavto veze nikra bechinat asiyya shebbemachashava vechen kaasher shomea otiyyot haddibbur hen nirshamot bemachashavto umharher bahen veze nikra bechinat dibbur shebbemachashava uvchinat yetzira veotiyyot hammachashava levaddah beli hirhur otiyyot haddibbur nikraot machashava shebbemachashava bechinat beria
Vehinne otiyyot haddibbur mammash hen mithauot umkabbelot chayyutan meotiyyot ellu atzman shebbemachashava

Veaf shellifamim medabber adam umharher bedavar acher hare eno yachol ledabber ki im otan dibburim vetzerufim shekkevar dibberam vehau bemachashavto peamim rabbot meod venishar bediburim vetzerufim ellu harshimu mehammachashava shennichnesa bahem peamim rabbot
Vezehu bechinat achorayim vechitzoniyyut netzach-hod-yesod mippartzuf haelon shennichnas battachton lihot lo bechinat mochin vechayyut kannoda
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 20: Ihu vechayyohi chad ihu vegarmohi chad behon perush eser sefirot daatzilut chayyohi hen haorot vegarmohi hen hakkelim shekkullan elokut ma sheen ken bivria-yetzira-asiyya chu vetzarich lehavin hetev ech haen-sof chad im garmohi hen hakkelim hare hakkelim hen bivchinat gevul vetachlit kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim
Amnam hakkavana hi lomar shehen elokut livro yesh meayin kemo haen-sof velo bivchinat hishtalshelut ila vealul levad

Uma shekkatav haramak inyan hishtalshelut ila vealul vechen hu bazzohar hakkadosh parashat bereshit hayenu behishtalshelut hassefirot bassefirot atzman bivchinat hakkelim shennikraot beli ma besefer yetzira sheenan bivchinat yesh umahut mussag uchmo haen-sof delet machashava tefisa veh kelal uchmo shekkatuv ufanay lo yerau unvuat moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom vehassagato hayeta mipperek elon denetzach dizer anpin uvhishtalshelut healul hu mukkaf mehaila uvatel bimtziut etzlo keziv hashshemesh bashshemesh kemo shekkatuv bappardes meharamak

Veaf gam tzimtzumim rabbim meod lo yoilu lihot geshem av keafar mehishtalshelut haruchaniyyut missechalim nivdalim afilu shel hammalachim ella lihot ruach habbehema mippene shor kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher veayyen sham

Veyesh meayin nikra beria bilshon hakkodesh vahagam shehayyesh hannivra hu gam ken kela chashiv kammeh dehayenu shebbatel bimtziut legabbe hakkoach vehaor hashshofea bo mehakkelim de sefirot daatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya shehakkav or-en-sof baruch-hu meir bahem uchziv hashshemesh bashshemesh kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim chelek hayenu kammeh daveka shehi yediato yitbarech milmala lematta

Aval bidia shemmimmatta lemala hayyesh hannivra hu davar nifrad legamre bidia vehassaga zo shemmimmatta ki hakkoach hashshofea bo eno mussag kelal uchlal vegam en aroch ze laze kelal uchlal lo mineh velo miktzateh mehaerech shemmehealul el haila shehealul yodea umassig eze hassaga beilato uvatel etzlo al-yede yedia vehassaga zo vegam bemahutam veatzmutam en hefresh gadol kal kach rak shezze ila veze alul velo mineh velo miktzateh mehahefresh shebben mahut hayyesh hannivra lemahut hakkoach vehaor hashshofea bo lehauoto meayin leyesh velachen nikra yesh meayin daveka

Vehinne reshit hayyesh hannivra utchilato hen hakkelim de sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya vegam haorot nefesh-ruach venivreu mibbechinat hanneshama de sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya shehu elokut vehen hallamed kelim demalchut daatzilut vechen baatzilut mechitzoniyyut hakkelim de sefirot daatzilut shehen elokut nivreu hahechalot daatzilut shemmitlabbesh bahen bechinat haigulim de sefirot vegam gufot hammalachim daatzilut shehen bechinat yesh uchmo shekkatuv uvmalachav yasim tahola sheenan bivchinat bitul legamre kealul legabbe ilato

Ach nishmot hammalachim sheyyatzu mizziuug hanneshikin vechen nishmot haadam sheyyatzu mizziuug deza venukva daatzilut kodem sheyyardu livria-yetzira-asiyya enan bichlal yesh vedavar nifrad bifne atzman ella hen meen bechinat elokut betzimtzum atzum uchen hakkelim de sefirot daatzilut shehen bivchinat gevul al-yede tzimtzum or haen-sof hu hakkav hamlubbash benefesh-ruach-neshama shellahem uchmo tzimtzum harishon lihot chalal vechu

Veaf gam leachar sheyyardu hannefesh-ruach-neshama daatzilut laolam hazze latztzaddikim harishonim efshar shello nishtanna mahutan lihot davar nifrad meelokut velachen hau mistallekot kesheratzu lachato beterem yechetu vekarov lomar sheggam haalafim verivvot almin deyatvin begulgalta daarich anpin uzer anpin enan almin mammash keen hahechalot daatzilut uvchinat yesh ella keen nishmot hammalachim sheyyatzu mizziuug hanneshikin venikreu almin legabbe bechinat haggulgalta vedikna
Ach enan elokut mammash livro yesh meayin meachar shekkevar yatzu venifredu mehakkelim de sefirot shebbahen melubbash hakkav meor-en-sof

Shehaor hu keen hammaor hu mahuto veatzmuto shel hammaatzil baruch-hu shemmetziuto hu meatzmuto veeno alul meeze ila shekkadma lo chas veshalom velachen hu levaddo bechocho vichalto livro yesh meayin vaefes hammuchlat mammash beli shum ila vesiba acheret kodemet layyesh hazze

Uchde sheyyihye hayyesh hazze hannivra bechoach haen-sof baal gevul umidda nitlabbesh or-en-sof bechelim de sefirot daatzilut umityached betochan betachlit hayyichud ad deihu vegarmohi chad livro bahen veal yadan beruim baale gevul vetachlit uvifrat al-yede hitlabbeshutan bivria-yetzira-asiyya

Amnam mudaat zot sheikar hithauut hayyesh vedavar nifrad legamre hu mimmalchut daatzilut shennaasa attik divria ki en melech belo am vechu vegam ribuy hannivraim vehitchallekutan shennivreu bechoach haen-sof yachid umuchad betachlit hu al-yede ribuy haotiyyot hayyotzin mimmalchut pi uvruach piv kal tzevaam ve motzaot happe hen me gevurot denukva

Velazot nikret alma deitgalya ki bah nigle koach or-en-sof livro yesh meayin shello al-yede ila vealul aval sefirot harishonot neetzlu behishtalshelut ila vealul veor haen-sof hu melubbash bechachma levaddah vezehu shekkatuv nautz techillatan besofan ki keter hu memutztza ben hammaatzil lanneetzalim veyesh bo bechina haacharona shel haen sof

Velachen nikra keter malchut ki en keter ella lemelech vegam ki bechina acharona deen-sof hi malchut deen-sof velachen gam hammalchut daatzilut nikra keter mimmatta lemala uma gam ki beriat hanneshamot mimmenna lihot yesh vedavar nifrad bifne atzmah beolam habberia venikra beshem leda kikriat yam-suf divattika talya vegam kal gidul hanneshamot kal chodashim mizziuug shel shemini atzeret ad shevii shel pesach hu kemo gidul zeer anpin venukva beveten ima ilaa shehu al-yede orot elonim meima ilaa umilmala lemala ad en-sof hammitlabbesh bah kal o yarche leda vechacha hu bivriat neshamot umalachim leolam habberia

Vegam kal ikar veshoresh hattipa shemmekabbelet umitabberet mizzeer anpin hu mimmochin deabba veima uvchal ziuug nimshechet leabba veima mearich anpin veattik yomin umilmala lemala ad en sof rak shehakkol behelem bemochin ad ledat hannukva hanneshamot vehammalachim vehahechalot leolam habberia nimtza shezzehu giluy or-en-sof mammash al-yede haibur vehalleda

Uvaze yuvan heot hammitzot bemalchut shel shem havaya vehattora bizer anpin vav shel shem havaya hagam shellemala baarich anpin hammitzot hen begulgalta belavnunit hi haurcha divfalguta desaare demitpalga letaryag urchin deorayeta shebbizer anpin veshoresh hattora denafka mechachma ilaa hu bemocha setimaa daarich anpin vehayenu hachachma detaame hammitzot ella shehu kechotam hammithappech

Venautz techillatan besofan hu koach haen-sof baruch-hu livro yesh meayin velo al-yede ila vealul sheyyihye healul mukkaf meilato uvatel bimtziut rak yihye hayyesh davar nifrad meelokut bichde sheyyihye hammaatzil baruch-hu melech al kal hannifradim al-yede sheyekayemu mitzotav sheyetzave alehem vesof maase bemachashava techilla

Velachen amru birushalmi velet leh lerabbi shimon shemmafsik lelulav vechu vechal hallomed shello laasot noach lo shennithappecha shilyato al panav vechu ki hashshilya notzra techilla mehattipa vehi levaddah hayeta ikar havalad ad yom shehitchila tzurat havalad vechacha hammitzot hen ikar hattora vesharshah hagam shehammitzva hi gufanit vehattora hi chachma rak shezze bechitzoniyyut veze bifnimiyyut uchdilkamman

Vehinne kemo chen mizziuug zeer anpin venukva divria-yetzira-asiyya nivreu meayin leyesh kal hannivraim vehannotzarim vehannaasim al-yede or hanneshama shebbetochan shehi elokut mehakkelim de sefirot demalchut daatzilut vegam betochah hearat hakkav deor-en-sof hamlubbash baatzilut ad happarsa vehearat hakkav shehaya meir bakkelim de sefirot demalchut baka happarsa immahem umeir bahem bivria-yetzira-asiyya kemo baatzilut mammash

Vechen gam hakkav beatzmo hamlubbash besiyyum vesof netzach-hod-yesod deadam kadmon shehu sof ragle hayyosher shello hammistayemim bemalchut daasiyya hinne hearat hakkav meira mishsham umitlabbeshet beor hanneshama de sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya shehu elokut veheara deheara mitlabbeshet benefesh-ruach de sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya veaf gam bechal hakkelim shellahem veheara deheara deheara hu bechal hannivraim venotzarim venaasim kemo shekkatuv hayyammim vechal asher bahem veatta mechayye et kullam

Vechal zot bivchinat hitpashshetut hachayyut lehachaotam amnam metziuto umahuto shel or haen-sof eno begeder makom kelal vesovev kal almin beshave veet hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male behashvaa achat velet atar panuy mineh af baaretz hallezu haggashmit rak shehu bivchinat makkif vesovev uchmo shennitbaer happerush belikkute amarim velo hitpashshetut vehitlabbeshut hachayyut lehachaotam ulhauotam meayin leyesh ki im al-yede heara deheara deheara vechu mehakkav kannizkar leel

Vegam meor-en-sof hassovev umakkif learba olamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya beshave meir el hakkav happenimi derech hakkelim de sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya uvhearato toch hakkelim noten bahem koach vaoz livro yesh meayin
Umeachar shehabberia hi al-yede hakkelim lazot hem hannivraim bivchinat ribuy vehitchallekut ugvul vetachlit uvifrat al-yede haotiyyot kannizkar leel

Veod zot yeter al ken al kal hannizkar leel heara deheara deheara vechal hannizkar leel hi mara kochah vichaltah bisod heafar haggashmi begiluy atzum beyeter oz misodot haelonim mimmennu vegam mitztzeva hashshamayim sheen bechocham vichaltam lehotzi yesh meayin tamid kisod heafar hammatzmiach tamid yesh meayin hem asavim veilanot vehammazzal hammakke veomer gedal hayenu leachar shekkevar tzamach haesev veeno omer lo litzmoach meayin leyesh ella mikkoten legodel velaset peri kal min umin bifrate peratiyyut aval beterem yitzmach lemi yomar kal mazzal umazzal lechal esev veesev bifrate peratiyyut mehakkoach hatztzomeach shebbo shehu ayin veruchani vehem gashmiyyim
Veen zot ella mishshum deragle adam kadmon mistayemim betachtit asiyya vetachat raglav meir or-en-sof baruch-hu hassovev kal almin beli hefsek rav benehem rak igule adam kadmon levaddo

Vegam hakkav meor-en-sof hammistayyem besiyyum ragle adam kadmon meir mimmatta lemala bivchinat or chozer kemo shehamlubbash baarich anpin veabba veimma uzer anpin venukva daatzilut meir beor chozer mimmalchut daatzilut umalchut daatzilut hi bechinat keter mimmatta lemala venautz techillatan besofan

Vechacha hu besiyyum hakkav deor-en-sof hammistayyem besiyyum hayyosher deragle adam kadmon meir mimmatta lemala livchinat or hanneshama demalchut demalchut daasiyya shehu elokut mammash mechitzoniyyut hakkelim demalchut daatzilut

Ulfi ma shekkatuv besefer haggilgulim perek huva belikkute amarim mitlabbeshet techilla heara zo shel hakkav deor-en-sof beor haatzilut shebbaasiyya umimmenna livria vitzira shebbaasiyya umehen livchinat or hanneshama demalchut demalchut daasiyya veal-yede ze yesh koach vaoz besiyyum hakkeli demalchut demalchut daasiyya shebbisod heafar vehu maamar tadshe haaretz vechu lihot poel bekerev haaretz tamid leolam vaed

Bechinat en-sof velo bilvad besheshet yeme vereshit kemaamar yishretzu hammayim umaamar totze haaretz nefesh chayya mechachma demalchut demalchut daasiyya shebbez yeme vereshit heir baolam hazze heara meor-en-sof bechesed chinnam beli haalaat mayyin nukvin kelal
Lehatzmiach asavim veilanot uferot meayin leyesh tamid midde shana beshana shehu meen bechinat en-sof sheim yitkayyem olam hazze ribuy rivvot shanim yatzmichu midde shana beshana

Ella sheyyesh mehen al-yede haalaat mayyin nukvin vehem hazzeruim vehannetuim veaf-al-pi-chen hem kemo yesh meayin shehaggarin hannatua en lo erech kelal legabbe happeri vegam neged kal hailan im haanafim vehealin vechen bemine zeronim virakot vegam bemine tevua lehithauot meot garinin miggarin echad hu kemo yesh meayin umikkal shekken hakkashshin vehashshibbolim

Vehinne happerot sheal-yede haalaat mayyin nukvin hi hazzeria vehannetia hem meshubbachim meod meod mehaolim mealehen mikkoach hatztzomeach levaddo shebbaaretz umizze naskil hamshachot orot elonim baatzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya shehu tachlit beriat haadam kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher

Umizze yuvan hetev beinyan seder madregot domem tzomeach chay medabber shehen bechinot afar mayim esh ruach sheaf shehachay hu lemala mehatztzomeach vehamdabber lemala mehachay af-al-pi-chen hachay nizon vechay mehatztzomeach vehamdabber mekabbel chayyuto mishshenehem vegam chachma vadaat sheen hattinok yodea likrot abba veima ad sheyyitom taam dagan chu vaadayin la achilna bisra detora chu ki hu bechinat or chozer mimmatta lemala mittachtit haasiyya shemmitgallet sham beyeter oz heara deheara chu meor-en-sof hassovev kal almin umehakkav or-en-sof shebbesiyyum ragle hayyosher deadam kadmon bivchinat or chozer kannizkar leel

Veuvan hetev baze tuv taam vadaat ma shemmalachim elonim shebbammerkava pene shor ufne nesher nehenim meod venizonim umistappekim meruach habbehema vehaof haola alehem mehakkarbanot sheal gabbe hammizbeach uchdikduk leshon hazzohar hakkadosh veithanyan misoda veikara dilhon

Veachare haddevarim vehaemet haelle daat lenavon nakal lehavin al-yede kal hannizkar leel godel maalat hammitzot maasiyyot asher hen tachlit yeridat hanneshamot laolam hazze haggashmi kemo shekkatuv hayyom laasotam veyafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim baolam hazze mikkal chayye olam-habba
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 21: Achar derishat shelomam kemishpat leohave shemo el hammitnaddevim baam laasot tzidkat im artzo hakkedosha latet midde shana beshana chok hakkatzuv maot eretz hakkodesh tibbane vetikkonen bimhera veyamenu alehem tittof millati vetizzal kattal imrati lezarez lizrizim ulchazzek yadayim rafot bemattan damim maot eretz yisrael midde shabbat beshabbatto ulfachot midde chodesh bechadsho meerko hakkatzuv leerech shana vechal kesef hakkodashim asher ala al lev ish lehitnaddev beli neder lefarnasat achenu yoshve eretz hakkodesh midde shana beshana

Ki hinne millevad hayyadua lakkol godel maalat hazzerizut bechal hammitzot hanneemar venishna bedivre rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha leolam yakdim adam lidvar mitzva chu uzrizuteh deavraham avinu alav-hashshalom hi haomedet laad lanu ulvanenu ad olam

Ki haakeda atzmah enah nechshava kal kach lenissaon gadol leerech maalat avraham avinu alav-hashshalom besheggam ki diber bo kach na et bincha chu vahare kamma vechamma kedoshim shemmasru nafsham al kedushshat gam ki lo diber bam rak sheavraham avinu alav-hashshalom asa zot bizrizut niflaa leharot simchato vecheftzo lemallot retzon kono velaasot nachat ruach leotzro

Umimmennu lamdu rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lekiyyum kal hammitzot bichlal uvifrat maase hatztzedaka haola al kullana hammegina umatztzela beferoteha baolam hazze mikkal mine puraniyyot hammitraggeshot kedichtiv utzdaka tatztzil mimmavet vechal shekken mishshear mine yissurim hakkallim mimmavet kal shekken shettov lanu gam baolam hazze lehakdimah kal ma deefshar shehare adam nidon bechal yom

Ach gam zot matzanu rainu baavodat hatztzedaka maala peratiyyut gedola veniflaa en aroch eleha lihot maase hatztzedaka naaset bifamim rabbot vechal hammarbe hare ze meshubbach velo befaam achat uvvat achat gam ki hassach hakkolel echad hu kemo shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha beferush hammishna sheshshanu chachamim zichronam livracha vehakkol lefi rov hammaase

Vehinne millevad ki harambam zichrono-livracha beer hetev taamo venimuko kede lezakkech hannefesh al-yede ribbuy hammaase hinne mikra male diber hakkatuv peullat tzedaka lechayyim dehayenu sheppeullatah usgullatah lehamshich chayyim elonim mechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu leeretz hachayyim hi shechinat uzzenu shealeha neemar veatta mechayye et kullam vehi sukkat david hannofelet ad afar uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha galu leedom shechina immahem chu ki beitaruta diltatta lehachaot ruach shefalim delet leh miggarmeh kelum itaruta dilela uvifrat behitnaddev am lehachaot yoshve eretz hachayyim mammash veday lammevin

Vechal maskil al davar gadol venifla kaze yimtza tuv taam vadaat kamma gedolim divre chachamim zichronam-livracha sheamru hakkol lefi rov hammaase dehayenu maase hatztzedaka hannaase bifamim rabbot lehamshich chayyim elonim leyached yichud elon peamim rabbot

Vehayenu name keen ma shekkatav harambam lezakkech hannefesh kannoda mizzohar hakkadosh dishchina nikret nefesh ki hi chayyenu venafshenu uchtiv ki shacha leafar nafshenu velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha gedola tzedaka shemmekarevet et haggeulla lahakimah meafar meat meat ad ki yavo shilo
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 22: Ahuvay achay vereay

Meahava mesutteret tochachat megulla lechu na venivachcha zichru yemot olam binu shenot dor vador hehayeta kazot mimot olam veayye efo metzatem minhag ze beechad mikkal sifre chachme yisrael harishonim vehaacharonim lihot minhag vetikun lishol beetza gashmiyyut kedat ma laasot beinyene haolam haggashmi af ligdole chachme yisrael harishonim ketannaim veamoraim asher kal raz lo anes lehu unhirin lehon shevilin derakia ki im linviim mammash asher hau lefanim beyisrael kishmuel haroe asher halach elav shaul lidrosh al devar haatonot shenneevdu leaviv

Ki beemet kal inyene adam levad middivre tora veyirat shamayim enam mussagim rak binvua velo lachachamim lechem kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha hakkol bide shamayim chutz miyyirat shamayim veshiva devarim mechussim chu en adam yodea bame mistakker chu umalchut bet david matay tachazor chu hinne hushu ze laze

Uma shekkatuv bishaya yoetz vachacham charashim vechen ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha venehenin mimmennu etza vetushiyya hayenu bedivre tora hannikra tushiyya kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha yoetz ze sheyyodea leabber shanim velikboa chodashim chu shessod haibur karuy etza vesod bilshon tora kidita besanhedrin daf ayyen sham beferush rashi

Ach haemet aggid lashshomim li ki ahava mekalkelet hashshura vehinne hi kesut enayim shello lirot haemet merov ahavatam lechayye hagguf leshem shamayim laavod bo et berishpe esh veshalhevet gedola meahavat nafsham et veal ken hetev chara lahem betzaar hagguf chas veshalom yerachem veen yecholin lekabbel kelal ad shemmaaviram al datam lechattet raglehem meir leir lishol etzot merachok velo shau el lashuv elav beruach nemucha vehachnaat hagguf lekabbel tochachto beahava ki et asher yeehav vechu

Uchmo av rachaman chacham vetzaddik hammakke beno sheen leven chacham lahafoch oref lanus limtzo lo ezra o afilu melitz yosher lifne aviv harachaman vehatztzaddik vechasid rak lihot yashar yechezu fanemo im aviv panim befanim lisbol hakkaotav beahava letov lo kal hayyamim

Vehinne lemala bechinat panim hu haratzon vehacheshek asher avinu shebbashshamayim mashpia levanav kal tuv olamim vechayye nefesh veguf beahava veratzon chashika vachafitza al-yede torat chayyim shehi retzono yitbarech asher natan lanu kemo sheomrim ki veor panecha natatta lanu torat chayyim chu laasot bah retzono veal ze neemar beor pene melech chayyim urtzono chu
Ma-sheen-ken leovde gillulim mashpia chayye gufam shello beratzon vachashika vachafitza lechach nikraim elohim acherim sheyyonkim mibbechinat achorayim
Vechach hu baadam haratzon vehacheshek hu bechinat panim veim eno mekabbel beahava veratzon keillu hofech oref veachor chas veshalom

Veetza hayeutza lekabbel beahava hi atzat befi chachamenu-zichronam-livracha lefashpesh bemaasav veyimtza lo aonot hatztzerichin meruk yissurim veyire laayin godel ahavato elav hamkalkelet hashshura kimshal melech gadol venora harochetz bichvodo uvatzmo tzoat beno yechido merov ahavato kemo shekkatuv im rachatz tzoat benot tziyyon chu beruach mishpat chu

Vechammayim happanim el panim titorer haahava belev kal maskil umevin yekar mahut ahavat el hattachtonim asher hi yekara vetova mikkal chayye haolamim kullam kemo shekkatuv ma yakar chasdecha vechu ki tov chasdecha mechayyim chu ki hachesed shehu bechinat ahava hu chayye hachayyim shebbechal haolamot kemo sheomrim mechalkel chayyim bechesed

Veaz gam yitten hattov veyaer panav elav bivchinat ahava megulla asher hayeta techilla melubbeshet umsutteret betochacha megulla veyitmatteku haggevurot besharshan veyitbattelu haddinin netzach sela vaed
Ahuvay achay vereay
Miggodel tirdati asher hikkifu alay yachad vesabbuni chammayim kal hayyom vechal hallayela tamid lo yecheshu lo uchal mallet massa lemor im hassefer kal asher bilvavi

Ach biktzara bati kemazkir umachazir al harishonot bichlal uvifrat el hammitnaddevim baam laamod al haavoda zo tefilla bekol ram lehitchazzek meod bechal oz vetaatzumot neged kal monea mibbayit umichutz beyad chazaka kemashmao shehu retzon yereav asher lemala min hachachma vehattevuna asher natan bahemma ladaat laasot et kal asher tziva behaskel vadaat

Rak ratzon pashut veruach nediva bechal ish asher yiddevennu libbo laavod avoda tamma laasot nachat ruach leotzro veal ze neemar ki am keshe oref hu vesalachta ki hasselicha hi gam ken lemala min hachachma ki shaalu lachachma chu umshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom bikesh midda keneged midda veday lammevin

Veod zot edrosh mimmaalatchem shello lehashlich devaray acharechem asher arachti siach lihot kal ish yashar veholech betummo kaasher asa haelokim et haadam yashar velo levakkesh cheshbonot rabbim mealilot mitzade gaver umachshevot adam vetachbulotav ki zo melechet shamayim hi velo melechet basar vadam
Ulhaamin beemuna shelema bemitzvat chachamenu-zichronam-livracha veheve shefal ruach bifne chal adam bichlal ki yatztziva milleta vetakkin pitgama shekkal echad metukkan mechavero

Uchtiv kal ish yisrael keish echad chaverim kemo sheish echad mechubbar meevarim rabbim uvhippardam nogea ballev ki mimmennu totzot chayyim im ken anachnu heot kullanu keish echad mammash tikon haavoda ballev umikkelal hen chu veal ken neemar ulavdo shechem echad daveka

Veal ken ahuvay yediday na vena litroach bechal lev vanefesh litkoa ahavat reehu belibbo veish et raat reehu al tachshevu bilvavchem ketiv velo taale al lev leolam veim taale yehdefenna millibbo kehindof ashan uchmo machashevet avoda-zara mammash
Ki gedola lashon hara keneged avoda-zara vegiluy araot ushfichut damim veim bedibbur kach chu uchvar noda lechal chacham lev yitron hechsher hammachashava al haddibbur hen letov vehen lemutav
Va hattov hamvarech et ammo bashshalom yasim alechem shalom vechayyim ad haolam kenefesh ohev nafsham millev vanefesh
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 23: Bigzerat irin pitgama umaamar kaddishin chachme hammishna alehem-hashshalom sheshshanu bemishnatam asara sheyyoshvin veoskin battora shechina sheruya venehem ki ze kal haadam veaf gam zot hayeta kal yeridato baolam hazze letzorech aliyya zo asher en aliyya lemala hemenna

Ki shechinat uzzo asher begavhe meromim vehashshamayim ushme hashshamayim lo yechalkelu ematah tishkon vetitgaddel betoch bene yisrael kemo shekkatuv ki ani shochen betoch bene yisrael al-yede esek hattora vehammitzot baasara daveka kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha atya toch toch chu veal ze neemar bekirbecha kadosh veen davar shebbikkedushsha befachot measara

Umishshum hache name itzterich lehu lerabbotenu-zichronam-livracha lemelaf mikkera minnayin sheafilu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora chu veaf gam zot lo matzu lo semach min hammikra ella likviat sachar bilvad leyachid lefi erko lefi ulfi erech hamrubbim aval leinyan hashraat kedushshat hakkadosh-baruch-hu en lo erech alehem kelal

Vehahefresh shebben hashraa likviut sachar muvan limvine madda ki keviat sachar hu shemmeir lenefesh tidreshennu beor torato shehu maate levusho mammash velachen nikret hattora or shenneemar ote or kassalma vehannefesh hi baalat gevul vetachlit bechal kochoteha lachen gam or hammeir bah hu gevuli metzumtzam umitlabbesh betochah veal ken yitpael lev mevakshe bishat hattefilla vechayyotze vah ki vo yismach libbam veyagil af gilat verannen vetitanneg nafsham benoam al veoro behiggaloto mimmaate levusho shehi hattora veyatza chabbarak chitztzo vezo hi keviat sechar hattora hakkevua tamid benefesh amela bah

Aval hahashraa hi heara atzuma meor hammeir bah beli gevul vetachlit veeno yachol lehitlabbesh benefesh gevulit ki im makkif aleha milmala meroshah vead raglah kemo sheamru chachamenu-zichronam-livracha akkal be asara shechinta sharya kelomar alehem milmala kemo shekkatuv vihi noam alenu umaase yadenu konna alenu kelomar ki noam asher hofia bemaase yadenu beesek hattora vehammitzot deorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad yitkonen veyishre alenu milmala lihoto beli gevul vetachlit veeno mitlabbesh benafshenu vesichlenu

Veal ken en anu massigim besichlenu hanneimut vehaarevut minnoam veziv hashshechina beli gevul vetachlit asher mitkonen veshore alenu bemaase yadenu betora umitzot barabbim daveka veal ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sechar mitzva behay alma leka ki i efshar laolam lehassigo ki im behitpashshetut hannefesh mehagguf veaf gam zot al derech hachesed kemo shekkatuv ulcha chased ki atta teshallem leish kemaasehu uchmo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shehakkadosh-baruch-hu noten koach batztzaddikim chu

Ma-sheen-ken bammalachim kemo sheshshamati merabbotay ki ilu nimtza malach echad omed bemaamad asara miyyisrael beyachad af sheenam medabberim bedivre tora tippol alav emata vafachad beli gevul vetachlit mishshechinta desharya alayehu ad shehaya mitbattel mimmetziuto legamre

Veal ken ra beenay hammaase asher naasa tachat hashshemesh bichlal uvifrat ben achay vereay hanniggashim el haggasha zo tefilla veachar hattefilla o lefaneha naase moshav letzim rachamana litztzelan kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shenayim sheyyoshvin veen benehem divre tora chu veim naasa moshav letzim baasara dishchinta sharya alayehu en lecha elbona uklana dishchinta gadol mizze rachamana-litzlan veim amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al haover avera basseter sheddochek ragle hashshechina chas veshalom haover avera barabbim dochek kal shiur koma shel yotzer bereshit kivyachol kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en ani vehu vechu ella shemmelech asur barhatim chu

Aval vay leman dedachakin lishchinta kad yokim lah kudsha-berich-hu veyema lah hitnaari meafar kumi vego veal telat milin mitakkeve yisrael begaluta al dedachakin lishchinta veal deavdin kelana bishchinta vechu kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh

Al ken ahuvay achay vereay al na tareu haraa haggedola hazzot utnu chavod la elohechem beterem yechshach dehayenu ben mincha lemaariv kal yemot hachol lilmod baasara penimiyyut hattora shehi aggada shebbesefer en yaakov sherov sodot hattora genuzin bah umchapperet aonotav shel adam kimvoar bechitve haarizal vehanniglot shebbah hen darche sheyyelech bahem haadam veyashit etzot benafsho bemile dishmayya uvmile deilma vechayyadua lechal chachme lev

Vegam lilmod meat beshulchan aruch orach-chayyim halachot hatztzerichot lechal adam veal ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha kal hashshone halachot bechal yom chu shehen halachot berurot ufsukot halacha lemaase kimvoar beferush rashi zichrono livracha sham
