Uvshabbat kodesh baalot hammincha yaasku behilchot shabbat ki hilcheta rabbeta leshabbeta uvkal yachol haadam likashel bah chas veshalom afilu beisur karet uskila mechesron yedia veshiggat talmud ola zadon chas veshalom veen tzarich lomar beisure divre-sofrim sherabbu kemo rabbu lemala uvifrat beisure muktze dishchiche tuva vachamurim divre-sofrim yoter middivre tora kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shekkal haover al divre chachamim afilu beisur kal shel divrehem kemo haochel kodem tefillat arvit uchhay gavena chayyav mita keover al chamurot shebbattora

Vechal yachid al yifrosh atzmo min hatztzibur afilu lilmod inyan acher ki im baddavar shehatztzibur asukin bo veen tzarich lomar shello yetze hachutza im lo yihu asara mibbilado vealav ani kore happasuk veozve yichlu chu kemo sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al kal davar shebbikdushsha ki en kedushsha kikdushshat hattora deorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad
Vechal happoresh min hatztzibur chu veshomea li yishkon betach uvyamav uvyamenu tivasha yehuda virushalayim tishkon lavetach amen ken yehi ratzon
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 24: Ahuvay achay al na tareu reim haahuvim leotzram usnuim leyitzram

Veal yaase adam atzmo rasha shaa achat lifne hammakom asher bachar bah mikkal hayyom lehikkahel velaamod lefanav beshaa zo shehi et ratzon lefanav lehitgallot lavo el hammikdash meat lifkod lishchinat kevodo hashshochen ittam betoch tumotam ulhimmatze ledorshav umvakshav umyachalav

Vehamsapper bitzrachav mare beatzmo sheeno chafetz lehitbonen velirot begiluy kevod malchuto venaase merkava temea lakkesil haelon shenneemar alav lo yachpotz kesil bitvuna chu kemo shekkatvu hazzohar vehaari zichrono livracha dehayenu sheeno chafetz lehitbonen velirot bikar tiferet gedullato shel melech-malche-hammelachim hakkadosh-baruch-hu hanniglot lemala beshaa zo vegam lematta el hachafetzim lehabbit el kevodo vegadlo hammitattef umitlabbesh betoch tevot hattefilla hassedura befi chol umitgalle lechal echad lefi sichlo veshoresh nishmato kedichtiv lefi sichlo yehullal ish yehallel ketiv

Umalchuta derakia keen malchuta deara shedderech hammelech lihot chevon uzzo bechadre chadarim vechamma shomrim al happetachim ad asher kamma vechamma metzappim yamim veshanim lirot uzzo uchvodo uchsheala retzono lehitgallot lakkol veheevir kol bechal malchuto lehikkahel velaamod lefanav leharotam kevod malchuto vikar tiferet gedullato mi sheomed lefanav veeno choshesh liroto umitassek bitzrachav kamma garua vesachal ufeti hu venimshal kabbehemot nidme beene kal habberiyyot

Vegam hu bizon hammelech beharoto lefanav sheeno safun beenav lekabbel nachat veshaashuim mehabbit el kevodo veyafo yoter meesek tzerachav vegam hu mitchayyev benafsho lammelech al harot kelono uvizono et hammelech leen kal roe veal ze neemar uchsilim merim kalon kelomar af shehu kesil lo yihye merim kalon sheyyihye nire hakkalon leen kol

Veal ken kavu chachamenu-zichronam-livracha battefilla keillu omed lifne hammelech al kal panim yihye mare beatzmo keillu omed chu leen kal roe beene vasar el maasav vediburav af sheen lo machashava lakkesil veal ze hainyan nitkan kal hattefillot lammitbonen bahem hetev umi sheeno mare ken mitchayyev benafsho vealav amru bazzohar hakkadosh deanhig kelana betikkuna ilaa veachaze feruda velet leh chulaka beelaha deyisrael rachamana litztzelan

Al ken shelichutayehu derabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ka avidna ligzor gezera shava lechal nefesh shello lasuach sicha betela mishsheyyatchil hashsheliach tzibur lehitpallel hattefilla ad gemar kaddish batra shacharit arvit umincha vechu

Vehaover al ze bezadon yeshev al haaretz vivakkesh mig anashim sheyyattiru lo niduy shellemala veshav verafa lo velo chal alav shum niduy lemafrea kal ikar ki mittechillato lo chal ki im al hammordim vehapposhim sheenam choshshim kelal levakkesh kappara min hashshamayim umin habberiyyot al heaon pelili hazze

Vegam daveka keshemmedabberim bezadon bishat nefesh velo al hashshocheach o shennizreku mippiv kamma tevot belo mitkaven sheeno tzarich hattara kelal uvochen libbot uchlaot elokim tzaddik hetiva lattovim velisharim belibbotam
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 25: Lehavin imre vina ma shekkatuv bassefer hannikra tzavaat rivash hagam shebbeemet enah tzavaato kelal velo tziva kelal lifne fetirato rak hem likkute imrotav hattehorot shellikketu lekute batar lekute velo yadu lechaven hallashon al matkunto ach hamchuvan hu emet laamito

Vehu behakdim maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha kal hakkoes keilu oved akkum vechu vehattaam muvan leode vina lefi shebbeet kaaso nistalleka mimmennu haemuna ki ilu haya maamin shemmeet hayeta zot lo lo haya bechaas kelal

Veaf shebben-adam shehu baal bechira mekallelo o makkehu o mazzik mamono umitchayyev bedine adam uvdine shamayim al roa bechirato af-al-pi-chen al hannizak kevar nigzar min hashshamayim veharbe sheluchim lammakom

Velo od ella afilu beshaa zo mammash shemmakkehu o mekallelo mitlabbesh bo koach veruach piv yitbarech hamchayyehu umkayemo uchmo shekkatuv ki amar lo kallel vehechan amar leshimi ella shemmachashava zo shennafla leshimi belibbo umocho yarda meet veruach piv hamchayye kal tzevaam hecheya rucho shel shimi beshaa sheddiber devarim ellu ledavid ki ilu nistallek ruach piv yitbarech rega echad merucho shel shimi lo yachol ledabber meuma
Vezehu ki amar lo baet hahi mammash kallel et david umi yomar lo vego

Vechannoda ma sheamar habbaal-shem-tov zichrono-livracha al pasuk leolam devarcha nitztzav bashshamayim shetztzeruf otiyyot shennivreu bahen hashshamayim shehu maamar yehi rakia chu hen nitztzavot veomdot melubbashot bashshamayim leolam lehachaotam ulkayemam

Velo kehappilosofim shekkofrim behashgacha feratit umdammin bedimonam hakkozev et maase ose shamayim vaaretz lemaase enosh vetachbulotav ki kaasher yatza latztzoref keli shuv en hakkeli tzarich lide hatztzoref sheaf sheyyadav mesullakot hemennu hu kayyam meatzmo vetach merot enehem hahevdel haggadol shebben maase enosh vetachbulotav shehu yesh miyyesh rak shemmeshanne hatztzura vehattemuna lemaase shamayim vaaretz shehu yesh meayin

Vehu pele gadol yoter mikkeriat yam-suf al derech mashal asher holich beruach kadim azza kal hallayela vayyibbaku hammayim veilu pasak haruach kerega hau hammayim chozrim venigarim bemorad kedarkam vetivam velo kamu kechoma af shetteva ze bammayim hu gam ken nivra umchuddash yesh meayin shehare chomat avanim nitztzevet meatzmah beli ruach rak shetteva hammayim eno chen vechal shekken vekal vachomer bivriat yesh meayin shehi lemala mehatteva vehafle vafele yoter mikkeriat yam-suf al achat kamma vechamma shebbehistallekut chas veshalom koach habbore yesh meayin min hannivra yashuv hannivra leayin vaefes mammash ella tzarich lihot koach happoel bannifal tamid lehachaoto ulkayemo uvchina zo hu devar veruach piv shebbaasara maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam
Vaafilu eretz hallezu haggashmit uvchinat domem shebbah chayyutan vekiyyuman hu devar mi maamarot hamlubbash bahen umkayeman lihot domem veyesh meayin velo yachzeru leayin vaefes mammash keshehau
Vezehu sheamar haarizal sheggam bedomem kaavanim veafar umayim yesh bahem bechinat nefesh vechayyut ruchaniyyit

Vehinne noda leode chen ki devar nikra beshem shechina bilshon rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha veima tattaa umatronita bilshon hazzohar uvifrat beresh parashat vaera lefi sheshshochen umitlabbesh bannivraim lehachaotam
Uvilshon hamkubbalim nikra beshem malchut al shem devar melech shilton ki hammelech manhig malchuto bediburo veod teamim acherim yeduim leode chen
Umudaat zot ki yesh bechinat umadregat malchut daatzilut uvchinat malchut divria vechu

Uferush malchut daatzilut hu devar hamchayye umhave neshamot haggedolot shehen mibbechinat atzilut kemo nishmat adam harishon shenneemar bo vayyippach beappav nishmat chayim chu uchmo nishmot haavot vehanneviim vechayyotze vahen shehau merkava la mammash uvtelim mammash bimtziut elav kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shechina medabberet mittoch gerono shel moshe vechen kal hanneviim uvaale ruach hakkodesh haya kol vedibbur haelon mitlabbesh bekolam vedibburam mammash kemo sheamar haarizal
Umalchut divria hu devar hamchayye umhave hanneshamot vehammalachim shebbeolam habberia sheen maalatam kemaalat haatzilut vechu
Umalchut daasiyya hu devar hamchayye umhave et olam hazze bichlalo ad yesod heafar vehammayim asher mittachat laaretz

Ella shebbechutz laaretz hachayyut hu al-yede hitlabbeshut sarim hachitzonim hammunnim al ummot dehayenu sheyyored nitzotz middevar hannikra beshem malchut daasiyya umeir al hassarim shel mala bivchinat makkif milmala ach eno mitlabbesh bahem mammash ella nimshach lahem chayyut meheara zo shemmeir alehem milmala bivchinat makkif

Umehassarim nishpa chayyut laummot velivhemot chayyot veofot shebbeartzotehem velaaretz haggashmit velashshamayim haggashmiyyim shehem haggalgallim ella sheshshamayim vaaretz uvhemot vechayyot veofot tehorim nishpaim mikkelipat nogah vehattemeim venafshot haummot mishshear kelipot
Vehinne shamayim vaaretz vechal asher bahem bechutz laaretz kullam kela mammash chashive legabbe hassarim shehem chayyutam vekiyyumam

Vehassarim kela mammash chashive legabbe hachayyut hannimshach lahem mehannitzotz middevar hammeir alehem milmala veaf-al-pi-chen hachayyut hannimshach letocham meheara zo hu bivchinat galut betocham shellachen nikraim beshem elokim acherim vekaru leh elaha deelahayya sheggam hem hen bechinat elokut

Velachen haggoyim hannishpaim mehem hem ovde avoda-zara mammash ad et ketz sheyevulla hammavet vehassitra achora veaz ehpoch el ammim chu likro chullam beshem venikra gam ken beshem galut hashshechina meachar shechayyut ze asher bivchinat galut betocham hu meheara hannimshechet lahem mehannitzotz middevar hannikra beshem shechina vegalut ze nimshach mechet etz haddaat veelach vehu bechinat achorayim levad dikdushsha
Ach kesheggalu yisrael leven haummot vaachizat yisrael vesharsham hu bivchinat panim haelonim hinne zo hi galut shelema veal ze amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha galu leedom shechina immahem

Vehinne af ki echad ushmo echad dehayenu dibburo veruach piv hamchunne bazzohar hakkadosh beshem shemo hu yachid umuchad af-al-pi-chen haheara vehamshachat hachayyut hannimshechet meruach piv yitbarech mitchalleket led madregot shonot shehen olamot atzilut beria yetzira asiyya

Vehashshinuy hu mechamat tzimtzumim umasachim rabbim letzamtzem haor vehachayyut ulhastiro shello yehe meir kal kach beolam habberia kemo beolam haatzilut uvolam hayetzira hu al yede tzimtzumim umasachim yoter vechu aval en shum shinuy chas veshalom beatzmut hashshechina shehi devar veruach piv

Vegam bivchinat haheara vehamshachat hachayyut hinne haheara shebbaatzilut bokaat hammasach umitlabbeshet babberia vechen mibberia litzira umitzira laasiyya velachen or-en-sof baruch-hu shebbaatzilut hu gam ken baasiyya uvaolam hazze hachumri al-yede hitlabbeshuto bemalchut divria-yetzira-asiyya kimvoar hakkol bechitve haari zichrono livracha

Vehinne nefesh haadam yadua lakkol shehi kelula mi sefirot chachma bina daat vechu veaf shekkullan meruach piv yitbarech kedichtiv vayyippach beappav chu mikkal makom derech perat chachma-bina-daat shebbenafsho hen dugma lechachma-bina-daat shebbe sefirot hamchunnot beshem abba veimma umiddot ahava veyira vechu shebbenafsho hen dugma lammiddot shebbe sefirot hannikraot beshem zeer anpin vechoach haddibbur shebbenafsho dugma laddibbur haelon hannikra beshem malchut ushchina velachen keshemmedabber divre tora meorer dibbur haelon leyached hashshechina umishshum hache kayema lan bikriat-shema uvirkat hammazon vedivre tora lo yatza behirhur belo dibbur

Vehinne ze leummat ze yesh asara kitre dimsaavuta umehen nimshachot nafshot haummot gam ken kelulot meeser bechinot ellu mammash umudaat zot baaretz ma shekkatuv besefer haggilgulim al pasuk asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo shehu sod galut hashshechina betoch hakkelipot lehachaotam ulhashlitam atta bizman haggalut aval hu lera lo vechu velachen haummot sholtin atta al yisrael lihot nafshot haummot mehakkelipot asher hashshechina mitlabbeshet bivchinat galut betocham vehinne af shezze tzarich beur rachav ech uma mikkal makom haemet ken hu

Ella sheaf-al-pi-chen en hakkelippot vehaummot yonkim umkabbelim chayyut ella meheara hannimshechet lahem mibbechinat achorayim dikdushsha keman deshade batar katfeh veaf gam zot al-yede tzimtzumim umasachim rabbim vaatzumim ad shennitlabbesha heara zo bechumriyyut olam hazze umashpaat laummot osher vechavod vechal taanugim gashmiyyim
Ma-sheen-ken yisrael yonkim mibbechinat panim haelonim kemo shekkatuv yaer panav elecha kal echad veechad lefi shoresh nishmato ad rum hammaalot

Veachar haddevarim vehaemet haelle haggeluyim viduim lakkol nachazor leinyan rishon beinyan hakkaas shehu keoved avoda-zara vehayenu bemile dealma ki hakkol bide shamayim chutz miyyirat shamayim velachen bemile dishmayya leafrushe meisura lo shayyach hay taama daamaran uchmo shekkatuv vayyiktzof moshe vehayenu mishshum ki hikra lefanav mitzva zo leafrushe meisura kede lezakkoto

Ach zehu kesheyyesh beyado limchot bekitzpo vechaaso al chavero aval kesheen beyado limchot kegon nachri hamdabber umvalbelo bitfillato im ken ma zot asa lo en zot ki im kede sheyyitgabber veyitammetz yoter bitfillato beomek hallev uvchavana gedola kal kach ad shello yishma dibbure hannachri
Ach shellemadrega zo tzarich hitorrut rabba vaatzuma

Veetza hayeutza lehitorrut zo hi meinyan ze atzmo kesheyyasim el libbo veyitbonen inyan yeridat hashshechina kivyachol vattered pelaim lehitlabbesh nitzotz mehearatah asher hi bivchinat galut betoch hakkelipot derech kelal lehachaotam veatta happaam nitzotz hearatah mitlabbesh bivchinat galut derech perat bedibbur nachri ze hamdabber devarim hamvalbelim avodat hi kavanat hattefilla uchmo shennitbaer leel ki ze leummat ze vechu vedibbur haelon mitlabbesh baddibbur hattachton vechu vezehu mammash asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo dehayenu sheal yede ze mitorer haadam lehitpallel yoter bechavana meumka delibba ad shello yishma diburav

Uma shekkatav hamlakket sharta lo yada lechaven hallashon bedikduk ki habbaal-shem-tov zichrono livracha haya omer divre tora bilshon idish velo bilshon hakkodesh veratza lomar nitlabbesha vehayenu bivchinat galut vezehu uvifrat im hu nachri chu sheaz hi bechinat galut beoter

Veen litmoha im nitzotz min hearat shechina nikra beshem shechina deha ashkechan sheafilu malach nivra nikra beshem befarashat vayyera leferush haramban uchmo shekkatuv vattikra shem haddover eleha vechu uchhay gavena tuva

Vechimdumme li shettefisatam enah mitztzad dikduk hallashon ella meikar inyan hitlabbeshut hashshechina bakkelipot sheen lahem emuna bema sheamar haarizal besefer haggilgulim sheim yirtzu lechallek ben kelipot haruchaniyyim leovde gillulim haggashmiyyim en lecha gashmi kaafar haaretz veaf-al-pi-chen mitlabbeshet bo malchut demalchut daasiyya uvtochah malchut ditzira chu vechannizkar leel veim mishshum tumat nafshot hannachrim hare nafshotehem mizziuug zeer anpin venukva diklipot haruchaniyyim kemo shekkatuv bechitve haarizal nimtza sheharuchaniyyim mekor tumatam

Ach beemet tzarich beur rachav ech hu hitlabbeshut zo aval lo alenu telunatam ki im al kitve haarizal veal yachshedeni shomea sheani beenay shehevanti divre haarizal lehafshitan miggashmiyyutan ki lo bati rak lefaresh divre habbaal-shem-tov zichrono livracha vetalmidav al pi kabbalat haarizal besheggam sheinyan ze eno mechachmat hakkabbala umehannistarot la elokenu ki im mehanniglot lanu ulvanenu lehaamin emuna shelema bemikra male sheddibber hakkatuv halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male neum sheen mikra yotze mide feshuto

Vegam hi emuna peshuta bistam kelalut yisrael umsura beyadam meavotehem hakkedoshim shehalchu bitmimut im beli lachkor besechel enoshi inyan haelokut asher hu lemala mehassechel ad en ketz leda ech hu male chal haaretz

Rak shechadashim mikkarov bau lachkor bachakira zo vei efshar lekarev lahem el hassechel ella daveka al pi hakdamot lekuchot mikkitve arizal mufshatot miggashmiyyutan uchfi sheshshamati merabbotay nishmatam eden ach i efshar levaer ze hetev bemichtav ki im mippe leozen shomaat lichide segulla velasseridim asher kore kedichtiv umvakshe havaya yavinu chol umikkelal hen atta shomea chu

Hinne attem reitem perush maamar echad missefarim hayeduim ledugma ulot ki gam kal hammaamarim hattemuhim yesh lahem perush uveur hetev leode chen ach lo yekauu maalatam elay levaer lahem hakkol bemichtav ki hi melacha keveda umrubba vei efshar beshum ofen rak im tirtzu shillechu mikkem echad umuchad shebbaeda ufe el pe adabber bo im yirtze va yihye im pi behattifi veyihu leratzon imre fi
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 26: Beraya mehemna parashat naso vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia behay chibbura dilach deihu sefer hazzohar min zahora deima ilaa teshuva beilen lo tzarich nissaon uvgin daatidin yisrael lemitam meilana dechayye deihu hay sefer hazzohar yippekun beh min galuta berachamim veyitkayyem behon badad yanchennu veen immo el nechar

Veilana detov vara deihu isur veheter tuma vetahora lo yishletu al yisrael yattir deha parnasa dilhon la leheve ella missitra deilana dechayye delet tamman lo kashya missitra dera velo machaloket meruach hattuma dichtiv veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz dela yitparnesun talmide chachamim meamme haaretz ella missitra detov deachlin tahora kasher heter vela meerev rav deachlin tuma pasul asur chu uvzimna deilana detov vara shalta chu inun chachamim dedamyan leshabbatot veyamim tovim let lehon ella ma deyahavin lehon inun chullin kegavena deom hashshabbat delet leh ella ma dimtakkenin leh beoma dechol

Uvzimna deshalta ilana dechayye itkafya ilana detov vara vela yehe leamme haaretz ella ma deyahavin lehon talmide chachamim veitkafyan techotayehu keillu la hau bealma vehache isur heter tuma vetahora lo itabber meamme haaretz demissitrayehu let ben galuta limot hammashiach ella shibud malchuyyot bilvad deinun lo taame meilana dechayye vetzarich lon matnitin beisur veheter tuma vetahora ad kan beraya mehemna

Vehinne hammuvan mehashkafa rishona lichora milleshon ze hammaamar lachasere madda shellimud isur veheter veseder teharot hu meilana detov vara millevad shehu pele gadol mechamat atzmo vesoter peshate hakketuvim umidreshe rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shekkal hattora hanniglet lanu ulvanenu nikra etz chayyim lammachazikim bah velo sefer hazzohar levad uvifrat shehaya ganuz bimehem vegam kal chachmat hakkabbala hayeta nistara bimehem venelama mikkal talmide chachamim ki im lichide segulla veaf gam zot behatznea lechet velo barabbim kidita baggemara

Uchmo sheamar haarizal dedaveka bedorot ellu haacharonim muttar umitzva legallot zot hachachma velo baddorot harishonim vegam rabbi shimon ben yochai amar bazzohar hakkadosh shello nitan reshut legallot rak lo velachaverav levaddam

Veaf gam zot pelia nisgava dilfi ze lo haya limud isur veheter vechal shekken dine mamonot dochin mitzvat tefilla shennitkena al pi sodot hazzohar veyichudim elonim layyodim kerabbi shimon ben yochai vachaverav veze eno kidita baggemara derabbi shimon ben yochai vachaverav vechal mi shettorato ummanuto en mafsikin litfilla
Vaafilu kesheosek bedine mamonot kerav yehuda dechullehu tannuye binzikin have vaafilu hache la have matzle ella mittelatin yomin litlatin yomin kad mehaddar talmuda kidita baggemara

Uvirushalmi perek kamma divrachot sevira leh lerabbi shimon ben yochai daafilu likriat-shema en mafsikin ki im mimmikra velo mimmishna daadife mimmikra lerabbi shimon ben yochai velo chilek ben seder zeraim umoed vekadashim teharot linzikin vesoter daat atzmo beraya mehemna bechamma mekomot demishna ihi shifcha chu vehammikra shehu torat moshe vadday adifa mikkabbala deihi matronita beraya mehemna sham vetora shebbichtav hu malka dehayenu yesod abba hamlubbash bizer anpin kemo sheamar haarizal

Vegam pilpul hakkushot veterutzim demissitra dera veruach hattuma ashkechan berabbi shimon ben yochai deasak beh tuva gam bihoto bammeara veadderabba bizchut tzaar hammeara zacha laze kidita baggemara deamar lerabbi pinchas ben yair akkal kushya peruke veamar lo ilu lo reitani bechach chu vegam beemet al karchacha ikar iskehem bammeara haya torat hammishnaot tr sidre shehaya bimehem ad rabbenu hakkadosh deilu sefer hazzohar vehattikunim haya yachol ligmor bev veg chodashim ki bevadday lo amar davar echad peamim
Gam amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash en lo lehakkadosh-baruch-hu ella ammot shel halacha bilvad

Veod yesh lehafli hafle vafele ech efshar shellimot hammashiach lo yitztarchu leda hilchot isur veheter vetuma vetahora ki ech yishchatu hakkarbanot vegam chullin im lo yedu hilchot derasa vachalada ushhiyya happoslim hashshechita ufgimat hassakkin vechi yivaled ish betivo sheyehe shochet beli shehiyya udrasa vegam hassakkin tihye beria veomedet beli pegima leolam

Veod harbe hilchot chelev vedam ushar isurin vegam tumat hammet yihu tzerichin leda kedichtiv hannaar ben mea shana yamut vegam tumat yoledet tzarich leda kedichtiv hara veoledet yachdav im teled ishsha bechal yom mibbia achat af-al-pi-chen din isur tumatah lo yishtanne
Veen lehaarich bedavar happashut umfursam hefko bechal hashshas umidrashim defarich hilcheta limshicha veeliyyahu ba lifshot kal hassefekot ufarasha zo atid eliyyahu ledorshah chu

Veod eno muvan ma shekkatuv dela yitparnesun talmide chachamim meamme haaretz chu vela meerev rav deachlin pasul tame veasur chas veshalom deha gam bizman bayit sheni lo hau mitparnesin meamme haaretz deachlin pasul asur chas veshalom shehare talmide chachamim hau lahem sadot uchramim keamme haaretz vaafilu hache hau oskin belimud isur veheter vetuma vetahora kal hazzugot shehau bime bayit sheni veheemidu talmidim laalafim urvavot velimud hannistar behester chu

Ach beemet keshettedakdek bilshon raya mehemna dilel veilana detov vara deihu isur veheter chu velo amar torat isur veheter o hilchot isur veheter ella rotze lomar deguf davar haasur vedavar hammuttar hu meilana detov vara shehu kelipat nogah kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim

Vezehu leshon asur shehakkelipa shora alav veeno yachol laalot lemala kedavar hammuttar dehayenu sheeno kashur veasur biklipa veuchal laalot al-yede haadam haochlo bechavana la vegam bistam kal adam haoved shebbechoach haachila hahi lomed umitpallel la venimtza shennaasa otiyyot hattora vehattefilla haola la mikkoach hannivrar mehammaachal hahu

Vezehu bechol aval beshabbat sheyyesh aliyya liklipat nogah beatzmah im hachitzoniyyut shebbechal haolamot lachen mitzva leechol kal taanugim beshabbat ulharbot bevasar veyayin af shebbechol nikra zolel vesove

Ma-sheen-ken bidvar isur sheeno yachol laalot lo beshabbat velo bechol gam keshemmitpallel velomed bakkoach hahu im lo sheachal lefikuach nefesh shehittiru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha venaasa heter gamur

Aval hallimud battora af hilchot isur veheter tuma vetahora shehem hammishnaot uvarayetot shebbaggemara ufoskim hamvaarim umvarrim divrehem lahalacha lemaase hen hen gufe tora shebbeal-pe shehi sefirat malchut daatzilut kidita bazzohar hakkadosh bimkomot en mispar uvresh tikunim malchut pe tora shebbeal pe karinan lah uvaatzilut ihu vegarmohi chad behon dehayenu sheor-en-sof baruch-hu mityached baatzilut betachlit hayyichud shehu urtzono vechachmato hamlubbashim bedibburo shennikra malchut hakkol echad

Uma sheamar haarizal shehammishnaot hen bemalchut ditzira rotze lomar levush malchut ditzira shennitlabbesha bah malchut daatzilut umalchut ditzira nikra shifcha legabbe malchut daatzilut umalchut divria nikra ama

Veteda mimma sheamar haarizal demikra dehayenu tora shebbichtav hu baasiyya vahare meforash bazzohar uvchitve haarizal mekomot en mispar shehi tiferet shehu zeer anpin daatzilut ella shemmitlabbeshet baasiyya vechen hu behedya besefer hakkavanot shemmikra umishna vetalmud vekabbala kullam baatzilut ella shemmikra mitlabbesh ad asiyya umishna ad hayetzira vetalmud bivria

Vehinne keshehammalchut daatzilut mitlabbeshet biklipat nogah kede levarer hannitzotzot shennaflu bechet adam harishon vegam harappach nitzotzin shennaflu bishvirat hakkelim azay gam hammalchut daatzilut nikra beshem etz haddaat tov vara legabbe zeer anpin daatzilut sheeno yored sham venikra etz chayyim

Vehinne hitlabbeshut hammalchut biklipat nogah hu sod galut hashshechina asher shalat haadam beadam chu vezehu shekkatuv beraya mehemna uvzimna deilana detov vara shalta chu inun chu dehayenu bizman galut hashshechina shemmashpaat lachitzonim shehem biklipat nogah shehaerev rav yonkim mishsham umittamtzitan nizonin talmide chachamim baggalut veaz ikar avodat haadam veikar esek hattora vehammitzot hu levarer hannitzotzot kannoda mehaarizal

Lachen ikar inyan hallimud hu beiyyun ufilpul halacha beisur veheter tuma vetahora levarer hammuttar vehattahor mehaasur vehattame al-yede iyyun ufilpul halacha bechachma bina vadaat kannoda deorayeta mechachma nafkat uvchachma dayeka itberiru vehayenu chachma ilaa daatzilut hamlubbeshet bemalchut daatzilut sod tora shebbeal-pe besod abba yasad beratta hamlubbeshet bemalchut ditzira vesod sod hammishnaot uvarayetot hamlubbashot biklipat nogah shekkeneged olam hayetzira sheshsham matchil bechinat haddaat hara shebbenogah vehabbarayetot hamlubbashot biklipat nogah shekkeneged olam haasiyya sheshsham matchil bechinat hara shebbenogah kannoda mehaarizal

Vehammaskil yavin inyan pele gadol mizze meod ma naase bashshamayim mimmaal al-yede iyyun uverur halacha pesuka min haggemara ufoskim rishonim veacharonim ma shehaya behelem davar kodem haiyyun hallaz ki al-yede ze maale halacha zo mehakkelipot shehau maalimim umchassim otah shello hayeta yedua kelal o shello hayeta muvenet hetev betaamah shehattaam hu sod hassefira chachma ilaa shennaflu mimmenna nitzotzin bakkelipot bishvirat hakkelim vehem sham bivchinat galut shehakkelipot sholtim alehem umaalimim chachmat hattora meelonim vetachtonim vezehu shekkatuv beraya mehemna shehakkushya hi missitra dera

Vehinne haelonim en bahem koach levarer ulhaalot mehashshevira shebbiklipat nogah ella hattachtonim levad lefi shehem melubbashim beguf chumri mashka dechiveya mikkelipat nogah vehem mattishim kochah bishvirat hattaaot veitkafya sitra achora veyitpardu kal poale aven velachen baim haelonim lishmoa chidushe tora mehattachtonim ma shemmechaddeshim umgallim taalumot hachachma shehau kevushim baggola ad atta

Vechal ish yisrael yuchal legallot taalumot chachma legallot ulchaddesh sechel chadash hen bahalachot hen beaggadot hen bannigle hen bannistar kefi bechinat shoresh nishmato umchuyyav baddavar lehashlim nishmato behaalaat kal hannitzotzot shennaflu lechelkah ulgoralah kannoda

Vechal divre tora uvifrat devar halacha hi nitzotz mehashshechina shehi hi devar kidita baggemara devar zo halacha sod malchut daatzilut hammalbeshet lechachma daatzilut umlubbashim bemalchut ditzira veyardu biklipat nogah bishvirat hakkelim
Vezehu sheamru baggemara kal haosek battora amar hakkadosh-baruch-hu maale ani alav keillu pedaani veet banay mibben haummot haolam

Aval betzet hashshechina mikkelipat nogah mehakkelipot achar sheyyushlam berur hannitzotzot veufrad hara mehattov veyitpardu kal poale aven vela shalta ilana detov vara betzet hattov mimmenna azay lo yihye esek hattora vehammitzot levarer berurin ki im leyached yichudim elonim yoter lehamshich orot elonim yoter mehaatzilut kemo sheamar haari zichrono livracha
Vehakkol al-yede penimiyyut hattora lekayyem hammitzot bechavanot elonot shemmechavvenot leorot elonim chu ki shoresh hammitzot hu lemala mala been-sof baruch-hu
Uma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha demitzot betelot leatid lavo hayenu bitchiyyat hammetim aval limot hammashiach kodem techiyyat hammetim en betelim

Velachen yihye gam ikar esek hattora gam ken bifnimiyyut hammitzot vetaamehem hannistarim aval hanniglot yihu geluyim viduim lechal ish yisrael bidia battechilla beli shichcha veen tzerichim laasok bahem ella leerev rav shello yizku lemitam meilana dechayye shehu penimiyyut hattora vehammitzva utzrichim laasok battora bammishna lehattish koach hassitra achora haddavuk bahem al yede esek hattora shello tishlot bahem lehachatiam kedichtiv vehachote ben mea shana yekullal sheyyihu chotim meerev rav

Vegam lemaase yihu tzerichim lifrate hilchot issur vetuma yoter miyyisrael shello yeera lahem pesul vetuma veissur ki lo yeunne chu vegam efshar vekarov haddavar sheyyedu mippenimiyyut hattora kal gufe hattora hanniglet kemo avraham avinu alav-hashshalom velachen en tzerichim laasok bahem kelal

Ma-sheen-ken bizman bayit sheni hau tzerichim laasok gam ki lo bishvil halacha lemaase bilvad ella shezzehu ikar avoda lehattish koach hassitra achora ulhaalot nitzotze hakkedushsha al-yede hattora vehaavoda kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher

Veachar haddevarim vehaemet yuvan hetev bettosefet beur haraya mehemna dilel bema sheamar ilana detov vara chu rotze lomar kelipat nogah shehu olam hazze haikar kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim veday lammevin
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 27: Ma shekkatav leoshve eretz hakkodesh tibbane vetikkonen bimhera veyamenu amen lenachamam bechiflayim letushiyya al petirat harav haggaon hamfursam ish elokim kadosh ner yisrael ammud hayemani pattish hechazak morenu harav verabbenu rabbi menachem mendel nishmato eden
Ahuvay achay vereay asher kenafshi chu alehem yichu chayyim ad haolam vetzeetzaehem ittam zera emet beruche hemma meatta vead olam

Achare derishat shelomam kemishpat leohave shemo bati ledabber al lev nidkaim hanneenachim vehanneenakim ulnachamam bechiflayim letushiyya asher shama azni vattaven lah al maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha deshavak chayyim lechal chay

Ki tzaddik beemunato yichye uvyirat lechayyim uvrishfe esh shalhevet ahavato mechayyim lechal bahen chayye rucho venishmato kal yeme cheldo vayehi behaalot rucho venishmato elav yeesof veyaale beiluy achar iluy ad rum hammaalot shavak chayye rucho peullato asher avad bah lefanim beyisrael peullat tzaddik lechayyim lechal chay hi nefesh kal chay hakkeshura benafsho bechavle avotot ahava rabba veahavat olam bal timmot lanetzach asher mi haish hechafetz chayyim ledavka ba chayyim baavodato tidbak nafsho vehayeta tzerura bitzror hachayyim et bechayye ruach appenu asher amarnu betzillo nichye vaggoyim

Asher shavak lanu bechal echad veechad kefi bechinat hitkashsheruto beemet veahavato ahavat emet hattehora mikkerev ish velev amok ki kammayim happanim vechu veruach ayeti ruach veamshich ruach verucho omedet bekirbenu mammash ki biroto yeladav maase yadav bekirbo yakdishu shemo yitbarech asher yitgaddel veyitkaddesh kaasher nelech bederech yeshara asher horanu midderachav venelcha beorchotav netzach sela vaed

Vezehu shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh detzaddika deitpattar ishtakkach bechullehu almin yattir mibbechayyohi dehayenu sheggam beze haolam hammaase hayyom laasotam ishtakkach yattir ki hammaase gadol gadel veholech gidule gidulin min or zarua latztzaddik bassade asher bercho hammeir laaretz vechutzot vegam anachnu elle fo hayyom kullanu chayyim bidrachav derech hakkodesh yikkare lah zot baavodat bemile dishmayya

Uvmile dealma beferush ittemar bazzohar hakkadosh detzaddikayya meginin al alma uvmitathon yattir mibbechayyehon veilmale tzelota detzaddikayya behahu alma la itkayyem alma riga chada vechal hakkarov karov el mishkan bechayyav kodem livracha

Ita bazzohar hakkadosh detzaddika deitpattar ishtakkach bechullehu almin yattir mibbechayyohi chu vetzarich lehavin tenach beolamot elonim ishtakkach yattir baaloto shamma aval baolam hazze ech ishtakkach yattir
Veyesh lomar al derech ma shekkibbalti al maamar chachamenu-zichronam-livracha deshavak chayyim lechal chay

Kannoda shechayye hatztzaddik enam chayyim besarim ki im chayyim ruchaniyyim shehem emuna veyira veahava ki beemuna ketiv vetzaddik beemunato yichye uvyira ketiv veyirat lechayyim uvahava ketiv rodef tzedaka vachesed yimtza chayyim vechesed hu ahava
Ushlosha middot ellu hem bechal olam veolam ad rum hammaalot hakkol lefi erech bechinat maalot haolamot ze al ze bederech ila vealul kannoda

Vehinne bihot hatztzaddik chay al pene haadama hau shelosha middot ellu betoch keli ulvush shellahem bivchinat makom gashmi shehi bechinat nefesh hakkeshura begufo vechal talmidav enam mekabbelim rak hearat middot ellu vezivan hammeir chutz lichli ze al-yede dibburav umachshevotav hakkedoshim velachen amru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha sheen adam omed al daat rabbo vechu

Aval leachar petirato lefi shemmitpardim bechinat hannefesh shennishara bakkever mibbechinat haruach shebbegan eden shehen shalosh middot hallalu lefichach yachol kal hakkarov elav lekabbel chelek mibbechinat rucho shebbegan eden hoil veenah betoch keli velo bivchinat makom gashmi kannoda maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha al yaakov avinu alav-hashshalom shennichnas immo gan eden vechen katav besefer asara maamarot sheavir gan eden mitpashshet saviv kal adam venirshamim baavir ze kal machshevotav vedibburav hattovim battora vaavodat vechen lehefech chas veshalom nirshamim baavir hammitpashshet miggehinnom saviv kal adam

Hilkach nakel meod letalmidav lekabbel chelkam mibbechinat ruach rabbam haatzmiyyit shehem emunato veyirato veahavato asher avad bahem et velo zivam bilvad hammeir chutz lakkeli lefi shebbechinat rucho haatzmit mitalla beiluy achar iluy lehikkalel bivchinat nishmato shebbegan eden haelon shebbaolamot haelonim

Venoda shekkal davar shebbikdushsha eno nekar legamre mikkol vachol mimmekomo umadregato harishona gam leachar shennitalla lemala lemala uvchina zo harishona shennishara lematta began eden hattachton bimkomo umadregato harishona hi hammitpashshetet betalmidav kal echad kefi bechinat hitkashsheruto vekirvato elav bechayyav uvmoto beahava rabba ki hamshachat kal ruchaniyyut enah ella al-yede ahava rabba kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh deruach diruta delibba amshich ruach milleela rak im yikkon likrat elohav bahachana rabba vigia atzuma lekabbel shalosh middot hallalu kederech shehorahu rabbo uchmaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha yagata umatzata taamin

Vehinne yesh od bechinat heara letalmidav rak sheenah mitlabbeshet betoch mocham mammash karishona rak meira alehem milmala vehi mealiyyat rucho venishmato limkor chutzbo dehayenu lachakal tappuchin kaddishin veal-yede ze naase sham yichud al-yede haalaat mayyin nukvin mikkal maasav vetorato vaavodato asher avad kal yeme chayyav venizreu bachakal tappuchin kaddishin orot elonim meod leummat tachtonim asher hem torato vaavodato

Vehearat orot elonim ellu meira al kal talmidav shennaasu ovde al-yede torato vaavodato veheara zo shealehem milmala machneset belibbam hirhure teshuva umaasim tovim vechal hammaasim tovim hannoladim meheara zo shemmeira meorot hazzeruim bassade hannizkar leel nikra gidule gidulin

Veheara zo hi behelem vehester gadol kemo shemesh hammeir lakkochavim mittachat laaretz kidita battikunim al moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom sheachar petirato mitpashshetet hearato bechal dara vedara leshishshim ribbo neshamot kemo shemesh hammeir mittachat laaretz leshishshim ribbo kochavim
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 28: Ma shekkatav limchuttano harav haggaon hamfursam ish elokim kedosh ner yisrael ammud hayemani pattish hechazak morenu verabbenu harav levi yitzchak nishmato eden av bet-din dikhillat kodesh barditshov lenachamo al petirat beno harav hechasid morenu verabbenu harav meir nishmato eden
Lamma nismecha parashat miryam lefarashat para lomar lecha ma para mechapperet vechu

Vetzarich lehavin lamma nismecha daveka lefara adumma hannaase chutz leshalosh machanot ella dechattat karyeh rachamana hannaase bachutz velo nismecha lefarashat chattat hannaase bifnim al gabbe hammizbeach kappara mammash

Amnam noda mizzohar hakkadosh vehaarizal sod hakkarbanot sheal gabbe hammizbeach hen bechinat haalaat mayyin nukvin minnefesh habbahamit shebbenogah el sharshan umkoran hen bechinot chayyot shebbammerkava hannosot et hakkisse pene shor ufne nesher vechu veal-yede ze nimshachim veordim mayyin duchrin mibbechinat adam sheal hakkisse hannikra beshem malka uzer anpin

Achen bisrefat happara adumma hinne al-yede hashlachat etz erez veezov vechu untinat mayim chayyim el haefer nikra beshem kidush me chattat bammishna vehi bechinat kodesh haelon hannikra beshem talla divdulcha kemo shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh shehi bechinat chachma ilaa umocha setimaa daarich anpin vaalah itmar beduchte tuva bazzohar hakkadosh bechachma itberiru veithappecha chashocha linhora dehayenu olam hattikun shennitbarer venittakken al-yede mocha setimaa daarich anpin meolam hattohu ushvirat hakkelim shennaflu bivria-yetzira-asiyya vechu kannoda velazot metaheret tumat hammet af shehu avi avot vechu ulmatta matta minnogah

Vehinne mudaat zot deabba yonek mimmazzal hashshemini hu tikun notzer chesed notzer otiyyot ratzon vehi et ratzon hammitgalle umeir bivchinat giluy milmala lematta beet petirat tzaddike elon ovde beahava bimsirat nafsham la bechayyehem arvit veshacharit bikriat-shema sheal-yede ze hau maalim mayyin nukvin leabba veima bikriat-shema kayyadua vechen betalmud tora demechachma nafka veal-yede ze hau nimshachim veordim bechinat mayyin duchrin mittikun venotzer chesed vehem hem hammeirim bivchinat giluy biftiratam kannoda shekkal amal haadam sheamla nafsho bechayyav lemala bivchinat helem vehester mitgalle umeir bivchinat giluy milmala lematta beet petiratv

Vehinne al-yede giluy hearat tikun venotzer chesed biftiratan meir chesed meolam ad olam al yereav ufoel yeshuot bekerev haaretz lechapper al aon haddor af gam al hazzedonot shehen mig kelipot hattemeot shellematta minnogah lefi shemmazzal denotzer mimmocha setimaa daarich anpin mekor habberurim veithappecha chashocha dishvirat hakkelim linhora deolam hattikun
Ma-sheen-ken bakkarbanot sheal gabbe hammizbeach sheenan mechapperim ella al hashshegagot shehen mehitgabberut nefesh habbahamit shemminnogah kemo shekkatuv belikkute tora parashat vayyikra
Velachen nismecha lefarashat para daveka ma para vechu uvyalkut parashat shemini haggirsa me chattat vechu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 29: Eshet chayil ateret balah chu
Ita baggemara perek dimgila udishtammesh betagga cholaf chu ze hammishtammesh bemi sheshshone halachot kitrah shel tora chu tana deve eliyyahu kal hashshone halachot muvtach lo chu

Vetzarich lehavin lamma nikreu hahalachot beshem tagga vechitrah shel tora vegam lamma hashshone halachot daveka muvtach lo chu velo shear divre tora vechen lehavin maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha beferek dimnachot afilu lo shana adam ella perek echad shacharit chu yatza yede chovato velamma eno yotze yede chovato bishar divre tora

Ach mudaat zot ma sheamar haarizal shekkal adam miyyisrael tzarich lavo begilgulim rabbim ad sheyekayyem kal taryag mitzot hattora bemachashava dibur umaase lehashlim levushe nafsho ultakkenam shello yehe levusha dechasra chu levad mitzot hatteluot bammelech shehu motzi kal yisrael ki hu kelalut kullam chu vehattaam hu kede lehalbish kal taryag bechinot vechochot shebbenafsho achat mehenna lo nedara chu

Uveur inyan hechrach vetzorech levushim ellu mevoar bazzohar umuvan lechal maskil ki lihot shennefesh ruach unshama shebbeadam hen bechinot nivraim vei efshar leshum nivra lehassig shum hassaga bevore veotzer hakkol en-sof baruch-hu

Vegam achare asher heir meoro yitbarech veheetzil bivchinat hishtalshelut madregot rabbot madrega achar madrega bivchinat tzimtzumim atzumim ulvushim rabbim vaatzumim hayeduim leode chen venikraim beidra rabba beshem searot uchdichtiv bedaniyyel usar resheh kaamar neke chu af-al-pi-chen lo yachla hannefesh o haruach unshama lemisbal haor ki tov umatok haor vechu kemo shekkatuv lachazot benoam leshon neimut vaarevut umtikut vetaanug atzum leen ketz kemo shekkatuv az titannag al vehisbia betzachtzachot chu leshon tziche tzama kemo shekkatuv bazzohar

Veen bechochah lekabbel hanneimut vaarevut hatztzachtzachot shello tetze minnartekah vetitbattel mimmetziutah kener baavuka im lo shemmibbechinat or ze atzmo tishtalshel vetimmashech mimmennu ezo heara muetet bederech hishtalshelut madrega achar madrega betzimtzumim rabbim ad sheyyibbare mimmenna levush echad nivra meen mahut or ze lehalbish hannefesh ruach unshama

Vederech levush ze shehu meen or ze tuchal lehanot mizziv or ze ulhassigo velo titbattel mimmetziutah vechimshal haroe bashshemesh derech ashashit zakka umira vechu uchmo shekkatuv vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal chu shennitlabbesh beanan veala veraa derech heanan vechu kemo shekkatuv bazzohar chelek daf vercht

Vehinne or ze hagganuz latztzaddikim leatid lavo hannikra beshem noam vetzachtzachot lehitanneg al ved meot almin dechissufin demitannege behon tzaddikayya chu kemo shekkatuv arba meot shekel kesef chu hinne yesh bo maalot umadregot rabbot meod gavoha meal gavoha ach heara muetet hayyoredet madrega achar madrega livro levush ze hi mibbechinat madrega haacharona shebbeor ze venikret beshem madrega hachitzona vaachorayim derech mashal kemo shekkatuv bazzohar daf ammud ayyen besefer mikdash melech very ammud uma deishtear chu

Vehinne kemo shebbenishmat haadam yesh bah koach hattaanug shemmitanneget mimma sheyyesh lah oneg mimmennu kemo mehaskalat sechel chadash uchhay gavena uvchinat chitzoniyyut vaachorayim shel koach uvchinat hattaanug shebbah hi bechinat koach haratzon shebbah shehu rotze ma shehu rotze dehayenu davar sheeno tzaar shehatztzaar hefech hattaanug

Vechacha al derech mashal beor en-sof baruch-hu gam ken kivyachol haratzon haelon baruch-hu hi bechinat chitzoniyyut vaachorayim livchinat oneg haelon venoam vetzachtzachot vealmin dechissufin hannizkarim leel

Hagam shehem meuchadim betachlit hayyichud shehu yitbarech urtzono echad velo kirtzon haadam chas veshalom lo mineh velo miktzateh veen dimon benehem kelal af-al-pi-chen dibbera tora kilshon bene adam leshakkech haozen ma sheyechola lishmoa bemashal umlitza minnishmat haadam hakkelula mikkoach hattaanug veharatzon vehachachma vehabbina vechu vechannire bechush shekkesheadam maskil eze sechel chadash nifla azay beotah rega al kal panim nolad lo taanug nifla besichlo mikkelal shehattaanug hu lemala mala mibbechinat hassechel vehachachma rak shemmelubbash bivchinat sechel vechachma uchshehaadam margish hassechel vechachma dehayenu shemmassigah umvinah hetev azay margish gam ken bechinat hattaanug hamlubbash bachachma

Velachen nikret bechinat bina beshem olam-habba bazzohar hakkadosh shehi bechinat hitgallut hachachma im hattaanug hamlubbash bah shemmassigim hatztzaddikim began eden umaskilim bifnimiyyut hattora deorayeta mechachma nafka veorayeta vekudsha-berich-hu kulla chad

Vehinne ratzon haelon baruch-hu mechunne venikra befi chachme haemet beshem keter elon uvo ammude or vechu perush derech mashal kemo sheyyesh ammudim bevet choma gadol nitztzavim baaretz verosham mechubbar battikra kacha mammash al derech mashal keter elon baruch-hu hu lemala mibbechinat madregat hachachma vehu milleshon koteret shehu machtir umakkif al hammochin shebbarosh shehem bechinot chachma-bina-daat

Veratzon ze nitlabbesh betaryag mitzot hattora vez mitzot derabbanan sherubbam kechullam hen mitzot maasiyyot vegam hatteluot bedibbur ha kayema lan daakimat sefatav have maase vegam hatteluot bammachashava o ballev hare hammitzva nitna laadam haggashmi shebbaolam hazze daveka shehu baal bechira lehattot levavo letov vechu ma-sheen-ken hanneshama belo guf en tzarich letzaotah al ze

Venimtza shehammitzot hen al derech mashal kemo haammudim nitztzavim merum hammaalot hu ratzon haelon baruch-hu ad haaretz hallezu hachumrit vehen al derech mashal kemo haammudim chalulin shemmakkifin umalbishin nishmat haadam o rucho o nafsho keshemmekayyem hammitzot vederech ammudim ellu olin hannefesh-ruach-neshama shello ad rum hammaalot litzror bitzror hachayyim et perush lihot tzerurot umlubbashot beor hakketer hu ratzon haelon baruch-hu veal-yede levush ze yuchlu lachazot benoam vetzachtzachot shellemala mimmaalat hakketer vehen penimiyyuto al derech mashal

Vahagam shennitbaer bemakom acher shehammitzot hen penimiyyut ratzon haelon baruch-hu hinne mudaat zot leode chen ribuy bechinot umadregot sheyyesh bechal bechina umadrega mimmadregot hakkedushsha kamma bechinot panim lefanim vechamma bechinot achorayim laachorayim leen ketz vechu

Vehinne mitzot derabbanan enan nechshavot mitzot bifne atzman shehare kevar neemar lo tosef ella hen yotzot venimshachot mimmitzot hattora uchlulot bahen bemispar taryag lehalbish taryag bechinot vechochot shebbenefesh-ruach-nishmat haadam
Vezehu shekkatuv bazzohar hakkadosh parashat pekude daf ammud deinun ovadin tavin deavid bar nash mashche minnehora deziva ilaa levusha chu vechame chu benoam vechu

Vahagam dehatam mayeri began eden hattachton shehallevushim sham hem mimmitzot maasiyyot mammash aval began eden haelon hallevushim hem meruta vechavana delibba beorayeta utzlota kemo shekkatuv bazzohar sham daf hare hakkavana hi kavanat esko battora lishmah meahavat umitzvat talmud tora hi gam ken mikkelal mitzot maasiyyot daakimat sefatav have maase vehirhur lav kedibbur dami veeno yotze yede chovato behirhur levaddo vechen bitfilla
Uma gam ki maalat hakkavana al haddibbur umaase enah mitztzad atzmah chu ella mitztzad hearat ratzon haelon chu kemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim chelek perek baarichut ayyen sham

Vehinne mudaat zot ki hinne ratzon haelon baruch-hu hamlubbash bettaryag mitzot shebbattora shebbichtav hu mufla umchusse tamir venelam veeno mitgalle ella battora shebbeal pe kemo mitzvat tefilin al derech mashal shenneemar battora shebbichtav ukshartam leot al yadecha vehau letotafot ben enecha vehu maamar satum venelam shello feresh hakkatuv ech uma likshor umahu totafot vehechan hu ben enecha veal yadecha ad sheppersha tora shebbeal pe shetztzarich likshor bayit echad al hayyad ved battim al harosh uvtocham parashiyyot vehabbattim yihu meor meubbad umrubbaim daveka umkushsharim birtzuot shel or shechorot daveka vechal shear perate hilchot asiyyat hattefilin shenneemru beal pe veal yadecha hi hazzeroa daveka velo kaf hayyad uven enecha ze kadkod velo hammetzach

Vechen kal mitzot shebbattora ben mitzot ase ben mitzot lo taase enan geluot viduot umforashot ella al-yede tora shebbeal pe kemitzvat lo taase shenneemar beshabbat lo taase melacha velo feresh ma hi melacha uvattora shebbeal pe nitparesh shehen melachot hayeduot velo tiltul avanim vekorot kevedot
Vechayyotze vahen hen kal hammitzot ben mitzot ase ben mitzot lo taase hen setumot velo meforashot ugluot viduot ella al-yede tora shebbeal pe

Umishshum hache ketiv al tora shebbeal pe al tittosh torat immecha kemo shekkatuv bazzohar mishshum sheal derech mashal kemo shekkal evre havalad kelulim betipat haav behelem gadol vehaem motziato lide giluy beledatah valad shalem beramach evarim veshasa gidim kacha mammash kal ramach mitzot ase veshasa mitzot lo taase baim mehahelem el haggiluy battora shebbeal pe veresheh dikra shema beni musar avicha kae attora shebbichtav denafka mechachma ilaa hannikret beshem av

Vezehu shekkatuv eshet chayil ateret balah ki hattora shebbeal pe hannikret eshet chayil hammolida umaamedet chayalot harbe kemo shekkatuv vaalamot en mispar al tikre alamot ella olamot ellu halachot delet lon chushbana kemo shekkatuv battikunim

Vechullan hen bechinat giluy ratzon haelon baruch-hu hannelam battora shebbichtav veratzon haelon baruch-hu hu lemala mala mimmaalat chachma ilaa uchmo keter vaatara sheal hammochin shebbarosh lachen nikreu hahalachot beshem tagga vechitrah shel tora vehashshone halachot muvtach lo shehu ben olam-habba al-yede hitlabbeshut nefesh-ruach-neshama shello baratzon haelon baruch-hu kannizkar leel
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 30: Mudaat zot ma sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha kal haragil lavo levet hakkeneset veom echad lo va hakkadosh-baruch-hu shoel alav shenneemar mi vachem yere vechu

Vechen bechal hammitzot uvifrat mitzvat hatztzedaka sheshshekula keneged kal hammitzot hagam shehi beli neder chas veshalom af-al-pi-chen kal hachayil asher naga yirat belibbam lo yaata lenafsham haelokit latet migraot bakkodesh measher kevar hurgelu midde shana lehafrish mimmeodam lehachaot ruach shefalim venidkaim delet lehon miggarmehon hi bechinat sukkat david hannofelet vechu lekomem ulromem vechu lemeheve echad beechad vechu

Vehakkol lefi rov hammaase vechu ulfi hacheshbon kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha kal peruta ufruta mitztarefet lecheshbon gadol vechu al derech maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ematay gadol havaya keshehu beir elohenu vechu hi bechinat umkom hacheshbon kemo shekkatuv enayich berechot becheshbon

Vehamchuvan kannoda ki beitaruta diltatta hamshachat chayyim chen vachesed bemaase hatztzedaka beratzon hattov vesever panim yafot itaruta dilela yaer havaya panav hu hearat vehamshachat chen vachesed veratzon elon mechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu asher ligdullato en cheker vehassaga kelal el bechinat malchutcha malchut kal olamim alma deitgalya hamchayye kal habberuim shebbechal hahechalot elonim vetachtonim shehen bivchinat mispar vecheshbon kemo shekkatuv elef alafim yeshammeshuneh

Vezehu cheshbon gadol sheal-yede rov maase hatztzedaka shalom ki perush shalom hu davar hamchabber umtavech ketzaot hafchiyyim shehen ketze hashshamayim leela bechinat veligdullato en cheker uktze hashshamayim letatta hammitlabbesh bivria-yetzira-asiyya bechinat gevul umispar veday lammevin
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 31: Noda bashshearim ma shekkatuv battikunim dishchinta ihi mara begaluta kivyachol

Perush al derech mashal kemo choli hagguf hammavdil ben kodesh vechu shessibat hacholi vehabberiut hi hitpashshetut vehiluch hachayyut mehallev el kal haevarim hamlubbeshet bedam hannefesh hayyotze mehallev el kal haevarim vesovev sovev holech haruach chayyim vehaddam toch toch kal haevarim vehaggidim hammuvlaim bahem vechozer el hallev

Veim sibuv vehiluch haruach chayyim hallaz hu kehilchato temidi kesidro hamsuddar lo mechayye hachayyim baruch-hu azay haadam bari betachlit ki kal haevarim mekushsharim yachad umkabbelim chayyutam harauy lahem mehallev al-yede sibuv hallaz

Ach im yesh eze kilkul beezehu mekoman hammonea umakkev o memaet sibuv vehiluch haddam im haruach chayyim hamlubbash bo azay nifsak o mitmaet hakkesher hallaz hamkashsher kal haevarim el hallev al-yede sibuv hallaz vaazay nofel haadam lemishkav vecholi yishmerenu

Vechacha mammash al derech mashal hinne kal nishmot yisrael nikraim bechinat evre dishchinta hannikret beshem lev kemo shekkatuv vetzur levavi uchmo shekkatuv veshachanti betocham perush ki leshon shechina hu sheor havaya shochen beolamot beria-yetzira-asiyya lehachaotam

Vehamshachat chaut ze hi al-yede hitlabbeshut techilla benishmot yisrael lefi shekkal hannivraim en aroch lahem el habbore yitbarech decholla kammeh kela mammash chashivin vei efshar lahem lekabbel chaut meoro veshifo yitbarech lihot nivraim meayin leyesh vechayyim vekayyamim ki im al-yede hanneshamot shealu bemachashava vekadmu livriat olamot sheal-yede bechinat haddibbur kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha bemi nimlach hakkadosh baruch-hu vechu kannoda bemakom acher

Venoda bashshearim ki kal hamshachat hachayyut vehahashpaa meelonim letachtonim mehem hen kemo shekkatuv besefer yetzira nautz techillatan besofan vesofan bitchillatan uvchitve haarizal mechunne beshem or yashar veor chozer uchmo shekkatuv vehachayyot ratzo vashov

Asher al ken al pi haddevarim vehaemet haelle asher i efshar levaer hetev bemichtav nikret hashshechina beshem lev vehanneshamot beshem evarim lehorot lanu ki kaasher kal hanneshamot devukot umkushsharot yachad azay sibuv vehiluch hachayyut vehahashpaa sovev sovev venautz sofan bitchillatan lekashsher ulchabber kullan lahavaya echad uldavka bo yitbarech uchmo shekkatuv attem nitztzavim hayyom kullechem lifne havaya elokechem kullechem dayeka velifne dayeka rashechem chu mechotev etzecha chu

Uvaze yuvan maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha ki churban bayit sheni unfilat yisrael baggalut vehistallekut hashshechina viridatah leedom bivchinat galut kivyachol hakkol haya baaon sinat chinnam uferud levavot rachamana litztzelan velachen nikret chola al derech mashal kemo shekkatuv somech noflim verofe cholim leshon rabbim hem kal haevarim vechu
Tanya, Part IV; Iggeret HaKodesh 32: Barech chelam ufoal yadam yirtze leratzon lahem lifne tamid ko yitten vecho yosif leammetz libbam baggibborim venadiv al nedivot yakum lihot gadol hamasse bechal ir uminyan vetechashev lo litzdaka
Veal haose neemar tzidkato omedet laad omedet leshon nekeva shemmekabbel hitorrut libbo hattahor miggadol hamasse af-al-pi-chen omedet laad

Perush shekkal hatztzedaka vehachesed sheyyisrael osin baolam hazze minnidvat libbam hattahor hen henna chayyot vekayyamot baolam hazze haggashmi ad zeman hattechiyya sheaz hu zeman giluy elokut veor-en-sof baruch-hu mibbechinat sovev kal almin baolam hazze uchmo shennitbaer baarichut bammichtav deeshtakad

Vetzarich lihot keli umachon lehitlabbesh bo or-en-sof baruch-hu kemo hagguf lanneshama al derech mashal kemo shekkatuv halo cho devari kaesh ma esh enah meira baolam hazze ella keshenneechezet umitlabbeshet bappetila chu kemo shennitbaer bemakom acher

Vehagguf vehakkeli leoro yitbarech hi middat hachesed undivat hallev liten ulhashpia chayyut leman delet leh chu kemo shekkatuv battikunim vechamma gufin tekkinat lon veitkeriu betikuna da chesed deroa yemina vechal hagguf nichlal beyamin vechach amar happayyat levusho tzedaka

Vezehu sheamru rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha en hatztzedaka mishtallemet ella lefi chesed shebbah shenneemar ziru lachem litzdaka kitzru lefi chased shehakkatzir hu giluy hazzeria hattemuna baaretz vechach hu hatztzedaka vehachesed sheyyisrael osin bizman haggalut hi temuna venisteret ad zeman hattechiyya sheyyitlabbesh veyair or-en-sof baruch-hu baolam hazze haggashmi veihu vegarmohi chad hem bechinot hakkelim deeser sefirot daatzilut vechal shekken vekal vachomer or-en-sof baruch-hu hassovev kal almin milmala mala mibbechinat atzilut
Ulfichach nikret tzedaka leshon nekeva tzidkato omedet laad shemmekabbelet heara meor-en-sof hassovev kal almin hammitlabbesh betochah baolam hazze haggashmi bizman hattechiyya

Aval tzedek lefanav yehallech hu leshon zachar hi middat hachesed hammitoreret belev haadam meatzmo al-yede hitorrut ahavat bikriat-shema uldavka vo velimsor nafsho beechad uvchal meodecha kifshuto vechu

Uvitaruta diltatta vechammayim happanim lappanim ken lev adam haelon chu itaruta dilela hu hamshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu hassovev kal almin lematta matta baolam hazze haggashmi bivchinat giluy bizman hattechiyya kimvoar bammichtav deeshtakad baarichut

Vezehu lefanav yehallech shemmolich umamshich panim haelonim milmala mehaatzilut ad olam haasiyya vechaet et lekatztzer vechal tuv mehem lo yibbatzer hetiva lattovim velisharim belibbotam kenefesh tidreshennu
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 1: Lehavin ech hakkore besipure maasiyyot shebbattora hu mekushshar bechachma ilaa

Al pi ma shekkatuv bakkavanot daf ammud kemo shehaadam osek lematta kach deokan haadam haelon lemala chu vechen yesh lomar behirhur baotiyyot hakketuvot aval haddibbur yesh lomar devokea vesalik laatzilut mammash o livria bidchilu urchimu sichliyyim o litzira bidchilu urchimu tiviyyim uvammikra salik meolam hazze le sefirot daasiyya mishshum devaka avirin vechu ma-sheen-ken behirhur ella haddeokan shehu shoresh nishmato vechu

Uma shekkatuv bazzohar chelek daf dehirhur la avid mide chu vehayenu afilu letav ayyen sham uvdaf ammud yesh lomar dehayenu leitara leela sheyyumshach mishsham letatta rak machashavto nishara sham umosifa sham or gadol betosefet veribuy haor baatzilut al-yede mikra umitzot maasiyyot shebbaasiyya sheikar hayyichud hu lemala rak happerot baolam hazze al-yede hamshachat or meat mizzeer lematta al-yede haddibbur umaase ma-sheen-ken behirhur lo nimshach kelum velachen lo yatza yede chovato ma sheyyarda nishmato laolam hazze rak lehamshich orot elonim lematta kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar lehamshich or
Aval lehaalot mimmatta lemala hu daveka al-yede machashava tova divla dechilu urchimu la farcha leela uchmo shekkatuv beshaar hannevua perek vehammachashava tova chu

Uma shekkatuv devaka rekiin vechu vehayenu afilu bela dechilu urchimu bemikkal shekken middevarim betelim demidda tova merubba hayenu rekiin daveka shehen hahechalot vehabbattim velo beguf haadam haelon vechal shekken benefesh-ruach-neshama afilu beadam daasiyya shehen sefirot orot vechelim vezehu shekkatuv battikkunim divla dechilu urchimu la yachla lesalka ulmekam kodam daveka
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 2: Ayyen etz chayyim shaar hannekuddot shaar perek sheen hachazarat panim befanim ki im al-yede mitzot maasiyyot daveka vetaam haddavar ki al-yede maasim tovim gorem ziuug haelon vechu

Ulhavin ammay maasiyyot daveka yuvan mimma shekkatuv beshaar man umd ki tzarich techilla lehaalot mayyin nukvin denukva dizer anpin umayyin nukvin denukva hen bechinat asiyya kemo shekkatuv sham perek

Vehinne hammaasim tovim nikraim kissuach vekitzutz hakkotzim hanneechazim baachorayim shehen bechinat asiyya kemo shekkatuv beshaar perek vehayenu al-yede haalaat hattov hagganuz bahem hamlubbash bemitzot maasiyyot limkoro likdushshat haatzilut shekkevar huvrera
Uma shekkatuv sham sheadam harishon tiken gam ken al-yede tefilla hayenu al-yede otiyyot haddibbur daakimat sefatav have maase ki hen minnefesh hachiyyunit shebbagguf vedamo asher sharshan minnogah
Vehinne habberurim daasiyya olin litzira al yede shem ban umitzira livria velaatzilut kemo shekkatuv beshaar man derush siman

Uvaze yuvan dehirhur la avid mide ki beli haalaat mayyin nukvin mehammelachim shebbenogah i efshar lehamshich tipin milmala leziuug zeer anpin venukva ki rotze linak meimmo velo lehashpia lematta kemo shekkatuv beshaar man derush veayyen zohar parashat pekude daf ammud deit siddura chu leistakkela chu vehen kavanot hattefilla veyichudim elonim layyodim umassigim leistakkela chu ki nefesh-ruach-neshama shellahem atzman hen mayyin nukvin bimsirat nafsham al hattora uvinfilat appayim kannoda
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 3: Lehavin ma shekkatuv beshaar hayyichudim perek deal-yede tora shello vechavana nivraim malachim beolam hayetzira vesham hevi mehazzohar parashat shelach delet kala deitavid chu bar kala deorayeta utzlota desalik uvaka chu vehinne mikkavanat hattefilla nivreu malachim beolam habberia kemo mikkavanat hattora uvlo chavana nidchet lematta legamre kemo shekkatuv bazzohar parashat pekude daf ammud go rakia tattaa chu deikkerin tzelotin pesilan chu veayyen sham parashat vayyakhel daf ammud i hi milla kidka yaut chu

Ach hahefresh ben tora litfilla shello vechavana muvan meelav ki limud hattora hu mevin veodea ma shellomed divlav hache la mikre limud kelal rak shellomed setam belo kavana lishmah meahavat shebbelibbo bivchinat giluy rak meahava hamsutteret hattivit ach eno lomed shello lishmah mammash lehitgaddel chu deha la salik leela min shimsha kemo shekkatuv befarashat vayechi daf ammud vehayenu mishshum shemmachashavto vechavanato hen mitlabbeshot beotiyyot haddibbur veenan mannichot otan lesalka leela

Vehache name bitfilla shello vechavana shemmechashshev machashavot zarot ella mippene shekkavanato lashshamayim lechach yesh lah tikun bekal lachazor velaalot keshemmitpallel bechavana afilu tefilla achat melukketet mittefillot kal hashshana kemo shekkatuv bemikdash melech parashat pekude

Uma shekkatuv befarashat pekude go rakia tattaa uvfarashat vayyakhel mashma dedaveka i ihi milla kidka yaut salkin immah ad avira derakia dilela chu lo kashe mide derakia tattaa meinun rekiin demiddabbere go alma shebbefarashat pekude hen demalchut daasiyya udfarashat vayyakhel hen dizer anpin daasiyya kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shaar hashshemot perek gabbe zeer anpin daasiyya ayyen sham

Veha demashma lichora befarashat pekude degam tefilla pesula ola ad hechal harishon shemmimmennu nidchet lematta vehu bizer anpin divria lo kashe mide shehare afilu kal haaonot mammash kallot vachamurot olot lesham afilu ad hechal had kemo shekkatuv daf ammud ella vadday sheen mahut haaliyyot shaot veen aroch vedimon benehem ella beshituf hashshem bilvad veday lammevin

Uvaze yuvan gam ken ma shekkatuv sham daf shebbehechal hav izdamman hammunne kayyamin hallevushim memunne al hallevushim shemmalbishim hanneshama mimmaase hammitzot af shehen began eden hattachton daasiyya kemo shekkatuv sham daf

Vehinne tefilla pesula adifa mittora shello lishmah mammash shehi tachat hashshemesh vehattefilla hi go rakia chu aval tora setam sheenah shello lishmah rak meahava mesutteret tivit la gara mehevel pihen shel tinokot-shel-bet-rabban desalik leela mippene shehu hevel sheen bo chet vesalik leela af im hu shello lishmah mammash miyyirat hartzua shebbeyad hassofer veayyen sham daf ammud shehammalachim hem maalim hahevel shel tinokot-shel-bet-rabban ad atzilut
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 4: Lehavin ma shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim devizman hazze ikar habberur al yede hattefilla daveka af shettalmud tora lemala mehattefilla
Hainyan hu sheal-yede tora umitzot mosifin or baatzilut chu perush or-en-sof baruch-hu bechelim daatzilut al-yede talmud tora bifnimit dehayenu hamshachot hammochin

Uvkiyyum hammitzot bechitzonit hakkelim shehem bechinot netzach-hod-yesod shebbe sefirot zeer anpin shebbaatzilut rak shemmitlabbeshim bivria-yetzira-asiyya betora umitzot haggashmiyyim shebbaolam hazze

Aval hattefilla hi hamshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu livria-yetzira-asiyya daveka lo bederech hitlabbeshut bilvad rak haor mammash leshannot hannivraim mikkemot shehem sheyyitrappe hachole veyered haggeshem mishshamayim laaretz veolidah veyatzmichah

Ma-sheen-ken betora umitzot sheen shinuy biklaf hattefilin al-yede hanachatan barosh uvazzeroa vegam bemitzot sheasiyyatan hu gemar mitzvatan hashshinuy hu al-yede adam velo bide shamayim kevitfilla shehi hamshachat hachayyut meen-sof baruch-hu shehu levaddo kol yachol
Vehilkach kede lehamshich or-en-sof baruch-hu lematta i efshar beli haalaat mayyin nukvin millematta daveka
Ma-sheen-ken letalmud tora shebbaatzilut hamuchedet belav hache bammaatzil baruch-hu
Vehaalaat mayyin nukvin bemocho velibbo shel adam hi bechinat rishpe esh beli gevul venikret meodecha kede leorer bechinat en-sof vehayenu al-yede gevurot desag shehen hen harappach nitzotzin chu
Velachen nikret hattefilla chayye shaa hi malchut hayyoredet bivria-yetzira-asiyya vetora chayye olam hu zeer anpin ki ramach pikkudin hen mitchallekin be kelim deeser sefirot dizer anpin chu
Vehinne bemakom echad katav sheramach mitzot ase hen be chasadim veshasa lo taase be gevurot vechu uvmakom acher katav shehen taryag archin nimshachin mechad archa chu shehu lavnunit vechu

Ach hainyan shekkal hammitzot letakken ramach evre zeer anpin al yede hamshachat or-en-sof baruch-hu bemochin hakkelulin be chasadim ve gevurot umkor hammochin hu lavnunit chu hu haoneg vechefetz haelon lehamshich haor lematta leramach evarin dizer anpin umitchalleket hahamshacha letaryag hamshachot peratiyyot lefi bechinat erech hammitzot kegon bitzdaka ugmilut chasadim nimshach or-en-sof baruch-hu lechitzoniyyut hakkeli dechesed dizer anpin uvkiyyum haddinin bechitzonit gevura uvrachamim chu
Vederech umaavar hahamshacha hu al-yede penimiyyut hakkelim umochotehen shehen dechilu urchimu sichliyyim o tiviyyim shehen bechinot mochin dekatnut vegadlut

Velaze bikesh moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom meod lekayyem hammitzot maasiyyot hatteluot baaretz shehen tachlit hahishtalshelut lehamshich or-en-sof baruch-hu levarer hakkelim dizer anpin divria-yetzira-asiyya shebbahen hen harappach nitzotzin al-yede tora umitzot maasiyyot shebbivria-yetzira-asiyya daveka

Vehinne lekiyyum mitzva shei efshar laasot al-yede acherim mevattelin talmud tora vaafilu maase merkava vechal shekken tefilla shehi bechinat mochin udchilu urchimu sichliyyim vehattaam kannizkar leel

Veod zot shebbeemet meod gadla vegavha maalat hammitzot maasiyyot vechen limudam al maalat hammochin shehen dechilu urchimu sichliyyim ki hagam dichtiv uldavka vo al-yede middotav mikkal makom enennu davek afilu bemiddot haelonot ella bimtziutan velo bemahutan uchmo shekkatuv veanochi afar vaefer

Vechal shekken beor-en-sof baruch-hu delet machashava tefisa veh beoro vehitpashshetut hachayyut mimmennu yitbarech ki im bimtziuto shehu shemmechayye et kullam velo bemahuto afilu laelonim kemo shekkatuv kadosh kadosh kadosh tzevaot chu levad alulim hanneetzalim massigim kal echad beilato kefi hasseder shebbeetz chayyim behitlabbeshut happartzufim
Aval lo benivraim afilu binshamot daatzilut kemo shekkatuv bemoshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom veraita et achoray chu

Ma-sheen-ken maase hammitzot maase elokim hemma henna bederech hishtalshelut mikkelim daatzilut livria-yetzira-asiyya mimmahutan veatzmutan dechitzoniyyutan kemo al derech mashal etrog uminav hilbish bahen hakkadosh-baruch-hu mimmahutan veatzmutan dachasadim penimit penimim dizer anpin vehayenu mibbechinat chitzoniyyutan kannoda bechal mitzot maasiyyot

Ma-sheen-ken haadam afilu yesh lo neshama daatzilut meachar shemmelubbeshet beguf lo yuchal limtzo benafsho ulhassig mahutan veatzmutan shel penimit hachasadim dizer anpin daatzilut ki haatzilut hi bechinat chayya bichlalut haolamot atzilut-beria-yetzira-asiyya shehi bechinat makkif milmala veenah mitlabbeshet bichli kelal ki im metziutan al-yede dechilu urchimu sichliyyim
Uma shekkatuv veraita et achoray hu bederech nevua daveka shehu hitpashshetut haggashmiyyut kemo shekkatuv beraya mehemna parashat mishpatim
Vehayenu hattaam lefi shei efshar lannivra lehassig kelum bemahut haelokut shehu habbore uvli hassaga en zo halbasha utfisa udvekut amitit

Ma-sheen-ken haetrog al derech mashal chayyuto nimshecha venishtalshela mimmahut chitzonit dechelim denukva dizer anpin daatzilut shehu bechinat elokut kemo shekkatuv beetz chayyim shekkal happerot hen baatzilut ki lamed kelim daatzilut yardu livria-yetzira-asiyya vehen yud maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam al-yede hitlabbeshut benukva daasiyya mahut bemahut ki hakkelim daatzilut naasu neshama baasiyya shehi bechinat elokut mammash lefi shebbaatzilut ihu vegarmohi chad hammaatzil vehanneetzal veal-yede hitlabbeshut mahut hanneshama bemahut hakkelim denukva daasiyya nithava haetrog
Nimtza keshettofes haetrog umnaano kehilchato hare ze tofes mammash chayyuto hamlubbash bo minnukva daatzilut hamuchedet beor-en-sof hammaatzil baruch-hu

Ma-sheen-ken bechavanato eno massig vetofes af hayyodea hassod ella metziutah velo mahutah ach belimud hilchot etrog massig vetofes haetrog mammash umitzvato kahalacha bivchinat dibbur umachashava vechal shekken hallomed hassod aval daveka sodot hammitzva delo gara millimud hilchoteha veadderabba chu af sheeno massig hammahut

Ma sheen ken beseder hahishtalshelut af im massig hammetziut lo adif mitztzad atzmo kelimud hammitzot shemmassig vetofes hammahut umaale alav keillu kiyyem befoal mammash kemo shekkatuv zot hattora chu

Ella sheyediat hammetziut mehahishtalshelut hi gam ken mitzva rama venissaa veadderabba ola al kullana kemo shekkatuv veyadata hayyom chu da et eloke avicha chu umvia lelev shalem chu shehu haikar vehassagat hammetziut hu lehafshit miggashmiyyut chu

Rak shezzo hi mitzva achat mittaryag vehaadam tzarich lekayyem kal taryag lefi shehen hishtalshelut hammahut dechitzonit dechelim daatzilut lechach tzarich leharbot belimud kal hattaryag vekiyyuman befoal mammash bemachashava dibbur umaase shehen beria-yetzira-asiyya levarer berurin asher sham

Veod zot shebbeemet habberurin shebbivria-yetzira-asiyya merappach al-yede tora umitzot bemachashava dibbur umaase gevohin besharshan minnefesh-ruach-neshama shebbaadam ki hen missag shebbifnimit adam kadmon venefesh-ruach-neshama shekkevar nitkenu al-yede ma hu yotze mehammetzach heara bealma vezehu shekkatuv lifne meloch melech chu vehayenu taama shehaadam chay bimzonot domem-tzomeach-chay umvarran bema shebbo vechay bahem lefi shehem misag
Veod zot kemo shekkatuv ufanay lo yerau sheppenimit haelon eno yachol lered lematta rak chitzoniyyuto uvchinat achorayim shehu novlot chachma ilaa

Veod zot shehare haddibbur middivre chachma ilaa eno molid vehattippa shennimshecha mehakkeli dechachma ilaa yesh bah koach hammolid umhave yesh meayin vegam hamshachat chachma ilaa kelula bah vehattaam mippene shebbah nimshach mahutah veatzmutah dechachma ilaa

Ma-sheen-ken bedibbur umachashava vaafilu behaskalat hassechel beezo chachma hare chachma zo rak heara mitpashshetet mimmahut hassechel shebbannefesh veatzmuto veheara zo hi rak levush lemahuto veatzmuto shel hassechel vehassechel hu heara ulvush lemahut hannefesh ma-sheen-ken hattippa nimshach bah gam mimmahut hannefesh veatzmutah hamlubbeshet bemochin velachen molida bedome lah mammash
Vezehu hahefresh ben avodat hammalachim hayyotzin minneshikin lehanneshamot hayyotzin mehakkelim
Ach hakkelim daatzilut naasu neshama livria-yetzira-asiyya vehilkach dechilu urchimu sichliyyim hen kemalachim dinshikin mehearat chitzonit dechachma-bina-daat bivria-yetzira-asiyya

Vehattaam mishshum difnimit chachma-bina-daat umahuto veatzmuto shel or penimi eno yachol lehitgallot ella al-yede hearat hakkelim daveka hayyordim lematta ketippat haadam mimmochin uchmo shekkatuv ufanay lo yerau

Uvar min kal den afilu binshama daatzilut af shehi mikkelim daatzilut vechen benefesh-ruach mikkelim ditzira-asiyya hinne rechimu dechilu urchimu sichliyyim shellahem meorrim gam ken bechelim ditzira-asiyya bechinat haalaa mimmatta lemala beitaruta diltatta vezehu bechinat histallekut levad chas veshalom

Aval bechinat hamshacha milmala lematta hu al-yede mitzot maasiyyot daveka lehamshich or bakkelim uvchitzonit hakkelim daveka shechitzoniyyut haelon yored lematta ufnimiyyut hattachton ole lemala vezehu shekkatuv bazzohar parashat pekude hannizkar leel deit siddura chu
Ushtehen tzorech gavoha haalaa vehamshacha al-yede haalaat mayyin nukvin missag bivchinat ovada umillula

Vezehu tachlit hahishtalshelut lehitgallot or elon lematta velo laalot hattachton lemala shezze eno ella lefi shaa veaf gam zot daveka aliyyot hakkelim leorot elonim hi maalat hashshabbat veom hakkippurim aval lo aliyyot vehistallekut haorot chas veshalom kemo shekkatuv bifri etz chayyim

Venefesh-ruach-neshama shel haadam legabbe gufo baolam hazze chashive keorot legabbe kelim vechen dechilu urchimu sichliyyim legabbe mitzot maasiyyot daveka velachen hitpallel moshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom tefillot keminyan vaetchannan al kiyyum mitzot maasiyyot daveka vehu haddin ledibbur gashmi shel hilchotehen

Ach lehavin ech haetrog shehu merappach shello nivreru adayin vechen kelaf hattefilin yamshich or bechelim dizer anpin venukva daatzilut shekkevar nivreru venitkenu al-yede shem ma lihot bechinat elokut

Hinne hammashal laze hi hazzeria vehannetia shehaggarin meorer koach hatztzomeach shebbaaretz shehu devar tadshe haaretz chu etz peri chu al-yede haalaat mayyin nukvin lesharsho kacha meorrim hakkelaf vehaetrog ad rum hammaalot shehu shem sag shellifne hashshevira shehu mahut veatzmut orot shebbeadam kadmon velo heara bealma kemo shem ma shemmimmitzcho

Vechen belimud veiyyun hilchotehen meorer bechinat chachma-bina-daat shebbeeser sefirot dechelim dizer anpin venukva vead rum hammaalot gam ken bechinat chachma-bina-daat shebbesag difnimit adam kadmon hayyotze derech haenayim chu
Vechal hannizkar leel hu bemitzot ase aval lo belimud perate hilchot isure lo taase lichora uvifrat bidla shechiche kelal kemo perate hilchot pigul uchhay gavena
Ach od zot hashshave bakkol ki kal dechilu urchimu sichliyyim shel hammalachim hen bechinot nivraim meayin leyesh vehen bechinot nefesh ruach divria-yetzira-asiyya

Aval perate hahalachot hen hamshachot chachma ilaa dehammaatzil baruch-hu hamlubbeshet begashmiyyut vehalbasha zo enah kehalbashat chachma ilaa bidchilu urchimu sichliyyim dehatam hallevush hu maalim umastir legamre kehester vehelem haaretz hachumriyyit legabbe chachma ilaa hamlubbeshet bah kemo shekkatuv kullam bechachma asita vehayenu chitzoniut dechitzoniyyut dechelim demalchut daatzilut shebbaasiyya shehi mesutteret legamre beruach-nefesh daasiyya vechen bivria hi mesutteret legamre beruach-nefesh shehem bechinot nivraim behester vehelem habbore mehannivra

Ma-sheen-ken hahalachot hare hearat hachachma meira bahen begiluy ulvush haasiyya hu derech maavar levad kemo beom tov shechesed daatzilut hamlubbash legamre bechesed divria mechayye olam hazze haggashmi al-yede maavar chesed ditzira vaasiyya hannikra gam ken hitlabbeshut sheim lo chen lo haya poel begashmiyyut olam hazze

Veaf sheggashmiyyut olam hazze vadday mastir legamre afilu hachesed daasiyya mikkal makom hahalacha atzmah enah gashmiyyut mammash shehi bechinat ratzon hannimshach mechachma ilaa lehakel o lehachamir rak sheyyored umeir bivchinat giluy begashmiyyut kemayim hayyordim mimmakom gavoha chu vehaddavar haggashmi atzmo shebbo medabberet hahalacha beemet hu mastir legamre kemo hammachalif para bachamor vechen besar happigul o lo figul vechasher

Rak hahalacha beatzmah im hattaam hannigle hi mibbechinat malchut divria vitzira divchinat neshama shehu elokut hamchayye umhave nefesh-ruach divria-yetzira-asiyya shehen dechilu urchimu shel hammalachim vehanneshamot vechachma-bina-daat shellahem meayin leyesh

Velachen hi merava tzimonam kodem sheyyarda laolam hazze kemayim hayyordim chu vegam achar sheyyarda laasiyya hi lemala mala mibbechinat chachma-bina-daat daasiyya afilu divchinat neshama shehi elokut

Vehattaam mishshum dechachma-bina-daat daasiyya divchinat neshama hu mekor hachayyut dechachma-bina-daat denefesh-ruach vetoldotehen vehithauutan meayin leyesh im toldotehen ad sof haasiyya hi haaretz vechal tzevaah

Aval chachma-bina-daat dahalachot betaamehen shebbemalchut divria vitzira inyan hachachma hi betikun partzufe haatzilut shebbahen teluyin kal taame hammitzot mitzot ase be chasadim umitzot lo taase be gevurot umishshum hache name kesheyyardu lehitlabbesh bannivraim hen bemalchut divria-vitzira divchinat neshama daveka shehu mikkelim daatzilut velo bivchinat nefesh-ruach

Veaf dechachma-bina-daat divria-yetzira divchinat neshama sheggavha meod maalatan al bechinat malchut divria yetzira dinshama veaf-al-pi-chen hen makor lechachma-bina-daat divria-yetzira shel bechinot nefesh-ruach shehen hammalachim lo kashe mide deveemet hammalachim vehanneshamot enan ella mittippa hannimshechet mechachma-bina-daat dinshama lisod zeer anpin venitan lenukva umishsham yatzu bivchinat leda ki af im timtza lomar shennivreu mehearat hakkelim denukva daatzilut hare hem hayyordim venaasim neshama
Aval atzmut chachma-bina-daat dinshama mitpashshet bev ketzaot dizer anpin venukva vesham hem shita sidre mishna ugmara

Uma shekkatuv beetz chayyim veshaar hayyichudim sheal-yede hakkavana naase levush neshama veal-yede hattora levush ruach deruach al-yede mishna ditzira veruach dinshama divria al-yede haggemara yesh lomar dehayenu daveka al-yede torat haadam baolam hazze haola lemala aval hattalmud atzmo shennitan besinay hu binshama velachen hu mevarer haruach vechen bemishna ditzira

Veaf im timtza lomar sheggam hannitan missinay hu beruach divria-yetzira hare noda shekkal malach shehu shaliach milmala azay nikra beshem mammash hashshochen bekirbo ma-sheen-ken kesheeno shaliach yesh lo shem acher kefi avodato vaazay kore kadosh kadosh kadosh chu kelomar sheshshem muvdal mimmennu vechen hu mammash bivchinat hitlabbeshut hattalmud bivchinat ruach divria vehammishna beruach ditzira hem sheluche dehayenu kelim denukva daatzilut hachitzonim battalmud vehaemtzaim bammishna

Asher hammishna vehattalmud shebbahem nimshachim misod abba hamkabbel mechachma setimaa daarich anpin shebbo melubbash or-en-sof baruch-hu venimtza sheor-en-sof hu shem shochen beruach divria-yetzira-asiyya bemikra umishna vetalmud uchshehaadam lomed mamshich or-en-sof baruch-hu baolam hazze lihot nichlal uvatel beoro yitbarech ki ze kal haadam

Vezot hayeta avodat rabbi shimon bar yochai vechal hattannaim veamoraim bannigle lehamshich oro yitbarech ulvarer berure nogah kal meshech zeman haggalut deshalta ilana detov vara kemo shekkatuv et asher shalat haadam beadam chu ki zehu tachlit hahishtalshelut sheyyered haelon lematta veyihye lo dira battachtonim kede lehaalotan lemeheve echad beechad

Ma-sheen-ken avodat hammalachim dechilu urchimu sichliyyim enah bivchinat hamshacha kelal uchlal rak histallekut chu uvaze yuvan ma shennivraim malachim meayin leyesh al-yede esek hattora afilu shello vechavana shehu bechinat ruach bilvad sheenah elokut kelal ella lefi sheaf-al-pi-chen shem shochen vechu veday lammevin
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 5: Ulhavin perate hahalachot dela shechiche kelal veefshar shello hau meolam bimtziut mikkal shekken shello yihu leatid lavo kemo perate dine pigul uchhay gavena

Hinne mudaat zot shekkal isur shebbaolam yesh lo shoresh umkor chayyim bakkelipot sheim lo chen lo haya yachol lihot bimtziut baolam bilti hashpaa elona vaafilu hamsalsel besaaro uchhay gavena mekabbel chayyuto berega zo mehechlot hakkelipot kemo shekkatuv bazzohar vehilkach gam perate haisurim shello vau lide maase meolam baolam hazze haggashmi mikkal makom sharshe chayyutam hen bimtziut befoal mammash behechlot hakkelipot

Vegam happeratim sheyyuchal lihot shello hau velo yihu leolam bimtziut kegon taut ushgagot shettaa vekara latteshii asiri chu uchhay gavena delo shayyach bemezid lihot kelipa shora al ze veuchal lihot dichhay gavena eno bimtziut behechlot hakkelipot nire li ma shekkatav veuchal lihot alma dela berira leh hayenu mishshum shehashshegagot baot minnogah im ken yesh lomar deyesh lahem shoresh behechalot denogah mikkal makom al kal panim yeshno bimtziut lehavdil bechachma ilaa shennitpashsheta bifrat ze lemoshe rabbenu alav-hashshalom besinay kammaamar ma shekkal talmid vatik atid lechaddesh chu vechal perate haibbayot derabbi yirmeya uchrachattu chu perek dechullin

Ki hitpashshetut chachma ilaa hi bivchinat en-sof hamlubbash bah befoal mammash vechal perat halacha hu shaar nimshach mechachma ilaa deyasad beratta umlubbash bah umimmenna nimshach umitlabbesh bivria-yetzira-asiyya

Venoda ki yenikat hakkelipot meachorayim de sefirot dikdushsha uvifrat millevushim de sefirot divria-yetzira-asiyya uvifrat ditzira vaasiyya hamoravim bakkelipot kannoda sheyenikatam mibbechinat hallevushim

Veal-yede esek hahalachot bedibbur umachashava mitparshim umitpardim mehakkedushsha kemo shekkatuv battikunim veraya mehemna leafrasha chu vehayenu kannoda mimma sheamru al shello berchu battora techilla chu shehu al-yede hamshachat or-en-sof bechachma ilaa hamlubbeshet bahen uvchachma itberiru beor-en-sof shebbah
Vehamshacha zo naasa al-yede deokan haelon shel haadam haosek gam ken bahalachot ellu lemala besharsho benukva dizer anpin divria-yetzira-asiyya

Uvaze yuvan chiyyuv kal nefesh-ruach-neshama lehashlim kal hattaryag bemachashava dibbur umaase shehen perate hahalachot utzrichot lavo begilgul lehashlim hattora bifshat-remez-derush-sod kede levarer kal habberurin hannogot lahem mikkal harappach shehi komat adam shelema taryag bechinot kelaliyyot ufratiyyot

Aval leatid lavo kesheyyushlam habberur yihye esek hattora bivchinat ase tov levad lehaalot hannefesh-ruach-neshama mala mala ad en sof vegam beshasa lo taase besharshan lemala shehen gevurot kedoshot ulhamtikan bachasadim beramach mitzot ase ulchallan yachad

Veal ken hattora chullah nitzchit bichlalah uvifratah sheggam perate hahalachot deshasa lo taase hen hen anafim mehakkelalot veyesh lechullam shoresh lemala be gevurot dikdushsha kemo hashasa lo taase atzman shehen lemala bechinat haddam hamchayye haevarim dechelim dizer anpin
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 6: David zemirot karit lehu chu hinne bazzohar shevacha deorayeta urnana chu ulhavin mahu hashshevach lehakkadosh-baruch-hu keshezze asur o muttar
Hinne hu al derech ma gadlu maasecha meod amku machshevotecha
Ki hinne noda shekkal haolamot elonim vetachtonim teluyim bedikduk mitzva achat derech mashal im hakkarban kasher naase yichud elon veolim kal haolamot lekabbel chayyutam veshifam
Veim shina shekkibel haddam bismolo derech mashal o shello bichli sharet kasher o shehayeta chatzitza azay nitbattela aliyyot haolamot vechayyutam veshifam mechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu
