Vechen bitfillin kesherot mitgallim mochin elonim dizer anpin venukva shehem mekor hachayyim lechal haolamot uvdikduk echad nifsalin umistallekin hammochin uchhay gavena bedikduke mitzot lo taase

Vehilchach hammitbonen ma gadlu maase shebberibuy haolamot vechal tzevaam veech kullam betelim bimtziut legabbe dikduk echad middikduke tora shehu omek machashava haelona vechachmato yitbarech asher bedikduk kal olim kal haolamot umkabbelim chayyutam veshifam o lehefech chas veshalom umizze nitbonen gedullat omek machashavto yitbarech shehu bivchinat beli gevul vetachlit umaalatah leen ketz vetachlit al maalot chayyut kal haolamot shekkal chayyutam shofea middikduk echad mimmenna shehu nimshach mimmekoro hu omek machashavto yitbarech kemo sear haadam hannimshach mimmocho al derech mashal vechannoda mehattikunim vehaidra rabba
Vezot hayeta simchat david hammelech alav-hashshalom shehaya mezammer umrannen lesammeach libbo beesek hattora beet tzarato

Ach ma shehaya mishtabbeach bithillat hattora bemaalatah zo veamar zemirot hau li chu neenash al ze veamar lo hakkadosh-baruch-hu zemirot karit lehu mishshum shebbeemet maalatah zo shekkal haolamot betelim legabbe dikduk echad mimmenna hi mibbechinat achorayim shel omek hammachashava kemo shekkatuv bemakom acher beshem haarizal al maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha novlot chachma shellemala tora

Aval penimit shebbaomek shehu penimit hattora hi meuchedet legamre beor-en-sof baruch-hu hamlubbash bah betachlit hayyichud ulgabbe en-sof baruch-hu kal haolamot kelo mammash veayin vaefes mammash ki atta hu ad shello nivra haolam vechu
Vehilkach gam lifnimiyyut hattora en leshabbechah kelal bithillat chayyut kal haolamot meachar dela mammash chashive

Uvivchinat penimiyyutah enah simchat levav enosh veshaashuav ella kivyachol simchat lev veshaashua hammelech hakkadosh-baruch-hu shemmishtaashea bah ki elokim hevin darkah veyada mekomah umaalatah bidiat atzmo kivyachol
Aval neelma meene chal chay kemo shekkatuv ufanay lo yerau dehayenu bechinat penimiyyutah kemo shennitbaer sham beshem haarizal
Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv vaehye etzlo chu shaashuim etzlo daveka mesacheket lefanav lefanav daveka dehayenu bivchinat penimiyyutah veal ze amar vaehye etzlo amon al tikre amon ella omen chu
Veal bechinat achorayim amar mesacheket betevel artzo veshaashuay et bene adam ki hattora nitna bivchinat panim veachor kedichtiv bimgila afa dizcharya vehi chetuva panim veachor

Ulfi shettafas david bivchinat achorayim lechach neenash beshichcha habbaa min bechinat achorayim venelam mimmennu lefi shaa ma shekkatuv avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau lechabber ulyached et hakketefayim shehen bechinat achorayim el avodat hakkodesh hi chachma ilaa bivchinat panim shemmishsham nimshechu halluchot shebbaaron kemo shekkatuv ketuvim mishshene evrehem chu uchmo shekkatuv birushalmi dishkalim shello hayeta bahen bechinat panim veachor ayyen sham
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 7: Utzdaka kenachal etan beamos sof siman perush kemo shennachal etan hu hamshacha hannimshechet mibbechinat etan shehi bechinat nekudda behechala utren rein vechu veotiyyot etan meshammeshot leatid perush ana atid leitgalya kemo shekkatuv hinne yaskil avdi vego vehayenu sheyyitgalle az or-en-sof baruch-hu veyichudo yitbarech toch penimiyyt nekuddat hallev al-yede hamshachat nachal etan hu hearat chachma ilaa sheyyair bifnimiyyut hallev libatel beyichudo yitbarech betachlit meumka delibba achare hasarat haarla mittaaot haggashmiyyot vechu

Vehinne atta begalut hachel hazze yesh gam ken etza yeutza lehair ketzat or mibbechinat etan letoch nekuddat penimiyyut hallev keen leatid vehayenu al-yede shemmeorer al nitzotz elokut shebbenafsho bechinat rachamim rabbim haelonim

Ki beemet kal zeman sheen haadam zoche sheyyitgalle or mibbechinat etan binkuddat penimit levavo libatel beyichudo yitbarech meumka delibba ad kelot hannefesh mammash azay beemet yesh rachamanut gedola al hannitzotz shebbenafsho ki hannitzotz nimshach mibbechinat chachma ilaa mammash uchsheeno yachol lehair mibbechinato letoch penimiyyut hallev sheshsham mekom giluy heara zo hare ze bivchinat galut mammash

Veal-yede rachamim rabbim haelonim yotze mehaggalut vehashshivya umeir letoch nekudda penimiyyut hallev bechinat ahava rabba zo kannoda mimma shekkatuv leyaakov asher pada et avraham uchmo shennitbaer belikkute amarim perek

Umudaat zot ki itaruta dilela beitaruta diltatta daveka talya milleta dehayenu al-yede hitorrut rachamim rabbim belev rachamanim vegomle chasadim lehashpia lematta hashpaa gashmiyyit zahav vachesef vechu velachen peullat hatztzedaka hi peullat nachal etan mammash
Vehinne mudaat zot ma shekkatuv ki or bead or vechol asher laish yitten bead nafsho haelokit lehairah beor hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 8: Hinne lo tova hashshemua shamati vattirgaz bitni asher am maavirim millifne hatteva haish hechafetz bachayyim vaarichut yamim shel kal anshe shelomenu shebbemikdash meat hazze shel anshe shelomenu kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha shelosha devarim maarichim yamav shel adam veechad mehem hammaarich bitfillato

Veaf gam mi shehashshaa dechuka lo beoter vei efshar lo beshum ofen lehamtin ad achar aniyyat kedushsha shel chazarat hashsheliach-tzibbur hazze halo tov tov lo shello lishmoa kedushsha uvarchu millered lechayyehem shel hachafetzim bachayyim veones rachamana patreh vehashsheliach-tzibbur motzio yede chovato af shello shama keilu shama shehu keone mammash vechidita baggemara gabbe am shebbassadot daanise veotzim yede chovat tefillat shemone esre atzmah bachazarat hashsheliach-tzibbur keillu shamu mammash vegam kedushsha uvarchu bichlal

Vehinne zot chakarnuha ken hu af gam baddorot harishonim shel chachme hammishna vehaggemara shehayeta toratam keva veikar avodatam velo tefillatam umikkal shekken atta happaam beikkevot meshicha sheen toratenu keva mitztzok haittim veikar haavoda beikkevot meshicha hi hattefilla kemo shekkatav harav chayyim vital zichrono livracha beetz chayyim ufri etz chayyim

Mikkal shekken vekal vachomer sherauy venachon liten nafshenu mammash aleha vehi chova shel tora mammash limvine madda toelet hahitbonnut veomek haddaat ketzat kal chad lefum shiura dileh besiddur shevacho shel makom baruch-hu bifsuke dezimra ushte verachot shellifne keriat-shema yotzer veahava leorer bahen haahava hamsutteret belev kal yisrael lavo livchinat giluy behitgallut hallev bishat keriat-shema atzmah

Shezzot hi mitzvat haahava shebbappasuk veahavta go bechal levavcha go hannimnet rishona betaryag mitzot kemo shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha shehi misode hattora vesharshah umakor lechal ramach mitzot ase ki al ahava hamsutteret belev kal yisrael betoladtam vetivam lo shayyach tziuuy kelal

Vedaat lenavon nakal ki keshehaahava hi mesutteret hi odena bannefesh haelokit levaddah uchshebbaa livchinat giluy lannefesh hachiyyunit azay hi behitgallut hallev bechalal semali mekom mishkan nefesh hachiyyunit
